declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.etaleModuleLowerShriek_exact
declarations.doc:
Extension by zero of sheaves of modules along an étale morphism of algebraic spaces is
exact.
declarations.statement:
theorem etaleModuleLowerShriek_exact :
    exactFunctor _ _ (etaleModuleLowerShriek B S hS f hf)
declarations.comment: exactness for modules along an étale morphism of algebraic spaces

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.preservesFiniteLimits_abelianEtaleExtensionByZero
declarations.doc:
Extension by zero of abelian sheaves along an étale morphism of algebraic spaces is left
exact.
declarations.statement:
instance preservesFiniteLimits_abelianEtaleExtensionByZero :
    PreservesFiniteLimits (abelianEtaleExtensionByZero B S hS f hf)
declarations.comment: left exactness for abelian sheaves along an étale morphism of algebraic spaces

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.abelianEtaleExtensionByZero_exact
declarations.doc:
Extension by zero of abelian sheaves along an étale morphism of algebraic spaces is
exact.
declarations.statement:
theorem abelianEtaleExtensionByZero_exact :
    exactFunctor _ _ (abelianEtaleExtensionByZero B S hS f hf)
declarations.comment: exactness for abelian sheaves along an étale morphism of algebraic spaces

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.ExtensionByZero.OverElements.extensionByZero_preservesMonomorphisms
declarations.doc: Extension by zero along the projection of the site of elements preserves monomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
lemma extensionByZero_preservesMonomorphisms :
    Functor.PreservesMonomorphisms (SheafOfModules.pullback.{u}
      (F := proj K) (𝟙 (restrictedRingSheaf K J JD R) :
        (restrictedRingSheaf K J JD R) ⟶ (restrictedRingSheaf K J JD R)))
declarations.comment: for the site of elements of a presheaf of sets, monomorphisms

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.ExtensionByZero.extensionByZero_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DJ.** Extension by zero of sheaves of modules along the localization `C/U ⟶ C`
is exact.

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.extensionByZero_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DJ.** Extension by zero of sheaves of modules along the localization `C/U ⟶ C`
is exact, with the universe of the site, the universe of its morphisms, the universe of the
sections of the sheaf of rings and the extra module universe all independent.
declarations.statement:
theorem extensionByZero_exact :
    exactFunctor _ _ (extensionByZero.{m, w, v, u} R U)
declarations.comment: exactness of extension by zero, with the site, morphism, ring-section and module universes independent; this is the statement the semi-representable lower shrieks consume, their structure sheaves having sections in a universe larger than their sites

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.ExtensionByZero.overMap_extensionByZero_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DJ for a relocalization.** Extension by zero of sheaves of modules along
`Over.map f : C/V ⥤ C/U` is exact: it is the slice equivalence, which is exact, followed by
extension by zero along the localization of `C/U` at `Over.mk f`, which is exact by
Stacks 03DJ.
declarations.statement:
theorem overMap_extensionByZero_exact :
    exactFunctor _ _ (SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} R f).leftAdjoint
declarations.comment: extension by zero along a relocalization C/V ⥤ C/U is exact

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.familyComponentLowerShriek_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DJ.** The extension by zero `j_{i,!}` of a component is exact. This is the
exactness of extension by zero along a localization `C / U ⥤ C`, which asks the site,
its morphisms and the module sections to share a universe — the generality at which parts (1)
and (2) of this tag are formalized, namely `RingedSite.{u, u, u}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem familyComponentLowerShriek_exact (X : RingedSite.{u, u, u})
    (K : FormalCoproduct.{u} X.C) (i : K.I) :
    exactFunctor _ _ (familyComponentLowerShriek X K i)
declarations.comment: the extension by zero of a component of a semi-representable object

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOnSite
declarations.doc:
A sheaf of modules on a site is **locally free** when every object has a covering family
on whose members the restricted module is free, that is, is a coproduct of copies of the
restricted structure sheaf.  This is Stacks 03DL(1).
declarations.statement: abbrev IsLocallyFreeOnSite (F : SheafOfModules.{w} R) : Prop

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite
declarations.doc:
A sheaf of modules on a site is **finite locally free** when every object has a covering
family on whose members the restricted module is finite free.  This is Stacks 03DL(2); rank
zero is included.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite (F : SheafOfModules.{m} R) : Prop

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.IsLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite
declarations.doc:
A sheaf of modules on a site is **locally generated by sections** when every object has a
covering on whose members the restricted module admits generating global sections.  The
covering of an object `U` is recorded as a family of objects of the slice site over `U` which
covers its terminal object.  This is Stacks 03DL(3).
declarations.statement: abbrev IsLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite (F : SheafOfModules.{w} R) : Prop

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.IsLocallyGeneratedByOnSite
declarations.doc:
A sheaf of modules on a site is **locally generated by `r` sections** when every object
has a covering sieve such that, for every arrow in that sieve, the restriction of the module
to its source is generated by a family of global sections indexed by a type equivalent to
`Fin r`.  This is Stacks 03DL(4).
declarations.statement: abbrev IsLocallyGeneratedByOnSite (F : SheafOfModules.{w} R) (r : ℕ) : Prop

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.IsFinitePresentationOnSite
declarations.doc:
A sheaf of modules on a site is **of finite presentation** when every object of the site has
a covering on whose members the restricted module admits a finite global presentation.

This is the finite refinement of `SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherentOnSite`; like it, it requires no
sheafification instance, so it also applies to the fibred categories of Stacks 06WG.
declarations.statement: class IsFinitePresentationOnSite (F : SheafOfModules.{m} R) : Prop

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.IsCoherentOnSite
declarations.doc:
A sheaf of modules on a site is **coherent** when it is of finite type and, for every
object `U` and every finite family of sections over `U`, the sheaf of relations among that
family is of finite type on the slice site over `U`.  This is Stacks 03DL(8).
declarations.statement: class IsCoherentOnSite (F : SheafOfModules.{m} R) : Prop

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherentOnSite
declarations.doc:
A sheaf of modules on a site is quasi-coherent when every object of the site has a
covering on whose members the restricted module admits a global presentation, as in
Stacks 03DL(6).  This predicate requires no sheafification instances.
declarations.statement: class IsQuasicoherentOnSite (M : SheafOfModules.{m} R) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isLocallyFreeOnSite_iff_pullbackModules
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DM for the clause 03DL (1): local freeness is intrinsic.**  A sheaf of modules on
the target of an equivalence of ringed topoi is locally free if and only if its pullback is.

The forward implication is Stacks 03DO.  The reverse one applies Stacks 03DO to the inverse
equivalence and carries the conclusion back along
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.pullbackModulesInverseObjIso`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyFreeOnSite_iff_pullbackModules :
    F.IsLocallyFreeOnSite ↔ (f.toModulesHom.pullbackModules.obj F).IsLocallyFreeOnSite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_iff_pullbackModules
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DM for the clause 03DL (2): finite local freeness is intrinsic.**  A sheaf of
modules on the target of an equivalence of ringed topoi is finite locally free if and only if
its pullback is; the rank on each member of the covering is unchanged in both directions.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_iff_pullbackModules :
    F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite ↔
      (f.toModulesHom.pullbackModules.obj F).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite_iff_pullbackModules
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DM for the clause 03DL (3): local generation by sections is intrinsic.**  A sheaf
of modules on the target of an equivalence of ringed topoi is locally generated by sections if
and only if its pullback is; the index type of the generating family is unchanged in both
directions.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite_iff_pullbackModules :
    F.IsLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite ↔
      (f.toModulesHom.pullbackModules.obj F).IsLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isQuasicoherentOnSite_iff_pullbackModules
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DM for the clause 03DL (6): quasi-coherence is intrinsic.**  A sheaf of modules on
the target of an equivalence of ringed topoi is quasi-coherent if and only if its pullback
is.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasicoherentOnSite_iff_pullbackModules :
    F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite ↔ (f.toModulesHom.pullbackModules.obj F).IsQuasicoherentOnSite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isCoherentOnSite_iff_pullbackModules
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DM for the clause 03DL (8): coherence is intrinsic.**  A sheaf of modules on the
target of an equivalence of ringed topoi is coherent if and only if its pullback is.

The forward implication is `AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isCoherentOnSite_pullbackModules`,
which is *not* an instance of Stacks 03DO — that tag omits coherence, and could not state it.
The reverse one applies the forward implication to the inverse equivalence and carries the
conclusion back along `AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.pullbackModulesInverseObjIso`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCoherentOnSite_iff_pullbackModules :
    F.IsCoherentOnSite ↔ (f.toModulesHom.pullbackModules.obj F).IsCoherentOnSite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isFinitePresentation_iff_pullbackModules
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DM for the clause 03DL (7): finite presentation is intrinsic.**  A sheaf of
modules on the target of an equivalence of ringed topoi is of finite presentation if and only
if its pullback is.

The forward implication is Stacks 03DO.  The reverse one applies Stacks 03DO to the inverse
equivalence and carries the conclusion back along
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.pullbackModulesInverseObjIso`.

For Descent, Lemma 05VG this is an **engine lemma awaiting instantiation** and carries no
`@[stacks 05VG]` attribute: 05VG asserts the clause at a comparison functor of Descent,
Proposition 03DX, and no such functor is known to satisfy
`[f.toToposHom.pushforward.IsEquivalence] [IsIso f.fSharp]`.  Instantiating it for 05VG would
need a named morphism of ringed topoi presenting the small Zariski comparison together with
proofs that its pushforward is an equivalence and its structure map an isomorphism.  See the
section at the end of
`StacksFrontier/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Sheaf/LocalTypesUnderComparison.lean`, where an
`add_to_stacks 05VG` against this declaration was retracted.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_iff_pullbackModules (f : RingedToposHom X Y)
    [f.toToposHom.pushforward.IsEquivalence] [IsIso f.fSharp]
    (F : SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O)) :
    F.IsFinitePresentation ↔ ((f.toModulesHom.pullbackModules).obj F).IsFinitePresentation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isFiniteType_iff_pullbackModules
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DM for the clause 03DL (5): being of finite type is intrinsic.**  A sheaf of
modules on the target of an equivalence of ringed topoi is of finite type if and only if its
pullback is.

For Descent, Lemma 05VG this is an **engine lemma awaiting instantiation** and carries no
`@[stacks 05VG]` attribute, for the reason given on
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isFinitePresentation_iff_pullbackModules` above: 05VG asserts
the clause at a comparison functor of Descent, Proposition 03DX, and no such functor is known
to satisfy this declaration's two instance hypotheses.  Instantiating it would need a named
morphism of ringed topoi presenting the small Zariski comparison together with proofs of
those two facts about it.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteType_iff_pullbackModules (f : RingedToposHom X Y)
    [f.toToposHom.pushforward.IsEquivalence] [IsIso f.fSharp]
    (F : SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O)) :
    F.IsFiniteType ↔ ((f.toModulesHom.pullbackModules).obj F).IsFiniteType

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isLocallyGeneratedByOnSite_iff_pullbackModules
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DM for the clause 03DL (4): local generation by `r` sections is intrinsic.**  A
sheaf of modules on the target of an equivalence of ringed topoi is locally generated by `r`
sections if and only if its pullback is.

For Descent, Lemma 05VG this is an **engine lemma awaiting instantiation** and carries no
`@[stacks 05VG]` attribute, for the reason given on
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isFinitePresentation_iff_pullbackModules` above: 05VG asserts
the clause at a comparison functor of Descent, Proposition 03DX, and no such functor is known
to satisfy this declaration's two instance hypotheses.  Instantiating it would need a named
morphism of ringed topoi presenting the small Zariski comparison together with proofs of
those two facts about it.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyGeneratedByOnSite_iff_pullbackModules (f : RingedToposHom X Y)
    [f.toToposHom.pushforward.IsEquivalence] [IsIso f.fSharp]
    (F : SheafOfModules.{w} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := Y.J)) Y.O)) (r : ℕ) :
    F.IsLocallyGeneratedByOnSite r ↔
      ((f.toModulesHom.pullbackModules).obj F).IsLocallyGeneratedByOnSite r

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_chartSchemeModule_iff
declarations.doc:
**Finite local freeness transports across the chart-scheme identification.**  A module on
the slice at an étale chart is finite locally free on the site if and only if the module it
becomes on the small étale site of the scheme underlying that chart is.

This is `Stacks.SheafOfModules.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_reindex_iff`, the clause 03DL (2) of
Modules on Sites, Lemma 03DM, applied to
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chartSchemeIdentification`; it is the companion of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFinitePresentation_chartSchemeModule_iff`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_chartSchemeModule_iff (U : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (W : (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS U.1 U.2).C)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
      ((smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS U.1 U.2).over W).O)) :
    SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite (chartSchemeSiteModule B S hS U W M) ↔
      SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite M
declarations.comment: finite locally free, at the chart-scheme identification

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_chartSmallEtaleRestriction_iff
declarations.doc:
**Finite local freeness is invariant under the comparison of Stacks 04M0.**  The restriction
of an `𝒪_X`-module to an étale scheme chart, read on the small étale site of the chart, is finite
locally free exactly when the restriction to the slice of the small étale site of `X` is.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_chartSmallEtaleRestriction_iff (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureRingSheaf B S hS X)) (U : SmallEtale B S hS X.1) :
    SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite (chartSmallEtaleRestriction B S hS X M U) ↔
      SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite (M.over U)
declarations.comment: finite locally free, at the localization of 04M0 at a chart

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_representedSmallEtaleModule_iff
declarations.doc:
**Finite local freeness is invariant under the comparison equivalence of Stacks 03DX (2) at a
representable algebraic space.**
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_representedSmallEtaleModule_iff (U : BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (representedSchemeStructureSheaf B S hS U)) :
    SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite (representedSmallEtaleModule B S hS U M) ↔
      SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite M
declarations.comment: finite locally free, at the comparison of a representable space with its scheme

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteFree_representedSmallEtaleModule_iff
declarations.doc:
**Finite freeness is invariant under the comparison equivalence of Stacks 03DX (2) at a
representable algebraic space.**  This is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_representedSmallEtaleModule_iff` for outright
finite freeness in place of finite local freeness; it is the same reindexing.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteFree_representedSmallEtaleModule_iff (U : BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (representedSchemeStructureSheaf B S hS U)) :
    SheafOfModules.IsFiniteFree (representedStructureRingSheaf B S hS U)
        (representedSmallEtaleModule B S hS U M) ↔
      SheafOfModules.IsFiniteFree (representedSchemeStructureSheaf B S hS U) M
declarations.comment: finite free, at the comparison of a representable space with its scheme

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_chartSmallEtaleRestriction_iff
declarations.doc:
**The rank clause of Stacks 0409 is invariant under the comparison of Stacks 04M0.**  The
restriction of an `𝒪_X`-module to an étale scheme chart, read on the small étale site of the
chart, has rank `r` exactly when the restriction to the slice of the small étale site of `X`
has.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_chartSmallEtaleRestriction_iff (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureRingSheaf B S hS X)) (U : SmallEtale B S hS X.1) (r : ℕ) :
    RingedSite.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank
        (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS (chartSpace B S hS X U).1 (chartSpace B S hS X U).2)
        (chartSmallEtaleRestriction B S hS X M U) r ↔
      RingedSite.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank ((smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).over U)
        (M.over U) r
declarations.comment: the rank clause of 0409, at the localization of 04M0 at a chart

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_representedSmallEtaleModule_iff
declarations.doc:
**The rank clause of Stacks 0409 is invariant under the comparison equivalence of
Stacks 03DX (2) at a representable algebraic space.**
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_representedSmallEtaleModule_iff (U : BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (representedSchemeStructureSheaf B S hS U)) (r : ℕ) :
    RingedSite.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank
        (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS (yoneda.obj U)
          (AlgebraicGeometry.isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B S hS U))
        (representedSmallEtaleModule B S hS U M) r ↔
      RingedSite.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank
        (_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleRingedSite (associatedBigEtaleSite B)
          ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U) U.left.property) M r
declarations.comment: the rank clause of 0409, at the represented-space comparison of 03DX (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_chartModuleReindex_iff
declarations.doc:
**Finite local freeness of a module on the slice at a chart is invariant under the
localization of Stacks 04M0.**  This is the general-module form of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_chartSmallEtaleRestriction_iff`, which states
the same for a module arising as the restriction of an `𝒪_X`-module.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_chartModuleReindex_iff
    (N : SheafOfModules.{u} ((structureRingSheaf B S hS X).over W)) :
    SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite
        ((chartModuleReindexEquivalence B S hS X W).functor.obj N) ↔
      SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite N
declarations.comment: finite locally free, at the localization of 04M0 at a chart, for a general module of the slice

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.isCoherentOnSite_iff_exists_cover_isCoherentOnSite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DN, coherence.** A sheaf of modules on a ringed site is coherent if and only if
its restriction to each member of some covering family of the final object is coherent on the
corresponding localized ringed site.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCoherentOnSite_iff_exists_cover_isCoherentOnSite :
    SheafOfModules.IsCoherentOnSite F ↔
      ∃ (I : Type (max u v)) (U : I → X.C), X.J.CoversTop U ∧
        ∀ i : I, SheafOfModules.IsCoherentOnSite
          (R := (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (X.over (U i)).O)) (F.over (U i))

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_iff_exists_cover_isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DN, finite local freeness.** A sheaf of modules on a ringed site is finite
locally free if and only if its restriction to each member of some covering family of the final
object is finite locally free on the corresponding localized ringed site.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_iff_exists_cover_isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite :
    SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite F ↔
      ∃ (I : Type (max u v)) (U : I → X.C), X.J.CoversTop U ∧
        ∀ i : I, SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite
          (R := (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (X.over (U i)).O)) (F.over (U i))

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_iff_exists_cover_isFiniteFree
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DN, finite local freeness.** A sheaf of modules on a ringed site is finite
locally free if and only if its restriction to each member of some covering family of the final
object is finite free.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_iff_exists_cover_isFiniteFree :
    SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite F ↔
      ∃ (I : Type (max u v)) (U : I → X.C), X.J.CoversTop U ∧
        ∀ i : I, ∃ n : ℕ,
          ∃ (ι : ∀ _ : Fin n,
            SheafOfModules.unit ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O).over (U i)) ⟶
              F.over (U i)),
            Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk (F.over (U i)) ι))

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation_iff_exists_cover_isFinitePresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DN, finite presentation.** A sheaf of modules is of finite presentation if and
only if its restrictions to the members of some covering family of the final object are of
finite presentation.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_iff_exists_cover_isFinitePresentation
    [∀ (U : C), ∀ (V : Over U),
      HasWeakSheafify ((J.over U).over V) AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [∀ (U : C), ∀ (V : Over U),
      ((J.over U).over V).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}] :
    M.IsFinitePresentation ↔
      ∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → C), J.CoversTop U ∧
        ∀ i : I, (M.over (U i)).IsFinitePresentation

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation_iff_exists_cover_finite_presentations
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DN, finite presentation.** A sheaf of modules is of finite presentation if and
only if its restrictions to the members of some covering family of the final object have
finite global presentations.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_iff_exists_cover_finite_presentations :
    M.IsFinitePresentation ↔
      ∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → C), J.CoversTop U ∧
        ∀ i : I, ∃ (p : (M.over (U i)).Presentation), p.IsFinite

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.isFiniteType_iff_exists_cover_isFiniteType
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DN, finite type.** A sheaf of modules is of finite type if and only if it is so
after restriction to each member of some covering family of the final object.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteType_iff_exists_cover_isFiniteType
    [∀ (U : C), ∀ (V : Over U),
      HasWeakSheafify ((J.over U).over V) AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [∀ (U : C), ∀ (V : Over U),
      ((J.over U).over V).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}] :
    M.IsFiniteType ↔
      ∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → C), J.CoversTop U ∧
        ∀ i : I, (M.over (U i)).IsFiniteType

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.isFiniteType_iff_exists_cover_finite_generators
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DN, finite type.** A sheaf of modules is of finite type if and only if it is
generated by finitely many global sections after restriction to each member of some covering
family of the final object.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteType_iff_exists_cover_finite_generators :
    M.IsFiniteType ↔
      ∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → C), J.CoversTop U ∧
        ∀ i : I, ∃ (σ : (M.over (U i)).GeneratingSections), σ.IsFiniteType

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.isLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite_iff_exists_cover_locallyGenerated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DN, local generation by sections.** A sheaf of modules on a ringed site is locally
generated by sections if and only if its restriction to each member of some covering family of
the final object is locally generated by sections on the corresponding localized ringed site.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite_iff_exists_cover_locallyGenerated
    [∀ (U : X.C) (V : Over U), HasWeakSheafify ((X.J.over U).over V) AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [∀ (U : X.C) (V : Over U), ((X.J.over U).over V).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}] :
    SheafOfModules.IsLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite F ↔
      ∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → X.C), X.J.CoversTop U ∧
        ∀ i : I, SheafOfModules.IsLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite
          (R := (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O).over (U i)) (F.over (U i))

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.isLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite_iff_exists_cover_generatingSections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DN, local generation by sections.** A sheaf of modules on a ringed site is locally
generated by sections if and only if its restriction to each member of some covering family of
the final object is generated by global sections.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite_iff_exists_cover_generatingSections :
    SheafOfModules.IsLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite F ↔
      ∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → X.C), X.J.CoversTop U ∧
        ∀ i : I, Nonempty ((F.over (U i)).GeneratingSections)

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.isLocallyGeneratedByOnSite_iff_exists_cover_isLocallyGeneratedBy
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DN, local generation by `r` sections.** A sheaf of modules on a ringed site is
locally generated by `r` sections if and only if its restriction to each member of some covering
family of the final object is, on the corresponding localized ringed site.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyGeneratedByOnSite_iff_exists_cover_isLocallyGeneratedBy
    [∀ (U : X.C) (V : Over U), HasWeakSheafify ((X.J.over U).over V) AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [∀ (U : X.C) (V : Over U), ((X.J.over U).over V).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}] :
    SheafOfModules.IsLocallyGeneratedByOnSite F r ↔
      ∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → X.C), X.J.CoversTop U ∧
        ∀ i : I, SheafOfModules.IsLocallyGeneratedByOnSite
          (R := (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O).over (U i)) (F.over (U i)) r

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.isLocallyGeneratedByOnSite_iff_exists_cover_generators
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DN, local generation by `r` sections.** A sheaf of modules on a ringed site is
locally generated by `r` sections if and only if its restriction to each member of some covering
family of the final object is generated by `r` global sections.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyGeneratedByOnSite_iff_exists_cover_generators :
    SheafOfModules.IsLocallyGeneratedByOnSite F r ↔
      ∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → X.C), X.J.CoversTop U ∧
        ∀ i : I, ∃ σ : (F.over (U i)).GeneratingSections, Nonempty (σ.I ≃ Fin r)

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.isLocallyFreeOnSite_iff_exists_cover_isLocallyFreeOnSite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DN, local freeness.** A sheaf of modules on a ringed site is locally free if and
only if its restriction to each member of some covering family of the final object is locally
free on the corresponding localized ringed site.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyFreeOnSite_iff_exists_cover_isLocallyFreeOnSite :
    SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOnSite F ↔
      ∃ (I : Type (max u v)) (U : I → X.C), X.J.CoversTop U ∧
        ∀ i : I, SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOnSite
          (R := Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (X.over (U i)).O) (F.over (U i))

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.isLocallyFreeOnSite_iff_exists_cover_isFree
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DN, local freeness.** A sheaf of modules on a ringed site is locally free if and
only if its restriction to each member of some covering family of the final object is free.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyFreeOnSite_iff_exists_cover_isFree :
    SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOnSite F ↔
      ∃ (I : Type (max u v)) (U : I → X.C), X.J.CoversTop U ∧
        ∀ i : I, SheafOfModules.IsFree (F.over (U i))

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite_iff_exists_cover_isQuasicoherentOnSite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DN, quasi-coherence.** A sheaf of modules is quasi-coherent if and only if its
restriction to each member of some covering family of the final object is quasi-coherent.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasicoherentOnSite_iff_exists_cover_isQuasicoherentOnSite :
    M.IsQuasicoherentOnSite ↔
      ∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → C), J.CoversTop U ∧
        ∀ i : I, (M.over (U i)).IsQuasicoherentOnSite

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite_iff_exists_cover_hasGlobalPresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DN, quasi-coherence.** A sheaf of modules is quasi-coherent if and only if its
restriction to each member of some covering family of the final object has a global
presentation.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasicoherentOnSite_iff_exists_cover_hasGlobalPresentation :
    M.IsQuasicoherentOnSite ↔
      ∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → C), J.CoversTop U ∧
        ∀ i : I, (M.over (U i)).HasGlobalPresentation

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite_iff_coversTop_hasGlobalPresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DN, quasi-coherence.**  A sheaf of modules is quasi-coherent if and only if it has
a global presentation on each member of some family of objects covering the final object.

This is `Stacks.SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite_iff_exists_cover_hasGlobalPresentation` with
the universe of the module sections independent of the universe of the coefficient rings.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasicoherentOnSite_iff_coversTop_hasGlobalPresentation (M : SheafOfModules.{m} R) :
    M.IsQuasicoherentOnSite ↔
      ∃ (I : Type u) (W : I → C), J.CoversTop W ∧
        ∀ i : I, (M.over (W i)).HasGlobalPresentation

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.LocalizedPullback.isQuasicoherentOnSite_pullbackTopos_of_quasicoherentData
declarations.doc:
**The quasi-coherent clause of Stacks 03DO for a morphism of ringed sites presented by a
left exact continuous functor.** The pullback of a sheaf of `O'`-modules admitting quasi-coherent
data is quasi-coherent on the site.

The data is transported by `Stacks.Sheaves.LocalizedPullback.localizedPullbackMapData` and the
transported presentations assemble into quasi-coherence on the site by
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite_of_mapData`.

This is the case to which Stacks 03DO's own proof reduces its quasi-coherent clause through
Section 03DG; the general statement, for an arbitrary morphism of ringed topoi, is
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isQuasicoherentOnSite_pullbackModules`, which transports this
one along the two equivalences of ringed topoi that Stacks 03CR produces.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasicoherentOnSite_pullbackTopos_of_quasicoherentData
    (q : M.QuasicoherentData.{ww}) :
    (f.toRingedToposSiteHom.pullbackTopos.obj M).IsQuasicoherentOnSite
declarations.comment:
quasi_coherent, for a morphism of ringed *sites* presented by a left exact
  continuous functor — the case 03DO's own proof reduces its quasi-coherent clause to through
  Section 03DG. The clause for an arbitrary morphism of ringed topoi is
  `AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isQuasicoherentOnSite_pullbackModules`, which transports this
  one along the two equivalences of ringed topoi 03CR produces

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.LocalizedPullback.isQuasicoherentOnSite_pullbackTopos
declarations.doc:
**The quasi-coherent clause of Stacks 03DO for a morphism of ringed sites, with the
hypothesis in the form the clause states it.** If a sheaf of `O'`-modules is quasi-coherent on
the site, so is its pullback along a morphism of ringed sites presented by a left exact
continuous functor.

Quasi-coherence may be tested on a single family covering the final object, by Stacks 03DN in the
form `Stacks.SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite_iff_exists_cover_hasGlobalPresentation`.  Such
a family `{W_i}` for `M` is carried to the family `{u(W_i)}` by
`Stacks.Sheaves.LocalizedPullback.coversTop_mapObj`, and the global presentation of `M|_{W_i}` to
one of `(f^*M)|_{u(W_i)}` by
`Stacks.Sheaves.LocalizedPullback.hasGlobalPresentation_over_pullbackTopos`.  No smallness
hypothesis on the slices of the target site is needed, for the reason recorded there.

This is the case to which Stacks 03DO's own proof reduces its quasi-coherent clause through
Section 03DG; the general statement, for an arbitrary morphism of ringed topoi, is
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isQuasicoherentOnSite_pullbackModules`, which transports this
one along the two equivalences of ringed topoi that Stacks 03CR produces.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasicoherentOnSite_pullbackTopos (hM : M.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) :
    (f.toRingedToposSiteHom.pullbackTopos.obj M).IsQuasicoherentOnSite
declarations.comment:
quasi_coherent, for a morphism of ringed *sites* presented by a left exact
  continuous functor — the case 03DO's own proof reduces its quasi-coherent clause to through
  Section 03DG. The clause for an arbitrary morphism of ringed topoi is
  `AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isQuasicoherentOnSite_pullbackModules`, which transports this
  one along the two equivalences of ringed topoi 03CR produces

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.LocalizedPullback.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_pullbackTopos
declarations.doc:
**The finite locally free clause of Stacks 03DO for a morphism of ringed sites presented by
a left exact continuous functor.** If a sheaf of `O'`-modules is finite locally free on the
site, so is its pullback along a morphism of ringed sites whose underlying functor is left
exact.  This is the clause of Stacks 03DO for Stacks 03DL (2).

Finite local freeness may be tested on a single family covering the final object, by Stacks 03DN
in the form `Stacks.SheafOfModules.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_iff_exists_cover_isFiniteFree`.
Such a family `{W_i}` for `M` is carried to the family `{u(W_i)}` by
`Stacks.Sheaves.LocalizedPullback.coversTop_mapObj`, and the finite freeness of `M|_{W_i}` is
carried to that of `(f^*M)|_{u(W_i)}` by
`Stacks.Sheaves.LocalizedPullback.isFiniteFree_over_pullbackTopos`.

This is the case to which Stacks 03DO's own proof reduces the clause through Section 03DG; the
general statement, for an arbitrary morphism of ringed topoi, is
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_pullbackModules`, which transports
this one along the two equivalences of ringed topoi that Stacks 03CR produces.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_pullbackTopos
    (hM : SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite M) :
    SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite
      (f.toRingedToposSiteHom.pullbackTopos.obj M)
declarations.comment:
the finite locally free property, clause 03DL (2), for a morphism of ringed
  *sites* presented by a left exact continuous functor — the case 03DO's own proof reduces that
  clause to through Section 03DG. The clause for an arbitrary morphism of ringed topoi is
  `AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_pullbackModules`, which transports
  this one along the two equivalences of ringed topoi 03CR produces

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.LocalizedPullback.isLocallyFreeOnSite_pullbackTopos
declarations.doc:
**The locally free clause of Stacks 03DO for a morphism of ringed sites presented by a left
exact continuous functor.** If a sheaf of `O'`-modules is locally free on the site, so is its
pullback along a morphism of ringed sites whose underlying functor is left exact.  This is the
clause of Stacks 03DO for Stacks 03DL (1).

Local freeness may be tested on a single family covering the final object, by Stacks 03DN in the
form `Stacks.SheafOfModules.isLocallyFreeOnSite_iff_exists_cover_isFree`.  Such a family `{W_i}`
for `M` is carried to the family `{u(W_i)}` by
`Stacks.Sheaves.LocalizedPullback.coversTop_mapObj`, and the freeness of `M|_{W_i}` is carried to
that of `(f^*M)|_{u(W_i)}` by `Stacks.Sheaves.LocalizedPullback.isFree_over_pullbackTopos`.

This is the case to which Stacks 03DO's own proof reduces the clause through Section 03DG; the
general statement, for an arbitrary morphism of ringed topoi, is
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isLocallyFreeOnSite_pullbackModules`, which transports this
one along the two equivalences of ringed topoi that Stacks 03CR produces.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyFreeOnSite_pullbackTopos (hM : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOnSite M) :
    SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOnSite
      (f.toRingedToposSiteHom.pullbackTopos.obj M)
declarations.comment:
the locally free property, clause 03DL (1), for a morphism of ringed *sites*
  presented by a left exact continuous functor — the case 03DO's own proof reduces that clause
  to through Section 03DG. The clause for an arbitrary morphism of ringed topoi is
  `AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isLocallyFreeOnSite_pullbackModules`, which transports this
  one along the two equivalences of ringed topoi 03CR produces

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.LocalizedPullback.isLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite_pullbackTopos
declarations.doc:
**The locally generated clause of Stacks 03DO for a morphism of ringed sites presented by a
left exact continuous functor.** If a sheaf of `O'`-modules is locally generated by sections, so
is its pullback along a morphism of ringed sites whose underlying functor is left exact.  This is
the clause of Stacks 03DO for Stacks 03DL (3).

Local generation by sections may be tested on a single family covering the final object, by
Stacks 03DN in the form
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.isLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite_iff_exists_cover_generatingSections`.
Such a family `{W_i}` for `M` is carried to the family `{u(W_i)}` by
`Stacks.Sheaves.LocalizedPullback.coversTop_mapObj`, and the generating sections of `M|_{W_i}`
to those of `(f^*M)|_{u(W_i)}` by
`Stacks.Sheaves.LocalizedPullback.generatingSectionsPullbackTopos`.

This is the case to which Stacks 03DO's own proof reduces the clause through Section 03DG; the
general statement, for an arbitrary morphism of ringed topoi, is
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite_pullbackModules`, which
transports this one along the two equivalences of ringed topoi that Stacks 03CR produces.  The
clause for local generation by a fixed number `r` of sections, Stacks 03DL (4), is proved for an
arbitrary morphism of ringed topoi in
`Stacks.Sheaves.LocalGeneration.pullbackModules_isLocallyGeneratedByOnSite`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite_pullbackTopos
    (hM : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite M) :
    SheafOfModules.IsLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite
      (f.toRingedToposSiteHom.pullbackTopos.obj M)
declarations.comment:
the locally generated property, clause 03DL (3), for a morphism of ringed *sites*
  presented by a left exact continuous functor — the case 03DO's own proof reduces that clause
  to through Section 03DG. The clause for an arbitrary morphism of ringed topoi is
  `AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite_pullbackModules`, which
  transports this one along the two equivalences of ringed topoi 03CR produces

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isLocallyFreeOnSite_pullbackModules
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DO for the clause 03DL (1).**  If a sheaf of `O_D`-modules is locally free, then
so is its pullback along an arbitrary morphism of ringed topoi
`(f, f♯) : (Sh(C), O_C) ⟶ (Sh(D), O_D)`.

Stacks 03CR factors `(f, f♯)` through two equivalences attached to dense subsite inclusions and
a morphism presented by a left exact morphism of sites, and the clause travels around that
square by
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isLocallyFreeOnSite_pullbackModules_of_twoSided`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyFreeOnSite_pullbackModules (hF : F.IsLocallyFreeOnSite) :
    (f.toModulesHom.pullbackModules.obj F).IsLocallyFreeOnSite
declarations.comment: part (1), locally free: for an arbitrary morphism of ringed topoi

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_pullbackModules
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DO for the clause 03DL (2).**  If a sheaf of `O_D`-modules is finite locally
free, then so is its pullback along an arbitrary morphism of ringed topoi; the rank on each
member of the covering is unchanged.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_pullbackModules (hF : F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite) :
    (f.toModulesHom.pullbackModules.obj F).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite
declarations.comment: part (2), finite locally free: for an arbitrary morphism of ringed topoi

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite_pullbackModules
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DO for the clause 03DL (3).**  If a sheaf of `O_D`-modules is locally generated
by sections, then so is its pullback along an arbitrary morphism of ringed topoi; the index type
of the generating family is unchanged.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite_pullbackModules
    (hF : F.IsLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite) :
    (f.toModulesHom.pullbackModules.obj F).IsLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite
declarations.comment:
part (3), locally generated by sections: for an arbitrary morphism of
  ringed topoi

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isQuasicoherentOnSite_pullbackModules
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DO for the clause 03DL (6).**  If a sheaf of `O_D`-modules is quasi-coherent,
then so is its pullback along an arbitrary morphism of ringed topoi.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasicoherentOnSite_pullbackModules (hF : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) :
    (f.toModulesHom.pullbackModules.obj F).IsQuasicoherentOnSite
declarations.comment: part (6), quasi-coherent: for an arbitrary morphism of ringed topoi

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.FinitePresentation.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_pullbackModules
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DO for the clause 03DL(2): pullback preserves finite local freeness.**  The
pullback `f^*F = O_C ⊗_{f⁻¹O_D} f⁻¹F` of Stacks 03D6(2) of a finite locally free sheaf of
`O_D`-modules along a morphism of ringed topoi `(f, f♯) : (Sh(C), O_C) ⟶ (Sh(D), O_D)` is finite
locally free.

The two halves are
`Stacks.Sheaves.PresentationTransport.exists_cover_isFiniteFree_inverseImage`, which produces a
covering of each object of the source site on whose members `f⁻¹F` is finite free, and
`Stacks.Sheaves.FinitePresentation.isFiniteFree_extendScalarsOver`, which carries that across
extension of scalars along `f⁻¹O_D ⟶ O_C`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_pullbackModules {X : RingedTopos.{v, u, w}}
    {Y : RingedTopos.{v', u', w}}
    [X.J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})]
    [Y.J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})]
    [X.J.HasSheafCompose (forget RingCat.{w})]
    [Y.J.HasSheafCompose (forget RingCat.{w})]
    [X.J.HasSheafCompose (forget AddCommGrpCat.{w})]
    [Y.J.HasSheafCompose (forget AddCommGrpCat.{w})]
    [HasWeakSheafify X.J AddCommGrpCat.{w}] [HasWeakSheafify Y.J AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [X.J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [Y.J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [∀ Z : X.C, HasWeakSheafify (X.J.over Z) AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [∀ Z : Y.C, HasWeakSheafify (Y.J.over Z) AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [∀ Z : X.C, (X.J.over Z).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [∀ Z : Y.C, (Y.J.over Z).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    (f : RingedToposModules.RingedToposHom X Y)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O))
    (hF : _root_.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite F) :
    _root_.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite (f.pullbackModules.obj F)

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.FiniteType.pullbackModules_isFiniteType
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DO for the clause 03DL(5): pullback preserves finite type.**  The pullback
`f^*F = O_C ⊗_{f⁻¹O_D} f⁻¹F` of Stacks 03D6(2) of a sheaf of `O_D`-modules of finite type along
a morphism of ringed topoi `(f, f♯) : (Sh(C), O_C) ⟶ (Sh(D), O_D)` is of finite type.

The two factors are `exists_cover_finite_generators_inverseImage`, which produces a covering of
each object of the source site carrying finitely many generating sections of `f⁻¹F`, and
`Stacks.Sheaves.LocalGeneration.extendScalars_exists_finite_generators`, which carries those
sections across extension of scalars along `f⁻¹O_D ⟶ O_C`; the result is assembled by
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.isFiniteType_of_locally_finite_generators`.
declarations.statement:
theorem pullbackModules_isFiniteType
    {X : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedTopos.{v, u, w}}
    {Y : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedTopos.{v', u', w}}
    [X.J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})]
    [Y.J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})]
    [X.J.HasSheafCompose (forget RingCat.{w})]
    [Y.J.HasSheafCompose (forget RingCat.{w})]
    [X.J.HasSheafCompose (forget AddCommGrpCat.{w})]
    [Y.J.HasSheafCompose (forget AddCommGrpCat.{w})]
    [HasWeakSheafify X.J AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [X.J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [∀ U : X.C, HasWeakSheafify (X.J.over U) AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [∀ U : Y.C, HasWeakSheafify (Y.J.over U) AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [∀ U : X.C, (X.J.over U).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [∀ U : Y.C, (Y.J.over U).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    (f : Stacks.Sheaves.RingedToposModules.RingedToposHom X Y)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O))
    (hF : F.IsFiniteType) :
    ((f.pullbackModules).obj F).IsFiniteType
declarations.comment: part (5), finite type: for an arbitrary morphism of ringed topoi

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.LocalGeneration.pullbackModules_isLocallyGeneratedByOnSite
declarations.doc:
The pullback of a sheaf of modules that is locally generated by `r` sections along a
morphism of ringed topoi is again locally generated by `r` sections.
declarations.statement:
theorem pullbackModules_isLocallyGeneratedByOnSite
    {X : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedTopos.{v, u, w}}
    {Y : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedTopos.{v', u', w}}
    [X.J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})]
    [Y.J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})]
    [X.J.HasSheafCompose (forget RingCat.{w})]
    [Y.J.HasSheafCompose (forget RingCat.{w})]
    [X.J.HasSheafCompose (forget AddCommGrpCat.{w})]
    [Y.J.HasSheafCompose (forget AddCommGrpCat.{w})]
    [HasWeakSheafify X.J AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [X.J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [∀ U : X.C, HasWeakSheafify (X.J.over U) AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [∀ U : Y.C, HasWeakSheafify (Y.J.over U) AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [∀ U : X.C, (X.J.over U).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [∀ U : Y.C, (Y.J.over U).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    (f : RingedToposModules.RingedToposHom X Y)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O)) (r : ℕ)
    (hF : F.IsLocallyGeneratedByOnSite r) :
    ((RingedToposModules.RingedToposHom.pullbackModules f).obj F).IsLocallyGeneratedByOnSite r
declarations.comment:
part (4), locally generated by `r` sections: for an arbitrary morphism of ringed
  topoi

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.FinitePresentation.isFinitePresentation_pullbackModules
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DO for the clause 03DL (7): pullback preserves finite presentation.**  The
pullback `f^*F = O_C ⊗_{f⁻¹O_D} f⁻¹F` of Stacks 03D6 (2) of a sheaf of `O_D`-modules of finite
presentation along a morphism of ringed topoi `(f, f♯) : (Sh(C), O_C) ⟶ (Sh(D), O_D)` is of
finite presentation.

The two halves are
`Stacks.Sheaves.PresentationTransport.exists_cover_isFinite_presentation_inverseImage`, which
produces a covering of each object of the source site carrying a finite presentation of
`f⁻¹F`, and
`Stacks.Sheaves.FinitePresentation.isFinitePresentation_pullbackModules_of_inverseImage_local`,
which transports those presentations across extension of scalars along `f⁻¹O_D ⟶ O_C` and
assembles them.
declarations.statement:
instance isFinitePresentation_pullbackModules {X : RingedTopos.{v, u, w}}
    {Y : RingedTopos.{v', u', w}}
    [X.J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})]
    [Y.J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})]
    [X.J.HasSheafCompose (forget RingCat.{w})]
    [Y.J.HasSheafCompose (forget RingCat.{w})]
    [X.J.HasSheafCompose (forget AddCommGrpCat.{w})]
    [Y.J.HasSheafCompose (forget AddCommGrpCat.{w})]
    [HasWeakSheafify X.J AddCommGrpCat.{w}] [HasWeakSheafify Y.J AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [X.J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [Y.J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [∀ U : X.C, HasWeakSheafify (X.J.over U) AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [∀ U : Y.C, HasWeakSheafify (Y.J.over U) AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [∀ U : X.C, (X.J.over U).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [∀ U : Y.C, (Y.J.over U).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    (f : RingedToposHom X Y) (F : SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O))
    [F.IsFinitePresentation] : ((f.pullbackModules).obj F).IsFinitePresentation
declarations.comment: part (7), finite presentation: for an arbitrary morphism of ringed topoi

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_modulePullback_of_isEtale

the finite locally free property, clause 03DL (2), along an étale morphism of
  algebraic spaces

the finite locally free property, clause 03DL (2), along a morphism of

declarations.doc:
The inverse image `a^*N` of Stacks 03LU of a quasi-coherent finite locally free `𝒪_Y`-module
along a morphism `a : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over `S` is finite locally free.

the finite locally free property, clause 03DL (2), for the morphism of small
  étale ringed topoi of an arbitrary morphism of algebraic spaces, stated for a quasi-coherent
  module: the source assumes no such hypothesis, and it is carried here because the reduction to
  the representable case runs through the comparison of Stacks 03DX (2), which needs it

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_modulePullback_of_isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DO for the clause 03DL(2) at a morphism of algebraic spaces.**  The inverse image
of Stacks 03LU of a finite locally free `𝒪_X`-module on the small étale site is again finite
locally free on the small étale site.

This is `Stacks.Sheaves.FinitePresentation.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_pullbackModules` at the
morphism of small étale ringed topoi of Stacks 03G8, exactly as
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFinitePresentationOnSite_modulePullback` is its companion for the
clause 03DL(7).  Stacks 03DO for the clause 03DL(2) is also registered against the ringed-topoi
statement, of which this is the specialization; the registration below is the one previously
carried by a version of this statement which additionally assumed the module quasi-coherent, so
its clause text still speaks of that hypothesis.  No hypothesis of the kind is needed here,
because nothing in the proof passes through the comparison of Stacks 03DX (2).
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_modulePullback_of_isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite
    {X' X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (g : X' ⟶ X)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (hF : SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite F) :
    SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite ((modulePullback B S hS g).obj F)

the finite locally free property, clause 03DL (2), for the morphism of small

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_iso_coproduct_spec_of_mono
declarations.doc:
A monomorphism into a disjoint union of spectra of fields is, over that disjoint union, the
inclusion of precisely a subset of its components.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_openImmersion_closedImmersion_factorization_of_isReduced
declarations.doc:
An immersion of a reduced scheme factors as an open immersion followed by a closed
immersion.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_openImmersion_closedImmersion_factorization_of_isReduced
    {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ X) [IsImmersion f] [IsReduced Z] :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (j : Z ⟶ Y) (i : Y ⟶ X),
      IsOpenImmersion j ∧ IsClosedImmersion i ∧ j ≫ i = f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.associatedModule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DU (4), at `τ = étale`.**  The associated-module functor of the small étale site
of `S`: the pullback of sheaves of modules along the morphism of ringed sites
`(S_étale, 𝒪) → (S_Zar, 𝒪_S)`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def associatedModule :
    S.Modules ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheaf B S hS)
declarations.comment: associated module on the small site, clause (4) at τ = étale, functor only

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallZariski.associatedModule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DU (4), at `τ = Zariski`.**  The associated-module functor of the small Zariski
site of `S`: the pullback of sheaves of modules along the morphism of ringed sites
`(S_Zar, 𝒪) → (S_Zar, 𝒪_S)`.

This is the functor of clause (4), as the pullback of Remark 03FH (1), like its étale
counterpart `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.associatedModule`.  The sections formula
`T ↦ Γ(T, f^*𝓕)` by which the source also names it is
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallZariski.associatedModuleOfSections`, and the two descriptions are
identified by `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallZariski.associatedModuleIsoOfSections`, which is
Remark 03FH (1) for the morphism `id_{small, Zar, Zar}`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def associatedModule :
    S.Modules ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheaf B S hS)
declarations.comment: associated module on the small site, clause (4) at τ = Zariski, functor only

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.associatedPresheaf_map_smul
declarations.doc:
**Tag 03DU, the module restriction maps.**  The restriction maps of the presheaf of
pullback sections are semilinear over the restriction maps of the presheaf of global
functions.
declarations.statement:
public theorem associatedPresheaf_map_smul {X Y : Cᵒᵖ} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (r : (structurePresheaf S toOver).obj X) (m : (associatedPresheaf S F toOver).obj X) :
    letI := associatedPresheafModule S F toOver X
    letI := associatedPresheafModule S F toOver Y
    (associatedPresheaf S F toOver).map f (r • m) =
      (structurePresheaf S toOver).map f r • (associatedPresheaf S F toOver).map f m

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleOver.structure_isSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DU, big étale structure sheaf.**  The presheaf of global functions is a sheaf of
rings on the big étale site over `S`: a covering family of that site is étale and surjective,
hence an fpqc covering, and global functions satisfy fpqc descent.

    Presheaf.IsSheaf (topology B S hS)
      (Stacks.Sites.structurePresheaf S (Over.post B.inclusion))

`(f : T → S) ↦ Γ(T, f^* F)` of [Stacks, Tag 03DS] satisfies the sheaf condition on the
localized big `τ`-site: it is an fpqc sheaf on all schemes over `S` by [Stacks, Tag 03DT], and
the functor into that slice is continuous.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.overAssociatedModule
declarations.doc:

`𝒪_S`-module `F` on the big `τ`-site of `S`, as a sheaf of modules over the structure sheaf of
clause (1).  Its sections over an object `f : T → S` of the site are the global sections
`Γ(T, f^* F)`, and no sheafification occurs.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def overAssociatedModule :
    SheafOfModules.{u} (overStructureSheaf τ B S hS)

`T/S ↦ Γ(T, 𝒪_T)` is a sheaf of rings on the localization at `S` of a big `τ`-site, for each of
the five topologies.
declarations.comment: the structure sheaf of a localized big site, uniformly in the topology

hence an fpqc covering, and global functions satisfy fpqc descent.

declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DU, big smooth structure sheaf construction.**  The structure sheaf of rings of
the big smooth site over `S`, whose value at `T/S` is `Γ(T, 𝒪_T)`.

of rings on the big syntomic site over `S`: a covering family of that site is syntomic and

declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DU, big syntomic structure sheaf construction.**  The structure sheaf of rings of
the big syntomic site over `S`, whose value at `T/S` is `Γ(T, 𝒪_T)`.

of rings on the big Zariski site over `S`: a covering family of that site is a jointly
surjective family of open immersions, hence an fpqc covering, and global functions satisfy

declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03DU, big Zariski structure sheaf construction.**  The structure sheaf of rings of
the big Zariski site over `S`, whose value at `T/S` is `Γ(T, 𝒪_T)`.
declarations.statement: public noncomputable def structureSheaf : Sheaf (topology B S hS) RingCat.{u}

declarations.doc:

étale site of `S` is a sheaf of rings.
