declarations.comment: the `Cech^p = 0 for p >= 1` clause, for the one-member covering 03FI reduces to; unconditional -- hcoeff, harrow and hcolim are all three discharged

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isZero_cechCohomology_succ_quasiCoherentPresheaf
declarations.doc:
Čech vanishing in positive degrees for a standard `τ`-covering of an affine object of
`Over S`, with the presheaf `Fᵃ` of [Stacks, Tag 03DS] as coefficients, for each of the five
topologies.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isZero_cechCohomology_succ_quasiCoherentPresheaf (τ : CoveringTopology)
    (F : S.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (𝒱 : PreZeroHypercover.{u} U)
    (h : IsStandardCovering τ (fun i ↦ (𝒱.X i).left) (fun i ↦ (𝒱.f i).left))
    (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    IsZero (cechCohomology 𝒱 (quasiCoherentPresheafFunctor S F) p)
declarations.comment: the `Cech^p = 0 for p >= 1` clause, for an arbitrary standard covering; unconditional -- hcoeff, harrow and hcolim are all three discharged

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidScheme.exists_finite_openClosed_subgroupoid
declarations.doc:
Around a point at which the object map is quasi-finite and whose source fibre is finite, a
flat finitely presented groupoid has, after an elementary étale base change, a finite
open-and-closed subgroupoid containing precisely the orbit of the point in the distinguished
fibre.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_finite_openClosed_subgroupoid
    {S : Scheme.{u}} (G : Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme S) (p : S)
    (u : G.objects.left) (hu : G.objects.hom u = p)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType G.objects.hom]
    (hqu : AlgebraicGeometry.quasiFiniteAt G.objects.hom u)
    [IsSeparated G.objects.hom] [IsSeparated G.arrows.hom]
    [Flat G.source.left] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation G.source.left]
    [Flat G.target.left] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation G.target.left]
    (hfinite : Set.Finite (G.source.left ⁻¹' {u})) :
    ∃ (N : AlgebraicGeometry.EtaleNeighborhood S p), N.IsElementary ∧
      ∃ (H : Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme N.scheme) (W W' : Scheme.{u})
        (jU : H.objects.left ⟶ pullback G.objects.hom N.toBase)
        (jW : W ⟶ pullback G.objects.hom N.toBase)
        (jR : H.arrows.left ⟶ pullback G.arrows.hom N.toBase)
        (jW' : W' ⟶ pullback G.arrows.hom N.toBase),
        IsOpenImmersion jU ∧ IsClosedImmersion jU ∧
        IsOpenImmersion jW ∧ IsClosedImmersion jW ∧
        IsIso (coprod.desc jU jW) ∧
        IsOpenImmersion jR ∧ IsClosedImmersion jR ∧
        IsOpenImmersion jW' ∧ IsClosedImmersion jW' ∧
        IsIso (coprod.desc jR jW') ∧
        H.objects.hom = jU ≫ pullback.snd G.objects.hom N.toBase ∧
        H.arrows.hom = jR ≫ pullback.snd G.arrows.hom N.toBase ∧
        (∃ u' : H.objects.left,
          (jU ≫ pullback.fst G.objects.hom N.toBase) u' = u ∧
          jU '' {x : H.objects.left | H.objects.hom x = N.point} =
            (pullback.map G.arrows.hom N.toBase G.objects.hom N.toBase
              G.target.left (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (by simp) (by simp)) ''
              ((pullback.map G.arrows.hom N.toBase G.objects.hom N.toBase
                G.source.left (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (by simp) (by simp)) ⁻¹' {jU u'}) ∧
          jR '' {r : H.arrows.left | H.arrows.hom r = N.point} =
            (pullback.map G.arrows.hom N.toBase G.objects.hom N.toBase
              G.source.left (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (by simp) (by simp)) ⁻¹'
                (jU '' {x : H.objects.left | H.objects.hom x = N.point})) ∧
        IsFinite H.objects.hom ∧ IsFinite H.arrows.hom ∧
        H.source.left ≫ jU ≫ pullback.fst G.objects.hom N.toBase =
          jR ≫ pullback.fst G.arrows.hom N.toBase ≫ G.source.left ∧
        H.target.left ≫ jU ≫ pullback.fst G.objects.hom N.toBase =
          jR ≫ pullback.fst G.arrows.hom N.toBase ≫ G.target.left ∧
        ∃ k : (pullback H.source H.target).left ⟶
            (pullback G.source G.target).left,
          k ≫ (pullback.fst G.source G.target).left =
              (pullback.fst H.source H.target).left ≫ jR ≫
                pullback.fst G.arrows.hom N.toBase ∧
          k ≫ (pullback.snd G.source G.target).left =
              (pullback.snd H.source H.target).left ≫ jR ≫
                pullback.fst G.arrows.hom N.toBase ∧
          H.comp.left ≫ jR ≫ pullback.fst G.arrows.hom N.toBase =
            k ≫ G.comp.left

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_stronglySplit_of_strongSplittingSituation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03FM.**  In the strong splitting situation of Stacks 04RL there are
an algebraic space `U'`, an étale morphism `g : U' ⟶ U` of algebraic spaces and a point
`u' : Spec κ(u) ⟶ U'` lying over `u : Spec κ(u) ⟶ U` such that the restriction `R' = R|_{U'}`
of `R` to `U'` is strongly split over `u'`.

`U'` is the object space of the finite part `(R_s/U, e)_fin` of Stacks 04RU, `g` its étale
projection, `u'` the pair `(u, Z_u)` where `Z_u` is the open and closed piece of the fibre
`F_u = R ×_{s, U} Spec κ(u)` supported on the arrows from `u` to itself, and the strong
splitting is the universal open `Z_univ` read inside `R|_{U'}`.  Being strongly split is a
condition on a point of `|U'|`, so it is asserted at the point of `|U'|` which the morphism
`u' : Spec κ(u) ⟶ U'` determines.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_stronglySplit_of_strongSplittingSituation
    (D : StrongSplittingSituation.{u})
    (C : BigFppfSite.{u}) (hS : C.Contains D.S)
    (hU : C.Contains D.groupoid.objects.left)
    (hR : C.Contains D.groupoid.arrows.left)
    (hP : C.Contains (pullback D.groupoid.source D.groupoid.target).left)
    (hK : C.Contains (Spec (D.groupoid.objects.left.residueField D.u))) :
    ∃ (U' : AlgebraicSpaces C D.S hS)
      (g : U' ⟶ (D.groupoid.realization C hS hU hR hP).objects),
      IsEtale C D.S hS g.hom ∧
      ∃ v : U'.obj.obj (Opposite.op
          (schemeSiteObject C hS (X := residueOver D.groupoid D.u) hK)),
        (yonedaSchemePointEquiv C hS hU (Opposite.op
            (schemeSiteObject C hS (X := residueOver D.groupoid D.u) hK))
            (g.hom.app _ v)).left =
          D.groupoid.objects.left.fromSpecResidueField D.u ∧
        GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.IsStronglySplitAt
          (GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.restrict (D.groupoid.realization C hS hU hR hP)
            g).groupoid
          ((residueSectionValuedPoint D.groupoid C hS D.u hK U' v).class C D.S hS U'.obj)
declarations.comment: all four assertions, in Situation 04RL: the algebraic space U', the étale g : U' ⟶ U and the point u' : Spec κ(u) ⟶ U' over u are PRODUCED, and R|_{U'} is strongly split over u'. Beyond Situation 04RL the only hypotheses are that the big fppf site contains the base, object, arrow and composable-pair schemes and Spec κ(u), which is this library's standing ambient requirement

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.quadraticGaloisTwistedDoubledOrigin
declarations.doc:
The quotient `X = U/R` of the affine line over a quadratic Galois extension by the diagonal
together with the twisted diagonal away from zero.
declarations.statement:
abbrev quadraticGaloisTwistedDoubledOrigin
    [FiniteDimensional k K] [IsGalois k K] (_hdegree : Module.finrank k K = 2)
    (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (_hσ : σ ≠ 1)
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (hS : B.Contains (base k))
    [HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.topology B (base k) hS) (Type u)] :
    Sheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B (base k) hS) (Type u)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.isAlgebraicSpace_quadraticGaloisTwistedDoubledOrigin
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03FN.** The Galois twist of the affine line with zero doubled **is an algebraic
space**: `R` is an étale equivalence relation on `U` over `S`, and so the quotient `X = U/R` is
an algebraic space. No descent hypothesis is needed.

The relation is an affine morphism into the self-product of the chart, so
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAlgebraicSpace_quotientSheaf_of_isAffineHom` applies: Stacks 0265 is
unconditional for an affine étale equivalence relation.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpace_quadraticGaloisTwistedDoubledOrigin
    (hdegree : Module.finrank k K = 2) (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (hσ : σ ≠ 1)
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (hS : B.Contains (base k))
    [HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.topology B (base k) hS) (Type u)] :
    IsAlgebraicSpace B (base k) hS
      (quadraticGaloisTwistedDoubledOrigin k K hdegree σ hσ B hS).obj
declarations.comment: X = U/R is an algebraic space

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.isIso_quadraticGaloisTwistedDoubledOrigin_over_puncturedBase
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03FN.** The quotient `X = U/R` agrees with the base away from the origin: the
base change of its structure morphism to the punctured base is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_quadraticGaloisTwistedDoubledOrigin_over_puncturedBase
    (hdegree : Module.finrank k K = 2) (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (hσ : σ ≠ 1) (B : BigFppfSite.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains (base k))
    [HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.topology B (base k) hS) (Type u)] :
    IsIso (pullback.snd (quotientBaseMap k K hdegree σ hσ B hS)
      ((Over.post (X := B.obj hS) B.inclusion).op.whiskerLeft
        (yoneda.map (puncturedBaseInclusion k))))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.surjective_isFinite_etale_and_baseChange_isScheme
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03FN, part (6).** There is a surjective, finite, étale morphism `S' ⟶ S` such
that the base change `X' = S' ×_S X` is a scheme: take `S' = U = Spec K[x]`, the chart itself,
and then `X'` is two copies of `U` glued along the puncture.

The chart is surjective, finite and étale over the base because `K[x]` is the base change of the
finite separable extension `K/k` along `k → k[x]`. For the base change: pulling the quotient
`X = U/R` back along `U ⟶ S` presents `X'` as the quotient of the self-product `U ×_S U` by the
base change of `R`; the self-product is two copies of `U` (`coverFiberProductSplitIso`), and the
induced relation is exactly the gluing relation of two copies of `U` along the puncture, which is
`isPullback_doubledRelation` — the base-changed relation is the kernel pair of the map to the
glued scheme. The representability criterion of Stacks 03C5 then identifies the quotient of the
base-changed relation with the functor of points of the glued scheme, and `X'` is that same
quotient.
declarations.statement:
theorem surjective_isFinite_etale_and_baseChange_isScheme
    (hdegree : Module.finrank k K = 2) (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (hσ : σ ≠ 1) :
    (Surjective (coverMap k K) ∧ IsFinite (coverMap k K) ∧ Etale (coverMap k K)) ∧
      ∃ χ : baseChangePresheaf k K B hS hdegree σ hσ ⟶
          (pointsFunctor k B hS).obj (doubledOverBase k K),
        IsIso χ
declarations.comment: part (6): finite etale cover trivialising X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.isEtale_quotientBaseMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03FN, part (2).** The structure morphism of the Galois twist of the affine line
with zero doubled is an étale morphism of algebraic spaces over the base, in the sense of
Stacks 03FR: every étale morphism from a scheme into the quotient is étale over the base.

The chart `U ⟶ X` is surjective and étale, and `U ⟶ S` is étale; so for an étale morphism
`T ⟶ X` the fibre product `W = T ×_X U` is étale over `S` and surjective étale over `T`, and
the étale case of Stacks 02KM makes `T ⟶ S` étale.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtale_quotientBaseMap [FiniteDimensional k K] [IsGalois k K]
    (hdegree : Module.finrank k K = 2) (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (hσ : σ ≠ 1)
    [HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.topology B (base k) hS) (Type u)] :
    Space.IsEtale B (base k) hS (quotientBaseMap k K hdegree σ hσ B hS)
declarations.comment: part (2): the morphism X -> S is etale

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.twistedRelation_isEtaleEquivalenceRelation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03FN.** The diagonal of the chart together with the twisted diagonal away from
the origin is an étale equivalence relation on the chart over the base.
declarations.statement:
theorem twistedRelation_isEtaleEquivalenceRelation [FiniteDimensional k K] [IsGalois k K]
    (hdegree : Module.finrank k K = 2) (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (hσ : σ ≠ 1) :
    Stacks.Groupoids.IsEtaleEquivalenceRelation (twistedRelation k K σ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.quadraticGaloisTwistedDoubledOrigin_not_representable
declarations.doc: **Stacks 03FN.** The quotient `X = U/R` is not represented by a scheme over the base.
declarations.statement:
theorem quadraticGaloisTwistedDoubledOrigin_not_representable (k K : Type u) [Field k]
    [Field K] [Algebra k K] [FiniteDimensional k K] [IsGalois k K]
    (hdegree : Module.finrank k K = 2) (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (hσ : σ ≠ 1) (B : BigFppfSite.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains (base k))
    [HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.topology B (base k) hS) (Type u)] :
    ¬ ∃ Y : Over (base k),
      Nonempty ((quadraticGaloisTwistedDoubledOrigin k K hdegree σ hσ B hS).obj ≅
        Stacks.Groupoids.points (Over.post B.inclusion) Y)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.isLocallySeparatedOver_quadraticGaloisTwistedDoubledOrigin
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03FN, part (5).** The Galois twist of the affine line with zero doubled is
locally separated over the base: its diagonal is an immersion.

The relation `j : R ⟶ U ×_S U` is an open immersion, hence an immersion, and the diagonal of
the quotient is covered by it.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallySeparatedOver_quadraticGaloisTwistedDoubledOrigin
    (hdegree : Module.finrank k K = 2) (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (hσ : σ ≠ 1)
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (hS : B.Contains (base k))
    [HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.topology B (base k) hS) (Type u)] :
    Space.IsLocallySeparatedOver B (base k) hS
      (quadraticGaloisTwistedDoubledOrigin k K hdegree σ hσ B hS).obj
declarations.comment: part (5): X is locally separated over S

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.isQuasiSeparatedOver_quadraticGaloisTwistedDoubledOrigin
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03FN, part (5).** The Galois twist of the affine line with zero doubled is
quasi-separated over the base: its diagonal is quasi-compact.

The relation `j : R ⟶ U ×_S U` is an affine morphism, hence quasi-compact, and the diagonal of
the quotient is covered by it.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiSeparatedOver_quadraticGaloisTwistedDoubledOrigin
    (hdegree : Module.finrank k K = 2) (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (hσ : σ ≠ 1)
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (hS : B.Contains (base k))
    [HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.topology B (base k) hS) (Type u)] :
    Space.IsQuasiSeparatedOver B (base k) hS
      (quadraticGaloisTwistedDoubledOrigin k K hdegree σ hσ B hS).obj
declarations.comment: part (5): X is quasi-separated over S

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.not_isSeparatedOver_quadraticGaloisTwistedDoubledOrigin
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03FN, part (5).** The Galois twist of the affine line with zero doubled is *not*
separated over the base: its diagonal is not a closed immersion.

The relation is a represented base change of the diagonal, so a closed-immersion diagonal
would make the relation a closed immersion of schemes, which
`AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.not_isClosedImmersion_twistedRelation_left`
excludes.
declarations.statement:
theorem not_isSeparatedOver_quadraticGaloisTwistedDoubledOrigin
    (hdegree : Module.finrank k K = 2) (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (hσ : σ ≠ 1)
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (hS : B.Contains (base k))
    [HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.topology B (base k) hS) (Type u)] :
    ¬ Space.IsSeparatedOver B (base k) hS
      (quadraticGaloisTwistedDoubledOrigin k K hdegree σ hσ B hS).obj
declarations.comment: part (5): X is not separated over S

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.baseChange_specExtension_isScheme_and_not_isScheme
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03FN, part (7).** Read over `Spec k` rather than over `S`, the base change
`X_{k'} = X ×_{Spec k} Spec k'` of the twisted doubled origin is a scheme — the affine line
over `k'` with zero doubled — while `X` itself is not a scheme.

The three conjuncts are: the chart `U` is the base change `S ×_{Spec k} Spec k'` of the base,
so that `X ×_{Spec k} Spec k'` is the presheaf `X ×_S U` of part (6); that presheaf is the
functor of points of the affine line over `k'` with zero doubled, which is part (6); and `X`
is not the functor of points of any scheme over the base, which is the `not_scheme` clause.
Together they say that `X_{k'}` is a scheme and `X` is not.
declarations.statement:
theorem baseChange_specExtension_isScheme_and_not_isScheme
    (hdegree : Module.finrank k K = 2) (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (hσ : σ ≠ 1) (B : BigFppfSite.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains (base k))
    [HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.topology B (base k) hS) (Type u)] :
    IsPullback (coverMap k K) (coverToSpecExtension K) (specBase k) (specExtension k K) ∧
      (∃ χ : baseChangePresheaf k K B hS hdegree σ hσ ⟶
          (pointsFunctor k B hS).obj (doubledOverBase k K), IsIso χ) ∧
      ¬ ∃ Y : Over (base k),
        Nonempty ((quadraticGaloisTwistedDoubledOrigin k K hdegree σ hσ B hS).obj ≅
          Stacks.Groupoids.points (Over.post B.inclusion) Y)
declarations.comment: part (7): X over Spec k, with X_{k'} a scheme but X not a scheme

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.exists_descentDatum_specExtension_not_isEffective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03FN, the closing claim.** For a degree two Galois extension `k'/k` with nonidentity
automorphism `σ` there is a descent datum for schemes relative to the one-member covering
`{Spec k' ⟶ Spec k}` which is not effective.

The datum is the Galois twist of the affine line over `k'` with the origin doubled; were it
effective, the two origins of that line would have the same image in the descended scheme, which
`AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.specOrigin_chart_ne` forbids.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_descentDatum_specExtension_not_isEffective (hdegree : Module.finrank k K = 2)
    (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (hσ : σ ≠ 1) :
    ∃ D : DescentDatum (specExtension k K), ¬ DescentData.IsEffective D
declarations.comment: the descent datum relative to {Spec k' -> Spec k} which is not effective

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.twistedRelationQuotient_zeroFibre
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03FN.** Over the origin the punctured twisted diagonal disappears, so the fibre
of the quotient over the origin of the base is the origin of the chart, `Spec K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem twistedRelationQuotient_zeroFibre (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (B : BigFppfSite.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains (base k))
    [HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.topology B (base k) hS) (Type u)] :
    let C := BigFppfOver B (base k) hS
    let F : C ⥤ Over (base k) := Over.post B.inclusion
    let Q : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
      (quotientSheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B (base k) hS) F (twistedRelation k K σ)).obj
    Nonempty ((Q ⨯ points F (zeroBaseOverBase k)) ≅ points F (zeroCoverOverBase k K))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_changeBigSiteYonedaHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03FP, part (1), for the canonical comparison.** The inverse image of the sheaf
represented by a test object of the smaller localized big fppf site is the sheaf represented by
its image, by the comparison determined by the transport of the identity.

The isomorphism of Stacks 03FP, part (1) is only produced as *some* isomorphism, so it cannot be
evaluated on sections. The argument transfers invertibility to the canonical comparison: the two
differ by precomposition with a morphism of the enlarged site, because a map out of a
representable sheaf is its own Yoneda transpose; that morphism is invertible because the canonical
comparison is bijective on sections over the image of the test object, where the chosen
isomorphism is bijective as well; and precomposition with an invertible morphism preserves
invertibility.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_changeBigSiteYonedaHom (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) :
    IsIso (changeBigSiteYonedaHom B B' h S hS T)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.changeBigSiteYonedaIso
declarations.doc:
**The inverse image of a representable algebraic space is represented by the image of the
test object**, by the canonical comparison of
`AlgebraicGeometry.changeBigSiteYonedaHom`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isAlgebraicSpace_sheafPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03FP, part (2).** Enlarging the big fppf site preserves algebraic spaces over the
base scheme: the inverse image of an algebraic space over `S` on the smaller localized site is an
algebraic space over `S` on the larger one.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.isAlgebraicSpace_sheafPullback_of_descent` with its descent hypothesis
discharged by `AlgebraicGeometry.descentForQuotients`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpace_sheafPullback
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) :
    letI J := overTopology .fppf B S hS
    letI K := overTopology .fppf B' S (largerContains h hS)
    letI i := inclusionOver h S hS
    letI : i.IsContinuous J K :=
      (inclusionOver_isMorphismOfSites (τ := .fppf) B B' h S hS).toIsContinuous
    letI : (i.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u) J K).IsRightAdjoint :=
      inclusionOver_sheafPushforwardContinuous_isRightAdjoint B B' h S hS
    IsAlgebraicSpace B' S (largerContains h hS)
      ((i.sheafPullback (Type u) J K).obj ⟨F, hF.isSheaf⟩).obj

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsEtale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03FR.** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *étale* when its composite
with every étale morphism from a representable presheaf into its source is again étale.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsEtale {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : F ⟶ G) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEtale_iff_exists_source_chart
declarations.doc:
A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is étale exactly when its composite with some
surjective étale chart of its source is étale.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtale_iff_exists_source_chart {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G) (f : F ⟶ G) :
    IsEtale B S hS f ↔
      ∃ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (p : yoneda.obj U ⟶ F),
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@AlgebraicGeometry.Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf p ∧
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf p ∧
        IsEtale B S hS (p ≫ f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEtale_iff_exists_target_chart
declarations.doc:
A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is étale exactly when its base change along some
surjective étale chart of its target is étale.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtale_iff_exists_target_chart {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (_hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G) (f : F ⟶ G) :
    IsEtale B S hS f ↔
      ∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (q : yoneda.obj V ⟶ G),
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@AlgebraicGeometry.Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf q ∧
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf q ∧
        IsEtale B S hS (pullback.snd f q)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEtale_iff_exists_etale_chart_square
declarations.doc:
A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is étale exactly when it fits in a commuting square
of charts, with the chart of the source surjective and étale, the chart of the target étale, and
the morphism of schemes between them étale.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtale_iff_exists_etale_chart_square {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G) (f : F ⟶ G) :
    IsEtale B S hS f ↔
      ∃ (U V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (p : yoneda.obj U ⟶ F) (q : yoneda.obj V ⟶ G) (α : U ⟶ V),
        p ≫ f = yoneda.map α ≫ q ∧
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@AlgebraicGeometry.Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf p ∧
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf p ∧
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf q ∧
        AlgebraicGeometry.Etale ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map α)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEtale_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03FS.** For a morphism `f : F ⟶ G` of algebraic spaces over `S` the following four
conditions are equivalent: `f` is étale; there is a surjective étale scheme chart of `F` whose
composite with `f` is étale; there is a surjective étale scheme chart of `G` along which the
base change of `f` is étale; and `f` fits into a commuting square of étale scheme charts, with
the chart of `F` surjective, whose upper morphism of schemes is étale.

Conditions (1), (2) and (4) are `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEtale_iff_exists_source_chart` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEtale_iff_exists_etale_chart_square`; condition (3) is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEtale_iff_exists_target_chart`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtale_tfae (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G) (f : F ⟶ G) :
    List.TFAE [
      IsEtale B S hS f,
      (∃ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (p : yoneda.obj U ⟶ F),
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@AlgebraicGeometry.Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf p ∧
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf p ∧
        IsEtale B S hS (p ≫ f)),
      (∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (ψ : yoneda.obj V ⟶ G),
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@AlgebraicGeometry.Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf ψ ∧
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf ψ ∧
        IsEtale B S hS (pullback.snd f ψ)),
      (∃ (U V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (p : yoneda.obj U ⟶ F) (q : yoneda.obj V ⟶ G) (α : U ⟶ V),
        p ≫ f = yoneda.map α ≫ q ∧
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@AlgebraicGeometry.Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf p ∧
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf p ∧
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf q ∧
        AlgebraicGeometry.Etale ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map α))
    ]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEtale_comp
declarations.doc: The composite of two étale morphisms of presheaves on the big fppf site of `S` is étale.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtale_comp {F G H : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} {f : F ⟶ G} {g : G ⟶ H}
    (hf : IsEtale B S hS f) (hg : IsEtale B S hS g) : IsEtale B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEtale_of_isPullback
declarations.doc: A base change of an étale morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is étale.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtale_of_isPullback {X' X Z Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    (p : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    (h : IsPullback p f' f g) (hf : IsEtale B S hS f.hom) :
    IsEtale B S hS f'.hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEtale_of_isEtale_over
declarations.doc:
A morphism between two algebraic spaces which are étale over a common algebraic space is
itself étale.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtale_of_isEtale_over {F G H : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G)
    (_hH : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS H) (f : F ⟶ G) (g : F ⟶ H) (h : G ⟶ H)
    (hg : IsEtale B S hS g) (hh : IsEtale B S hS h) (hfg : f ≫ h = g) :
    IsEtale B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace.exists_etale_surjective_coproduct_affine_cover
declarations.doc:
An algebraic space over `S` has a surjective étale chart whose source is a disjoint union
of affine schemes, each mapping into an affine open of `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsAlgebraicSpace.exists_etale_surjective_coproduct_affine_cover
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) :
    ∃ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS)
      (f : yoneda.obj U ⟶ F)
      (I : Type u) (Y : I → Scheme.{u})
      (e : (∐ Y) ≅ (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U),
      (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) f ∧
      (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) f ∧
      (∀ i, IsAffine (Y i)) ∧
      (∀ i, ∃ (V : S.Opens), IsAffineOpen V ∧
        ∀ y : Y i,
          (Sigma.ι Y i ≫ e.hom ≫ B.inclusion.map U.hom) y ∈ V)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace.exists_etale_surjective_isSeparated_cover
declarations.doc:
An algebraic space over `S` has a surjective étale chart whose underlying scheme is
separated.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsAlgebraicSpace.exists_etale_surjective_isSeparated_cover
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) :
    ∃ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj U ⟶ F),
      Scheme.IsSeparated ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U) ∧
      (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) f ∧
      (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) f
declarations.comment: the cover may be taken separated

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_etale_surjective_coproduct_affine_cover
declarations.doc:
An algebraic space has a surjective étale atlas which is a disjoint union of affine schemes,
each mapping into an affine open of the base.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etale_surjective_coproduct_affine_cover
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) :
    ∃ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS)
      (f : yoneda.obj U ⟶ F)
      (I : Type u) (Y : I → Scheme.{u})
      (e : (∐ Y) ≅ (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U),
      (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) f ∧
      (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) f ∧
      (∀ i, IsAffine (Y i)) ∧
      (∀ i, ∃ (V : S.Opens), IsAffineOpen V ∧
        ∀ y : Y i,
          (Sigma.ι Y i ≫ e.hom ≫ B.inclusion.map U.hom) y ∈ V)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_zariski_cover_affine_etale_atlas
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03FY.** An algebraic space over `S` has a Zariski covering by open subspaces,
each of which admits a surjective étale atlas from an affine scheme and maps into an affine
open of `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_zariski_cover_affine_etale_atlas
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (X : I → Subfunctor F),
      IsZariskiCover B S hS I X ∧
      ∀ i, ∃ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj U ⟶ (X i).toFunctor) (V : S.Opens),
        IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U) ∧
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf f ∧
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf f ∧
        IsAffineOpen V ∧
        ∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (_ : (X i).toFunctor.obj (Opposite.op T))
          (t : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T), (B.inclusion.map T.hom) t ∈ V

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_zariskiCovering_affine_etale_chart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03FY.** An algebraic space over `S` is the union of a family of open subspaces
each of which carries a surjective étale chart from a single affine scheme, and those affine
schemes may be taken to map into affine opens of `S`. Surjectivity of the chart is recorded
both on point sets (Tag 03ME) and in the relatively representable form, the two being
equivalent by Tag 03H5.

The family is indexed by the summands of the affine chart of Stacks 03FX in the form
`AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace.exists_affine_coproduct_atlas`, which keeps the summands
as affine objects `W i` of the site. The member of the covering attached to `i` is the open
subspace swept out by `W i`, and the chart of that member is the factorisation of
`yoneda.map (j i) ≫ f` through it, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isOpenSubspace_etale_surjective_lift_openSubspaceOfPoints_range`.
The members cover because the chart `f` is surjective on points (Tag 03H5) and every point of
its source lies in one summand.

The attribute carries a part string rather than being bare because the covering clause is the
point-set one; the bare attribute sits on
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_zariski_cover_affine_etale_atlas`, which states the same
thing with the covering clause in the repository's `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsZariskiCover`
vocabulary of Tag 02YY. The two are interchangeable by the Zariski-coverings part of Tag
03BZ.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_zariskiCovering_affine_etale_chart
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (X : I → Subfunctor F) (W : I → BigFppfOver B S hS)
      (b : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (W i) ⟶ (X i).toFunctor),
      (∀ i, IsOpenSubspace B S hS (X i)) ∧
      (⋃ i, Set.range (pointsMap B S hS (X i).toFunctor (X i).ι)) = Set.univ ∧
      (∀ i, IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj (W i))) ∧
      (∀ i, (MorphismProperty.inverseImage (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf (b i)) ∧
      (∀ i, Function.Surjective (pointsMap B S hS (yoneda.obj (W i)) (b i))) ∧
      (∀ i, (MorphismProperty.inverseImage (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf (b i)) ∧
      (∀ i, ∃ V : S.Opens, IsAffineOpen V ∧
        (∀ y : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj (W i),
          (B.inclusion.map (W i).hom) y ∈ V) ∧
        ∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (_x : (X i).toFunctor.obj (Opposite.op T))
          (t : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T),
          (B.inclusion.map T.hom) t ∈ V)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSeparated_of_isEtale_of_scheme_isSeparated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03FZ, first assertion.** An étale morphism to an algebraic space from an object of
the site whose underlying scheme is separated is a separated morphism of algebraic spaces.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparated_of_isEtale_of_scheme_isSeparated
    (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (_hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (U : BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (hU : Scheme.IsSeparated ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U))
    (f : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X) (_hf : IsEtale B S hS f) :
    IsSeparated B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSeparated_scheme_pullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03FZ, second assertion.** The object of the site representing the self-fibre
product of an étale chart with separated underlying scheme has separated underlying scheme.
Its second projection is a base change of the chart, hence a separated morphism, and its
target is a separated scheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparated_scheme_pullback
    (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (U : BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (hU : Scheme.IsSeparated ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U))
    (f : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X) (_hf : IsEtale B S hS f) :
    Scheme.IsSeparated ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj
      ((hX.diagonal_representable.of_diag f).pullback f))
declarations.comment: the self-fibre product is a separated scheme

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.essentiallySmall_spacesEtale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03G0.** The spaces-étale site of an algebraic space is essentially small at the
universe of the schemes, even though its objects live in `Type (u + 1)`.

It is the full subcategory of the slice of the algebraic spaces over `X` cut out by étaleness of
the structure morphism, and that slice is essentially small because the algebraic spaces over `S`
are.
declarations.statement:
instance essentiallySmall_spacesEtale (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) :
    EssentiallySmall.{u} (SpacesEtale B S hS X)
declarations.comment: the set-theoretic condition: the site is essentially small

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03G0.** The spaces-étale site of `X`: the category of algebraic spaces étale over
`X`, with the commutative triangles over `X` as morphisms.
declarations.statement: abbrev SpacesEtale

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.IsCovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03G0.** A family in the spaces-étale site of `X` covers when every point of its
target lifts to a point of some member of the family.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsCovering (E : Covering (SpacesEtale B S hS X)) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.isSite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03G0.** Joint surjectivity on points of families in the spaces-étale site of `X`
satisfies the site axioms.
declarations.statement: theorem isSite : IsSite (IsCovering B S hS X)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.comparisonFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03G1.** The canonical inclusion of the small étale site of `X` into its
spaces-étale site: an étale scheme chart of `X` is an algebraic space étale over `X`.
declarations.statement: def comparisonFunctor : SmallEtale B S hS X.1 ⥤ SpacesEtale B S hS X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.comparisonFunctor_obj
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03G1.** The comparison sends a scheme chart to its Yoneda algebraic space over
`X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem comparisonFunctor_obj (U : SmallEtale B S hS X.1) :
    ((comparisonFunctor B S hS X).obj U).1 = chartOver B S hS X U

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.comparisonFunctor_map
declarations.doc: **Stacks 03G1.** The comparison sends a chart morphism to its Yoneda morphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem comparisonFunctor_map {U V : SmallEtale B S hS X.1} (f : U ⟶ V) :
    HEq ((comparisonFunctor B S hS X).map f).hom.left.hom
      (yoneda.map ((SmallEtale.toOver B S hS X.1).map f))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.comparisonFunctor_specialCocontinuous
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03G1.** The comparison functor is special cocontinuous in the sense of Stacks
03CG.
declarations.statement:
theorem comparisonFunctor_specialCocontinuous :
    IsSpecialCocontinuous (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS X)
      (comparisonFunctor B S hS X)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.comparisonFunctor_sheafEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03G1.** Restriction along the comparison functor is an equivalence of sheaf
categories, for sheaves valued in any category with the limits needed to define the
restriction.
declarations.statement:
instance comparisonFunctor_sheafEquivalence (A : Type w) [Category.{w'} A]
    [∀ Y, HasLimitsOfShape (StructuredArrow Y (comparisonFunctor B S hS X).op) A] :
    ((comparisonFunctor B S hS X).sheafPushforwardContinuous A
      (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1)
      (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS X)).IsEquivalence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_affine_chartDiagram_ofArrows
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03G2: the affine chart diagrams over `f` are cofinal.**  Every étale scheme chart
`U` of `X` carries a covering family of affine étale charts of `X`, each of which is the chart of
`X` of a commuting square of étale scheme charts over `f` whose chart of `Y` is affine.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_affine_chartDiagram_ofArrows (f : X ⟶ Y) (U : SmallEtale B S hS X.1) :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (W : I → SmallEtale B S hS X.1) (a : ∀ i, W i ⟶ U)
      (d : I → ChartDiagram B S hS X.1 Y.1 f.hom),
      (∀ i, (d i).U = W i) ∧
      (∀ i, IsAffine ((SmallEtale.toOver B S hS X.1 ⋙
        BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj (W i))) ∧
      (∀ i, IsAffine ((SmallEtale.toOver B S hS Y.1 ⋙
        BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj (d i).V)) ∧
      Sieve.ofArrows W a ∈ SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1 U
declarations.comment: affine chart diagrams are cofinal: covering family

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.generate_affineChartDiagram_mem_topology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03G2: the affine chart diagrams over `f` are cofinal, in sieve form.**  The affine
étale charts of `X` which are the chart of `X` of a commuting square of étale scheme charts over
`f` whose chart of `Y` is affine and satisfies a condition `Q` holding on all affine charts
generate a covering sieve of every étale chart of `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem generate_affineChartDiagram_mem_topology (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (Q : SmallEtale B S hS Y.1 → Prop)
    (hQ : ∀ V : SmallEtale B S hS Y.1,
      IsAffine ((SmallEtale.toOver B S hS Y.1 ⋙ BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj V) → Q V)
    (U : SmallEtale B S hS X.1) :
    Sieve.generate (fun (Z : SmallEtale B S hS X.1) (_ : Z ⟶ U) =>
      IsAffine ((SmallEtale.toOver B S hS X.1 ⋙ BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Z) ∧
      ∃ d : ChartDiagram B S hS X.1 Y.1 f.hom, ∃ _ : d.U = Z,
        IsAffine ((SmallEtale.toOver B S hS Y.1 ⋙ BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj d.V) ∧
          Q d.V) ∈ SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1 U
declarations.comment: affine chart diagrams are cofinal: covering sieve

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallToposMorphism_comp_abelianInverseImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03G2, part (3), inverse-image composition, at abelian coefficients:**
`(f ≫ g)⁻¹ ≅ g⁻¹ ⋙ f⁻¹` for the inverse image of *abelian* sheaves along the morphisms of small
étale topoi.

It is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallToposMorphism_comp_inverseImage`, the same statement for
sheaves of sets, carried over by `StacksTag03LR.abelianInverseImageCompIso`.
declarations.statement:
def smallToposMorphism_comp_abelianInverseImage (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    Sites.abelianInverseImage (smallToposMorphism B S hS (f ≫ g)) ≅
      Sites.abelianInverseImage (smallToposMorphism B S hS g) ⋙
        Sites.abelianInverseImage (smallToposMorphism B S hS f)
declarations.comment: part (3), inverse-image composition at abelian coefficients

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallBaseChange
declarations.doc:
For a morphism `f` whose underlying morphism of presheaves is representable, base change along
`f` of étale scheme charts of `Y`, as a functor to étale scheme charts of `X`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def smallBaseChange {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f.hom) :
    SmallEtale B S hS Y.1 ⥤ SmallEtale B S hS X.1
declarations.comment: part (4), base change on scheme charts

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallBaseChange_projection
declarations.doc:
The cartesian projection from a pulled-back scheme chart to the original chart, viewed as a
morphism of algebraic spaces.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def smallBaseChange_projection {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f.hom) :
    (smallBaseChange B S hS f hf ⋙ comparisonFunctor B S hS X) ⋙
        SpacesEtale.toSpaces B S hS X ⟶
      comparisonFunctor B S hS Y ⋙ SpacesEtale.toSpaces B S hS Y
declarations.comment: part (4), projection of pulled-back scheme charts

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallBaseChange_isPullback
declarations.doc: The base change of an étale scheme chart is cartesian after passage to algebraic spaces.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallBaseChange_isPullback {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f.hom) (V : SmallEtale B S hS Y.1) :
    IsPullback ((smallBaseChange_projection B S hS f hf).app V)
      ((smallBaseChange B S hS f hf ⋙ comparisonFunctor B S hS X).obj V).1.hom
      ((comparisonFunctor B S hS Y).obj V).1.hom f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallBaseChange_comparison
declarations.doc:
The square formed by small and spaces-étale base change and the comparison functors commutes
up to its canonical natural isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def smallBaseChange_comparison {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f.hom) :
    smallBaseChange B S hS f hf ⋙ comparisonFunctor B S hS X ≅
      comparisonFunctor B S hS Y ⋙ (spacesBaseChange B S hS f).functor

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallBaseChange_comparison_projection
declarations.doc:
The comparison isomorphism `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallBaseChange_comparison` is compatible
with the cartesian projections to the original chart.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallBaseChange_comparison_projection {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f.hom) (V : SmallEtale B S hS Y.1) :
    ((smallBaseChange_comparison B S hS f hf).hom.app V).hom.left ≫
        (spacesBaseChange B S hS f).projection.app ((comparisonFunctor B S hS Y).obj V) =
      (smallBaseChange_projection B S hS f hf).app V

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallBaseChange_isMorphismOfSites
declarations.doc: Base change of étale scheme charts is a morphism of small étale sites.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallBaseChange_isMorphismOfSites {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f.hom) :
    _root_.IsMorphismOfSites.{u + 1} (smallBaseChange B S hS f hf)
      (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1) (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallBaseChange_topos
declarations.doc:
The direct image of `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallToposMorphism` is isomorphic to the direct
image along the morphism of small étale sites given by base change on scheme charts.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def smallBaseChange_topos {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f.hom) :
    letI := (smallBaseChange_isMorphismOfSites B S hS f hf).toIsContinuous
    (smallToposMorphism B S hS f).pushforward ≅
      (smallBaseChange B S hS f hf).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (u + 1))
        (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1) (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallBaseChange_topos_comparison
declarations.doc:
The isomorphism `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallBaseChange_topos`, composed with the comparison
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallBaseChange_pushforward_comparison`, is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallToposMorphism_comparison`.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallBaseChange_topos_comparison {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f.hom)
    (F : Sheaf (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS X) (Type (u + 1))) :
    letI := (smallBaseChange_isMorphismOfSites B S hS f hf).toIsContinuous
    (smallBaseChange_topos B S hS f hf).hom.app
        (((comparisonFunctor B S hS X).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (u + 1))
          (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS X)).obj F) ≫
      (smallBaseChange_pushforward_comparison B S hS f hf).hom.app F =
      (smallToposMorphism_comparison B S hS f).hom.app F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallToposMorphism_comp_comparison
declarations.doc:
The small-site composition isomorphism
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallToposMorphism_comp` is precisely the transport of the cartesian
composition on the spaces-étale site through the comparison equivalences, on every sheaf.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallToposMorphism_comp_comparison {X Y Z : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (g : Y ⟶ Z) (F : Sheaf (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS X) (Type (u + 1))) :
    (smallToposMorphism B S hS g).pushforward.map
        ((smallToposMorphism_comparison B S hS f).hom.app F) ≫
      (smallToposMorphism_comparison B S hS g).hom.app
        (((spacesBaseChange B S hS f).functor.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (u + 1))
          (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS Y) (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS X)).obj F) ≫
      ((comparisonFunctor B S hS Z).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (u + 1))
        (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Z.1) (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS Z)).map
          ((spacesBaseChange_pushforward_comp B S hS f g).hom.app F) =
    (smallToposMorphism_comp B S hS f g).hom.app
        (((comparisonFunctor B S hS X).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (u + 1))
          (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS X)).obj F) ≫
      (smallToposMorphism_comparison B S hS (f ≫ g)).hom.app F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallToposMorphism_comp_mate
declarations.doc:
The inverse-image composition isomorphism
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallToposMorphism_comp_inverseImage` is the adjoint mate of the
direct-image composition isomorphism `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallToposMorphism_comp`.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallToposMorphism_comp_mate {X Y Z : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Z.1) (Type (u + 1)))
    (G : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) (Type (u + 1)))
    (h : ((MorphismOfTopoi.comp (smallToposMorphism B S hS g)
      (smallToposMorphism B S hS f)).inverseImage).obj F ⟶ G) :
    (smallToposMorphism B S hS (f ≫ g)).adj.homEquiv F G
        ((smallToposMorphism_comp_inverseImage B S hS f g).hom.app F ≫ h) =
      (MorphismOfTopoi.comp (smallToposMorphism B S hS g)
          (smallToposMorphism B S hS f)).adj.homEquiv F G h ≫
        (smallToposMorphism_comp B S hS f g).hom.app G

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.spacesBaseChange_comp_inv_assoc
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03G2, part (2), associativity.**  The base-change composition isomorphisms of the
spaces-étale sites obey the associativity cocycle law.  This is the cocycle law for
`CategoryTheory.Over.pullbackComp`, restricted to the objects étale over the base.
declarations.statement:
theorem spacesBaseChange_comp_inv_assoc (f : V ⟶ W) (g : W ⟶ X) (h : X ⟶ Y)
    (U : SpacesEtale B S hS Y) :
    (spacesBaseChange_comp B S hS (f ≫ g) h).inv.app U ≫
        (spacesBaseChange_comp B S hS f g).inv.app
          ((spacesBaseChange B S hS h).functor.obj U) =
      (spacesBaseChange_comp B S hS f (g ≫ h)).inv.app U ≫
        (spacesBaseChange B S hS f).functor.map
          ((spacesBaseChange_comp B S hS g h).inv.app U)
declarations.comment: part (2), associativity of the composition isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallToposMorphismTypeU_comp_assoc
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03G2, part (3), associativity.**  The composition isomorphisms of the direct images
of the small étale topoi obey the associativity cocycle law.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallToposMorphismTypeU_comp_assoc (f : V ⟶ W) (g : W ⟶ X) (h : X ⟶ Y)
    (M : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS V.1) (Type u)) :
    (smallToposMorphismTypeU B S hS h).pushforward.map
          ((smallToposMorphismTypeU_comp B S hS f g).hom.app M) ≫
        (smallToposMorphismTypeU_comp B S hS (f ≫ g) h).hom.app M =
      (smallToposMorphismTypeU_comp B S hS g h).hom.app
          ((smallToposMorphismTypeU B S hS f).pushforward.obj M) ≫
        (smallToposMorphismTypeU_comp B S hS f (g ≫ h)).hom.app M
declarations.comment: part (3), associativity of the composition isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallToposMorphism
declarations.doc:
The morphism of small étale topoi induced by a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces: the
morphism of spaces-étale topoi of the base-change morphism of sites, transported along the
comparison equivalences `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtaleToposEquiv`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def smallToposMorphism {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    MorphismOfTopoi
      (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) (Type (u + 1)))
      (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1) (Type (u + 1)))
declarations.comment: part (3), morphism of small étale topoi

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallToposMorphism_comparison
declarations.doc:
The small étale direct image agrees, through the comparison equivalences, with the direct
image of the spaces-étale morphism of sites.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def smallToposMorphism_comparison {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ((comparisonFunctor B S hS X).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (u + 1))
          (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS X)) ⋙
        (smallToposMorphism B S hS f).pushforward ≅
      ((spacesBaseChange B S hS f).functor.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (u + 1))
          (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS Y) (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS X)) ⋙
        (comparisonFunctor B S hS Y).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (u + 1))
          (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1) (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS Y)
declarations.comment: part (3), comparison with the spaces-étale topoi

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallToposMorphism_comp
declarations.doc:
The small étale direct image is compatible with composition: the composite of the morphisms
of topoi of `f` and `g` has the same direct image as the morphism of topoi of `f ≫ g`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def smallToposMorphism_comp {X Y Z : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    (MorphismOfTopoi.comp (smallToposMorphism B S hS g)
        (smallToposMorphism B S hS f)).pushforward ≅
      (smallToposMorphism B S hS (f ≫ g)).pushforward

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallToposMorphism_comp_inverseImage
declarations.doc:
The inverse-image composition isomorphism, oriented for pullback of sheaves:
`(f ≫ g)⁻¹ ≅ g⁻¹ ⋙ f⁻¹`. It is the adjoint mate of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallToposMorphism_comp`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def smallToposMorphism_comp_inverseImage {X Y Z : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    (smallToposMorphism B S hS (f ≫ g)).inverseImage ≅
      (smallToposMorphism B S hS g).inverseImage ⋙
        (smallToposMorphism B S hS f).inverseImage

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.spacesBaseChange_comp_assoc
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03G2, part (2).** The composition isomorphism of spaces-étale base change is
associative: for `f : X ⟶ Y`, `g : Y ⟶ Z` and `h : Z ⟶ W` the two ways of identifying the
threefold iterated base change with base change along `f ≫ g ≫ h` — first contracting `g` and
`h`, or first contracting `f` and `g` — agree.

This is the coherence that makes `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.spacesBaseChange_comp` a genuine
compatibility of base change with composition, and it is the spaces-étale analogue of
`CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.overMapPullback_assoc`.
declarations.statement:
theorem spacesBaseChange_comp_assoc {W X Y Z : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (h : Z ⟶ W) :
    Functor.isoWhiskerRight (spacesBaseChange_comp B S hS g h)
          (spacesBaseChange B S hS f).functor ≪≫ spacesBaseChange_comp B S hS f (g ≫ h) =
      Functor.associator _ _ _ ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (spacesBaseChange B S hS h).functor
          (spacesBaseChange_comp B S hS f g) ≪≫
        spacesBaseChange_comp B S hS (f ≫ g) h ≪≫
        eqToIso (congrArg (fun k => (spacesBaseChange B S hS k).functor)
          (Category.assoc f g h))
declarations.comment: part (2), associativity of the composition isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallToposMorphism_comp_assoc
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03G2, part (3).** The direct-image composition isomorphism of the morphisms of small
étale topoi is associative: for `f : X ⟶ Y`, `g : Y ⟶ Z` and `h : Z ⟶ W` the two ways of
identifying the threefold composite of direct images with the direct image of `f ≫ g ≫ h` agree.

This is the coherence that makes the construction of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallToposMorphism` "compatible with compositions" in the sense of part
(3) of the tag, rather than merely equipped with composition isomorphisms.  It is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.spacesBaseChange_pushforward_comp_assoc'` transported along the comparison
equivalences of Stacks 03G1 by
`MorphismOfTopoi.transport_comp_pushforward_comp_assoc`.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallToposMorphism_comp_assoc {W X Y Z : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (g : Y ⟶ Z) (h : Z ⟶ W) :
    Functor.isoWhiskerRight (smallToposMorphism_comp B S hS f g)
          (smallToposMorphism B S hS h).pushforward ≪≫
        smallToposMorphism_comp B S hS (f ≫ g) h ≪≫
        eqToIso (congrArg (fun k => (smallToposMorphism B S hS k).pushforward)
          (Category.assoc f g h)) =
      Functor.associator _ _ _ ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (smallToposMorphism B S hS f).pushforward
          (smallToposMorphism_comp B S hS g h) ≪≫
        smallToposMorphism_comp B S hS f (g ≫ h)
declarations.comment: part (3), associativity of the composition isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.spacesBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03G2, part (1).** The canonical base-change datum on the spaces-étale sites: the
base change `CategoryTheory.Over.pullback f` of the slice over `Y`, restricted to the objects
étale over the base, with the first projection of the fibre product.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def spacesBaseChange {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    SpacesBaseChange B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.spacesBaseChange_isMorphismOfSites
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03G2, part (1).** Base change defines a morphism of sites in the direction
`X → Y`: it is continuous, the spaces-étale site of `Y` has a terminal object and fibre
products, and base change preserves both.
declarations.statement:
theorem spacesBaseChange_isMorphismOfSites {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (spacesBaseChange B S hS f).functor.IsMorphismOfSites
      (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS Y) (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS X)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.spacesBaseChange_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03G2, part (2).** Base change along a composite is canonically isomorphic to the
iterated base change, by `CategoryTheory.Over.pullbackComp` restricted to the objects étale
over the base.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def spacesBaseChange_comp {X Y Z : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    (spacesBaseChange B S hS g).functor ⋙ (spacesBaseChange B S hS f).functor ≅
      (spacesBaseChange B S hS (f ≫ g)).functor

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.spacesBaseChange_comp_projection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03G2, part (2).** The composition isomorphism is compatible with the cartesian
projections to the original object, which pins it down.
declarations.statement:
theorem spacesBaseChange_comp_projection {X Y Z : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (g : Y ⟶ Z) (V : SpacesEtale B S hS Z) :
    ((spacesBaseChange_comp B S hS f g).hom.app V).hom.left ≫
        (spacesBaseChange B S hS (f ≫ g)).projection.app V =
      (spacesBaseChange B S hS f).projection.app
          ((spacesBaseChange B S hS g).functor.obj V) ≫
        (spacesBaseChange B S hS g).projection.app V

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FMap
declarations.doc:
A map of sections along a morphism of algebraic spaces, natural under simultaneous étale
restriction of the source and target charts.
declarations.statement:
structure FMap (P : (SmallEtale B S hS F)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v)
    (Q : (SmallEtale B S hS G)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type w)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chartCorrespondence
declarations.doc:
The *chart correspondence* of a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces: a bijection
between the `f`-maps from a sheaf of sets `Q` on the small étale site of `Y` to a sheaf of sets
`P` on the small étale site of `X`, and the homomorphisms from `Q` into the direct image of `P`
along `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtaleRingedToposHom`, satisfying the sectionwise
characterization `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsChartCorrespondence`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def chartCorrespondence (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (P : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) (Type u))
    (Q : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1) (Type u)) :
    { e : FMap B S hS X.1 Y.1 f.hom P.obj Q.obj ≃
        (Q ⟶ (smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS f).toToposHom.pushforward.obj P) //
      IsChartCorrespondence B S hS f P Q e }
declarations.comment: f-maps are exactly maps into the direct image

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.fmapInverseImageEquiv
declarations.doc:
`f`-maps from `Q` to `P` are exactly homomorphisms from the inverse image of `Q` into `P`,
the inverse image being that of `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtaleRingedToposHom`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def fmapInverseImageEquiv (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (P : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) (Type u))
    (Q : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1) (Type u)) :
    FMap B S hS X.1 Y.1 f.hom P.obj Q.obj ≃
      ((smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS f).toToposHom.inverseImage.obj Q ⟶ P)
declarations.comment: f-maps are exactly maps out of the inverse image

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.fMapEquivPushforwardHom
declarations.doc:
A map on sections over every commutative pair of étale scheme charts over `f` is
equivalently a map of sheaves into the small étale direct image.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def fMapEquivPushforwardHom :
    FMap B S hS X.1 Y.1 f.hom F.obj G.obj ≃
      (G ⟶ (smallToposMorphism B S hS f).pushforward.obj F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.fMapEquivInverseImageHom
declarations.doc:
A map on sections over every commutative pair of étale scheme charts over `f` is
equivalently a map of sheaves out of the small étale inverse image. The bijection is the
composite of `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.fMapEquivPushforwardHom` with the adjunction bijection of
the morphism of small étale topoi.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def fMapEquivInverseImageHom :
    FMap B S hS X.1 Y.1 f.hom F.obj G.obj ≃
      ((smallToposMorphism B S hS f).inverseImage.obj G ⟶ F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.fMapEquivPushforwardHom_chart
declarations.doc:
The bijection `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.fMapEquivPushforwardHom` is the canonical one.
Transport a sheaf `F` on the small étale site of `X` through an isomorphism with the restriction
of a spaces-étale sheaf `H`; then on a diagram `d` of étale scheme charts over `f` the transported
`f`-map is restriction of the section of the direct image along any arrow from the chart of `X`
into the cartesian base change of the chart of `Y` whose composite with the cartesian projection
is the Yoneda morphism of the vertical morphism of `d`.
declarations.statement:
theorem fMapEquivPushforwardHom_chart
    (H : Sheaf (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS X) (Type (u + 1)))
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) (Type (u + 1)))
    (i : F ≅ (comparisonRestriction B S hS X).obj H)
    (G : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1) (Type (u + 1)))
    (ξ : FMap B S hS X.1 Y.1 f.hom F.obj G.obj)
    (d : ChartDiagram B S hS X.1 Y.1 f.hom)
    (h : (comparisonFunctor B S hS X).obj d.U ⟶ chartBaseChange B S hS f d.V)
    (hh : ((SpacesEtale.toSpaces B S hS X).map h ≫
        (spacesBaseChange B S hS f).projection.app
          ((comparisonFunctor B S hS Y).obj d.V)).hom = yoneda.map d.g)
    (s : G.obj.obj (op d.V)) :
    let ψ : G ⟶ (spacesDirectImageRestriction B S hS f).obj H :=
      fMapEquivPushforwardHom B S hS f F G ξ ≫
        (smallToposMorphism B S hS f).pushforward.map i.hom ≫
        (smallToposMorphism_comparison B S hS f).hom.app H
    (((sheafToPresheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1)
      (Type (u + 1))).map i.hom).app (op d.U)) (ξ.app d s) =
      H.obj.map h.op
        (((sheafToPresheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1)
          (Type (u + 1))).map ψ).app (op d.V) s)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.structurePresheaf_isSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03G6.** Global regular functions form a sheaf of commutative rings on the small
étale site of an algebraic space.

Stated with 03G6's own hypotheses, in their original binder order, so that dependent results apply
it positionally; the hypothesis is discarded, and `structurePresheaf_isSheaf'` is the general
statement.
declarations.statement:
theorem structurePresheaf_isSheaf (_hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS F) (structurePresheaf B S hS F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.structureSheaf
declarations.doc:
The structure sheaf of commutative rings on the small étale site of the algebraic space `F`.

Stated with 03G6's own hypotheses, in their original binder order, so that a ringed site built on
it applies this positionally; `structureSheaf'` is the general form, and the two are equal by
`rfl`.
declarations.statement:
def structureSheaf (_hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) :
    Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS F) CommRingCat.{u}
declarations.comment: the structure sheaf of an algebraic space

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pushforwardAlgebraIdAlgebraIso
declarations.doc:
**The direct image of `𝒪_Y` along the identity of `Y` is `𝒪_Y`, as an `𝒪_Y`-algebra**, with
no anti-equivalence and no hypothesis.

`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pushforwardAlgebra` of a morphism is its structure map read as an
algebra structure, so this is the identity clause of Stacks 03G8 — the structure map of an
identity is an isomorphism, `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_fSharp_id` — read through
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.AlgebraSheaf.ofHomIso`: the inverse of that structure map carries it to
the identity of `𝒪_Y`, which is the structure map of `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.unitAlgebra`.

This is the isomorphism that `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pushforwardAlgebraIdIso` of
`StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Spaces.DirectImageAlgebraFactorization` obtains from an assumed
anti-equivalence and that
`StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Spaces.RelativeSpecDirectImage` carries as the hypothesis
`hid`.
declarations.statement:
def pushforwardAlgebraIdAlgebraIso (Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) :
    pushforwardAlgebra B S hS (Over.mk (𝟙 Y)) ≅ unitAlgebra B S hS Y
declarations.comment: the identity clause at the level of algebras: (𝟙_Y)_* 𝒪_Y is 𝒪_Y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_fSharp_id
declarations.doc:
**The identity clause of Stacks 03G8:** the structure map of the morphism of small étale
ringed topoi of `𝟙 : A ⟶ A` is an isomorphism `𝒪_A ≅ (𝟙_A)_* 𝒪_A`.

On underlying sheaves of sets this is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.structureSharpSet_id`, which
identifies the structure map of an identity with the canonical comparison
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtaleDirectImageIdIso` of the direct image along an identity with
the identity functor; forgetting the ring operations reflects isomorphisms, so the
`CommRingCat`-valued structure map is invertible too.
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_structureSharp_id` is the same statement for the `RingCat`-valued
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.structureSharp`, which is not the map that
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pushforwardAlgebra` is built from.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_fSharp_id (A : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) :
    IsIso (smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS (𝟙 A)).fSharp
declarations.comment: the identity clause: the structure map of an identity is an isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtaleRingedToposHom
declarations.doc: The morphism of small étale ringed topoi induced by a morphism of algebraic spaces.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def smallEtaleRingedToposHom (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    RingedToposHom (smallEtaleRingedTopos B S hS X) (smallEtaleRingedTopos B S hS Y)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtaleRingedToposHom_pushforward
declarations.doc: The underlying geometric morphism of `smallEtaleRingedToposHom`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def smallEtaleRingedToposHom_pushforward (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ((comparisonFunctor B S hS X).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
          (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS X)) ⋙
        (smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS f).toToposHom.pushforward ≅
      ((spacesBaseChange B S hS f).functor.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
          (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS Y) (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS X)) ⋙
        (comparisonFunctor B S hS Y).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
          (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1) (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS Y)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtaleRingedToposHom_representable
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03G8.** For a representable morphism of algebraic spaces the geometric direct
image of `smallEtaleRingedToposHom` is base change of étale scheme charts.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def smallEtaleRingedToposHom_representable (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f.hom) :
    letI := (smallBaseChange_isMorphismOfSites B S hS f hf).toIsContinuous
    (smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS f).toToposHom.pushforward ≅
      (smallBaseChange B S hS f hf).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
        (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1) (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.structureSharp_comp_chartProjectionSharpDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03G8, part (2), for a representable morphism of algebraic spaces.** The structure
map `f♯ : 𝒪_Y ⟶ f_*𝒪_X` of Stacks 03G8, followed by the identification
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chartProjectionSharpDirectImage` of the sections of `f_*𝒪_X` over an
étale chart `V` of `Y` with the regular functions on the scheme `X ×_Y V`, is pullback of
regular functions along the cartesian projection `X ×_Y V ⟶ V` — which is the structure map of
the morphism of small étale ringed sites of Stacks 070R, part (2).
declarations.statement:
theorem structureSharp_comp_chartProjectionSharpDirectImage (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f.hom) :
    letI := isContinuous_smallBaseChange B S hS f hf
    structureSharp B S hS f ≫ chartProjectionSharpDirectImage B S hS f hf =
      cartesianProjectionSharp B S hS f hf
declarations.comment: part (2): the structure map is pullback along the cartesian projection

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.fSharp_comp_chartProjectionSharpDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03G8, part (2), for a representable morphism of algebraic spaces, on the morphism
of ringed topoi.** The structure map `f♯` of the morphism of small étale ringed topoi of
Stacks 03G8, read on sheaves of not necessarily commutative rings and followed by the
identification of the sections of `f_*𝒪_X` over an étale chart `V` of `Y` with the regular
functions on `X ×_Y V`, is pullback of regular functions along the cartesian projection
`X ×_Y V ⟶ V`.
declarations.statement:
theorem fSharp_comp_chartProjectionSharpDirectImage (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f.hom) :
    letI := isContinuous_smallBaseChange B S hS f hf
    (sheafCompose (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1)
            (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).map
          (smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS f).fSharp ≫
        chartProjectionSharpDirectImage B S hS f hf =
      cartesianProjectionSharp B S hS f hf
declarations.comment: part (2): the same for the structure map of the morphism of ringed topoi

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.cartesianProjectionSharpCommRing_eq_changeOfSites
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03G8, part (2).** For a morphism of schemes, `f♯` of the space construction *is*
the structure-sheaf homomorphism of Stacks 070R: the small étale site of the representable
algebraic space `yoneda.obj T` is a site of schemes over `T` through
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.schemeChartToOver`, and over that presentation the map
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.cartesianProjectionSharpCommRing` — which
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.structureSharp_comp_chartProjectionSharpDirectImage` identifies with
`f♯` — is `AlgebraicGeometry.ChangeOfSites.structureSharp`, the structure-sheaf homomorphism of
a change-of-topologies morphism of sites, formed with the cartesian projections.
declarations.statement:
theorem cartesianProjectionSharpCommRing_eq_changeOfSites :
    letI := isContinuous_smallBaseChange B S hS (representedSpaceMap B S hS g) hg
    cartesianProjectionSharpCommRing B S hS (representedSpaceMap B S hS g) hg =
      AlgebraicGeometry.ChangeOfSites.structureSharp
        (SmallEtale.topology B S hS (yoneda.obj T))
        (SmallEtale.topology B S hS (yoneda.obj T'))
        (schemeChartToOver B S hS T) (schemeChartToOver B S hS T')
        (smallBaseChange B S hS (representedSpaceMap B S hS g) hg)
        (cartesianProjection B S hS (representedSpaceMap B S hS g) hg)
        (schemeChart_structure_isSheaf B S hS T)
        (schemeChart_structure_isSheaf B S hS T')
declarations.comment: part (2): for a morphism of schemes this is the Stacks 070R structure map

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.structureSharp_representedSpaceMap_eq_changeOfSites
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03G8, part (2).** For a morphism of schemes `g : T' ⟶ T` over `S` the structure
map `f♯ : 𝒪_Y ⟶ f_*𝒪_X` of Stacks 03G8, followed by the canonical identification
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chartProjectionSharpDirectImage` of the sections of `f_*𝒪_{T'}` over an
étale chart `V` of `T` with the regular functions on the scheme `T' ×_T V`, *is* the structure
map of Stacks 070R: the map `AlgebraicGeometry.ChangeOfSites.structureSharp` of the
change-of-topologies morphism of sites given by base change of étale charts, formed with the
cartesian projections `T' ×_T V ⟶ V`.

The identification is an isomorphism, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_chartProjectionSharpDirectImage`, so this is an equality of the
two structure maps and not merely a factorization.
declarations.statement:
theorem structureSharp_representedSpaceMap_eq_changeOfSites :
    letI := isContinuous_smallBaseChange B S hS (representedSpaceMap B S hS g)
      (relativelyRepresentable_yoneda_map B S hS g)
    (sheafCompose (SmallEtale.topology B S hS (yoneda.obj T))
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).map
        (AlgebraicGeometry.ChangeOfSites.structureSharp
          (SmallEtale.topology B S hS (yoneda.obj T))
          (SmallEtale.topology B S hS (yoneda.obj T'))
          (schemeChartToOver B S hS T) (schemeChartToOver B S hS T')
          (smallBaseChange B S hS (representedSpaceMap B S hS g)
            (relativelyRepresentable_yoneda_map B S hS g))
          (cartesianProjection B S hS (representedSpaceMap B S hS g)
            (relativelyRepresentable_yoneda_map B S hS g))
          (schemeChart_structure_isSheaf B S hS T)
          (schemeChart_structure_isSheaf B S hS T')) =
      structureSharp B S hS (representedSpaceMap B S hS g) ≫
        chartProjectionSharpDirectImage B S hS (representedSpaceMap B S hS g)
          (relativelyRepresentable_yoneda_map B S hS g)
declarations.comment: part (2): for a morphism of schemes, f♯ is the structure map of Stacks 070R

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtaleRingedToposHom_comp_fSharp
declarations.doc:
The structure map of the composite morphism of small étale ringed topoi, followed by the
comparison of the direct images of sheaves of commutative rings, is the structure map of the
composite morphism of algebraic spaces.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallEtaleRingedToposHom_comp_fSharp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    ((smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS g).comp
        (smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS f)).fSharp ≫
        (smallEtaleRingedToposHom_compRingIso B S hS f g).hom.app
          (smallEtaleRingedTopos B S hS X).O =
      (smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS (f ≫ g)).fSharp

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_compRingIso_isCartesianComposition_comp_fSharp
declarations.doc:
There is an isomorphism between the direct images of sheaves of commutative rings of the
composite of morphisms of ringed topoi and of the composite morphism of algebraic spaces which is
induced by cartesian composition and carries the structure map of the composite to the structure
map of the composite morphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_compRingIso_isCartesianComposition_comp_fSharp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    ∃ i : pushforwardCommRingFunctor.{u, u, u, u + 1, u, u + 1}
        ((smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS g).comp
          (smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS f)).toToposHom ≅
      pushforwardCommRingFunctor.{u, u, u, u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS (f ≫ g)).toToposHom,
      IsCartesianComposition B S hS f g i ∧
        ((smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS g).comp
            (smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS f)).fSharp ≫
            i.hom.app (smallEtaleRingedTopos B S hS X).O =
          (smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS (f ≫ g)).fSharp
declarations.comment: existence of the cartesian ring comparison

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.structureProjectionOfHom_comp
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 03G8], compatibility with composition, at the level of modules.**  For
`f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z` the canonical morphism `𝒪_Z ⟶ (f ≫ g)_*𝒪_X` of `𝒪_Z`-modules is the
canonical morphism `𝒪_Z ⟶ g_*𝒪_Y` of `g`, followed by the direct image along `g` of the
canonical morphism `𝒪_Y ⟶ f_*𝒪_X` of `f`, followed by the composition comparison
`g_*(f_*𝒪_X) ⟶ (f ≫ g)_*𝒪_X` of direct images of [Stacks Project, Tag 03LU].

The proof is the transposed one: by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.structureProjectionOfHom_eq_homEquiv_structureModulePullbackMap` each
of the three canonical morphisms is a transpose along the adjunction of
[Stacks Project, Tag 03D7], the composition law for the comparison of inverse images is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.structureModulePullbackMap_comp`, and transposing the resulting
composite is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.homEquiv_modulePullbackCompIso_inv_app_comp` followed by
the two naturalities of `CategoryTheory.Adjunction.homEquiv`.
declarations.statement:
theorem structureProjectionOfHom_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    structureProjectionOfHom B S hS (f ≫ g) =
      structureProjectionOfHom B S hS g ≫
        (modulePushforward B S hS g).map (structureProjectionOfHom B S hS f) ≫
        (modulePushforwardCompIso B S hS f g).hom.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit (structureRingSheaf B S hS X))
declarations.comment: compatibility with composition at the level of modules

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_structureProjectionOfHom
declarations.doc:
**The canonical morphism `𝒪_Y ⟶ e_*𝒪_X` of modules of an isomorphism `e` of algebraic spaces
is invertible.**

Its underlying morphism of sheaves of sets is the structure map `e.hom♯`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.moduleSheafFunctor_map_structureProjectionOfHom`), which is invertible
by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_structureSharpSet`, and the underlying-sheaf functor reflects
isomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_structureProjectionOfHom (e : X ≅ Y) :
    IsIso (structureProjectionOfHom B S hS e.hom)
