**Stacks 03I2.** Let `S` be a scheme contained in a big fppf site and let `P` be a property
of morphisms of schemes which is preserved by arbitrary base change, is fppf local on the base,
and is such that morphisms with `P` satisfy descent for fppf coverings. Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a
morphism of presheaves on the big fppf site of `S` with `X` a sheaf and `Y` an algebraic space
over `S`, and suppose some surjective étale chart `g : yoneda.obj U ⟶ Y` of `Y` makes the base
change of `f` representable with `P`. Then `X` is an algebraic space over `S`, and `f` is
representable and has `P`.

The three conclusions of the source are the two conjuncts: the second,
`(P.inverseImage _).presheaf f`, is representability of `f` together with `P` for every
represented base change of it.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpace_and_presheaf_of_surjectiveEtaleChart
    {P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}} [P.IsStableUnderBaseChange]
    [P.IsLocalAtTarget Scheme.fppfPrecoverage]
    (hP : SatisfiesDescent.{u, 0} P Scheme.fppfPrecoverage)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) {f : X ⟶ Y}
    {U : BigFppfOver B S hS} {g : yoneda.obj U ⟶ Y}
    (hs : (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
      (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) g)
    (he : (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
      (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) g)
    (hV : (P.inverseImage (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf (pullback.snd f g)) :
    IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X ∧
      (P.inverseImage (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isAlgebraicSpace_extend
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03I4 (3).** Extension along a morphism `g : S ⟶ S'` of a big fppf site carries
algebraic spaces over `S` to algebraic spaces over `S'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpace_extend
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S S' : B.Schemes) (g : S ⟶ S')
    {L : Sheaf (B.topology.over S) (Type u) ⥤
      Sheaf (B.topology.over S') (Type u)}
    (adj : L ⊣ (Over.map g).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
      (B.topology.over S) (B.topology.over S'))
    (F : (BigFppfOver B (B.inclusion.obj S) S.property)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B (B.inclusion.obj S) S.property F) :
    IsAlgebraicSpace B (B.inclusion.obj S') S'.property
      (L.obj (⟨F, hF.isSheaf⟩ : Sheaf (B.topology.over S) (Type u))).obj

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_relocalizeOfRestricted
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03I4 (1).** For a morphism `g : S ⟶ S'` of a big fppf site and a sheaf `F` on the big
fppf site of `S`, the canonical map from the presheaf of pairs of a factorization `T' → S → S'` and
a section of `F` over it to the extension `j_!F` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_relocalizeOfRestricted
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S S' : B.Schemes) (g : S ⟶ S')
    {L : Sheaf (B.topology.over S) (Type u) ⥤
      Sheaf (B.topology.over S') (Type u)}
    (adj : L ⊣ (Over.map g).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
      (B.topology.over S) (B.topology.over S'))
    (F : Sheaf (B.topology.over S) (Type u)) :
    IsIso (OverShriek.relocalizeOfRestricted g (adj.unit.app F).hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.extend_representable
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03I4.** Extension along `g : S ⟶ S'` carries a sheaf represented by `X / S` to
one represented by `X / S'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem extend_representable
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S S' : B.Schemes) (g : S ⟶ S')
    {L : Sheaf (B.topology.over S) (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf (B.topology.over S') (Type u)}
    (adj : L ⊣ (Over.map g).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
      (B.topology.over S) (B.topology.over S'))
    (X : Over S) (F : Sheaf (B.topology.over S) (Type u))
    (hF : Nonempty (F.obj ≅ yoneda.obj X)) :
    Nonempty (((L.obj F).obj) ≅ yoneda.obj ((Over.map g).obj X))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrict_representable
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03I4.** Restricting a sheaf represented by `X' / S'` along `g : S ⟶ S'` gives a
sheaf represented by the fibre product `S ×_{S'} X' / S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrict_representable
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S S' : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) (hS' : B.Contains S')
    (g : B.obj hS ⟶ B.obj hS')
    (X' : BigFppfOver B S' hS')
    (F' : Sheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S' hS') (Type u))
    (hF' : Nonempty (F'.obj ≅ yoneda.obj X')) :
    ∃ (Xbase : BigFppfOver B S hS)
      (p : Xbase.left ⟶ X'.left),
        IsPullback (B.inclusion.map p) (B.inclusion.map Xbase.hom)
          (B.inclusion.map X'.hom) (B.inclusion.map g) ∧
          Nonempty
            (((((Over.map g).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
              (B.topology.over (B.obj hS)) (B.topology.over (B.obj hS'))).obj F').obj) ≅
                yoneda.obj Xbase)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrict_eval
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03I4, part (4): evaluation of a restricted sheaf.** Let `g : S ⟶ S'` be a morphism of
a big fppf site, let `j = Over.map g` be the associated localization functor and let `F'` be a
sheaf on the big fppf site over `S'`. For an object `T / S`, the sections of `j^{-1}F'` over
`T / S` are the sections of `F'` over `T / S'`, that is over `T` with structure morphism the
composite `T ⟶ S ⟶ S'`.

Restriction along a continuous functor is precomposition, so this is the instance of
`CategoryTheory.Functor.sheafPushforwardContinuous_obj_obj_obj` for `j`; it is recorded here to
state the clause for the big fppf site, with `T / S'` written as the composite structure
morphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrict_eval
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S S' : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) (hS' : B.Contains S')
    (g : B.obj hS ⟶ B.obj hS')
    (F' : Sheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S' hS') (Type u))
    (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) :
    (((Over.map g).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
        (B.topology.over (B.obj hS)) (B.topology.over (B.obj hS'))).obj F').obj.obj
          (Opposite.op T) = F'.obj.obj (Opposite.op (Over.mk (T.hom ≫ g)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_extended_presentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03I4, part (3): the extension of a presentation.** A chosen étale presentation `U / R`
of an algebraic space `F` over `S` extends along `g : S ⟶ S'` to a presentation of `L F` by the
images `j U` and `j R` of `U` and `R`, where `j = Over.map g`.

The data produced is the identification `α : L h_U ≅ h_{j U}` of the extension of the representable
`h_U`, and the extended atlas `f : h_{j U} ⟶ L F`, which is `L` of the original atlas read through
`α`.  Its kernel pair is the pair of images `j` of the two projections of `R`; those two make `j R`
an étale equivalence relation on `j U` over `S'`; `f` is surjective and étale after every
representable base change; and `f` exhibits `L F` as the coequalizer of its kernel pair in sheaves
over `S'`.

The quotient is specified by this universal property rather than by a sheafification, so that no
smallness hypothesis on sheafification is needed on either slice.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_extended_presentation
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S S' : B.Schemes) (g : S ⟶ S')
    {L : Sheaf (B.topology.over S) (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf (B.topology.over S') (Type u)}
    (adj : L ⊣ (Over.map g).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
      (B.topology.over S) (B.topology.over S'))
    (F : (BigFppfOver B (B.inclusion.obj S) S.property)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B (B.inclusion.obj S) S.property F)
    (P : Presentation B (B.inclusion.obj S) S.property F hF) :
    let J := B.topology.over S
    let J' := BigFppfOver.topology B (B.inclusion.obj S') S'.property
    let FF : Sheaf J (Type u) := ⟨F, hF.isSheaf⟩
    let G := (L.obj FF).obj
    let target := (Over.map g).map P.target
    let source := (Over.map g).map P.source
    ∃ (hU : Presheaf.IsSheaf J (yoneda.obj P.U))
      (hU' : Presheaf.IsSheaf J' (yoneda.obj ((Over.map g).obj P.U)))
      (hR' : Presheaf.IsSheaf J' (yoneda.obj ((Over.map g).obj P.R)))
      (α : (L.obj (⟨yoneda.obj P.U, hU⟩ : Sheaf J (Type u))).obj ≅
        yoneda.obj ((Over.map g).obj P.U))
      (f : yoneda.obj ((Over.map g).obj P.U) ⟶ G)
      (hpb : IsPullback (yoneda.map target) (yoneda.map source) f f),
      let UF : Sheaf J' (Type u) := ⟨yoneda.obj ((Over.map g).obj P.U), hU'⟩
      let RF : Sheaf J' (Type u) := ⟨yoneda.obj ((Over.map g).obj P.R), hR'⟩
      let tf : RF ⟶ UF := ⟨yoneda.map target⟩
      let sf : RF ⟶ UF := ⟨yoneda.map source⟩
      let ff : UF ⟶ L.obj FF := ⟨f⟩
      let w : tf ≫ ff = sf ≫ ff := Sheaf.hom_ext hpb.w
      Stacks.Groupoids.IsEtaleEquivalenceRelation
        (prod.lift ((Over.post B.inclusion).map target)
          ((Over.post B.inclusion).map source)) ∧
      f = α.inv ≫ (L.map (⟨P.toSpace⟩ :
        (⟨yoneda.obj P.U, hU⟩ : Sheaf J (Type u)) ⟶ FF)).hom ∧
      (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B (B.inclusion.obj S') S'.property))) f ∧
      (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B (B.inclusion.obj S') S'.property))) f ∧
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofork.ofπ ff w))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.baseChangePresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03I4, part (6).** The restriction along `g : S ⟶ S'` of a presentation `U'/R'` of an
algebraic space `F'` over `S'` is again a presentation, of the restriction `j⁻¹F' = F'|_S`: the
presenting scheme and its relation are the base changes `U'_S = (Over.pullback g).obj U'` and
`R'_S = (Over.pullback g).obj R'` along `g`, with projections the images under `Over.pullback g`
of the original ones, and atlas the restriction of the original atlas read through
`CategoryTheory.OverShriek.restrictYonedaIso`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def baseChangePresentation
    {F' : (BigFppfOver B S' hS')ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type w} {hF' : IsAlgebraicSpace B S' hS' F'}
    (P' : Space.Presentation B S' hS' F' hF') :
    Space.Presentation B S hS ((OverShriek.relocalizeRestrict g).obj F')
      (isAlgebraicSpace_relocalizeRestrict B S S' hS hS' g F' hF')

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isAlgebraicSpace_relocalizeRestrict
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03I5, part (1), algebraicity.** The restriction of an algebraic space over `S'` along
a morphism `g : S ⟶ S'` of a big fppf site is an algebraic space over `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpace_relocalizeRestrict
    (F' : (BigFppfOver B S' hS')ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type w) (hF' : IsAlgebraicSpace B S' hS' F') :
    IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS ((OverShriek.relocalizeRestrict g).obj F')

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isAlgebraicSpace_viewOver
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03I5, part (2), algebraicity.** An algebraic space over `S`, viewed over `S'` along
the lower-shriek extension of a morphism `g : S ⟶ S'` of the site, is an algebraic space over
`S'`.

This is Stacks 03I4 part (3) (`AlgebraicGeometry.isAlgebraicSpace_extend`) for the left adjoint
`AlgebraicGeometry.relocalizeSheafFunctor`, whose value on a sheaf is the presheaf-level extension
itself.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpace_viewOver
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) :
    IsAlgebraicSpace B S' hS' ((OverShriek.relocalizePresheafFunctor g).obj F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.presheaf_property_map_base_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03I6.** Let `g : S ⟶ S'` be a morphism of a big fppf site and let `P` be a property
of morphisms of schemes stable under base change. For an algebraic space `F` over `S` and a
morphism `f : h_T ⟶ F` from the representable algebraic space of an object `T` of the big fppf
site of `S`, the morphism `P`-property of representable base changes holds for the image of `f`
under the forward functor of Stacks 04SG exactly when it holds for `f`.
declarations.statement:
theorem presheaf_property_map_base_iff
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S S' : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S) (hS' : B.Contains S')
    (g : B.obj hS ⟶ B.obj hS') (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) [P.IsStableUnderBaseChange]
    (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (F : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ F.obj) :
    MorphismProperty.presheaf (P.inverseImage (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S' hS'))
        ((spacesOverSmallerBaseFunctor B S S' hS hS' g).map
          (ObjectProperty.homMk f :
            (schemeSpace T : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) ⟶
              F)).hom.left ↔
      MorphismProperty.presheaf (P.inverseImage (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)) f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsDecentSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03I8, decent.** An algebraic space over `S` is *decent* when every one of its
points satisfies the equivalent conditions of Stacks 03JV, taken here in the form of
condition (4): a quasi-compact monomorphism from the spectrum of a field.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsDecentSpace : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsReasonableSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03I8, reasonable.** An algebraic space over `S` is *reasonable* when it
satisfies the equivalent conditions of Stacks 03JT, taken here in the form of condition (2):
every étale chart of it by an affine scheme has universally bounded fibres.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsReasonableSpace : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsVeryReasonableSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03I8, very reasonable.** An algebraic space over `S` is *very reasonable* when
it satisfies the equivalent conditions of Stacks 03IH, taken here in the form of condition
(2), which is property `(ε)` of Stacks 03JX: there is a jointly surjective family of étale
charts by schemes whose two self-intersection projections are quasi-compact.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsVeryReasonableSpace : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.AffineLineTranslation.not_isDecentSpace_translationQuotient
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ID.** The quotient of the affine line over a field of characteristic zero by
the integer translations is not a decent algebraic space: the point of the quotient
represented by the generic point of the line has no monomorphic field-valued
representative.
declarations.statement:
theorem not_isDecentSpace_translationQuotient (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharZero k]
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (hS : B.Contains (Spec (.of k)))
    (hG : B.Contains (Spec (.of (RatFunc k))))
    [HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.topology B (Spec (.of k)) hS) (Type u)] :
    ¬ Space.IsDecentSpace B (Spec (.of k)) hS
      (translationQuotient k B hS (contains_affineLine k B hS))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.factorsThrough_openSubspace_iff_points
declarations.doc:
A morphism of algebraic spaces factors through an open subspace if and only
if its map on points has image in the point set of that subspace.
declarations.statement:
theorem factorsThrough_openSubspace_iff_points
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (U : Subfunctor X) (hU : IsOpenSubspace B S hS U)
    (f : Y ⟶ X) :
    (∃ g : Y ⟶ U.toFunctor, g ≫ U.ι = f) ↔
      (Set.range (pointsMap B S hS Y f) ⊆
        Set.range (pointsMap B S hS U.toFunctor U.ι))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isVeryReasonableSpace_iff_exists_isZariskiCover_quasiCompact_chart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03IH.** An algebraic space over `S` is very reasonable — it has a jointly
surjective family of étale charts by schemes whose two self-intersection projections are
quasi-compact — if and only if it has a Zariski covering by open subspaces each of which
carries a quasi-compact surjective étale chart by a scheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem isVeryReasonableSpace_iff_exists_isZariskiCover_quasiCompact_chart
    (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) :
    IsVeryReasonableSpace B S hS X ↔
      ∃ (I : Type u) (Xᵢ : I → Subfunctor X), IsZariskiCover B S hS I Xᵢ ∧
        ∃ (U : I → BigFppfOver B S hS) (φ : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (U i) ⟶ (Xᵢ i).toFunctor),
          ∀ i, IsEtale B S hS (φ i) ∧
            Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (φ i) ∧
            IsQuasiCompact B S hS (φ i)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.locallyQuasiFinite_of_etale
declarations.doc: An étale morphism of schemes is locally quasi-finite.
declarations.statement:
theorem locallyQuasiFinite_of_etale {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [Etale f] :
    LocallyOfFiniteType f ∧ LocallyQuasiFinite f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.flat_and_generalizingMap_of_etale
declarations.doc: An étale morphism of schemes is flat, and hence generalizations lift along it.
declarations.statement:
theorem flat_and_generalizingMap_of_etale {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [Etale f] :
    Flat f ∧ GeneralizingMap f.base

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.finite_preimage_singleton_of_etale_of_quasiCompact
declarations.doc:
A quasi-compact étale morphism of schemes has finite fibres.

It is locally quasi-finite, hence quasi-finite as it is quasi-compact.
declarations.statement:
theorem finite_preimage_singleton_of_etale_of_quasiCompact {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Etale f] [QuasiCompact f] (s : S) : (f.base ⁻¹' {s}).Finite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.discreteTopology_fiber
declarations.doc: Every scheme-theoretic fibre of an étale morphism is a discrete space.
declarations.statement:
theorem discreteTopology_fiber {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Etale f] (s : S) : DiscreteTopology (f.fiber s)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.unramified_of_etale
declarations.doc: An étale morphism of schemes is unramified.
declarations.statement: theorem unramified_of_etale {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [Etale f] : Unramified f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.etale_iff_iso_coproduct_spectra_finite_separable
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03PC (over a field).** A morphism to the spectrum of a field is
étale if and only if its source is, over that spectrum, a coproduct of spectra of finite
separable field extensions.
declarations.statement:
public theorem etale_iff_iso_coproduct_spectra_finite_separable
    (k : Type u) [Field k] {U : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ Spec (.of k)) :
    Etale f ↔
      ∃ (I : Type u) (K : I → Type u) (_ : ∀ i, Field (K i))
        (_ : ∀ i, Algebra k (K i)) (_ : ∀ i, Module.Finite k (K i))
        (_ : ∀ i, Algebra.IsSeparable k (K i))
        (e : U ≅ ∐ fun i ↦ Spec (.of (K i))),
        e.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun i ↦ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (K i)))) = f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.finite_fiber_pointsMap_of_etale_presentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03IJ, the fibres of the presenting scheme.** An étale morphism `φ : h_U ⟶ X` of
presheaves on the big fppf site of `S` out of a representable presheaf whose self-fibre-product
projections are quasi-compact in the sense of Stacks 03HE has finite fibres on points.

Any point of a fibre of `|U| → |X|` and a fixed point of that fibre are the two projections of
a point of the relation, so the fibre is the image of a fibre of the first projection of the
relation.
declarations.statement:
theorem finite_fiber_pointsMap_of_etale_presentation
    (hφ : IsEtale B S hS φ) (hs : IsQuasiCompact B S hS (pullback.fst φ φ))
    (_ht : IsQuasiCompact B S hS (pullback.snd φ φ)) (x : points B S hS X) :
    (pointsMap B S hS (yoneda.obj U) φ ⁻¹' {x}).Finite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.finite_fiber_selfPullback_pointsMap_of_etale_presentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03IJ, the fibres of the relation scheme.** Under the same hypotheses the relation
`h_U ×_X h_U` has finite fibres on points over `X`.

A fibre of `|R| → |X|` is the union, over the finitely many points of the corresponding fibre
of `|U| → |X|`, of the fibres of `|R| → |U|`.
declarations.statement:
theorem finite_fiber_selfPullback_pointsMap_of_etale_presentation
    (hφ : IsEtale B S hS φ) (hs : IsQuasiCompact B S hS (pullback.fst φ φ))
    (ht : IsQuasiCompact B S hS (pullback.snd φ φ)) (x : points B S hS X) :
    (pointsMap B S hS (pullback φ φ) (pullback.fst φ φ ≫ φ) ⁻¹' {x}).Finite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_iso_yoneda_spec_of_isDecentSpace_of_etale_fieldSpec
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03IK.** Let `S` be a scheme, let `k` be a field and let `F` be an
algebraic space over `S` admitting a surjective étale morphism from the spectrum of `k`. If `F`
is decent then `F` is represented by the spectrum of a field `k'` over `S`, with `k` a finite
separable extension of `k'`, and under that identification the given morphism is the one induced
by the extension `k/k'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_iso_yoneda_spec_of_isDecentSpace_of_etale_fieldSpec
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    (hdecent : IsDecentSpace B S hS F)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (hk : B.Contains (Spec (.of k))) (b : Spec (.of k) ⟶ S)
    (f : yoneda.obj (Over.mk (⟨b⟩ : B.obj hk ⟶ B.obj hS)) ⟶ F)
    (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS f)
    (hetale : (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
      (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf f) :
    ∃ (k' : Type u) (_ : Field k') (_ : Algebra k' k) (_ : Module.Finite k' k)
      (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable k' k) (hk' : B.Contains (Spec (.of k')))
      (b' : Spec (.of k') ⟶ S),
      ∃ (hbase : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k' k)) ≫ b' = b)
        (e : F ≅ yoneda.obj (Over.mk (⟨b'⟩ : B.obj hk' ⟶ B.obj hS))),
        f ≫ e.hom = yoneda.map (Over.homMk
          (ObjectProperty.homMk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k' k))) :
            B.obj hk ⟶ B.obj hk') (by
              apply ObjectProperty.hom_ext
              simpa using hbase))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_specialization_lift_of_isDecentSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03IL.** Let `X` be a decent algebraic space over a scheme `S` and let `x, x'` be
points of `|X|` with `x' ⤳ x`, that is, `x` a specialization of `x'`. Then for every étale
`φ : h_U ⟶ X` with `U` an object of the site and every point `p` of `|U|` above `x` there is a
point `p' ⤳ p` of `|U|` above `x'`.

This is the source's "combine 03JX and 03K2": decency is condition (4) of Stacks 03JV at
every point, which gives condition (1) at `x'` by, in this namespace,
`HasQuasiCompactMonomorphicFieldRepresentative.hasFiniteFibresOnEveryAffineEtaleChart`, and
that is the hypothesis of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_specialization_lift_of_finite_etale_fibers`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_specialization_lift_of_isDecentSpace
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hXdec : IsDecentSpace B S hS X) (x x' : points B S hS X) (hs : x' ⤳ x)
    (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (φ : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X)
    (hφ : (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
      (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) φ)
    (p : points B S hS (yoneda.obj U)) (hp : pointsMap B S hS (yoneda.obj U) φ p = x) :
    ∃ p' : points B S hS (yoneda.obj U),
      p' ⤳ p ∧ pointsMap B S hS (yoneda.obj U) φ p' = x'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_of_specializes_of_pointsMap_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03IM.** Let `X` be an algebraic space over `S` and let `x` be a point of `X`
above which every étale chart of `X` by an affine scheme has a finite fibre, which is
condition (2) of Stacks 03JS for the pair `(X, x)`. If two points `u` and `u'` of an étale
scheme chart of `X` both lie above `x` and `u` is a specialization of `u'`, then `u = u'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_of_specializes_of_pointsMap_eq {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (x : points B S hS X)
    (hfinite : ∀ V : BigFppfOver B S hS, IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj V) →
      ∀ ψ : yoneda.obj V ⟶ X, (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf ψ →
      (pointsMap B S hS (yoneda.obj V) ψ ⁻¹' {x}).Finite)
    (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (φ : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X)
    (hφ : (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
      (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf φ)
    (u u' : points B S hS (yoneda.obj U))
    (hu : pointsMap B S hS (yoneda.obj U) φ u = x)
    (hu' : pointsMap B S hS (yoneda.obj U) φ u' = x)
    (hs : u' ⤳ u) : u = u'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isQuasicoherentOnSite_idealZeroLocus_eq
declarations.doc:
**Every closed set of points of an algebraic space is the zero locus of a quasi-coherent
sheaf of ideals.**
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isQuasicoherentOnSite_idealZeroLocus_eq (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (T : Set (points B S hS X.1)) (hT : IsClosed T) :
    ∃ I : (SheafOfModules.unit (structureRingSheaf B S hS X)).Submodule,
      I.toSheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherentOnSite ∧ idealZeroLocus B S hS X I = T
declarations.comment: a section, not a lemma: a closed set is cut out by a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.reducedClosedSubspace
declarations.doc:
**The reduced closed subspace of an algebraic space supported on a closed set of
points**, as data rather than as a choice of a witness to an existence statement.

It is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.reducedClosedSubspaceOfChart` at a chart chosen from the
atlas clause of the algebraic-space hypothesis. The choice is of a chart, which the
hypothesis provides; it is not a choice of the subspace, and by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_reducedClosedSubspaceOfChart` the result does not depend on it.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def reducedClosedSubspace (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (T : Set (points B S hS X)) (hT : IsClosed T) : Subfunctor X
declarations.comment: the subspace itself, on a closed set of points

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.range_pointsMap_ι_reducedClosedSubspace
declarations.doc: **The point set of the reduced closed subspace is the closed set one started with.**
declarations.statement:
theorem range_pointsMap_ι_reducedClosedSubspace (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (T : Set (points B S hS X)) (hT : IsClosed T) :
    Set.range (pointsMap B S hS (reducedClosedSubspace B S hS X hX T hT).toFunctor
      (reducedClosedSubspace B S hS X hX T hT).ι) = T
declarations.comment: property (a): the point set of the subspace is the given closed set

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasEtaleLocalProperty_isReduced_reducedClosedSubspace
declarations.doc: **The reduced closed subspace is reduced**, in the étale-local sense of Stacks 03E6.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasEtaleLocalProperty_isReduced_reducedClosedSubspace
    (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (T : Set (points B S hS X)) (hT : IsClosed T) :
    HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS (reducedClosedSubspace B S hS X hX T hT).toFunctor
      (fun Y : Scheme.{u} => IsReduced Y)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isClosedSubspace_reducedClosedSubspace
declarations.doc:
**The reduced closed subspace is a closed subspace**, unconditionally: the inclusion of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.reducedClosedSubspace` into `X` is representable and a closed immersion
after every representable base change.

This is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isClosedSubspace_reducedClosedSubspace_of_closedImmersionDescent` with
its hypothesis discharged by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEffectiveDescentAlongSurjectiveEtale_isClosedImmersion`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isClosedSubspace_reducedClosedSubspace
    (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (T : Set (points B S hS X)) (hT : IsClosed T) :
    IsClosedSubspace B S hS (reducedClosedSubspace B S hS X hX T hT)
declarations.comment: property (c): the subspace is a closed subspace

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_reducedClosedSubspace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03IQ, uniqueness, unconditionally.** A closed subspace of an algebraic space
which is étale-locally reduced and has a given set of points is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.reducedClosedSubspace`.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_reducedClosedSubspace (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (T : Set (points B S hS X)) (hT : IsClosed T) (W : Subfunctor X)
    (hWc : IsClosedSubspace B S hS W)
    (hWT : Set.range (pointsMap B S hS W.toFunctor W.ι) = T)
    (hWr : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS W.toFunctor (fun Y : Scheme.{u} => IsReduced Y)) :
    W = reducedClosedSubspace B S hS X hX T hT

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.existsUnique_reducedClosedSubspace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03IQ**: a closed subset of the points of an algebraic space carries a unique
reduced closed subspace structure, with no hypothesis.

Uniqueness is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_reducedClosedSubspace`, the witness is the
datum `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.reducedClosedSubspace`, and the closed-subspace clause of
existence is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isClosedSubspace_reducedClosedSubspace`, whose own
descent hypothesis is discharged by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEffectiveDescentAlongSurjectiveEtale_isClosedImmersion`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_reducedClosedSubspace
    (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (T : Set (points B S hS X)) (hT : IsClosed T) :
    ∃! Z : Subfunctor X,
      IsClosedSubspace B S hS Z ∧
        Set.range (pointsMap B S hS Z.toFunctor Z.ι) = T ∧
          HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS Z.toFunctor (fun Y : Scheme.{u} => IsReduced Y)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.existsUnique_reducedClosedSubspace'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03IQ.** A closed subset of the set of points of an algebraic space over `S`
carries a unique reduced closed subspace structure: there is exactly one subfunctor of `X`
which is a closed subspace, has that closed set as its set of points, and is étale-locally
reduced.

The witness is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.reducedClosedSubspace`, which is constructed explicitly.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_reducedClosedSubspace' (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (T : Set (points B S hS X)) (hT : _root_.IsClosed T) :
    ∃! Z : Subfunctor X,
      IsClosedSubspace B S hS Z ∧
        Set.range (pointsMap B S hS Z.toFunctor Z.ι) = T ∧
          HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS Z.toFunctor (fun Y : Scheme.{u} => IsReduced Y)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isOpenMap_pointsMap_of_isEtale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03IR.** An étale morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over `S` induces an
open map `|X| → |Y|` on the point sets of Tag 03BU, for the topology of Tag 03BX.

The hypothesis `_hG` that the target is an algebraic space is retained from the source
statement but is not used: only an étale chart of the source enters the argument.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpenMap_pointsMap_of_isEtale (f : F ⟶ G) (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    (_hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G) (hf : IsEtale B S hS f) :
    @IsOpenMap _ _ (pointTopology B S hS F) (pointTopology B S hS G)
      (pointsMap B S hS F f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.universallyClosed_pullback
declarations.doc:
A base change of a universally closed morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is universally
closed.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.universallyClosed_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03IT.** For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over `S` the following are
equivalent: `f` is universally closed; the base change of `f` along every morphism to `Y` from
a presheaf represented by an object of the site is closed; the same for the objects with affine
underlying scheme; the base change of `f` along some surjective étale morphism to `Y` from a
represented presheaf is universally closed; and there is a Zariski covering of `Y` along each
member of which the base change of `f` is universally closed.

Algebraicity of the source is retained from the source statement and is not used.
declarations.statement:
theorem universallyClosed_tfae (_hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    List.TFAE
      [UniversallyClosed B S hS f,
        ∀ (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ Y),
          IsClosedMorphism B S hS (pullback.fst g f),
        ∀ (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ Y),
          IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Z) →
            IsClosedMorphism B S hS (pullback.fst g f),
        ∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y),
          IsSurjective B S hS g ∧ IsEtale B S hS g ∧
            UniversallyClosed B S hS (pullback.fst g f),
        ∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → Subfunctor Y) (_ : IsZariskiCover B S hS I U),
          ∀ i, UniversallyClosed B S hS (pullback.fst (U i).ι f)]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isClosedMorphism_comp
declarations.doc: A composition of closed morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is closed.
declarations.statement:
theorem isClosedMorphism_comp {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (hf : IsClosedMorphism B S hS f)
    (hg : IsClosedMorphism B S hS g) :
    IsClosedMorphism B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.universallyClosed_comp
declarations.doc:
A composition of universally closed morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is universally
closed.
declarations.statement:
theorem universallyClosed_comp {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (hf : UniversallyClosed B S hS f)
    (hg : UniversallyClosed B S hS g) :
    UniversallyClosed B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.AffineLineTranslation.structureMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03IV.** The structure morphism of the quotient `𝔸¹_k/ℤ` of Stacks 02Z7, the unique
morphism to the terminal object `Spec k` of the big fppf site over `Spec k`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def structureMap :
    translationQuotient k B hS hU ⟶ yoneda.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 (B.obj hS)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.AffineLineTranslation.universallyClosed_structureMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03IV.** For a field `k` of characteristic zero the structure morphism of the
quotient `𝔸¹_k/ℤ` of Stacks 02Z7 to `Spec k` is universally closed.

The source calls this a strange example because the quotient is, by Stacks 02Z7, an algebraic
space which is not a scheme. The statement needs no hypothesis beyond characteristic zero — in
particular none of the effective fppf descent of Stacks 0265, which the representability of the
quotient's chart does need.
declarations.statement:
theorem universallyClosed_structureMap [CharZero k] :
    Space.UniversallyClosed B (Spec (.of k)) hS (structureMap k B hS hU)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ValuativeCriterion.Uniqueness
declarations.doc: There is at most one extension of a compatible generic point to any valuation ring.
declarations.statement: public def Uniqueness (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ValuativeCriterion.Existence
declarations.doc:
A compatible generic point extends after a field extension and passage to a
dominating valuation ring.
declarations.statement: public def Existence (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ValuativeCriterion
declarations.doc: A morphism satisfies both parts of the valuative criterion.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev ValuativeCriterion
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.valuativeCriterion_uniqueness_of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03IY, uniqueness part.** The base change of a morphism of algebraic spaces
satisfying the uniqueness part of the valuative criterion satisfies it again.

Two lifts of a valuative square for the base change `b` agree after composing with `a`, by
uniqueness for `p` applied to the induced valuative square, and after composing with `b`,
because both are lifts; so they agree.
declarations.statement:
theorem valuativeCriterion_uniqueness_of_isPullback
    {F G F' G' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    {a : F ⟶ F'} {b : F ⟶ G} {p : F' ⟶ G'} {q : G ⟶ G'} (sq : IsPullback a b p q)
    (hp : ValuativeCriterion.Uniqueness p) : ValuativeCriterion.Uniqueness b

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.valuativeCriterion_existence_of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03IY, existence part.** The base change of a morphism of algebraic spaces
satisfying the existence part of the valuative criterion satisfies it again.

A valuative square for the base change `b` induces one for `p`; a dominating extension and a
lift there, together with the bottom edge pushed along the extension, define a map into the
fibre product by the universal property of the cartesian square, and that map is a lift of
the dominating extension of the original square.
declarations.statement:
theorem valuativeCriterion_existence_of_isPullback
    {F G F' G' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    {a : F ⟶ F'} {b : F ⟶ G} {p : F' ⟶ G'} {q : G ⟶ G'} (sq : IsPullback a b p q)
    (hp : ValuativeCriterion.Existence p) : ValuativeCriterion.Existence b

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.valuativeCriterionExistence_comp
declarations.doc: The existence part of the valuative criterion is preserved under composition.
declarations.statement:
public theorem valuativeCriterionExistence_comp
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : ValuativeCriterion.Existence f)
    (hg : ValuativeCriterion.Existence g) :
    ValuativeCriterion.Existence (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.valuativeCriterion_uniqueness_comp
declarations.doc: Uniqueness of lifts in valuative squares is stable under composition.
declarations.statement:
public lemma valuativeCriterion_uniqueness_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : ValuativeCriterion.Uniqueness f)
    (hg : ValuativeCriterion.Uniqueness g) :
    ValuativeCriterion.Uniqueness (f ≫ g)

registrations.name: IsNowhereDense.image_val
registrations.comment: nowhere dense subsets of a subspace

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_dense_open_isSeparated
declarations.doc: A quasi-compact scheme has a separated dense open subscheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_dense_open_isSeparated (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] :
    ∃ V : X.Opens, Dense (V : Set X) ∧ Scheme.IsSeparated V

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isNowhereDense_image_of_quasiFinite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03J2.** The image of a closed nowhere dense subset under a quasi-finite
morphism of schemes is nowhere dense.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNowhereDense_image_of_quasiFinite {Y X : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [LocallyQuasiFinite f] [QuasiCompact f] (T : Set Y)
    (hT_closed : IsClosed T) (hT_nowhereDense : IsNowhereDense T) :
    IsNowhereDense (f.base '' T)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BoundsFiberDegrees
declarations.doc:
An integer bounds the degrees of the fibres of `f` if each fibre is finite locally free of
some rank no greater than that integer.
declarations.statement: public abbrev BoundsFiberDegrees {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℤ) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.HasUniversallyBoundedFibers
declarations.doc: The fibres of `f` are universally bounded if their degrees have a common integer bound.
declarations.statement: public abbrev HasUniversallyBoundedFibers {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.cardinalMk_pullback_le_of_degree_le
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03J5.** If all field-valued base changes of a morphism are finite of
degree at most `n`, then each of them has at most `n` points.
declarations.statement:
theorem cardinalMk_pullback_le_of_degree_le
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] (g : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Y),
      ∃ r ≤ n, Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank (pullback.fst g f) r) :
    ∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] (g : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Y),
      Cardinal.mk (pullback g f : Scheme.{u}) ≤ n

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.sum_finrank_residueField_le_of_degree_le
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03J5.** In a field-valued base change whose degree is uniformly bounded
by `n`, the sum of the residue degrees at any finite family of distinct points is at most `n`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem sum_finrank_residueField_le_of_degree_le
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] (g : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Y),
      ∃ r ≤ n, Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank (pullback.fst g f) r) :
    ∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] (g : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Y) {t : ℕ}
      (x : Fin t → (pullback g f : Scheme.{u})), Function.Injective x →
      (∑ i,
        letI := ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (pullback.fst g f).appTop ≫
          (pullback g f).Γevaluation (x i)).hom.toAlgebra
        Module.finrank k ((pullback g f).residueField (x i))) ≤ n

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.hasUniversallyBoundedFibers_of_boundsFiberDegrees
declarations.doc:
A common integer bound on the degrees of the fibres makes those fibres universally
bounded.
declarations.statement:
public lemma hasUniversallyBoundedFibers_of_boundsFiberDegrees {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (n : ℤ) (h : BoundsFiberDegrees f n) : HasUniversallyBoundedFibers f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.boundsFiberDegrees_iff_field_baseChange
declarations.doc:
An integer bounds the degrees of the fibres of a morphism of schemes exactly when each of its
base changes to the spectrum of a field is finite locally free of a rank bounded by that
integer.
declarations.statement:
theorem boundsFiberDegrees_iff_field_baseChange {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℤ) :
    BoundsFiberDegrees f n ↔
      ∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] (g : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Y),
        ∃ r : ℕ, (r : ℤ) ≤ n ∧
          Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank (pullback.fst g f) r

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.boundsFiberDegrees_iff_field_baseChange_of_nonneg
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03J5.** A nonnegative integer bounds the degrees of the fibres of a
scheme morphism exactly when every field-valued base change is finite locally free of rank at
most that integer.

The nonnegativity hypothesis is the source's and is not used, so it is named `_hn`; the form
without it is `AlgebraicGeometry.boundsFiberDegrees_iff_field_baseChange`, in
`StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Morphisms.FibreDimension.UniversallyBoundedBaseChange`.
declarations.statement:
theorem boundsFiberDegrees_iff_field_baseChange_of_nonneg
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℤ) (_hn : 0 ≤ n) :
    BoundsFiberDegrees f n ↔
      ∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] (g : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Y),
        ∃ r : ℕ, (r : ℤ) ≤ n ∧
          Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank (pullback.fst g f) r

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.boundsFiberDegrees_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03J6.** If a nonnegative integer `n` bounds the degrees of the fibres of
`f` and an integer `m` bounds the degrees of the fibres of `g`, then `n * m` bounds the degrees of
the fibres of the composite `f ≫ g`.
declarations.statement:
theorem boundsFiberDegrees_comp {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (n m : ℤ)
    (hn : 0 ≤ n) (hf : BoundsFiberDegrees f n) (hg : BoundsFiberDegrees g m) :
    BoundsFiberDegrees (f ≫ g) (n * m)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.hasUniversallyBoundedFibers_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03J6.** A composition of morphisms with universally bounded fibres has
universally bounded fibres.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasUniversallyBoundedFibers_comp {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : HasUniversallyBoundedFibers f) (hg : HasUniversallyBoundedFibers g) :
    HasUniversallyBoundedFibers (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.boundsFiberDegrees_isStableUnderBaseChange
declarations.doc:
Every integer bound on the degrees of the fibres of a morphism
of schemes is preserved by arbitrary base change.
declarations.statement:
instance boundsFiberDegrees_isStableUnderBaseChange (n : ℤ) :
    MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange
      (fun {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) ↦ BoundsFiberDegrees f n)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.boundsFiberDegrees_of_isPullback_of_surjective
declarations.doc:
Let `f'` be a base change of `f` along a surjective morphism. An integer bounding the degrees
of the fibres of `f'` also bounds the degrees of the fibres of `f`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.hasUniversallyBoundedFibers_of_isPullback_of_surjective
declarations.doc:
Let `f'` be a base change of `f` along a surjective morphism. If `f'` has universally bounded
fibres, then so does `f`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.hasUniversallyBoundedFibers_of_isImmersion
declarations.doc:
An immersion of schemes has universally bounded fibres; the integer one bounds the degrees of
its fibres.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasUniversallyBoundedFibers_of_isImmersion {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsImmersion f] : HasUniversallyBoundedFibers f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.hasUniversallyBoundedFibers_of_locallyQuasiFinite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JA.** A locally quasi-finite morphism of finite type whose source is quasi-compact
has universally bounded fibres.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasUniversallyBoundedFibers_of_locallyQuasiFinite {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [LocallyQuasiFinite f] [CompactSpace X] :
    HasUniversallyBoundedFibers f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.boundsFiberDegrees_of_comp_of_surjective_flat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03JB**, the precise form. If `f` is surjective and flat, then an
integer bounding the degrees of the fibres of `f ≫ h` also bounds the degrees of the fibres
of `h`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem boundsFiberDegrees_of_comp_of_surjective_flat {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z) [Surjective f] [Flat f] (n : ℤ)
    (hbound : BoundsFiberDegrees (f ≫ h) n) :
    BoundsFiberDegrees h n

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.hasUniversallyBoundedFibers_of_comp_of_surjective_flat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03JB.** If `f` is surjective and flat and the fibres of `f ≫ h` are
universally bounded, then so are the fibres of `h`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem hasUniversallyBoundedFibers_of_comp_of_surjective_flat {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z) [Surjective f] [Flat f]
    (hbound : HasUniversallyBoundedFibers (f ≫ h)) :
    HasUniversallyBoundedFibers h

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isInvariantOpen_largestTargetOpen_source
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03JC.** For a groupoid scheme whose source and target maps are
coverings for one of the five topologies, the largest open of the object scheme over which the
source map has a target-local property is invariant.
declarations.statement:
theorem isInvariantOpen_largestTargetOpen_source {S : Scheme.{u}} (G : GroupoidScheme S)
    (P Q : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
    (hQ : (Q = (@IsOpenImmersion : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})) ∨ IsDescentMorphismClass Q)
    [P.IsLocalAtTarget (Scheme.precoverage Q)]
    (hs : Presieve.ofArrows (fun _ : Unit => G.arrows.left)
      (fun _ => G.source.left) ∈ Scheme.precoverage Q G.objects.left)
    (ht : Presieve.ofArrows (fun _ : Unit => G.arrows.left)
      (fun _ => G.target.left) ∈ Scheme.precoverage Q G.objects.left) :
    IsInvariantOpen G (largestTargetOpen P G.source.left)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidScheme.exists_invariant_affine_open_of_orbit_subset_affine
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03JE.** In a groupoid scheme with finite locally free source and
target maps, a point whose orbit is contained in an affine open has an invariant affine open
neighbourhood.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_invariant_affine_open_of_orbit_subset_affine {S : Scheme.{u}}
    (G : Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme S)
    [Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFree G.source.left]
    [Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFree G.target.left] (x : G.objects.left)
    (h : ∃ W : G.objects.left.Opens, IsAffineOpen W ∧
      ∀ r : G.arrows.left, G.source.left.base r = x → G.target.left.base r ∈ W) :
    ∃ V : G.objects.left.Opens, IsAffineOpen V ∧ x ∈ V ∧ IsInvariantOpen G V

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidScheme.exists_isInvariantOpen_isAffineOpen_mem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03JE.** Let `(U, R, s, t, c)` be a groupoid scheme with `s` and `t`
finite locally free, and let `u` be a point of `U` whose equivalence class `t(s⁻¹({u}))` is
contained in an affine open of `U`. Then `u` has an `R`-invariant affine open neighbourhood in
`U`.

The neighbourhood is the nonvanishing locus of the norm along `s` of the pullback along `t` of a
function cutting the class of `u` out of an invariant open inside the given affine open; see the
implementation notes.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isInvariantOpen_isAffineOpen_mem
    [IsFiniteLocallyFree G.source.left] [IsFiniteLocallyFree G.target.left]
    (u : G.objects.left)
    (hu : ∃ W : G.objects.left.Opens, IsAffineOpen W ∧
      G.target.left.base '' (G.source.left.base ⁻¹' {u}) ⊆ (W : Set G.objects.left)) :
    ∃ V : G.objects.left.Opens, IsInvariantOpen G V ∧ IsAffineOpen V ∧ u ∈ V

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isGreatest_isOpenSubspace_isRepresentable
registrations.comment: a largest open subspace which is a scheme

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.denseRange_schematicLocus_of_isZariskiLocallyQuasiSeparatedOver
registrations.comment: density of the schematic locus for quasi-separated spaces

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isOpenSubspace_and_isRepresentable_schematicLocus_of_isAlgebraicSpace
declarations.doc:
The schematic locus of an algebraic space over `S` is an open subspace and is
representable.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpenSubspace_and_isRepresentable_schematicLocus_of_isAlgebraicSpace
    {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) :
    IsOpenSubspace B S hS (schematicLocus B S hS X) ∧
      (schematicLocus B S hS X).toFunctor.IsRepresentable

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isGreatest_isOpenSubspace_isRepresentable
declarations.doc:
An algebraic space `X` over a scheme `S` has a largest open subspace which is a scheme: the
set of open subspaces of `X` that are represented by a scheme over `S` has a greatest element.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isGreatest_isOpenSubspace_isRepresentable
    {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) :
    ∃ X' : Subfunctor X, IsGreatest
      {G : Subfunctor X | IsOpenSubspace B S hS G ∧ G.toFunctor.IsRepresentable} X'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.mem_range_pointsMap_schematicLocus_iff
declarations.doc:
A point of a presheaf lies in the point set of the schematic locus of Tag 03JH exactly
when it lies in the point set of one representable open subspace.

The schematic locus is the supremum of the representable open subspaces, and the supremum of
subfunctors is the object-wise union, so a field-valued point of it takes its value in one
member of the family.
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_range_pointsMap_schematicLocus_iff
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (y : points B S hS F) :
    y ∈ Set.range (pointsMap B S hS (schematicLocus B S hS F).toFunctor
        (schematicLocus B S hS F).ι) ↔
      ∃ G : Subfunctor F, IsOpenSubspace B S hS G ∧ G.toFunctor.IsRepresentable ∧
        y ∈ Set.range (pointsMap B S hS G.toFunctor G.ι)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.schematicLocus
declarations.doc:
The schematic locus of `F`: the union of all open subspaces of `F` which are represented
by a scheme over `S`.
declarations.statement: def schematicLocus (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) : Subfunctor F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.le_schematicLocus
declarations.doc:
Every open subspace which is represented by a scheme over `S` is contained in the
schematic locus.
declarations.statement:
theorem le_schematicLocus (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (G : Subfunctor F)
    (hG : IsOpenSubspace B S hS G) (hGrep : G.toFunctor.IsRepresentable) :
    G ≤ schematicLocus B S hS F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_denseRange_isRepresentable_isOpenSubspace_of_isReasonableSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JI.** The schematic locus of a reasonable algebraic space is dense: a reasonable
algebraic space `X` over a scheme `S` has a representable open subspace whose point set is dense
in `|X|`.

Reasonableness is condition (2) of Stacks 03JT, so Stacks 03JT in the form
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_boundedEtaleCover_of_isReasonableSpace` gives a jointly
surjective family of étale charts `φ i` by affine schemes with universally bounded fibres. No
member of the family is surjective, so the corollary does not apply to `X` directly. Replacing
`X` by the open subspace `X i` swept out by `φ i` — Stacks 06NF — makes the induced chart
`ψ i : h_{U i} ⟶ X i` surjective, and the bound passes from `φ i` to `ψ i` because `(X i).ι` is
a monomorphism. The corollary then gives in each `X i` a representable open subspace `L i` with
dense point set.

Stacks 03JH, in the form
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_denseRange_isRepresentable_isOpenSubspace_of_isAlgebraicSpace`,
reduces the conclusion to finding a nonempty representable open subspace inside every nonempty
open subspace `G` of `X`. The point sets of the `X i` cover `|X|`, so some `|X i|` meets `|G|`;
the preimage of `|G|` in `|X i|` is then a nonempty open set, which by density meets `|L i|`. So
`|G| ∩ |L i|` is nonempty, and the open subspace of `X` it cuts out is contained in `G` and
contained in `L i`, hence representable by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRepresentable_of_le_of_isRepresentable`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_denseRange_isRepresentable_isOpenSubspace_of_isReasonableSpace
    {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hreasonable : IsReasonableSpace B S hS X) :
    ∃ G : Subfunctor X, IsOpenSubspace B S hS G ∧ G.toFunctor.IsRepresentable ∧
      DenseRange (pointsMap B S hS G.toFunctor G.ι)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_lift_closedSubspace_iff_pointsMap_range_subset
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JJ.** A morphism from a reduced algebraic space factors through a closed
subspace if and only if its image on underlying points lies in that closed subspace.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_lift_closedSubspace_iff_pointsMap_range_subset (B : BigFppfSite.{u})
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (Z : Subfunctor X) (hZ : IsClosedSubspace B S hS Z)
    (hred : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS Y (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsReduced T))
    (f : Y ⟶ X) :
    (∃ g : Y ⟶ Z.toFunctor, g ≫ Z.ι = f) ↔
      Set.range (pointsMap B S hS Y f) ⊆ Set.range (pointsMap B S hS Z.toFunctor Z.ι)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasUniversallyBoundedFibers
declarations.doc:
A scheme morphism to a presheaf has universally bounded fibres if every field-valued
base change is represented by a finite scheme and all their degrees have one integer bound.
declarations.statement:
abbrev HasUniversallyBoundedFibers (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (U : BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (f : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasUniversallyBoundedFibers_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JM.** Let `X` be a presheaf on the big fppf site of `S`, let `f : V ⟶ U` be a
morphism of schemes over `S` and let `g : U ⟶ X` be a morphism over `S`. If the fibres of `f`
and of `g` are universally bounded, then so are the fibres of the composite `V ⟶ X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasUniversallyBoundedFibers_comp
    {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} {V U : BigFppfOver B S hS}
    (f : V ⟶ U) (g : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X)
    (hf : HasUniversallyBoundedFibers B S hS V (yoneda.map f))
    (hg : HasUniversallyBoundedFibers B S hS U g) :
    HasUniversallyBoundedFibers B S hS V (yoneda.map f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasUniversallyBoundedFibers_baseChange
declarations.doc:
A representable base change of a scheme morphism with universally bounded fibres
is represented by a scheme whose fibres remain universally bounded.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasUniversallyBoundedFibers_baseChange
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (g : Y ⟶ X) (hg : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable g)
    (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X)
    (hf : HasUniversallyBoundedFibers B S hS U f) :
    ∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS)
      (i : yoneda.obj V ⟶ yoneda.obj U) (p : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y),
      IsPullback i p f g ∧ HasUniversallyBoundedFibers B S hS V p

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasUniversallyBoundedFibers_of_baseChange_of_range_subset
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JO.** Let `g : Y ⟶ X` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`, let
`f : h_U ⟶ X` be a morphism from a scheme over `S`, and let `h_V ⟶ Y` be a base change of `f`
along `g`. If the image of `|h_U| → |X|` is contained in the image of `|Y| → |X|` and the
fibres of `h_V ⟶ Y` are universally bounded, then the fibres of `f` are universally
bounded, with the same bound.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasUniversallyBoundedFibers_of_baseChange_of_range_subset
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {U : BigFppfOver B S hS} (f : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X)
    (himage : Set.range (pointsMap B S hS (yoneda.obj U) f) ⊆
      Set.range (pointsMap B S hS Y g))
    {V : BigFppfOver B S hS} {i : yoneda.obj V ⟶ yoneda.obj U} {p : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y}
    (hcart : IsPullback i p f g) (hp : HasUniversallyBoundedFibers B S hS V p) :
    HasUniversallyBoundedFibers B S hS U f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasUniversallyBoundedFibers_of_comp_of_surjective_flat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JP.** Let `X` be an algebraic space over `S`, let `U ⟶ V` be a morphism of
schemes over `S` and let `V ⟶ X` be a morphism over `S`. If the fibres of the composite
`U ⟶ X` are universally bounded and `U ⟶ V` is surjective and flat, then the fibres of
`V ⟶ X` are universally bounded, with the same bound.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasUniversallyBoundedFibers_of_comp_of_surjective_flat
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    {U V : BigFppfOver B S hS} (φ : U ⟶ V) (h : yoneda.obj V ⟶ X)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.Surjective ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map φ)]
    [AlgebraicGeometry.Flat ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map φ)]
    (hU : HasUniversallyBoundedFibers B S hS U (yoneda.map φ ≫ h)) :
    HasUniversallyBoundedFibers B S hS V h

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.cardinalMk_pointFiber_le_of_hasUniversallyBoundedFibers
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JQ.** If the fibres of a morphism `f : h_U ⟶ X` from a represented presheaf
are universally bounded, then one natural number bounds the number of points of `|h_U|`
lying above each point of `|X|`.
declarations.statement:
theorem cardinalMk_pointFiber_le_of_hasUniversallyBoundedFibers
    (hf : HasUniversallyBoundedFibers B S hS U f) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ x : points B S hS X,
      Cardinal.mk (pointsMap B S hS (yoneda.obj U) f ⁻¹' {x}) ≤ (n : Cardinal)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_etaleCover_finite_fibre_iff_forall_affine_etale
declarations.doc:
For a point `x` of an algebraic space `X` over `S`, the following are equivalent: some
jointly locally surjective family of étale charts of `X` has finite fibres above `x`, and every
étale chart of `X` by an affine scheme has a finite fibre above `x`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etaleCover_finite_fibre_iff_forall_affine_etale (B : BigFppfSite.{u})
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S) (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (x : points B S hS X) :
    (∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → BigFppfOver B S hS) (φ : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (U i) ⟶ X),
      Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (Sigma.desc φ) ∧
      ∀ i, (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) (φ i) ∧
        (pointsMap B S hS (yoneda.obj (U i)) (φ i) ⁻¹' {x}).Finite) ↔
    (∀ U : BigFppfOver B S hS, IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U) →
      ∀ φ : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X, (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) φ →
        (pointsMap B S hS (yoneda.obj U) φ ⁻¹' {x}).Finite)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.finite_chartFibre_of_etaleCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JS, part (1) implies part (2).** If some family of étale charts of an algebraic
space `F` over `S` whose coproduct is surjective has finite chart fibres above a point `x` of
`|F|`, then every étale chart of `F` with affine source has a finite chart fibre above `x`.

The family is used only through joint surjectivity on points, which is what surjectivity of the
coproduct gives by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_pointsMap_eq_of_isSurjective_sigmaDesc`, and
affineness of the chart is used only through quasi-compactness of its underlying scheme; the
general statement is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.finite_chartFibre_of_jointlySurjective`.
declarations.statement:
theorem finite_chartFibre_of_etaleCover
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) {x : points B S hS F}
    {I : Type u} {V : I → BigFppfOver B S hS} (ψ : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (V i) ⟶ F)
    (hψ : ∀ i, IsEtale B S hS (ψ i)) (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS (Sigma.desc ψ))
    (hfin : ∀ i, (chartFibre B S hS F (ψ i) x).Finite)
    (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (hU : IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U))
    (φ : yoneda.obj U ⟶ F) (hφ : IsEtale B S hS φ) :
    (chartFibre B S hS F φ x).Finite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_etaleCover_finite_chartFibre
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JS, part (2) implies part (1).** An algebraic space over `S` has an étale
covering family by affine schemes, so if every étale chart with affine source has a finite chart
fibre above a point `x` of `|F|`, then the members of one covering family do.

The covering family is the one of Stacks 03FX
(`AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace.exists_affine_coproduct_atlas`), exactly as in
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasFiniteFibresOnEveryAffineEtaleChart.hasFiniteFibresOnSomeEtaleCover`,
whose surjectivity argument this repeats.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etaleCover_finite_chartFibre
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    {x : points B S hS F}
    (h : ∀ U : BigFppfOver B S hS, IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U) →
      ∀ φ : yoneda.obj U ⟶ F, IsEtale B S hS φ → (chartFibre B S hS F φ x).Finite) :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (V : I → BigFppfOver B S hS) (ψ : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (V i) ⟶ F),
      (∀ i, IsEtale B S hS (ψ i)) ∧ IsSurjective B S hS (Sigma.desc ψ) ∧
      ∀ i, (chartFibre B S hS F (ψ i) x).Finite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isReasonableSpace_iff_exists_boundedEtaleCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JT.** For an algebraic space `X` over `S` the following are equivalent: `(1)`
there is a jointly surjective family of étale charts of `X` by schemes, each with universally
bounded fibres, and `(2)` every étale chart of `X` by an affine scheme has universally bounded
fibres, which is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsReasonableSpace`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isReasonableSpace_iff_exists_boundedEtaleCover
    (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) :
    IsReasonableSpace B S hS X ↔
      ∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → BigFppfOver B S hS) (φ : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (U i) ⟶ X),
        Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (Sigma.desc φ) ∧
        ∀ i, (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) (φ i) ∧
          HasUniversallyBoundedFibers B S hS (U i) (φ i)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasEtaleQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative_iff_hasMonomorphicFieldRepresentative
declarations.doc:
For a point of an algebraic space over `S`, having a field-valued representative with étale
quasi-compact self-intersection projections is equivalent to having a monomorphic field-valued
representative.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasEtaleQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative_iff_hasMonomorphicFieldRepresentative
    {F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    (x : points B S hS F) :
    HasEtaleQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative B S hS F x ↔
      HasMonomorphicFieldRepresentative B S hS F x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasFiniteRelationFiberAt_iff_everyEtaleChart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JU, conditions (1) and (2).** For a point of an algebraic space over `S`,
finiteness of one relation fibre in one étale chart is equivalent to finiteness of every
relation fibre in every étale chart.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasFiniteRelationFiberAt_iff_everyEtaleChart (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    (x : points B S hS F) :
    HasFiniteRelationFiberAt B S hS F x ↔
      HasFiniteRelationFiberAtEveryEtaleChart B S hS F x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasFiniteRelationFiberAtEveryEtaleChart_iff_hasEtaleQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JU, conditions (2) and (3).** For a point of an algebraic space over `S`,
finiteness of every relation fibre in every étale chart is equivalent to having a field-valued
representative with étale quasi-compact self-intersection projections.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasFiniteRelationFiberAtEveryEtaleChart_iff_hasEtaleQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) (x : points B S hS F) :
    HasFiniteRelationFiberAtEveryEtaleChart B S hS F x ↔
      HasEtaleQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative B S hS F x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasMonomorphicFieldRepresentative.hasFiniteRelationFiberAtEveryEtaleChart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JU, condition (4) implies condition (2).** If a point `x` of an algebraic space
`F` over `S` has a field-valued representative presenting it by a monomorphism out of the
spectrum of a field, then for every étale chart `φ : h_U ⟶ F` and every pair of points of `|U|`
above `x` the fibre of `|h_U ×_F h_U| → |U| × |U|` over that pair is finite.
declarations.statement:
theorem HasMonomorphicFieldRepresentative.hasFiniteRelationFiberAtEveryEtaleChart
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    {x : points B S hS F} (h : HasMonomorphicFieldRepresentative B S hS F x) :
    HasFiniteRelationFiberAtEveryEtaleChart B S hS F x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasFiniteRelationFiberAtEveryEtaleChart.hasEtaleQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JU, part (2) implies part (3).** If every pair of points above a point `x` of an
algebraic space `F` over `S`, in every étale chart of `F`, has finite relation fibre, then `x`
has a field-valued representative whose two self-intersection projections are étale and
quasi-compact.

Take a surjective étale chart `φ : h_U ⟶ F` and a point `a` of `|U|` above `x`, let `u` be the
point of the scheme `U` underlying `a`, and let `ν : P ⟶ U` be the canonical morphism from the
spectrum `P` of the residue field at `u`. It is a monomorphism, by Stacks 01L6, and the
composite `f : h_P ⟶ F` presents `x`. Writing the self-fibre-product of `f` as
`N = P ×_U (U ×_F U) ×_U P`, its first projection factors as the base change of `ν` followed by
the base change of the chart, that is as a monomorphism followed by an étale morphism to `P`;
and `N` maps monomorphically to `U ×_F U` with both legs above `a`, so condition (2) makes
`|N|` finite. The first projection is therefore étale by Tags 02GL and 03DP and quasi-compact
by finiteness, and the second is the first conjugated by the symmetry of the
fibre product.
declarations.statement:
theorem HasFiniteRelationFiberAtEveryEtaleChart.hasEtaleQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    {x : points B S hS F}
    (h : HasFiniteRelationFiberAtEveryEtaleChart B S hS F x) :
    HasEtaleQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative B S hS F x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasEtaleQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative.hasMonomorphicFieldRepresentative
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JU, part (3) implies part (4).** If a point `x` of an algebraic space `F` over `S`
has a field-valued representative whose two self-intersection projections are étale and
quasi-compact, then `x` has a field-valued representative presenting it by a monomorphism.

Let `f : h_U ⟶ F` be the morphism presented by the representative of condition (3), so that `U`
is `Spec k` for a field `k`, and let `R` be the kernel pair of `f`, which exists because the
diagonal of `F` is representable. The two projections `R ⟶ U` are étale and quasi-compact, hence
finite locally free with `R` affine, so `(U, R)` is a finite locally free equivalence relation on
an affine scheme; Stacks 03BM represents its fppf quotient sheaf by the spectrum of the invariant
ring, which is a field, and which lies in the site because the quotient does not increase size.
The descent of `f` to that quotient sheaf is a monomorphism because `R` is the kernel pair of `f`
and `F` is a sheaf, and the resulting field-valued point is dominated by the original one, so it
represents the same point of `|F|`.
declarations.statement:
theorem HasEtaleQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative.hasMonomorphicFieldRepresentative
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) {x : points B S hS F}
    (h : HasEtaleQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative B S hS F x) :
    HasMonomorphicFieldRepresentative B S hS F x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasMonomorphicFieldRepresentative.hasEtaleQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JU, part (4) implies part (3).** A field-valued representative presenting a point
by a monomorphism has invertible self-intersection projections, and an isomorphism is étale and
quasi-compact after every representable base change.
declarations.statement:
theorem HasMonomorphicFieldRepresentative.hasEtaleQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative
    {x : points B S hS F} (h : HasMonomorphicFieldRepresentative B S hS F x) :
    HasEtaleQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative B S hS F x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasFiniteRelationFiberAt.hasFiniteRelationFiberAtEveryEtaleChart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JU, part (1) implies part (2).** If some étale chart of an algebraic space `F`
over `S` has two points above `x` with finite relation fibre, then every pair of points above
`x` in every étale chart of `F` has finite relation fibre.

Let `φ : h_U ⟶ F` be the chart of part (1), with points `a`, `b` above `x`, and let
`ψ : h_W ⟶ F` be any étale chart with points `c`, `d` above `x`. The fibre product
`T = h_W ×_F h_U` is representable with both projections étale, and Tag 03H4 lifts `(a, c)` and
`(b, d)` to points of `|T|`. The relation fibre of `h_T ⟶ F` above that pair of lifts is finite
because the relation fibre of `φ` above `(a, b)` is, and the relation fibre of `ψ` above `(c, d)`
is finite because that one is.

The hypothesis `_hF` that `F` is an algebraic space is retained from the source statement but is
not used.
declarations.statement:
theorem HasFiniteRelationFiberAt.hasFiniteRelationFiberAtEveryEtaleChart
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (_hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    {x : points B S hS F} (h : HasFiniteRelationFiberAt B S hS F x) :
    HasFiniteRelationFiberAtEveryEtaleChart B S hS F x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasFiniteRelationFiberAtEveryEtaleChart.hasFiniteRelationFiberAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JU, part (2) implies part (1).** An algebraic space over `S` has a surjective
étale chart, which carries a point above `x`, so the universally quantified condition (2) is
witnessed and condition (1) holds.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasFiniteRelationFiberAt_of_everyEtaleChart` with its
hypothesis that some étale chart has a point above `x` discharged by an atlas of Tag 03FQ, which
is surjective on the points of Tag 03BU by Tag 03H5. Together with
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasFiniteRelationFiberAt.hasFiniteRelationFiberAtEveryEtaleChart` it
makes conditions (1) and (2) of Stacks 03JU equivalent.
declarations.statement:
theorem HasFiniteRelationFiberAtEveryEtaleChart.hasFiniteRelationFiberAt
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    {x : points B S hS F} (h : HasFiniteRelationFiberAtEveryEtaleChart B S hS F x) :
    HasFiniteRelationFiberAt B S hS F x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasQuasiCompactMonomorphicFieldRepresentative_of_hasQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JV, condition (5) implies condition (4).** If some field-valued point in the
class of `x` presents it by a quasi-compact morphism, then some field-valued point in that
class presents it by a morphism which is both a monomorphism and quasi-compact.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasQuasiCompactMonomorphicFieldRepresentative_of_hasQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    {x : points B S hS F}
    (h : HasQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative B S hS F x) :
    HasQuasiCompactMonomorphicFieldRepresentative B S hS F x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasFiniteChartAndRelationFibersAt_iff_hasQuasiCompactMonomorphicFieldRepresentative
declarations.doc:
For a point of an algebraic space over `S`, finiteness of the fibres of every affine étale
chart and of its self-intersection above the point is equivalent to the point being in the class
of a quasi-compact monomorphism from the spectrum of a field.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasFiniteChartAndRelationFibersAt_iff_hasQuasiCompactMonomorphicFieldRepresentative
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (x : points B S hS X) :
    HasFiniteChartAndRelationFibersAt B S hS X x ↔
      HasQuasiCompactMonomorphicFieldRepresentative B S hS X x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasQuasiCompactMonomorphicFieldRepresentative
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JV, condition (4).** A point of `F` has a *quasi-compact monomorphic
field-valued representative* when some field-valued point in its class presents it by a
morphism which is both a monomorphism and quasi-compact.
declarations.statement: def HasQuasiCompactMonomorphicFieldRepresentative (x : points B S hS F) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasFiniteFibresOnEveryAffineEtaleChart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JV, condition (1).** For every affine scheme `U` and every étale morphism
`φ : h_U ⟶ F`, setting `R = h_U ×_F h_U`, the fibres of `|U| → |F|` and of `|R| → |F|`
above `x` are both finite.
declarations.statement: def HasFiniteFibresOnEveryAffineEtaleChart (x : points B S hS F) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasFiniteFibresOnSomeEtaleCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JV, condition (2).** There is a family of étale morphisms `φ i : h_{U i} ⟶ F`
whose coproduct is surjective on points and for which, setting `R i = h_{U i} ×_F h_{U i}`,
the fibres of `|U i| → |F|` and of `|R i| → |F|` above `x` are all finite.
declarations.statement: def HasFiniteFibresOnSomeEtaleCover (x : points B S hS F) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasMonomorphicFieldRepresentativeWithFiniteCharts
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JV, condition (3).** Some field-valued representative of `x` presents it by a
monomorphism `Spec(k) ⟶ F` whose base change along every étale chart of `F` with affine
source is a finite scheme over `k`.
declarations.statement: def HasMonomorphicFieldRepresentativeWithFiniteCharts (x : points B S hS F) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JV, condition (5).** Some field-valued point in the class of `x` presents it
by a quasi-compact morphism, the monomorphism condition of condition (4) being dropped.
declarations.statement: def HasQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative (x : points B S hS F) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.EveryFieldRepresentativeIsQuasiCompact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JV, condition (6).** *Every* field-valued point in the class of `x` presents
it by a quasi-compact morphism.
declarations.statement: def EveryFieldRepresentativeIsQuasiCompact (x : points B S hS F) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasQuasiCompactMonomorphicFieldRepresentative.hasQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JV, condition (4) implies condition (5).** Forgetting that the presenting
morphism is a monomorphism leaves a quasi-compact field-valued representative.
declarations.statement:
theorem HasQuasiCompactMonomorphicFieldRepresentative.hasQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative
    {x : points B S hS F}
    (h : HasQuasiCompactMonomorphicFieldRepresentative B S hS F x) :
    HasQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative B S hS F x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.EveryFieldRepresentativeIsQuasiCompact.hasQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JV, condition (6) implies condition (5).** A point of `|F|` is by construction
the class of some field-valued point, so a universally quasi-compact class has a
quasi-compact representative.
declarations.statement:
theorem EveryFieldRepresentativeIsQuasiCompact.hasQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative
    {x : points B S hS F}
    (h : EveryFieldRepresentativeIsQuasiCompact B S hS F x) :
    HasQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative B S hS F x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasQuasiCompactMonomorphicFieldRepresentative.everyFieldRepresentativeIsQuasiCompact
declarations.doc:
If a point `x` of an algebraic space `F` over `S` is the class of a field-valued point whose
presenting morphism `Spec(k) ⟶ F` is a quasi-compact monomorphism, then the presenting morphism
of *every* field-valued point in the class of `x` is quasi-compact.
declarations.statement:
theorem HasQuasiCompactMonomorphicFieldRepresentative.everyFieldRepresentativeIsQuasiCompact
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    {x : points B S hS F}
    (h : HasQuasiCompactMonomorphicFieldRepresentative B S hS F x) :
    EveryFieldRepresentativeIsQuasiCompact B S hS F x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasQuasiCompactMonomorphicFieldRepresentative.hasMonomorphicFieldRepresentativeWithFiniteCharts
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JV, condition (4) implies condition (3).** If a point `x` of a presheaf `F` on
the big fppf site of `S` is the class of a field-valued point whose presenting morphism
