`Spec(k) ⟶ F` is a quasi-compact monomorphism, then that same monomorphism presents `x` and
has finite base change to every affine étale chart of `F`.

The representative, the equality of classes and the monomorphism are carried over unchanged;
the only content is the finiteness of the base change, which is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFinite_pullback_fst_fieldMorphism_of_isQuasiCompact` applied to the
affine — hence quasi-compact — chart.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasMonomorphicFieldRepresentativeWithFiniteCharts
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) {x : points B S hS F}
    (h : HasQuasiCompactMonomorphicFieldRepresentative B S hS F x) :
    HasMonomorphicFieldRepresentativeWithFiniteCharts B S hS F x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasQuasiCompactMonomorphicFieldRepresentative.hasFiniteFibresOnEveryAffineEtaleChart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JV, condition (4) implies condition (1).** If a point `x` of an algebraic space
`F` over `S` is the class of a field-valued point whose presenting morphism `Spec(k) ⟶ F` is a
quasi-compact monomorphism, then for every affine scheme `U` and every étale `φ : h_U ⟶ F` the
fibres of `|U| → |F|` and of `|R| → |F|` above `x`, where `R = h_U ×_F h_U`, are both finite.
declarations.statement:
theorem HasQuasiCompactMonomorphicFieldRepresentative.hasFiniteFibresOnEveryAffineEtaleChart
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    {x : points B S hS F}
    (h : HasQuasiCompactMonomorphicFieldRepresentative B S hS F x) :
    HasFiniteFibresOnEveryAffineEtaleChart B S hS F x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasFiniteFibresOnEveryAffineEtaleChart.hasFiniteFibresOnSomeEtaleCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JV, condition (1) implies condition (2).** An algebraic space over `S` has an
étale covering family by affine schemes, so the finiteness condition of condition (1), which
quantifies over *every* affine étale chart, is in particular satisfied by the members of one
covering family.
declarations.statement:
theorem HasFiniteFibresOnEveryAffineEtaleChart.hasFiniteFibresOnSomeEtaleCover
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    {x : points B S hS F}
    (h : HasFiniteFibresOnEveryAffineEtaleChart B S hS F x) :
    HasFiniteFibresOnSomeEtaleCover B S hS F x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasQuasiCompactMonomorphicFieldRepresentative.hasFiniteFibresOnSomeEtaleCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JV, condition (4) implies condition (2).** The composite of the two implications
above: condition (4) gives condition (1), which gives condition (2).
declarations.statement:
theorem HasQuasiCompactMonomorphicFieldRepresentative.hasFiniteFibresOnSomeEtaleCover
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    {x : points B S hS F}
    (h : HasQuasiCompactMonomorphicFieldRepresentative B S hS F x) :
    HasFiniteFibresOnSomeEtaleCover B S hS F x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasFiniteFibresOnSomeEtaleCover.hasFiniteFibresOnEveryAffineEtaleChart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JV, condition (2) implies condition (1).** If some family of étale charts of an
algebraic space `F` over `S` with surjective coproduct has finite chart and relation fibres above
a point `x` of `|F|`, then every étale chart of `F` with affine source has finite chart and
relation fibres above `x`.

The chart half is Stacks 03JS. For the relation half, condition (2) supplies condition (1) of
Stacks 03JU at `x`, so Stacks 03JU, part (1) implies part (2), bounds the relation fibre above
each pair of points of the — now finite — chart fibre, and the fibre of `|R| → |F|` above `x` is
the union of those.
declarations.statement:
theorem HasFiniteFibresOnSomeEtaleCover.hasFiniteFibresOnEveryAffineEtaleChart
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    {x : points B S hS F} (h : HasFiniteFibresOnSomeEtaleCover B S hS F x) :
    HasFiniteFibresOnEveryAffineEtaleChart B S hS F x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasFiniteFibresOnEveryAffineEtaleChart_iff_onSomeEtaleCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JV, conditions (1) and (2) are equivalent.** For a point `x` of an algebraic
space `F` over `S`, finiteness of the chart and relation fibres above `x` on *every* étale
chart with affine source holds if and only if it holds on the members of *some* étale
covering family.

This is the first equivalence of Stacks 03JV to be closed. The forward direction is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasFiniteFibresOnEveryAffineEtaleChart.hasFiniteFibresOnSomeEtaleCover`,
which reads the covering family off the affine atlas of Stacks 03FX; the reverse direction is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasFiniteFibresOnSomeEtaleCover.hasFiniteFibresOnEveryAffineEtaleChart`
above, which is the source's own argument through Stacks 03JS and 03JU. Algebraicity of `F` is
used in both directions and is not removable: the atlas of Stacks 03FX and the transfer of
Stacks 03JU each require it.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasFiniteFibresOnEveryAffineEtaleChart_iff_onSomeEtaleCover
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    {x : points B S hS F} :
    HasFiniteFibresOnEveryAffineEtaleChart B S hS F x ↔
      HasFiniteFibresOnSomeEtaleCover B S hS F x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasMonomorphicFieldRepresentativeWithFiniteCharts.hasFiniteFibresOnEveryAffineEtaleChart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JV, condition (3) implies condition (1).** If a point `x` of an algebraic space
`F` over `S` is presented by a monomorphism `Spec(k) ⟶ F` whose base change along every étale
chart with affine source is finite over `Spec(k)`, then for every affine scheme `U` and every
étale `φ : h_U ⟶ F` the fibres of `|U| → |F|` and of `|R| → |F|` above `x`, where
`R = h_U ×_F h_U`, are both finite.

This is the source's "apply Lemma 040U to every étale morphism `U → X` with `U` affine", in the
nonemptiness-free form
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.finite_chartFibre_and_relationFibre_of_mono_isFinite`: finiteness of
the field fibre over `Spec(k)` makes its point set finite and Stacks 03H4 maps that set onto
the chart fibre, after which the relation fibre is bounded by Stacks 0AC7 above each pair of
points of the chart fibre, the monomorphism being what 0AC7 needs.
declarations.statement:
theorem HasMonomorphicFieldRepresentativeWithFiniteCharts.hasFiniteFibresOnEveryAffineEtaleChart
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    {x : points B S hS F}
    (h : HasMonomorphicFieldRepresentativeWithFiniteCharts B S hS F x) :
    HasFiniteFibresOnEveryAffineEtaleChart B S hS F x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasMonomorphicFieldRepresentativeWithFiniteCharts.hasFiniteFibresOnSomeEtaleCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JV, condition (3) implies condition (2).** The composite of the implication
above with
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasFiniteFibresOnEveryAffineEtaleChart.hasFiniteFibresOnSomeEtaleCover`:
a monomorphic representative with finite charts gives finiteness of the chart and relation
fibres on every affine étale chart, hence on the members of the affine étale covering family of
Stacks 03FX.
declarations.statement:
theorem HasMonomorphicFieldRepresentativeWithFiniteCharts.hasFiniteFibresOnSomeEtaleCover
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    {x : points B S hS F}
    (h : HasMonomorphicFieldRepresentativeWithFiniteCharts B S hS F x) :
    HasFiniteFibresOnSomeEtaleCover B S hS F x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative.everyFieldRepresentativeIsQuasiCompact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JV, condition (5) implies condition (6).** If some field-valued point in the
class of a point `x` of an algebraic space `F` over `S` presents it by a quasi-compact
morphism `Spec(k) ⟶ F`, then *every* field-valued point in the class of `x` does.
declarations.statement:
theorem HasQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative.everyFieldRepresentativeIsQuasiCompact
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    {x : points B S hS F}
    (h : HasQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative B S hS F x) :
    EveryFieldRepresentativeIsQuasiCompact B S hS F x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative_iff_everyFieldRepresentativeIsQuasiCompact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JV, conditions (5) and (6) are equivalent.** For a point `x` of an algebraic
space `F` over `S`, *some* field-valued point in the class of `x` has quasi-compact presenting
morphism if and only if *every* one does.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative_iff_everyFieldRepresentativeIsQuasiCompact
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    {x : points B S hS F} :
    HasQuasiCompactFieldRepresentative B S hS F x ↔
      EveryFieldRepresentativeIsQuasiCompact B S hS F x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasQuasiCompactMonomorphicFieldRepresentative_of_finiteCharts
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JV, condition (3) implies condition (4).** Let `F` be an algebraic space over
`S` and let `x` be a point of `F`. If some field-valued representative of `x` presents it by
a monomorphism whose base change along every affine étale chart of `F` is finite, then that
monomorphism is in addition quasi-compact.

A surjective étale chart `h_V ⟶ F` by a single object of the site exists by Stacks 03FX, and
`V` is covered by its affine open subschemes, each of which is an object of the site whose
composite to `F` is an affine étale chart. The hypothesis applies to those charts, and the
resulting fibre products are affine objects of the site whose projections to the members of
the covering are morphisms of affine schemes, hence quasi-compact. The Zariski-local criterion
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiCompact_pullback_snd_of_openCover` turns that into
quasi-compactness of the base change of the representative along the chart, which is condition
(4) of Stacks 03KG, and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiCompact_of_surjectiveEtale_atlas` is its condition (4) implies
condition (1).

Together with the converse this closes the adjacent equivalence of conditions (3) and
(4) of Stacks 03JV.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasQuasiCompactMonomorphicFieldRepresentative_of_finiteCharts
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) {x : points B S hS F}
    (h : HasMonomorphicFieldRepresentativeWithFiniteCharts B S hS F x) :
    HasQuasiCompactMonomorphicFieldRepresentative B S hS F x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRepresentable_of_isQuasiSeparatedScheme
declarations.doc:
Condition `(ι)` implies condition `(θ)`: an algebraic space which is a quasi-separated
scheme is representable.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRepresentable_of_isQuasiSeparatedScheme
    (h : IsQuasiSeparatedScheme B S hS X) : X.IsRepresentable

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAbsolutelyZariskiLocallyQuasiSeparated_of_isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated
declarations.doc:
Condition `(η)` implies condition `(ζ)`: a quasi-separated algebraic space is Zariski
locally quasi-separated.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAbsolutelyZariskiLocallyQuasiSeparated_of_isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (h : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ X) :
    IsAbsolutelyZariskiLocallyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_isQuasiSeparatedScheme
declarations.doc:
Condition `(ι)` implies condition `(η)`: an algebraic space which is a quasi-separated
scheme is a quasi-separated algebraic space.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_isQuasiSeparatedScheme
    (h : IsQuasiSeparatedScheme B S hS X) : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasFiniteChartFibersAtEveryPoint_of_hasFiniteChartAndRelationFibers
declarations.doc:
Condition `(γ)` implies condition `(α)`: if every affine étale chart has finite fibres
together with its self-intersection, then every affine étale chart has finite fibres.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasFiniteChartFibersAtEveryPoint_of_hasFiniteChartAndRelationFibers
    (h : HasFiniteChartAndRelationFibersAtEveryPoint B S hS X) :
    HasFiniteChartFibersAtEveryPoint B S hS X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasFiniteRelationFibersAtEveryPoint_of_hasFiniteChartAndRelationFibers
declarations.doc:
Condition `(γ)` implies condition `(β)`, in the form of condition (1) of Stacks 03JU:
for an algebraic space satisfying `(γ)`, every point has an étale chart and a pair of points
above it whose relation fibre is finite.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasFiniteRelationFibersAtEveryPoint_of_hasFiniteChartAndRelationFibers
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (h : HasFiniteChartAndRelationFibersAtEveryPoint B S hS X) :
    HasFiniteRelationFibersAtEveryPoint B S hS X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasFiniteChartAndRelationFibersAtEveryPoint_of_alpha_and_beta
declarations.doc:
Conditions `(α)` and `(β)` imply condition `(γ)`: an algebraic space all of whose affine
étale charts have finite fibres and all of whose points have a finite relation fibre satisfies
condition `(γ)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasFiniteChartAndRelationFibersAtEveryPoint_of_alpha_and_beta
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hα : HasFiniteChartFibersAtEveryPoint B S hS X)
    (hβ : HasFiniteRelationFibersAtEveryPoint B S hS X) :
    HasFiniteChartAndRelationFibersAtEveryPoint B S hS X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasFiniteChartAndRelationFibersAtEveryPoint_iff_alpha_and_beta
declarations.doc:
Condition `(γ)` is equivalent to conditions `(α)` and `(β)` together: for an algebraic
space over `S`, finiteness of the fibres of every affine étale chart together with its
self-intersection is equivalent to finiteness of the fibres of every affine étale chart
together with finiteness of one relation fibre at every point.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasFiniteChartAndRelationFibersAtEveryPoint_iff_alpha_and_beta
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) :
    HasFiniteChartAndRelationFibersAtEveryPoint B S hS X ↔
      HasFiniteChartFibersAtEveryPoint B S hS X ∧
        HasFiniteRelationFibersAtEveryPoint B S hS X

Condition `(θ)` implies condition `(ζ)`: a representable algebraic space over `S` is
Zariski locally quasi-separated.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasFiniteChartAndRelationFibersAtEveryPoint_of_isReasonableSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JX, `(δ) ⇒ (γ)`.** A reasonable algebraic space satisfies condition `(γ)`:
above every point of it, every étale chart by an affine scheme has a finite fibre, and so
does the self-intersection of that chart.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasFiniteChartAndRelationFibersAtEveryPoint_of_isReasonableSpace
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hr : IsReasonableSpace B S hS X) :
    HasFiniteChartAndRelationFibersAtEveryPoint B S hS X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isReasonableSpace_of_isVeryReasonableSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03JX, `(ε) ⇒ (δ)`.** A very reasonable algebraic space over `S` is reasonable:
every étale chart of it by an affine scheme has universally bounded fibres.

This is also the third implication of Stacks 03M5. The given family of charts is refined by the
affine opens of its sources, which have universally bounded fibres over the space by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasUniversallyBoundedFibers_affineOpen_comp_of_isQuasiCompact`, and
Stacks 03JT turns one such jointly surjective family into reasonableness.
declarations.statement:
theorem isReasonableSpace_of_isVeryReasonableSpace
    (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (h : IsVeryReasonableSpace B S hS X) :
    IsReasonableSpace B S hS X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isVeryReasonableSpace_of_isAbsolutelyZariskiLocallyQuasiSeparated
declarations.doc:
A Zariski locally quasi-separated algebraic space over `S` is very reasonable: it admits a
jointly surjective family of étale charts by schemes whose two self-intersection projections
are quasi-compact.
declarations.statement:
theorem isVeryReasonableSpace_of_isAbsolutelyZariskiLocallyQuasiSeparated
    (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hζ : IsAbsolutelyZariskiLocallyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ X) :
    IsVeryReasonableSpace B S hS X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_directedApproximation_of_isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03K0 for a quasi-separated space.** A quasi-compact, quasi-separated algebraic
space over `S` carries a directed approximation in the sense of the source, with clause (1)
in its original form over all quasi-compact test schemes: the constant system indexed by the
one-object category works, all of whose transition morphisms and coprojections are
identities.

By `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_directedApproximation` the
quasi-separatedness hypothesis is also *necessary* when `X` is a scheme, so the statement of
Stacks 03K0 is not available for a general quasi-compact reasonable `X`; the hypothesis is
the correction, and an approximation of a non-quasi-separated `X` exists only after clause
(1) is restricted to quasi-compact quasi-separated test schemes.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_directedApproximation_of_isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated
    (X : Sheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (Type u))
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X.obj)
    (hqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X.obj)
    (hqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ X.obj) :
    Nonempty (DirectedApproximation B S hS hZ X)
declarations.comment: correction: clause (1) as literally stated holds only for quasi-separated X,and is proved here under that hypothesis

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_directedApproximation
declarations.doc:
**Clause (1) of Stacks 03K0, as stated, forces `X` to be quasi-separated.** Let `X` be a
quasi-compact algebraic space which is a scheme, and suppose it carries a directed
approximation by quasi-separated algebraic spaces satisfying clause (1) in the form the
source states it, over every quasi-compact test scheme. Testing clause (1) on `T = X`
itself — legitimate, since `X` is a quasi-compact scheme over `S` — produces a section of
one coprojection `X i ⟶ X`, exhibiting `X` as a retract of the quasi-separated space `X i`;
so `X` is quasi-separated.

Consequently Stacks 03K0 is **false as stated**: a quasi-compact scheme which is not
quasi-separated is a quasi-compact reasonable algebraic space carrying no such system. The
repair supported by the source's own proof is to restrict clause (1) to test schemes that
are quasi-compact *and quasi-separated*.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_of_directedApproximation
    (X : Sheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (Type u))
    [hrep : X.obj.IsRepresentable]
    (hqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X.obj)
    (A : DirectedApproximation B S hS hZ X) :
    IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ X.obj
declarations.comment: refutation of clause (1) as stated: it forces X quasi-separated, so thecorrect clause (1) restricts to quasi-compact quasi-separated test schemes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_correctedDirectedApproximation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03K0.** A quasi-compact reasonable algebraic space over `S` is the colimit, in
sheaves, of a directed system of quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic spaces, and the
system can be arranged to satisfy clauses (1), (2) and (3) of the source. No quasi-separatedness
is assumed of `X`.

The system is the one of the source's proof, and it is not constant: by Stacks 03H6 write
`X = U/R` with `U` affine, and index the system by the quasi-compact open subschemes `R' ⊆ R`
which are still equivalence relations on `U`, ordered by inclusion. Reasonableness bounds the
degrees of the fibres of `U ⟶ X` by some `N` (Stacks 03JL), and that bound is what makes the
index set *cofinal in the quasi-compact opens of `R`* and hence directed: the chain of
composites `A ↦ c(A ×_{s, U, t} A)` out of a quasi-compact open `A` containing `e(U)`
stabilises at step `N`, because a chain of length exceeding `N` repeats a point in a fibre of
`U(k) ⟶ X(k)` for an algebraically closed `k` and can be shortened. Each stage `U/R'` is an
algebraic space by Stacks 02WW, and is quasi-separated by Stacks 07S4 because `R'` is
quasi-compact and `U` affine — whereas `R` itself is quasi-compact only when `X` is
quasi-separated, which is precisely when the system collapses to a single stage.

Clause (1) is the corrected one: injectivity of `colim X i(T) ⟶ X(T)` over every quasi-compact
test scheme `T`, surjectivity over the quasi-compact *quasi-separated* ones; see
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CorrectedDirectedApproximation`. Over all quasi-compact `T` the
surjectivity fails, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_quasiCompact_reasonable_isEmpty_directedApproximation`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_correctedDirectedApproximation
    (B : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (hZ : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u}))
    (X : (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hX : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hqc : AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X)
    (hr : IsReasonableSpace B S hS X) :
    Nonempty (CorrectedDirectedApproximation B S hS hZ ⟨X, hX.isSheaf⟩)
declarations.comment: clause (1) in the corrected form: the test schemes are the quasi-compactquasi-separated ones, which is what the source's proof supports

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_quasiCompact_reasonable_isEmpty_directedApproximation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03K0 is false as stated.** There are a big fppf site, a scheme over its terminal
object, and no hypotheses at all, for which the lemma's hypotheses hold and its conclusion
fails: the represented sheaf is an algebraic space, representable, quasi-compact and
reasonable, and it carries no directed system of quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic
spaces with the three clauses of 03K0, because clause (1) over every quasi-compact test scheme
forces quasi-separatedness of the space itself — a hypothesis 03K0 does not make.

The witness is the doubled-origin scheme of Example 01KL, and the three facts about it that the
refutation needs are proved in this library: quasi-compactness
(`AlgebraicGeometry.compactSpace_scheme`), failure of quasi-separatedness
(`AlgebraicGeometry.not_quasiSeparatedSpace_scheme`) and reasonableness
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isReasonableSpace_yoneda`, the composite `(θ) ⇒ (δ)` of Stacks 03JX).

The repair supported by the source's own proof is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_correctedDirectedApproximation`, whose clause (1) quantifies
over test schemes that are quasi-compact *and quasi-separated*; it holds for every
quasi-compact reasonable algebraic space, this one included.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_quasiCompact_reasonable_isEmpty_directedApproximation (k : Type u) [Field k] :
    ∃ (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (hZ : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u}))
      (X : Sheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B (⊤_ Scheme.{u}) hZ) (Type u))
      (_ : X.obj.IsRepresentable),
      IsAlgebraicSpace B (⊤_ Scheme.{u}) hZ X.obj ∧
      IsQuasiCompactSpace B (⊤_ Scheme.{u}) hZ X.obj ∧
      IsReasonableSpace B (⊤_ Scheme.{u}) hZ X.obj ∧
      IsEmpty (DirectedApproximation B (⊤_ Scheme.{u}) hZ hZ X)
declarations.comment: refutation of clause (1) as stated, assuming nothing: the doubled-origin scheme of Example 01KL is a quasi-compact reasonable algebraic space with no such system

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_specializes_pointsMap_eq_of_isEtale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03K2.** Let `X` be an algebraic space over `S`, let `x' ⤳ x` be a
specialization of points of `X` and assume that every étale chart of `X` by an affine scheme
has a finite fibre above `x'`, which is condition (2) of Stacks 03JS for the pair `(X, x')`.
Then for every étale chart `φ : h_U ⟶ X` of `X` by a scheme and every point `u` of the chart
above `x` there is a point `u'` of the chart above `x'` with `u' ⤳ u`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_specializes_pointsMap_eq_of_isEtale
    {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    {x x' : points B S hS X} (hs : x' ⤳ x)
    (hfinite : ∀ V : BigFppfOver B S hS, IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj V) →
      ∀ ψ : yoneda.obj V ⟶ X, (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf ψ →
      (pointsMap B S hS (yoneda.obj V) ψ ⁻¹' {x'}).Finite)
    (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (φ : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X)
    (hφ : (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
      (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf φ)
    (u : points B S hS (yoneda.obj U)) (hu : pointsMap B S hS (yoneda.obj U) φ u = x) :
    ∃ u' : points B S hS (yoneda.obj U), u' ⤳ u ∧
      pointsMap B S hS (yoneda.obj U) φ u' = x'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.t0Space_points_of_hasFiniteChartFibers
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03K3.** The point space of an algebraic space over `S` all of whose points have
finite fibres in every étale chart by an affine scheme — in particular, of a decent algebraic
space — is Kolmogorov.
declarations.statement:
theorem t0Space_points_of_hasFiniteChartFibers
    {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hdecent : HasFiniteChartFibersAtEveryPoint B S hS X) :
    T0Space (points B S hS X)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.t0Space_points_of_isDecentSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03K3.** The point space of a decent algebraic space over `S` is Kolmogorov: decency
is condition (4) of Stacks 03JV at every point, which gives condition `(α)` of Stacks 03JX, and
Stacks 03K3 concludes.

Kolmogorov is `T0Space`; `StacksFrontier.Topology.Sober.Defs` identifies Definition 004X's
Kolmogorov condition with `T0Space` in `kolmogorov_iff`.
declarations.statement:
theorem t0Space_points_of_isDecentSpace (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hdec : IsDecentSpace B S hS X) : T0Space (points B S hS X)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_of_specializes_of_pointsMap_eq_of_hasFiniteChartFibers
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03K5.** Let `X` be an algebraic space over `S` every point of which satisfies
condition (2) of Stacks 03JS — in particular, a decent one — and let `h_U ⟶ X` be an étale
chart of `X` by a scheme. Two points of the chart with the same image in `X`, one a
specialization of the other, are equal.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_of_specializes_of_pointsMap_eq_of_hasFiniteChartFibers
    {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hdecent : HasFiniteChartFibersAtEveryPoint B S hS X)
    (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (φ : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X)
    (hφ : (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
      (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf φ)
    (u u' : points B S hS (yoneda.obj U))
    (huu' : pointsMap B S hS (yoneda.obj U) φ u = pointsMap B S hS (yoneda.obj U) φ u')
    (hs : u' ⤳ u) : u = u'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.stacksSober_points_of_isDecentSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03K6.** The point space of a decent algebraic space over `S` is sober in the sense
of Stacks 004X: it is Kolmogorov, and every irreducible closed subset of it has a unique
generic point.
declarations.statement:
theorem stacksSober_points_of_isDecentSpace (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hdec : IsDecentSpace B S hS X) : StacksSober (points B S hS X)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.valuativeCriterion_existence_iff_lift
declarations.doc:
For a representable morphism, a lift after a dominating extension exists
exactly when every valuative square has a lift before extension.
declarations.statement:
public theorem valuativeCriterion_existence_iff_lift
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f) :
    ValuativeCriterion.Existence f ↔
      (∀ q : ValuativeSquare f, Nonempty q.Lift)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.universallyClosed_of_isQuasiCompact_of_valuativeCriterion_existence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03KA.** A quasi-compact morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` which satisfies the
existence part of the valuative criterion is universally closed.

By Stacks 03IT it is enough to check that the base change along every morphism from a
represented presheaf with affine scheme is closed on points; such a base change is again
quasi-compact (Stacks 03HF) and again satisfies the existence part (Stacks 03IY), so
`isClosedMap_pointsMap_of_isAffine_target` applies.
declarations.statement:
theorem universallyClosed_of_isQuasiCompact_of_valuativeCriterion_existence
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsQuasiCompact B S hS f) (hval : ValuativeCriterion.Existence f) :
    UniversallyClosed B S hS f

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Functor.isRepresentable_of_relativelyRepresentable_of_target_isRepresentable
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03KC**.
If `a : F ⟶ G` is a representable morphism of presheaves on `𝒞` and the target `G` is itself
representable, then so is `F`.
declarations.statement:
lemma CategoryTheory.Functor.isRepresentable_of_relativelyRepresentable_of_target_isRepresentable
    {F G : 𝒞ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v} (a : F ⟶ G) (ha : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable a)
    [hG : G.IsRepresentable] : F.IsRepresentable

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.presheaf_of_isLocallySurjective_pullback
declarations.doc:
A morphism property of a representable transformation descends along a transformation
which becomes surjective after fppf sheafification.
declarations.statement:
theorem presheaf_of_isLocallySurjective_pullback (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
    [P.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [P.IsLocalAtTarget Scheme.fppfPrecoverage]
    {F G H : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (a : F ⟶ G) (b : H ⟶ G)
    (ha : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable a)
    (hb : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) b)
    (hbase : (P.inverseImage (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf (pullback.snd a b)) :
    (P.inverseImage (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf a

declarations.doc:
Condition `(α)` is Zariski local: an algebraic space with a Zariski open covering by open

declarations.statement:
theorem hasFiniteChartFibersAtEveryPoint_of_isZariskiCover (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)

Condition `(β)` is Zariski local: an algebraic space with a Zariski open covering by open

declarations.statement:
theorem hasFiniteRelationFibersAtEveryPoint_of_isZariskiCover
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (I : Type u) (Xᵢ : I → Subfunctor X)
    (hcover : IsZariskiCover B S hS I Xᵢ)
    (hβ : ∀ i : I, HasFiniteRelationFibersAtEveryPoint B S hS (Xᵢ i).toFunctor) :

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasFiniteChartAndRelationFibersAtEveryPoint_of_isZariskiCover
declarations.doc:
Condition `(γ)` is Zariski local: an algebraic space with a Zariski open covering by open
subspaces satisfying condition `(γ)` satisfies condition `(γ)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasFiniteChartAndRelationFibersAtEveryPoint_of_isZariskiCover

    (hcover : IsZariskiCover B S hS I Xᵢ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAbsolutelyZariskiLocallyQuasiSeparated_of_isZariskiCover
declarations.doc:
Condition `(ζ)` is Zariski local: an algebraic space with a Zariski open covering by open
subspaces which are Zariski locally quasi-separated is Zariski locally quasi-separated.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAbsolutelyZariskiLocallyQuasiSeparated_of_isZariskiCover

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isReasonableSpace_of_isZariskiCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03KE, the case `(δ)`.** An algebraic space with a Zariski open covering by
reasonable open subspaces is reasonable.

Given an affine étale chart `φ : h_U ⟶ X`, the point sets of the members of the covering pull
back to an open cover of the affine scheme `U`, which therefore has a finite refinement by
affine opens each of which maps into a single member. Each of those affine opens is an affine
étale chart of the member it maps into, so reasonableness there bounds its fibres, and
Stacks 03JO carries the bound along the inclusion of the member; the finitely many bounds
then assemble to one for `φ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isReasonableSpace_of_isZariskiCover
    (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (I : Type u) (Xᵢ : I → Subfunctor X) (hcover : IsZariskiCover B S hS I Xᵢ)
    (hδ : ∀ i : I, IsReasonableSpace B S hS (Xᵢ i).toFunctor) :
    IsReasonableSpace B S hS X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isVeryReasonableSpace_of_isZariskiCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03KE, the case `(ε)`.** Property `(ε)` of Stacks 03JX — very reasonableness — is
local for Zariski coverings: a presheaf on the big fppf site of `S` admitting a Zariski
covering by very reasonable open subspaces is itself very reasonable.
declarations.statement:
theorem isVeryReasonableSpace_of_isZariskiCover
    (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (I : Type u) (Xᵢ : I → Subfunctor X)
    (hcover : IsZariskiCover B S hS I Xᵢ)
    (hε : ∀ i : I, IsVeryReasonableSpace B S hS (Xᵢ i).toFunctor) :
    IsVeryReasonableSpace B S hS X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isDecentSpace_of_relativelyRepresentable
declarations.doc:
Decency passes from the target of a representable morphism of presheaves on the big fppf
site of `S` to its source, when the source is an algebraic space.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDecentSpace_of_relativelyRepresentable
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f) (hY : IsDecentSpace B S hS Y) :
    IsDecentSpace B S hS X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasFiniteChartAndRelationFibersAtEveryPoint_of_relativelyRepresentable
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a representable morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`. If every étale
chart of `Y` by an affine scheme and the self-intersection of that chart have finite fibres
above every point, then the same holds for `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasFiniteChartAndRelationFibersAtEveryPoint_of_relativelyRepresentable
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f)
    (hYγ : HasFiniteChartAndRelationFibersAtEveryPoint B S hS Y) :
    HasFiniteChartAndRelationFibersAtEveryPoint B S hS X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isReasonableSpace_of_relativelyRepresentable
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03KF, the case `(δ)`, and the reasonable half of Stacks 0ABT.** Property `(δ)`
of Stacks 03JX — reasonableness — passes from the target of a representable morphism of
algebraic spaces over `S` to its source.

A jointly surjective family of étale charts of `Y` with universally bounded fibres, which
reasonableness of `Y` provides through Stacks 03JT, base changes along `f` to a family of
étale charts of `X`; the bounds survive by Stacks 03JN and joint surjectivity survives
because the squares are cartesian, so Stacks 03JT applies to `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isReasonableSpace_of_relativelyRepresentable
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f) (hYr : IsReasonableSpace B S hS Y) :
    IsReasonableSpace B S hS X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasFiniteRelationFibersAtEveryPoint_of_relativelyRepresentable_of_target
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03KF, the case `(β)`.** Property `(β)` of Stacks 03JX passes from the target of
a representable morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` to its source.

Property `(β)` is condition (1) of Stacks 03JU at every point, which is how
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasFiniteRelationFibersAtEveryPoint` spells it. The source's
argument runs on condition (4) instead, a monomorphic field-valued representative, so the
hypothesis on `Y` is carried across the equivalences of Stacks 03JU before
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasFiniteRelationFibersAtEveryPoint_of_relativelyRepresentable`
transports it to `X`; that is what makes `Y` an algebraic space a hypothesis here.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasFiniteRelationFibersAtEveryPoint_of_relativelyRepresentable_of_target
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f)
    (hYβ : HasFiniteRelationFibersAtEveryPoint B S hS Y) :
    HasFiniteRelationFibersAtEveryPoint B S hS X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRepresentable_of_relativelyRepresentable_of_target
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03KF, property `(θ)`.** Property `(θ)` of an algebraic space over `S` is
representability of its functor of points, so this is the case `𝒫 = (θ)`: for a representable
morphism `f : X ⟶ Y`, representability of `Y` gives representability of `X`.

Neither the sheaf condition nor an atlas is used, so the implication holds for presheaves on
any category; that general form is Stacks 03KC.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRepresentable_of_relativelyRepresentable_of_target
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f) (hYθ : Y.IsRepresentable) :
    X.IsRepresentable

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isVeryReasonableSpace_of_relativelyRepresentable
declarations.doc:
Property `(ε)` of Stacks 03JX, very reasonableness, passes from the target of a representable
morphism of presheaves on the big fppf site of `S` to its source.
declarations.statement:
theorem isVeryReasonableSpace_of_relativelyRepresentable
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f) (hY : IsVeryReasonableSpace B S hS Y) :
    IsVeryReasonableSpace B S hS X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiCompact_tfae
declarations.doc:
For a morphism `f : F ⟶ G` of algebraic spaces over `S` the following six
conditions are equivalent: `f` is quasi-compact; the base change of `f` along every morphism
to `G` from a presheaf represented by an object of the site is quasi-compact; for every such
object with affine underlying scheme the fibre product is a quasi-compact algebraic space;
the base change of `f` along some surjective étale morphism to `G` from a represented
presheaf is quasi-compact; the same for some surjective étale morphism from an arbitrary
algebraic space; and there is a Zariski covering of `G` along each member of which the base
change of `f` is quasi-compact.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiCompact_tfae {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G) (f : F ⟶ G) :
    List.TFAE
      [IsQuasiCompact B S hS f,
        ∀ (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ G),
          IsQuasiCompact B S hS (pullback.fst g f),
        ∀ (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ G),
          IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Z) →
            IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS (pullback g f),
        ∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ G),
          IsSurjective B S hS g ∧ IsEtale B S hS g ∧
            IsQuasiCompact B S hS (pullback.fst g f),
        ∃ (G' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (_ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G')
          (g : G' ⟶ G), IsSurjective B S hS g ∧ IsEtale B S hS g ∧
            IsQuasiCompact B S hS (pullback.fst g f),
        ∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → Subfunctor G) (_ : IsZariskiCover B S hS I U),
          ∀ i, IsQuasiCompact B S hS (pullback.fst (U i).ι f)]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiCompact_pullback_snd_of_isQuasiCompact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03KG, part (1) implies part (2).** If `f : X ⟶ Y` is a quasi-compact morphism of
algebraic spaces over `S`, then for every object `Z` of the site and every `g : h_Z ⟶ Y` the
projection `Z ×_Y X ⟶ h_Z` is quasi-compact.

This is Stacks 03HF, `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiCompact_of_isPullback`, read at the
cartesian square of the chosen fibre product; no representability of `Z` is used.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiCompact_pullback_snd_of_isQuasiCompact
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : IsQuasiCompact B S hS f)
    (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ Y) :
    IsQuasiCompact B S hS (pullback.snd f g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiCompactSpace_pullback_of_isQuasiCompact_pullback_snd
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03KG, part (2) implies part (3).** If every projection `Z ×_Y X ⟶ h_Z` of
`f : X ⟶ Y` along a morphism from a represented presheaf is quasi-compact, then `Z ×_Y X` is a
quasi-compact algebraic space whenever the scheme underlying `Z` is affine.

An affine object of the site represents a quasi-compact algebraic space, and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiCompactSpace_source_of_isQuasiCompact` then transfers
quasi-compactness from the target of the projection to its source. Only the single instance
`g` of part (2) is used, not the whole of it, and the algebraic-space hypotheses `_hX` and
`_hY` are retained from the source but are not needed.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiCompactSpace_pullback_of_isQuasiCompact_pullback_snd
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (_hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (_hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (h : ∀ (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ Y),
      IsQuasiCompact B S hS (pullback.snd f g))
    (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ Y)
    (hZ : IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Z)) :
    IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS (pullback f g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiCompact_of_isQuasiCompactSpace_pullback_affine'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03KG, part (3) implies part (1): quasi-compactness of a morphism of algebraic
spaces may be tested on affine schemes.** If `Z ×_Y X` is a quasi-compact algebraic space for
every object `Z` of the site with affine underlying scheme and every `g : h_Z ⟶ Y`, then
`f : X ⟶ Y` is quasi-compact.

A quasi-compact algebraic space has a surjective étale morphism from an affine scheme by
Stacks 03H6, and `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiCompactSpace_pullback_of_isSurjective`
replaces the test object by that affine scheme.

`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiCompact_of_isQuasiCompactSpace_pullback_affine` is the same
assertion with the fibre product of the hypothesis taken in the other order and the two
algebraic-space hypotheses in front of the morphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiCompact_of_isQuasiCompactSpace_pullback_affine'
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (h : ∀ (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ Y),
      IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Z) →
        IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS (pullback f g)) :
    IsQuasiCompact B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiCompact_of_surjectiveEtale_atlas
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03KG, part (4) implies part (1): quasi-compactness of a morphism of algebraic
spaces is étale-local on the target.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over
`S`. If there are an object `V` of the site and a surjective étale morphism `φ : h_V ⟶ Y` such
that the projection `V ×_Y X ⟶ h_V` is quasi-compact, then `f` is quasi-compact.

This is the leg of Stacks 03KG that the proof of Stacks 03JV uses in passing from its
condition (3) to its condition (4). Quasi-compactness of an arbitrary test object is reduced
in two steps — to an affine scheme chart of it, which is part (3) implies part (1), and from
there to a quasi-compact object factoring through `φ` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_compactSpace_factoring_of_isSurjective_isEtale` — after which
the hypothesis applies directly.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiCompact_of_surjectiveEtale_atlas
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (φ : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y)
    (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS φ) (hφ : IsEtale B S hS φ)
    (h : IsQuasiCompact B S hS (pullback.snd f φ)) :
    IsQuasiCompact B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_surjectiveEtale_atlas_isQuasiCompact_pullback_snd
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03KG, part (1) implies part (4).** A quasi-compact morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of
algebraic spaces over `S` has a surjective étale chart `φ : h_V ⟶ Y` of its target along
which its base change `V ×_Y X ⟶ h_V` is quasi-compact.

Any scheme atlas of `Y` will do: it is surjective and étale by Stacks 03H5 and by
multiplicativity of the represented étale morphisms, and the base change of `f` along it is
quasi-compact by Stacks 03HF. Together with
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiCompact_of_surjectiveEtale_atlas` this makes conditions (1) and
(4) of Stacks 03KG equivalent, and it exhibits the hypothesis of that statement as
satisfiable.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_surjectiveEtale_atlas_isQuasiCompact_pullback_snd
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (hf : IsQuasiCompact B S hS f) :
    ∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (φ : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y),
      IsSurjective B S hS φ ∧ IsEtale B S hS φ ∧
      IsQuasiCompact B S hS (pullback.snd f φ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isAlgebraicSpace_surjectiveEtale_isQuasiCompact_pullback_snd
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03KG, part (4) implies part (5).** A surjective étale chart of `Y` by an object
of the site is in particular a surjective étale morphism of algebraic spaces onto `Y`.

The presheaf represented by an object of the site is an algebraic space, so this is a
repackaging; it is stated so that the implications recorded for Tag 03KG reach condition (5)
in the shape the source gives it.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isAlgebraicSpace_surjectiveEtale_isQuasiCompact_pullback_snd
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (φ : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y)
    (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS φ) (hφ : IsEtale B S hS φ)
    (h : IsQuasiCompact B S hS (pullback.snd f φ)) :
    ∃ (Y' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (_hY' : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y')
      (g : Y' ⟶ Y), IsSurjective B S hS g ∧ IsEtale B S hS g ∧
        IsQuasiCompact B S hS (pullback.snd f g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_surjectiveEtale_atlas_of_isAlgebraicSpace_surjectiveEtale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03KG, part (5) implies part (4): an algebraic-space chart may be replaced by a
scheme chart.** If `g : Y' ⟶ Y` is a surjective étale morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`
along which the base change of `f : X ⟶ Y` is quasi-compact, then the same holds for a chart
of `Y` by an object of the site.

Compose `g` with a scheme atlas `a : h_V ⟶ Y'` of `Y'`. The composite is surjective on points
because `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pointsMap` is functorial, étale because
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsEtale g` tests exactly the étale charts of `Y'`, and the base change
of `f` along it is a base change of the base change along `g`, hence quasi-compact by
Stacks 03HF. Note that `Y` itself need not be assumed an algebraic space.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_surjectiveEtale_atlas_of_isAlgebraicSpace_surjectiveEtale
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {Y' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hY' : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y')
    (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS g) (hg : IsEtale B S hS g)
    (h : IsQuasiCompact B S hS (pullback.snd f g)) :
    ∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (φ : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y),
      IsSurjective B S hS φ ∧ IsEtale B S hS φ ∧
      IsQuasiCompact B S hS (pullback.snd f φ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiCompact_of_zariskiCover
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`. If there is a Zariski covering
of `Y` by open subspaces `W i`, that is one whose point sets cover the space of points of `Y`,
such that each of the morphisms `f⁻¹(W i) ⟶ W i`, that is `pullback.snd f (W i).ι`, is
quasi-compact, then `f` is quasi-compact.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiCompact_of_zariskiCover
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    {I : Type u} (W : I → Subfunctor Y) (hW : ∀ i, IsOpenSubspace B S hS (W i))
    (hcov : ∀ y : points B S hS Y, ∃ i,
      y ∈ Set.range (pointsMap B S hS (W i).toFunctor (W i).ι))
    (h : ∀ i, IsQuasiCompact B S hS (pullback.snd f (W i).ι)) :
    IsQuasiCompact B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_zariskiCover_isQuasiCompact_pullback_snd
declarations.doc:
A quasi-compact morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over `S` admits a Zariski
covering of `Y` over each member of which its restriction is quasi-compact.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_zariskiCover_isQuasiCompact_pullback_snd
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (hf : IsQuasiCompact B S hS f) :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (W : I → Subfunctor Y), (∀ i, IsOpenSubspace B S hS (W i)) ∧
      (∀ y : points B S hS Y, ∃ i,
        y ∈ Set.range (pointsMap B S hS (W i).toFunctor (W i).ι)) ∧
      ∀ i, IsQuasiCompact B S hS (pullback.snd f (W i).ι)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.valuativeCriterion_existence_iff_finiteSeparable
declarations.doc:
Allowing arbitrary field extensions in the existence valuative criterion
is equivalent to allowing only finite separable ones.
declarations.statement:
public theorem valuativeCriterion_existence_iff_finiteSeparable
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ValuativeCriterion.Existence f ↔ ExistenceFiniteSeparable f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.universallyClosed_surjective_specMap_algebraMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03KI, the morphism `Spec k' ⟶ Spec k`.** For a finite extension `k'/k` of fields,
the morphism `Spec k' ⟶ Spec k` is universally closed, being finite, and surjective, its
target being a single point.
declarations.statement:
theorem universallyClosed_surjective_specMap_algebraMap [FiniteDimensional k K] :
    UniversallyClosed (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) ∧
      Surjective (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))
declarations.comment: Spec(k') → Spec(k) is universally closed and surjective

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.isQuasiCompact_quotientBaseMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03KI, the quasi-compactness clause.** The structure morphism `π : X ⟶ S = 𝔸¹_k` of
the Galois twist of the affine line with zero doubled is quasi-compact.

The quotient is a quasi-compact algebraic space, its chart being the affine line over `k'`, and
the base is quasi-separated, being affine; so part (1) of Stacks 073B applies.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiCompact_quotientBaseMap :
    Space.IsQuasiCompact B (base k) hS (quotientBaseMap k K hdegree σ hσ B hS)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.universallyClosed_quotientBaseMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03KI, the universal closedness clause.** The structure morphism
`π : X ⟶ S = 𝔸¹_k` of the Galois twist of the affine line with zero doubled is universally
closed.

The chart `U = Spec k'[x] ⟶ X` is surjective and `U ⟶ S` is universally closed, being finite, so
Stacks 08AJ pushes universal closedness down to `π`.
declarations.statement:
theorem universallyClosed_quotientBaseMap :
    Space.UniversallyClosed B (base k) hS (quotientBaseMap k K hdegree σ hσ B hS)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.universallyClosed_doubledProjOver
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03KI, the affine line with zero doubled.** The affine line over `k'` with zero
doubled is universally closed over the affine line over `k'`.

The two copies of the affine line cover it, and their union maps to the affine line by the
codiagonal, which is finite; so Mathlib's descent of universal closedness along a surjection
applies.
declarations.statement: theorem universallyClosed_doubledProjOver : UniversallyClosed (doubledProjOver k K).left
declarations.comment: the affine line with zero doubled is universally closed over the affine line

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.exists_isIso_baseChangePresheaf_comp_doubledProjOver
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03KI, the base change to `k'`.** After base change along
`U = S ×_{Spec k} Spec k' = 𝔸¹_{k'} ⟶ S`, the structure morphism `π` is identified with the
morphism from the affine line over `k'` with zero doubled to the affine line over `k'`: the base
change `U ×_S X` is isomorphic to the functor of points of the glued scheme, compatibly with the
projections to `U`.

The isomorphism is the one of part (6) of Stacks 03FN; both it and the projections are
determined on the self-product `U ×_S U`, where both projections are the first one.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isIso_baseChangePresheaf_comp_doubledProjOver :
    ∃ χ : baseChangePresheaf k K B hS hdegree σ hσ ⟶
        (pointsFunctor k B hS).obj (doubledOverBase k K),
      IsIso χ ∧ χ ≫ (pointsFunctor k B hS).map (doubledProjOver k K) =
        pullback.fst (pointsCoverToBase k K B hS) (quotientBaseMap k K hdegree σ hσ B hS)
declarations.comment: after base change by Spec(k') → Spec(k), π is the affine line with zero doubled over the affine line

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.exists_mono_isPullback_zeroFibre
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03KI, the point above the origin.** The point of `X` above `0 ∈ 𝔸¹_k` is a
monomorphism `Spec k' ⟶ X`: there is a monomorphism from the functor of points of `Spec k'`
into `X` whose square over the origin `Spec k ⟶ 𝔸¹_k` is Cartesian, so `Spec k'` is the whole
fibre of `π` over the origin.

The fibre is computed in
`AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.twistedRelationQuotient_zeroFibre`; its map to `X` is a
monomorphism because the origin is a monomorphism into the base.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_mono_isPullback_zeroFibre :
    ∃ m : (pointsFunctor k B hS).obj (zeroCoverOverBase k K) ⟶
        (quadraticGaloisTwistedDoubledOrigin k K hdegree σ hσ B hS).obj,
      Mono m ∧ IsPullback m ((pointsFunctor k B hS).map (zeroCoverToZeroBase k K))
        (quotientBaseMap k K hdegree σ hσ B hS)
        ((pointsFunctor k B hS).map (zeroBaseToBase k))
declarations.comment: the point of X above 0 corresponds to a monomorphism Spec(k') → X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.formalDiskValuativeSquare
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03KI, the solid square.** The square displayed in the example: its valuation ring is
the ring `k⟦x⟧` of formal power series, its fraction field the field `k((x))` of Laurent series,
its structure morphism over the base the coordinate map `Spec k⟦x⟧ ⟶ 𝔸¹_k` of
`AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.formalDiskBaseMap`, and its top edge the point
`Spec k((x)) ⟶ X` of
`AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.laurentGenericPoint`.

Only the top edge carries content: the target of `π` is the terminal presheaf, so the edge of the
square into it, and the commutativity of the square, are the only ones there are.
declarations.statement:
def formalDiskValuativeSquare :
    Space.ValuativeSquare (quotientBaseMap k K hdegree σ hσ B hS)
declarations.comment: the solid square of the displayed diagram, over the valuation ring k⟦x⟧

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.isEmpty_lift_formalDiskValuativeSquare
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03KI, the missing dotted arrow.** The square of the example has no dotted arrow: a
dotted arrow is in particular a point of the quotient over the formal disc, and there is none,
the point of `X` above the origin being `Spec k'`, which has no `k`-point.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEmpty_lift_formalDiskValuativeSquare :
    IsEmpty (formalDiskValuativeSquare k K B hS hdegree σ hσ).Lift
declarations.comment: there cannot exist a dotted arrow

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.existenceFiniteSeparable_and_not_forall_nonempty_lift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03KI, a finite separable extension is needed.** The structure morphism `π` satisfies
the existence part of the valuative criterion when the fraction field may be replaced by a
finite separable extension, but not when it may not be extended at all.

The first half is Stacks 0A3X, part (1), for the quasi-separated (Stacks 03FN, part (5)) and
universally closed morphism `π`, refined by Stacks 03KH; the second is the square of the example
over `k⟦x⟧`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existenceFiniteSeparable_and_not_forall_nonempty_lift :
    Space.ExistenceFiniteSeparable (quotientBaseMap k K hdegree σ hσ B hS) ∧
      ¬ ∀ q : Space.ValuativeSquare (quotientBaseMap k K hdegree σ hσ B hS), Nonempty q.Lift
declarations.comment: a finite separable field extension is needed in general

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.quotientBaseMap_example
declarations.statement:
theorem quotientBaseMap_example :
    Space.IsQuasiCompact B (base k) hS (quotientBaseMap k K hdegree σ hσ B hS) ∧
      Space.UniversallyClosed B (base k) hS (quotientBaseMap k K hdegree σ hσ B hS) ∧
      (∃ χ : baseChangePresheaf k K B hS hdegree σ hσ ⟶
          (pointsFunctor k B hS).obj (doubledOverBase k K),
        IsIso χ ∧ χ ≫ (pointsFunctor k B hS).map (doubledProjOver k K) =
          pullback.fst (pointsCoverToBase k K B hS) (quotientBaseMap k K hdegree σ hσ B hS)) ∧
      UniversallyClosed (doubledProjOver k K).left ∧
      (UniversallyClosed (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) ∧
        Surjective (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))) ∧
      (∃ m : (pointsFunctor k B hS).obj (zeroCoverOverBase k K) ⟶
          (quadraticGaloisTwistedDoubledOrigin k K hdegree σ hσ B hS).obj,
        Mono m ∧ IsPullback m ((pointsFunctor k B hS).map (zeroCoverToZeroBase k K))
          (quotientBaseMap k K hdegree σ hσ B hS)
          ((pointsFunctor k B hS).map (zeroBaseToBase k))) ∧
      ¬ Nonempty
        (yoneda.obj (siteObject B (base k) hS (contains_powerSeries k B hS)
            (formalDiskBaseMap k)) ⟶
          (quadraticGaloisTwistedDoubledOrigin k K hdegree σ hσ B hS).obj) ∧
      IsEmpty (formalDiskValuativeSquare k K B hS hdegree σ hσ).Lift ∧
      Space.ExistenceFiniteSeparable (quotientBaseMap k K hdegree σ hσ B hS) ∧
      ¬ ∀ q : Space.ValuativeSquare (quotientBaseMap k K hdegree σ hσ B hS), Nonempty q.Lift
declarations.comment: all the assertions of the example together

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.not_nonempty_hom_formalDisk
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03KI**, third assertion of the example. For a quadratic Galois extension `K/k`,
the formal disc over `k` has no point of the quadratic Galois twisted doubled origin lying
over `AlgebraicGeometry.TwistedDoubledOrigin.formalDiskBaseMap`.

So the solid valuative square over the valuation ring `k⟦x⟧` whose bottom edge is that
coordinate map admits no dotted arrow, and a fortiori none compatible with the generic point
coming from the isomorphism of Stacks 03FN away from the origin: a finite separable extension
of the fraction field is genuinely needed in the existence part of Stacks 03IX.
declarations.statement:
theorem not_nonempty_hom_formalDisk
    [FiniteDimensional k K] [IsGalois k K] (hdegree : Module.finrank k K = 2)
    (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (hσ : σ ≠ 1) (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (hS : B.Contains (base k))
    (hDisk : B.Contains (Spec (.of (PowerSeries k))))
    [HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.topology B (base k) hS) (Type u)] :
    ¬ Nonempty
      (yoneda.obj (siteObject B (base k) hS hDisk (formalDiskBaseMap k)) ⟶
        (quadraticGaloisTwistedDoubledOrigin k K hdegree σ hσ B hS).obj)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.universallyClosed_iff_valuativeCriterion_existence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03KJ.** A quasi-compact morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` whose source is a

theorem universallyClosed_iff_valuativeCriterion_existence

    (hdecent : IsDecentSpace B S hS X) :
    UniversallyClosed B S hS f ↔ ValuativeCriterion.Existence f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiSeparated_tfae
declarations.doc:
For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over a
scheme `S` the following six conditions are equivalent: `f` is quasi-separated; the base change of
`f` along every morphism from a representable presheaf is quasi-separated; the same for the test
objects with affine underlying scheme; for every affine test object the fibre product is a
quasi-separated algebraic space, that is quasi-separated over the terminal scheme; there is a
surjective étale scheme chart of the target along which the base change of `f` is quasi-separated;
and there is a Zariski covering of the target over whose members the base changes of `f` are
quasi-separated.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiSeparated_tfae (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    List.TFAE [
      IsQuasiSeparated B S hS f,
      (∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ Y),
        IsQuasiSeparated B S hS (pullback.snd f g)),
      (∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ Y),
        IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T) →
          IsQuasiSeparated B S hS (pullback.snd f g)),
      (∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ Y),
        IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T) →
          IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ (pullback f g)),
      (∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y),
        (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) g ∧
        (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) g ∧
        IsQuasiSeparated B S hS (pullback.snd f g)),
      (∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → Subfunctor Y),
        IsZariskiCover B S hS I U ∧
        ∀ i, IsQuasiSeparated B S hS (pullback.snd f (U i).ι))
    ]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSeparated_tfae
declarations.doc:
For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S` the following are equivalent:
`f` is separated; the base change of `f` along every morphism from a representable presheaf is
separated; the same for the test objects with affine underlying scheme; for every affine test
object the fibre product is a separated algebraic space over the terminal scheme; there is a
surjective étale scheme chart of the target along which the base change of `f` is separated; and
there is a Zariski covering of the target over whose members the base changes of `f` are
separated.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparated_tfae (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    List.TFAE [
      IsSeparated B S hS f,
      (∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ Y),
        IsSeparated B S hS (pullback.snd f g)),
      (∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ Y),
        IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T) →
          IsSeparated B S hS (pullback.snd f g)),
      (∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ Y),
        IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T) →
          IsAbsolutelySeparated B S hS hZ (pullback f g)),
      (∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y),
        (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) g ∧
        (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) g ∧
        IsSeparated B S hS (pullback.snd f g)),
      (∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → Subfunctor Y),
        IsZariskiCover B S hS I U ∧
        ∀ i, IsSeparated B S hS (pullback.snd f (U i).ι))
    ]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallySeparated_tfae
declarations.doc:
For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S` the following are equivalent:
`f` is locally separated; the base change of `f` along every morphism from a representable presheaf
is locally separated; the same for the test objects with affine underlying scheme; for every affine
test object the fibre product is a locally separated algebraic space over the terminal scheme;
there is a surjective étale scheme chart of the target along which the base change of `f` is
locally separated; and there is a Zariski covering of the target over whose members the base
changes of `f` are locally separated.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallySeparated_tfae (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    List.TFAE [
      IsLocallySeparated B S hS f,
      (∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ Y),
        IsLocallySeparated B S hS (pullback.snd f g)),
      (∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ Y),
        IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T) →
          IsLocallySeparated B S hS (pullback.snd f g)),
      (∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ Y),
        IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T) →
          IsAbsolutelyLocallySeparated B S hS hZ (pullback f g)),
      (∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y),
        (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) g ∧
        (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) g ∧
        IsLocallySeparated B S hS (pullback.snd f g)),
      (∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → Subfunctor Y),
        IsZariskiCover B S hS I U ∧
        ∀ i, IsLocallySeparated B S hS (pullback.snd f (U i).ι))
    ]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.separationProperties_graph
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03KO.** Let `Z` be an algebraic space over the scheme `S` and let `f : X ⟶ Y` be
a morphism of algebraic spaces over `Z`.  For the graph `i : X ⟶ X ×[Z] Y` of `f`:

1. `i` is representable, locally of finite type, locally quasi-finite, separated and a
   monomorphism;
2. if `Y ⟶ Z` is locally separated then `i` is an immersion;
3. if `Y ⟶ Z` is separated then `i` is a closed immersion; and
4. if `Y ⟶ Z` is quasi-separated then `i` is quasi-compact.

The graph is a section of the first projection of `X ×[Z] Y`, and all four parts are the
corresponding parts of Stacks 03KP for that section; parts (2), (3) and (4) use in addition
that the first projection inherits the relevant separation property from `Y ⟶ Z` as a base
change of it.
declarations.statement:
theorem separationProperties_graph {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (g : Y ⟶ Z) (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) :
    (yoneda.relativelyRepresentable (graph B S hS f g) ∧
        IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS (graph B S hS f g) ∧
        IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS (graph B S hS f g) ∧
        IsSeparated B S hS (graph B S hS f g) ∧
        Mono (graph B S hS f g)) ∧
      (IsLocallySeparated B S hS g → IsImmersion B S hS (graph B S hS f g)) ∧
      (IsSeparated B S hS g → IsClosedImmersion B S hS (graph B S hS f g)) ∧
      (IsQuasiSeparated B S hS g → IsQuasiCompact B S hS (graph B S hS f g))
