declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleExtensionByZero_preservesFiniteLimits
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03S5 for sheaves of modules, on the sites of Tag 021B.** Extension by zero of
sheaves of `Λ`-modules along an object `U` of the small étale site of `X` preserves finite
limits. Together with the finite colimits it preserves as a left adjoint, extension by zero is
exact.

The small étale site of `U` has fibre products and equalizers, and composition with `U ⟶ X`
preserves both, so Tag 04BH for module coefficients applies.
declarations.statement:
public instance moduleExtensionByZero_preservesFiniteLimits :
    PreservesFiniteLimits (moduleExtensionByZero B X hX U Λ)
declarations.comment: left exactness of j_! for sheaves of modules on the small etale sites of Tag 021B

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalkExtensionByZeroIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03S5.** The stalk at a geometric point `x` of `X` of the extension by zero of an
abelian étale sheaf on `U` is the direct sum of its stalks at the lifts of `x` to `U`.
declarations.statement:
public def stalkExtensionByZeroIso
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    etaleStalk B X hX x ((abelianExtensionByZero B X hX U).obj F).obj ≅
      (∐ fun p : geometricPointLifts B X hX U x => liftedStalk B X hX U x F p)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalkExtensionByZeroIso_germ
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03S5.** The stalk isomorphism sends the germ of a section over an étale
neighbourhood `W ⟶ U`, viewed in the extension by zero through the adjunction unit, to its
germ at the induced lift, in the corresponding summand of the direct sum. This formula
characterises the isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem stalkExtensionByZeroIso_germ
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (W : SmallEtale B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property)
    (p : geometricPointLifts B X hX U x)
    (w : (geometricPointFiber B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property
      (geometricPointOfLift B X hX U x p)).obj W)
    (q : (geometricPointFiber B X hX x).obj ((smallEtalePostcompose B X hX U).obj W))
    (hq : q.1 = w.1) (s : F.obj.obj (op W)) :
    (stalkExtensionByZeroIso B X hX U x F).hom
      ((colimit.ι ((CategoryOfElements.π (geometricPointFiber B X hX x)).op ⋙
          ((abelianExtensionByZero B X hX U).obj F).obj)
          (op (Functor.elementsMk _ ((smallEtalePostcompose B X hX U).obj W) q)))
        (((abelianExtensionByZeroAdjunction B X hX U).unit.app F).hom.app (op W) s)) =
      (Sigma.ι (fun p : geometricPointLifts B X hX U x => liftedStalk B X hX U x F p) p)
        ((colimit.ι ((CategoryOfElements.π (geometricPointFiber B U.obj.left.1
            U.obj.left.property (geometricPointOfLift B X hX U x p))).op ⋙ F.obj)
          (op (Functor.elementsMk _ W w))) s)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalkExtensionByZeroIso_naturality
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03S5.** The stalk decomposition of extension by zero is natural in the abelian
sheaf.
declarations.statement:
public theorem stalkExtensionByZeroIso_naturality
    {F G : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}}
    (f : F ⟶ G) :
    colimMap (Functor.whiskerLeft (CategoryOfElements.π (geometricPointFiber B X hX x)).op
        ((abelianExtensionByZero B X hX U).map f).hom) ≫
        (stalkExtensionByZeroIso B X hX U x G).hom =
      (stalkExtensionByZeroIso B X hX U x F).hom ≫
        Limits.Sigma.map (fun p : geometricPointLifts B X hX U x =>
          colimMap (Functor.whiskerLeft (CategoryOfElements.π (geometricPointFiber
            B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property (geometricPointOfLift B X hX U x p))).op f.hom))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.abelianExtensionByZero_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03S5.** Extension by zero of abelian sheaves along an étale morphism is exact.
Under the equivalence of the small étale site of `U` with the localization of the small étale
site of `X` at `U`, extension by zero becomes lower shriek along `Over.forget U`, which is
exact.
declarations.statement:
public theorem abelianExtensionByZero_exact :
    exactFunctor _ _ (abelianExtensionByZero B X hX U)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.abelianExtensionByZeroBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03S6, abelian sheaves.** Extension by zero of abelian étale sheaves commutes
with base change: for `f : Y ⟶ X` and `j : V ⟶ X` étale with base change `j' : V' ⟶ Y` and
`f' : V' ⟶ V`, one has `j'_! ∘ f'^{-1} ≅ f^{-1} ∘ j_!`, naturally in the sheaf.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def abelianExtensionByZeroBaseChangeIso
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) {X Y : B.Scheme} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (U : SmallEtale B X.1 X.property) :
    (smallEtaleBaseChange B (baseChangedEtaleProjection B f U)).sheafPullback
        AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B
          ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).obj U).obj.left.1
          ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).obj U).obj.left.property) ⋙
      abelianExtensionByZero B Y.1 Y.property
        ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).obj U) ≅
    abelianExtensionByZero B X.1 X.property U ⋙
      (smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (SmallEtale.topology B X.1 X.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B Y.1 Y.property)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleExtensionByZeroBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03S6, sheaves of modules.** Extension by zero of étale sheaves of `Λ`-modules
commutes with base change, by the same adjunction argument as for abelian sheaves.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def moduleExtensionByZeroBaseChangeIso
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) {X Y : B.Scheme} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (U : SmallEtale B X.1 X.property) (Λ : Type v) [Ring Λ] :
    (smallEtaleBaseChange B (baseChangedEtaleProjection B f U)).sheafPullback
        (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} Λ)
        (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B
          ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).obj U).obj.left.1
          ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).obj U).obj.left.property) ⋙
      moduleExtensionByZero B Y.1 Y.property
        ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).obj U) Λ ≅
    moduleExtensionByZero B X.1 X.property U Λ ⋙
      (smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPullback (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} Λ)
        (SmallEtale.topology B X.1 X.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B Y.1 Y.property)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.abelianExtensionByZeroToPushforward_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03S7.** For a finite étale morphism, the canonical map from extension by zero to
the direct image is an isomorphism on abelian sheaves.
declarations.statement:
public theorem abelianExtensionByZeroToPushforward_isIso :
    IsIso (abelianExtensionByZeroToPushforward B X hX U)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleExtensionByZeroToPushforward_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03S7.** For a finite étale morphism, the canonical map from extension by zero to
the direct image is an isomorphism on sheaves of `Λ`-modules.
declarations.statement:
public theorem moduleExtensionByZeroToPushforward_isIso (Λ : Type v) [Ring Λ] :
    IsIso (moduleExtensionByZeroToPushforward B X hX U Λ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_abelianShriekConstant
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03S8, part (2).** For an étale morphism `j : U ⟶ X` of quasi-compact and
quasi-separated schemes, presented as an object `U` of the small étale site of `X`, and `M` a
finite abelian group, the extension by zero `j_!\underline{M}` is a constructible abelian sheaf
on `X_étale`.

By `AlgebraicGeometry.abelianShriekConstantIsoCopower` this sheaf is the copower sheaf by `M` on
the sheaf `h_U^#` of sets, which is constructible by part (1) of the same tag; and the copower
sheaf by a finite abelian group carries a constructible sheaf of sets to a constructible abelian
sheaf. No input beyond part (1) of the tag is used.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_abelianShriekConstant [Finite M]
    [CompactSpace X.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj] (U : SmallEtale B X.obj X.property)
    [CompactSpace U.obj.left.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace U.obj.left.obj] :
    IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B X
      ((abelianExtensionByZero B X.obj X.property U).obj
        ((constantSheaf (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.obj U.obj.left.property)
          AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj M))
declarations.comment: part (2), abelian sheaves: an extension by zero of the constant sheaf at a finite abelian group at a quasi-compact quasi-separated etale object is a constructible abelian sheaf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.abelianShriekZModIsConstructible
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03S8, part (2), at the finite abelian groups `Z/nZ`.** The predicate
`AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianShriekZModIsConstructible` holds: for every scheme `Y` of `B` that is
quasi-compact and quasi-separated, every quasi-compact quasi-separated étale object `U` of
`Y_étale` and every positive integer `n`, the abelian sheaf `j_{U!}(Z/nZ)` is constructible.

`ZMod n` is finite exactly because `n` is positive, so this is
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_abelianShriekConstant` at
`M = ULift (ZMod n)`.
declarations.statement: public theorem abelianShriekZModIsConstructible : AbelianShriekZModIsConstructible B
declarations.comment: part (2) at the finite groups Z/nZ, the form AbelianShriekZModIsConstructible

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleSetSheaf_sheafifiedYoneda
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03S8, part (1).** For an étale morphism of quasi-compact and quasi-separated
schemes `j : U ⟶ X`, presented as an object `U` of the small étale site of `X`, the sheaf `h_U`
represented by `U` is a constructible sheaf of sets on `X_étale`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleSetSheaf_sheafifiedYoneda (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (X : B.Scheme)
    [CompactSpace X.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj]
    (U : SmallEtale B X.obj X.property)
    [CompactSpace U.obj.left.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace U.obj.left.obj]
    (hstrat : HasFiniteEtaleStratification B X U) :
    IsConstructibleSetSheaf B X
      ((Sheaf.sheafifiedYoneda (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)).obj U)
declarations.comment: part (1), carrying the conclusion of Stacks 03S0 (an etale morphism of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes becomes finite etale on the strata of a partition of its target into constructible locally closed subschemes) as the explicit hypothesis hstrat

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructible_sheafifiedYoneda_and_abelianShriekConstant_and_moduleShriek_of_qcqs
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03S8.** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme of a big étale site,
`R` a Noetherian commutative ring and `U` a quasi-compact quasi-separated object of the small
étale site of `X`, so that `j : U ⟶ X` is an étale morphism of quasi-compact quasi-separated
schemes. Then

1. the sheaf `h_U^#` of sets represented by `U` is a constructible sheaf of sets on `X_étale`;
2. for every finite abelian group `M` the extension by zero `j_!\underline{M}` is a constructible
   abelian sheaf on `X_étale`; and
3. for every finite `R`-module `M` the extension by zero `j_{U!}\underline{M}` is a constructible
   sheaf of `R`-modules on `X_étale`.

This is the whole tag in one statement, under the source's quasi-compactness and
quasi-separatedness of `X` and of `U` and no other hypothesis. Each part is proved by the theorem
that states it alone: `AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleSetSheaf_sheafifiedYoneda_of_qcqs` for
part (1), `AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_abelianShriekConstant` for part (2), and
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_moduleShriek` for part (3). All six existing
registrations of the tag are retained, each stating its own part or a case of one.

The ring `R`, its commutativity and its Noetherianness are hypotheses of part (3) alone: parts
(1) and (2) do not mention `R` and are proved without it. Part (1) is used in proving parts (2)
and (3), so the conjunction asserts no more than parts (2) and (3) together do; it is the
statement of the tag rather than a new fact.

No instance beyond the source's hypotheses is assumed, although the components appear to assume
four families of them; see the implementation notes above.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructible_sheafifiedYoneda_and_abelianShriekConstant_and_moduleShriek_of_qcqs
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (X : B.Scheme) (R : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [CompactSpace X.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj] (U : SmallEtale B X.obj X.property)
    [CompactSpace U.obj.left.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace U.obj.left.obj] :
    IsConstructibleSetSheaf B X
        ((Sheaf.sheafifiedYoneda (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)).obj U) ∧
      (∀ (M : AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) [Finite M],
        IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B X
          ((abelianExtensionByZero B X.obj X.property U).obj
            ((constantSheaf (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.obj U.obj.left.property)
              AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj M))) ∧
      (∀ (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) [Module.Finite R M],
        IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X R (moduleShriek.{u, u + 1, u + 1} B X R U M))
declarations.comment: the whole tag: part (1) the sheaf of sets represented by a quasi-compact quasi-separated etale object is constructible, part (2) an extension by zero of the constant sheaf at a finite abelian group is a constructible abelian sheaf, part (3) an extension by zero of the constant sheaf at a finite module over a Noetherian commutative ring is a constructible sheaf of modules. Unconditional: only the source's quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness of X and of U, and part (3)'s own Noetherian commutative ring. No IsRightAdjoint or HasWeakSheafify assumption is carried, those being inferable here although the elaborated signatures of parts (2) and (3) assume them. All six component registrations are retained.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_moduleShriek
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03S8, part (3).** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme, `Λ` a
Noetherian ring and `M` a finite `Λ`-module. For `U` a quasi-compact and quasi-separated object of
the small étale site of `X`, the extension by zero `j_{U!}\underline{M}` is a constructible sheaf
of `Λ`-modules on `X_étale`.

By `ModuleCat.exists_cokernel_finFreeSigma_of_finite` the module `M` is the cokernel of a map
between finite direct sums of copies of `Λ`. Extension by zero of the constant sheaf is a left
adjoint, so it carries that presentation to one of `j_{U!}\underline{M}` as the cokernel of a map
between finite direct sums of copies of `j_{U!}\underline{Λ}`, which are constructible.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleModuleSheaf_moduleShriek
    [CompactSpace X.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj] (U : SmallEtale B X.obj X.property)
    [CompactSpace U.obj.left.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace U.obj.left.obj]
    (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) [Module.Finite R M] :
    IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X R (moduleShriek.{u, u + 1, u + 1} B X R U M)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleSetSheaf_sheafifiedYoneda_of_qcqs
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03S8, part (1).** For an étale morphism `j : U ⟶ X` of quasi-compact and
quasi-separated schemes, presented as an object `U` of the small étale site of `X`, the sheaf
`h_U` represented by `U` is a constructible sheaf of sets on `X_étale`.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleSetSheaf_sheafifiedYoneda` with its hypothesis, the
conclusion of Stacks 03S0, discharged by `AlgebraicGeometry.hasFiniteEtaleStratification`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleSetSheaf_sheafifiedYoneda_of_qcqs
    [CompactSpace X.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj] (U : SmallEtale B X.obj X.property)
    [CompactSpace U.obj.left.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace U.obj.left.obj] :
    IsConstructibleSetSheaf B X
      ((Sheaf.sheafifiedYoneda (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)).obj U)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_moduleShriekConstant
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03S8 for sheaves of modules.** For `U` a quasi-compact quasi-separated object of the
small étale site of a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme `X` and `Λ` a Noetherian commutative
ring in an arbitrary universe `r`, the extension by zero `j_{U!}\underline{\Lambda}_U` of the
constant free rank-one module sheaf is a constructible sheaf of `Λ`-modules in
`ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ`.

By `AlgebraicGeometry.moduleShriekConstantIsoCopower` this sheaf is the copower module sheaf by
the free rank-one module on the sheaf `h_U^#` of sets, which is constructible as a sheaf of sets
in the module universe by
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleFiniteSheaf_sheafifiedUliftYoneda_of_qcqs`, part (1) of the same
tag. The copower stands in for `ModuleCat.free Λ`, whose source `Type r ⥤ ModuleCat.{r} Λ` would
force the ring into the module universe.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleModuleSheaf_moduleShriekConstant
    [CompactSpace X.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj] (U : SmallEtale B X.obj X.property)
    [CompactSpace U.obj.left.obj] [QuasiSeparatedSpace U.obj.left.obj] :
    IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X Λ (moduleShriekConstant.{u, r, r} B X Λ U)
declarations.comment: sheaves of modules over a Noetherian commutative ring in an arbitrary universe: an extension by zero of a constant free rank-one module sheaf at a quasi-compact quasi-separated etale object is constructible

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isFilteredColimit_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_of_torsionSheafProperty
declarations.doc:
**The content of Stacks 03SA (2).** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme and
let `F` be a torsion abelian sheaf on `X_étale`. Then `F` is a filtered colimit of constructible
abelian sheaves.

This is the faithful restatement of
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isFilteredColimit_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf`
(`Constructible/TorsionColimitOfConstructibles.lean`), whose torsion hypothesis is
`AlgebraicGeometry.IsTorsionAbelianSheaf`, the *pointwise* annihilation of every section over
every étale object. That condition strengthens the hypothesis of the tag, whose "torsion abelian
sheaf" is the *local* condition of Stacks 0DD7, here `Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty`; the
two are not equivalent, the objects of `X_étale` not being quasi-compact.

The proof is the source's, and is the same as the pointwise version's: the presentation supplied
by `h093C` writes `F` as a filtered colimit of the cokernels displayed by Stacks 09YT, and those
cokernels are constructible by the library's Stacks 09YT,
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_of_hasFiniteZModShriekPresentation`, which rests on
Stacks 03RZ (2).

Two statements of the source are hypotheses of this theorem rather than inputs it derives.
Stacks 03S8 (2) at the finite groups `ℤ/nℤ`, as `h03S8`, is a theorem of the library —
`AlgebraicGeometry.abelianShriekZModIsConstructible` of
`Constructible/AbelianShriekConstructible.lean` proves
`AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianShriekZModIsConstructible` outright — so any caller can supply it.
Stacks 093C for torsion abelian sheaves at the local torsion notion, as `h093C` in the spelling
`AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyTorsionAbelianSheavesAreFilteredColimitsOfZModPresentations`, is not:
the library has no proof of it, and no caller can supply it, so the tag is registered with that
one hypothesis named in its clause string.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isFilteredColimit_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_of_torsionSheafProperty
    (h093C : LocallyTorsionAbelianSheavesAreFilteredColimitsOfZModPresentations B X)
    (h03S8 : AbelianShriekZModIsConstructible B) (hXc : CompactSpace X.obj)
    (hXq : QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hF : torsionSheafProperty (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) F) :
    ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (_ : SmallCategory I) (_ : IsFiltered I)
      (D : I ⥤ Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
      (ι : D ⟶ (Functor.const I).obj F), Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk F ι)) ∧
        ∀ i, IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B X (D.obj i)
declarations.comment: part (2), at the faithful local torsion notion; 093C and 03S8 (2) granted

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isFilteredColimit_isConstructibleSetSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03SA (1).** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme and `F` a sheaf of
sets on `X_étale`. Then `F` is a filtered colimit of constructible sheaves of sets.

This is the source's own proof: Stacks 093C writes `F` as a filtered colimit of coequalizers of
maps between finite coproducts of representables at quasi-compact quasi-separated objects, and
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleSetSheaf_of_presentation` says those coequalizers are
constructible. Of the three cited inputs, Stacks 03S8 (1) and Stacks 03RZ (1) are discharged from
the library; what remains as hypotheses is Stacks 093C, and Stacks 03S0, which Stacks 03S8 (1)
itself carries.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isFilteredColimit_isConstructibleSetSheaf
    (h093C : SetSheavesAreFilteredColimitsOfPresentations B X)
    (h03S0 : EtaleFiniteStratificationExists B) (hXc : CompactSpace X.obj)
    (hXq : QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (Type (u + 1))) :
    ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (_ : SmallCategory I) (_ : IsFiltered I)
      (D : I ⥤ Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (Type (u + 1)))
      (ι : D ⟶ (Functor.const I).obj F), Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk F ι)) ∧
        ∀ i, IsConstructibleSetSheaf B X (D.obj i)
declarations.comment: part (1), granted Stacks 093C (1) in the coequalizer spelling as the hypothesis h093C and Stacks 03S0 as the hypothesis h03S0; Stacks 03S8 (1) and Stacks 03RZ (1) are discharged from the library

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isFilteredColimit_isConstructibleModuleSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03SA (3).** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme, `Λ` a Noetherian
ring and `F` a sheaf of `Λ`-modules on `X_étale`. Then `F` is a filtered colimit of constructible
sheaves of `Λ`-modules.

This is the source's own proof: Stacks 093C writes `F` as a filtered colimit of cokernels of maps
between finite direct sums of the sheaves `j_{U!}Λ` at quasi-compact quasi-separated objects, and
the library's Stacks 095N says those cokernels are constructible once the generators are — that is
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_of_hasFiniteShriekPresentation`. Stacks 03RZ (3) is
discharged from the library; what remains as hypotheses is Stacks 093C and the
sheaves-of-modules case of Stacks 03S8.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isFilteredColimit_isConstructibleModuleSheaf
    (h093C : ModuleSheavesAreFilteredColimitsOfPresentations B X Λ)
    (hshriek : ∀ U : SmallEtale B X.obj X.property, IsQCQSEtaleObject B X U →
      IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X Λ (moduleShriekConstant.{u, u + 1, u + 1} B X Λ U))
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (_ : SmallCategory I) (_ : IsFiltered I)
      (D : I ⥤ Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
      (ι : D ⟶ (Functor.const I).obj F), Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk F ι)) ∧
        ∀ i, IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X Λ (D.obj i)
declarations.comment: part (3), granted Stacks 093C (2) in the shriek spelling as the hypothesis h093C and the sheaves-of-modules case of Stacks 03S8 as the hypothesis hshriek, which is the same hypothesis the library's Stacks 095N carries; Stacks 03RZ (3) is discharged from the library

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isFilteredColimit_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_of_qcqs
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03SA (2).** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme and let `F` be a
torsion abelian sheaf on `X_étale`. Then `F` is a filtered colimit of constructible abelian
sheaves.

The torsion condition is the local one of Stacks 0DD7, `Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty`:
every section is annihilated by a positive integer after restriction along the arrows of a
covering sieve. The colimit is taken in the category of abelian sheaves on `X_étale`, over a small
filtered index category, and the terms are constructible in the sense of Stacks 03RW (2). This is
`AlgebraicGeometry.ind_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_of_torsionSheafProperty` in the
diagram-and-cocone spelling of parts (1) and (3).
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isFilteredColimit_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_of_qcqs
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hF : Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) F) :
    ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (_ : SmallCategory I) (_ : IsFiltered I)
      (D : I ⥤ Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
      (ι : D ⟶ (Functor.const I).obj F), Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk F ι)) ∧
        ∀ i, IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B X (D.obj i)
declarations.comment: part (2), torsion abelian sheaves, torsion in the local sense of Stacks 0DD7

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isFilteredColimit_isConstructibleSetSheaf_of_qcqs
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03SA, part (1).** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme and `F` a
sheaf of sets on `X_étale`. Then `F` is a filtered colimit of constructible sheaves of sets.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isFilteredColimit_isConstructibleSetSheaf` with both of its
hypotheses discharged: Stacks 093C (1) by
`AlgebraicGeometry.setSheavesAreFilteredColimitsOfPresentations` and Stacks 03S0 by
`AlgebraicGeometry.etaleFiniteStratificationExists`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isFilteredColimit_isConstructibleSetSheaf_of_qcqs
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (Type (u + 1))) :
    ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (_ : SmallCategory I) (_ : IsFiltered I)
      (D : I ⥤ Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (Type (u + 1)))
      (ι : D ⟶ (Functor.const I).obj F), Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk F ι)) ∧
        ∀ i, IsConstructibleSetSheaf B X (D.obj i)
declarations.comment: part (1), sheaves of sets, with 093C (1) and 03S0 discharged

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isFilteredColimit_isConstructibleModuleSheaf_of_qcqs
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03SA, part (3).** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme, `Λ` a
Noetherian ring and `F` a sheaf of `Λ`-modules on `X_étale`. Then `F` is a filtered colimit of
constructible sheaves of `Λ`-modules.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isFilteredColimit_isConstructibleModuleSheaf` with both of its
hypotheses discharged: Stacks 093C (2) by
`AlgebraicGeometry.moduleSheavesAreFilteredColimitsOfPresentations` and Stacks 03S8 for sheaves of
modules by `AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleModuleSheaf_moduleShriekConstant`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isFilteredColimit_isConstructibleModuleSheaf_of_qcqs
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (_ : SmallCategory I) (_ : IsFiltered I)
      (D : I ⥤ Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
      (ι : D ⟶ (Functor.const I).obj F), Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk F ι)) ∧
        ∀ i, IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X Λ (D.obj i)
declarations.comment: part (3), sheaves of modules, with 093C (2) and 03S8 discharged

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isFilteredColimit_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03SA (2).** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme and let `F` be a
torsion abelian sheaf on `X_étale`. Then `F` is a filtered colimit of constructible abelian
sheaves.

This is the source's own proof, organised as for parts (1) and (3): the granted presentation
writes `F` as a filtered colimit of the cokernels displayed by Stacks 09YT, and those cokernels
are constructible by the library's Stacks 09YT,
`AlgebraicGeometry.isConstructibleAbelianSheaf_of_hasFiniteZModShriekPresentation`, which in turn
rests on Stacks 03RZ for abelian sheaves
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Constructible.constructibleAbelianSheaf_isWeakSerreClass`, an unconditional
instance of this library). Of the inputs the source cites, Stacks 03RZ (2) is discharged from the
library; what remains granted is Stacks 093C for torsion abelian sheaves, which subsumes the
source's reduction to part (3), and Stacks 03S8 (2) at the finite groups `ℤ/nℤ`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isFilteredColimit_isConstructibleAbelianSheaf
    (h093C : TorsionAbelianSheavesAreFilteredColimitsOfZModPresentations B X)
    (h03S8 : AbelianShriekZModIsConstructible B) (hXc : CompactSpace X.obj)
    (hXq : QuasiSeparatedSpace X.obj)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hF : IsTorsionAbelianSheaf B X F) :
    ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (_ : SmallCategory I) (_ : IsFiltered I)
      (D : I ⥤ Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
      (ι : D ⟶ (Functor.const I).obj F), Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk F ι)) ∧
        ∀ i, IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf B X (D.obj i)
declarations.comment: part (2), torsion abelian sheaves, granted Stacks 093C for torsion abelian sheaves in the Z/nZ-shriek spelling as the hypothesis h093C, which subsumes the source's reduction to part (3), and Stacks 03S8 (2) at the finite groups Z/nZ as the hypothesis h03S8; Stacks 03RZ (2) and Stacks 09YT are discharged from the library

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.torsionCurveAssertions
declarations.statement:
theorem torsionCurveAssertions {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [HasExt.{u + 1} (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ 1) (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hF : Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty X.smallEtaleTopology F) :
    TorsionCurveAssertions f F

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.curveStatements_extensionByZero_forget₂_of_isFiniteLocallyConstant
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 03SD.** In Situation 0A52 — `k` algebraically closed, `X` separated,
of finite type and of dimension at most one over `k` — assume `X` is reduced. Let `j : U ⟶ X` be
an open immersion with `U` connected, `ℓ` a prime and `G` a finite locally constant sheaf of
`F_ℓ`-vector spaces (`ZMod ℓ`-modules) on `U_étale`. Then statements (1) -- (8) of Situation
0A52 (`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.CurveStatements`) hold for the abelian sheaf `F = j_! G`, at every
coefficient universe and every `Ext` universe.

`j_! G` is killed by `ℓ`, hence torsion, so this is the reduction theorem
`curveStatements_of_torsionSheafProperty_max` applied with Lemma 0A5B on smooth curves
(`curveStatementsConstantOnSmoothCurves_of_prime`). The hypotheses that `X` is reduced, that `U`
is connected and that `G` is finite locally constant are those of the source; the proof does not
use them.
declarations.statement:
theorem curveStatements_extensionByZero_forget₂_of_isFiniteLocallyConstant {k : Type u}
    [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {X U : Scheme.{u}} (π : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSeparated π]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType π] [QuasiCompact π] [IsReduced X] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ 1)
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] [ConnectedSpace U] {ℓ : ℕ} (hℓ : ℓ.Prime)
    (G : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} (ZMod ℓ)))
    [Stacks.ConstantSheaf.IsFiniteLocallyConstant U.smallEtaleTopology G]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v})] :
    CurveStatements.{u, v, w} π ((extensionByZero.{u, v} j).obj
      ((sheafCompose U.smallEtaleTopology
        (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} (ZMod ℓ)) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v})).obj G))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.abelianTrace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03SE.** The trace map of the finite étale morphism `U ⟶ X` on abelian étale
sheaves: the counit `j_!j^{-1} ⟶ id` of the extension-by-zero adjunction, read as a map
`j_*j^{-1} ⟶ id` through the comparison isomorphism `j_! ≅ j_*` of Stacks 03S7.
declarations.statement:
public def abelianTrace :
    let := smallEtaleBaseChange_isContinuous B U.obj.hom
    abelianRestriction B X hX U ⋙
        (smallEtaleBaseChange B U.obj.hom).sheafPushforwardContinuous
          AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (SmallEtale.topology B X hX)
          (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property) ⟶
      𝟭 (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X hX) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleTrace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03SE.** The trace map of the finite étale morphism `U ⟶ X` on étale sheaves of
`Λ`-modules, constructed exactly as in the abelian case.
declarations.statement:
public def moduleTrace :
    let := smallEtaleBaseChange_isContinuous B U.obj.hom
    moduleRestriction B X hX U Λ ⋙
        (smallEtaleBaseChange B U.obj.hom).sheafPushforwardContinuous
          (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} Λ)
          (SmallEtale.topology B X hX)
          (SmallEtale.topology B U.obj.left.1 U.obj.left.property) ⟶
      𝟭 (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X hX) (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} Λ))

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.curveStatements_extensionByZero_zmod_of_smooth
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 03SG.** In Situation 0A52 — `k` algebraically closed, `X` separated,
of finite type and of dimension at most one over `k` — assume `X` is smooth over `k`. Let
`j : U ⟶ X` be an open immersion, `ℓ` a prime and `F = j_! 𝐙/ℓ𝐙` the extension by zero of the
constant sheaf on `U_étale` with value an abelian group `E` cyclic of order `ℓ`. Then statements
(1) -- (8) of Situation 0A52 hold for `F`, in the sense of
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.CurveStatements`, at every coefficient universe and every `Ext`
universe.

A smooth `X` over a field is reduced, so this is Lemma 0A3Q,
`curveStatements_extensionByZero_constantSheaf_of_prime`.
declarations.statement:
theorem curveStatements_extensionByZero_zmod_of_smooth {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    {X U : Scheme.{u}} (π : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSeparated π] [LocallyOfFiniteType π]
    [QuasiCompact π] [Smooth π] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ 1) (j : U ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] {ℓ : ℕ} (hℓ : ℓ.Prime) (E : AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v})
    (hE : Nonempty (E ≃+ ZMod ℓ))
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v})] :
    CurveStatements.{u, v, w} π ((extensionByZero.{u, v} j).obj
      ((constantSheaf U.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}).obj E))

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.mono_etaleModuleCohomology_map_unit_of_finiteEtale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03SH, the méthode de la trace.** For `f : T ⟶ S` finite étale of degree `d` and a
sheaf of `Λ`-modules `F` on which multiplication by `d` is an isomorphism, the map
`H^n(S, F) ⟶ H^n(T, f⁻¹ F)` — induced by the restriction `F ⟶ f_* f⁻¹ F`, followed by the
identification `H^n(S, f_* f⁻¹ F) = H^n(T, f⁻¹ F)` — is injective: the restriction has a left
inverse, the trace divided by `d`.
declarations.statement:
theorem mono_etaleModuleCohomology_map_unit_of_finiteEtale [IsIso (d • 𝟙 F)] (n : ℕ) :
    Mono (((etaleModuleGlobalSections.{u, r} Λ S).rightDerived n).map
        ((etaleModuleInverseImageAdj.{u, r} Λ f).unit.app F) ≫
      (etaleModuleCohomologyDirectImageIsoOfIsIntegralHom Λ f n
        ((etaleModuleInverseImage.{u, r} Λ f).obj F)).hom)
declarations.comment: the méthode de la trace: H^n(X, F) → H^n(Y, f⁻¹F) is injective when multiplication by the degree is an isomorphism of F

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isZero_etaleModuleCohomology_of_finiteEtale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03SH, the vanishing consequence of the méthode de la trace.** For `f : T ⟶ S` finite
étale of degree `d` and a sheaf of `Λ`-modules `F` on which multiplication by `d` is an
isomorphism, `H^q(T, f⁻¹ F) = 0` implies `H^q(S, F) = 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_etaleModuleCohomology_of_finiteEtale [IsIso (d • 𝟙 F)] (q : ℕ)
    (h : IsZero (((etaleModuleGlobalSections.{u, r} Λ T).rightDerived q).obj
      ((etaleModuleInverseImage.{u, r} Λ f).obj F))) :
    IsZero (((etaleModuleGlobalSections.{u, r} Λ S).rightDerived q).obj F)
declarations.comment: if H^q(Y, f⁻¹F) = 0 then H^q(X, F) = 0, when multiplication by the degree is an isomorphism of F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleTrace_app_eq_sum_of_cover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03SH, the trace on a split cover is the sum map.** If over the étale object `Q` of
`T` the morphism `f` is described by the pairwise disjoint morphisms `φ i : Q ⟶ T'` whose graphs
cover `Q ×_T T'`, so that `(f_* f^{-1} ℱ)(Q) = ℱ(Q ×_T T') = ⨁ᵢ ℱ(Q)`, then the trace sends a
section to the sum of its restrictions to the sheets `φ i`, each read on `Q`.
declarations.statement:
theorem moduleTrace_app_eq_sum_of_cover
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B T.1 T.property) (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} Λ))
    (Q : SmallEtale B T.1 T.property) {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι]
    (φ : ι → (Q ⟶ SmallEtale.ofEtaleHom B f))
    (hcov : ∀ z : ((smallEtaleBaseChange B (SmallEtale.ofEtaleHom B f).obj.hom).obj Q).obj.left.1,
      ∃ i, z ∈ Set.range (B.inclusion.map
        (smallEtaleLiftGraph B T.1 T.property (SmallEtale.ofEtaleHom B f) Q (φ i)).hom.left))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => smallEtaleArrowsDisjoint B T.1 T.property
      (SmallEtale.ofEtaleHom B f) Q (φ i) (φ j)))
    (s : F.obj.obj (op ((smallEtalePostcompose B T.1 T.property (SmallEtale.ofEtaleHom B f)).obj
      ((smallEtaleBaseChange B (SmallEtale.ofEtaleHom B f).obj.hom).obj Q)))) :
    ((moduleTrace B T.1 T.property (SmallEtale.ofEtaleHom B f) Λ).app F).hom.app (op Q) s =
      ∑ i, F.obj.map (smallEtaleLiftPostIso B T.1 T.property (SmallEtale.ofEtaleHom B f) Q
        (φ i)).inv.op
        (((moduleRestriction B T.1 T.property (SmallEtale.ofEtaleHom B f) Λ).obj F).obj.map
          (smallEtaleLiftGraph B T.1 T.property (SmallEtale.ofEtaleHom B f) Q (φ i)).op s)
declarations.comment: if Y is a disjoint union of copies of the base, the trace is the sum map, for sheaves of Λ-modules

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.eq_moduleTrace_app_of_sum
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03SH, the trace is characterized by the sum formula.** A morphism
`τ : f_* f^{-1} ℱ ⟶ ℱ` which, over every étale neighbourhood `Q` on which `f` is a disjoint union
of copies of `Q` (pairwise disjoint sheets `φ i : Q ⟶ T'` whose graphs cover `Q ×_T T'`), sends a
section to the sum of its restrictions to the sheets is the trace: such neighbourhoods cover `T`
(Stacks 04HN), and two morphisms of sheaves agreeing on a covering agree.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_moduleTrace_app_of_sum
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B T.1 T.property) (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} Λ))
    (τ : (B.smallPushforward f (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} Λ)).obj
      ((moduleRestriction B T.1 T.property (SmallEtale.ofEtaleHom B f) Λ).obj F) ⟶ F)
    (hτ : ∀ (Q : SmallEtale B T.1 T.property) {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι]
      (φ : ι → (Q ⟶ SmallEtale.ofEtaleHom B f)),
      (∀ z : ((smallEtaleBaseChange B (SmallEtale.ofEtaleHom B f).obj.hom).obj Q).obj.left.1,
        ∃ i, z ∈ Set.range (B.inclusion.map
          (smallEtaleLiftGraph B T.1 T.property (SmallEtale.ofEtaleHom B f) Q (φ i)).hom.left)) →
      Pairwise (fun i j => smallEtaleArrowsDisjoint B T.1 T.property
        (SmallEtale.ofEtaleHom B f) Q (φ i) (φ j)) →
      ∀ s : F.obj.obj (op ((smallEtalePostcompose B T.1 T.property (SmallEtale.ofEtaleHom B f)).obj
        ((smallEtaleBaseChange B (SmallEtale.ofEtaleHom B f).obj.hom).obj Q))),
      τ.hom.app (op Q) s =
        ∑ i, F.obj.map (smallEtaleLiftPostIso B T.1 T.property (SmallEtale.ofEtaleHom B f) Q
          (φ i)).inv.op
          (((moduleRestriction B T.1 T.property (SmallEtale.ofEtaleHom B f) Λ).obj F).obj.map
            (smallEtaleLiftGraph B T.1 T.property (SmallEtale.ofEtaleHom B f) Q (φ i)).op s)) :
    τ = (moduleTrace B T.1 T.property (SmallEtale.ofEtaleHom B f) Λ).app F
declarations.comment: the trace is characterized by being the sum map étale locally on the base, for sheaves of Λ-modules

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.unit_comp_moduleTrace_eq_nsmul
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03SH, the trace of a finite étale morphism of degree `d` on sheaves of modules.**
For `f` finite étale and finite locally free of rank `d`, the restriction map `ℱ ⟶ f_* f^{-1} ℱ`
(the unit of `f^{-1} ⊣ f_*`) followed by the trace `f_* f^{-1} ℱ ⟶ ℱ` of Definition 03SE is
multiplication by `d`.
declarations.statement:
theorem unit_comp_moduleTrace_eq_nsmul (d : ℕ)
    [Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank (B.inclusion.map f) d]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B T.1 T.property) (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} Λ)) :
    (smallEtalePostcomposePushforwardAdjunction B f
        (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} Λ)).unit.app F ≫
        (moduleTrace B T.1 T.property (SmallEtale.ofEtaleHom B f) Λ).app F = d • 𝟙 F
declarations.comment: restriction followed by the trace is multiplication by the degree, for sheaves of Λ-modules

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.smallEtaleSite_iso_of_universalHomeomorphism
declarations.doc:
**Part (1) of Stacks Project, Tag 03SI: the small étale sites of a universal homeomorphism
are isomorphic.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a universal homeomorphism. Base change along `f` is an
equivalence from the small étale category of `Y` to that of `X`, and a sieve on a scheme étale
over `Y` is covering exactly when its image under base change is covering.

The equivalence of categories is Stacks Project, Tag 04DZ; the correspondence of coverings holds
for any surjection.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallEtaleSite_iso_of_universalHomeomorphism (f : X ⟶ Y) [UniversalHomeomorphism f] :
    (smallEtaleBaseChange f).IsEquivalence ∧
      ∀ (V : Y.Etale) (S : Sieve V),
        S.functorPushforward (smallEtaleBaseChange f) ∈
            smallEtaleTopology X ((smallEtaleBaseChange f).obj V) ↔
          S ∈ smallEtaleTopology Y V
declarations.comment:
part (1): the isomorphism of sites, as the equivalence of the small etale
categories induced by base change together with the correspondence of covering sieves. The
source's hypothesis is a universal homeomorphism, which is this statement's hypothesis as
well.

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.smallEtaleInverseImage_isEquivalence_of_universalHomeomorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03SI, part (2).** For a universal homeomorphism `f : X ⟶ Y` the small étale topoi of
`X` and `Y` are equivalent: the canonical inverse-image functor on sheaves of types is an
equivalence of categories.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallEtaleInverseImage_isEquivalence_of_universalHomeomorphism :
    (smallEtaleInverseImage.{u, v} f).IsEquivalence
declarations.comment: part (2), equivalence of the small étale topoi

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.etaleCohomologyRestrictionMap_bijective_of_universalHomeomorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03SI, part (3).** For a universal homeomorphism `f : X ⟶ Y` étale cohomology agrees
in every degree: restriction along `f` is bijective on `H^q` of every abelian sheaf on the small
étale site of `Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem etaleCohomologyRestrictionMap_bijective_of_universalHomeomorphism
    [HasSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}]
    [HasSheafify Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v})]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v})]
    (F : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}) (q : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective (etaleCohomologyRestrictionMap.{u, v, w} f F q)

declarations.name: Stacks.Frobenius.absoluteFrobenius
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03SM.** The absolute Frobenius of a scheme in characteristic `p`: it
is the identity on points and the `p`-th power map on the structure sheaf.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def absoluteFrobenius (X : Scheme.{u}) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (hX : IsInCharacteristic X p) : X ⟶ X

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.absoluteFrobeniusCohomologyFunctorIso
declarations.doc:
On a scheme `X` of characteristic `p`, pullback along the absolute Frobenius is identified
with the identity functor on abelian étale sheaves, so composing it with cohomology in degree `j`
gives back cohomology in degree `j`, naturally in the sheaf.

See [Stacks Project, Tag 03SN](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03SN).
declarations.statement:
public def absoluteFrobeniusCohomologyFunctorIso
    [HasWeakSheafify (smallEtaleTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}]
    [∀ F : X.Etaleᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v},
      (smallEtaleBaseChange (absoluteFrobenius X p hX)).op.HasLeftKanExtension F]
    [HasSheafify (smallEtaleTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v})] (j : ℕ) :
    Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback
          (smallEtaleBaseChange (absoluteFrobenius X p hX)) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}
          (smallEtaleTopology X) (smallEtaleTopology X) ⋙
        Sheaf.functorH (smallEtaleTopology X) j ≅
      Sheaf.functorH (smallEtaleTopology X) j
declarations.comment: pullback along the absolute Frobenius is identified with the identity functor

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.absoluteFrobenius_etaleCohomologyRestrictionMap_eq_id
declarations.doc:
**The Baffling Theorem**: on a scheme `X` of characteristic `p` the absolute Frobenius induces
the identity on `H^j(X, ℤ/nℤ)`. The canonical pullback map on étale cohomology, followed by the
canonical identification of the inverse image of the constant sheaf `ℤ/nℤ` with `ℤ/nℤ`, sends
every class to itself, in every degree `j`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem absoluteFrobenius_etaleCohomologyRestrictionMap_eq_id
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v})] (n j : ℕ)
    (x : Sheaf.H.{w}
      ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}).obj
        (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{max (u + 1) v} (ZMod n)))) j) :
    Sheaf.H.map
        ((etaleAbelianInverseImageConstantIso.{u, v} (absoluteFrobenius X p hX)).hom.app
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{max (u + 1) v} (ZMod n)))) j
        (etaleCohomologyRestrictionMap.{u, v, w} (absoluteFrobenius X p hX)
          ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}).obj
            (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{max (u + 1) v} (ZMod n)))) j x) = x
declarations.comment: the induced map on H^j(X, Z/nZ) is the identity

declarations.name: cohomologyPullbackMap_eq_id_of_preimageEq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks tag 03SO.** Let `X` be a topological space and `g : X ⟶ X` a continuous map such
that `g ⁻¹' U = U` for every open `U` of `X`. Then the map `g` induces on sheaf cohomology,
followed by the canonical comparison of the pullback sheaf with the original one, is the
identity, in every degree `n` and for every abelian sheaf `F`: `g` induces the identity on
cohomology, for any coefficients.

See [Stacks Project, Tag 03SO](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03SO).
declarations.statement:
theorem cohomologyPullbackMap_eq_id_of_preimageEq
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    (F : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (n : ℕ) :
    (Sheaf.H.map ((Adjunction.leftAdjointIdIso (sheafAdjunctionOpensMap g)
          (sheafPushforwardIdOfPreimageEq g h)).hom.app F) n).comp
        (Stacks.Cohomology.cohomologyPullbackMap.{w} (sheafAdjunctionOpensMap g)
          (sheafPushforwardIdOfPreimageEq g h) F n) =
      AddMonoidHom.id (Sheaf.H.{w} F n)
declarations.comment: g induces the identity on cohomology, for any coefficients

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.etaleCohomologyPullbackMap_comp_comparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03SP.** Let `X` be a scheme and `g : X ⟶ X` a morphism such that every
étale `X`-scheme `U` is isomorphic over `X` to its base change `U ×_{g} X`, functorially in `U`.
Then `g` induces the identity on cohomology, for any abelian sheaf `F` and in every degree `n`:
the map `H^n(X, F) ⟶ H^n(X, g^{-1}F)` induced by `g`, followed by the canonical comparison
`H^n(X, g^{-1}F) ≅ H^n(X, F)`, is the identity of `H^n(X, F)`.

See [Stacks Project, Tag 03SP](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03SP).
declarations.statement:
public theorem etaleCohomologyPullbackMap_comp_comparison (X : Scheme.{u}) (g : X ⟶ X)
    (e : 𝟭 X.Etale ≅ smallEtaleBaseChange g)
    [HasWeakSheafify (smallEtaleTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}]
    [∀ F : X.Etaleᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v},
      (smallEtaleBaseChange g).op.HasLeftKanExtension F]
    [HasSheafify (smallEtaleTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v})]
    (F : Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}) (n : ℕ) :
    (Sheaf.H.map ((etaleSheafPullbackComparison.{u, v} X g e).hom.app F) n).comp
        (etaleCohomologyPullbackMap.{u, v, w} X g e F n) =
      AddMonoidHom.id (Sheaf.H.{w} F n)
declarations.comment: g induces the identity on cohomology, for any sheaf

declarations.name: Stacks.Frobenius.geometricFrobenius
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03SQ.** The geometric Frobenius of a scheme over a finite field of
characteristic `p` and cardinality `p ^ f`. It is the `f`-fold absolute Frobenius, bundled with
its canonical structure as a morphism over the field.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def geometricFrobenius {k : Type u} [Field k] [Fintype k]
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) (p f : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p]
    (hcard : Fintype.card k = p ^ f) : X ⟶ X

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.geometricFrobeniusPushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
Let `k` be a finite field with `p ^ f` elements, let `X` be a scheme over `k` and let `π_X` be
the geometric Frobenius of `X`. Then a sheaf `ℱ` on the small étale site of `X` is canonically
isomorphic to its direct image `(π_X)_* ℱ`, naturally in `ℱ`.
On sections over an étale `φ : U ⟶ X` the isomorphism
`ℱ(U) ⟶ (π_X)_* ℱ(U) = ℱ(U ×_{φ, X, π_X} X)` is restriction along the inverse of
`γ_U = (F_U^f, φ)`.
declarations.statement:
public def geometricFrobeniusPushforwardIso :
    𝟭 (Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology X.left) A) ≅
      (smallEtaleBaseChange
          (Stacks.Frobenius.geometricFrobenius X p f hcard).left).sheafPushforwardContinuous A
        (smallEtaleTopology X.left) (smallEtaleTopology X.left)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.geometricFrobeniusInverseImageIso
declarations.doc:
Let `k` be a finite field with `p ^ f` elements, let `X` be a scheme over `k` and let `π_X` be
the geometric Frobenius of `X`. Then the inverse image `π_X^{-1} ℱ` of a sheaf `ℱ` on the small
étale site of `X` is canonically isomorphic to `ℱ`, naturally in `ℱ`. The isomorphism is the
left-adjoint mate of `geometricFrobeniusPushforwardIso`.
declarations.statement:
public def geometricFrobeniusInverseImageIso
    [HasWeakSheafify (smallEtaleTopology X.left) A]
    [∀ F : X.left.Etaleᵒᵖ ⥤ A,
      (smallEtaleBaseChange
        (Stacks.Frobenius.geometricFrobenius X p f hcard).left).op.HasLeftKanExtension F] :
    Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback
        (smallEtaleBaseChange (Stacks.Frobenius.geometricFrobenius X p f hcard).left) A
        (smallEtaleTopology X.left) (smallEtaleTopology X.left) ≅
      𝟭 (Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology X.left) A)
declarations.comment: inverse image, for coefficients admitting sheafification and left Kan extensions

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.geometricFrobeniusDescentIsos
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03SR.** Let `k` be a finite field with `q = p ^ f` elements, let `X` be
a scheme over `k` with geometric Frobenius `π_X = F_X^f`, and let `ℱ` be a sheaf on the small
étale site `X_étale`, with values in any category (sets, abelian groups, `Λ`-modules, ...).
Then there are canonical isomorphisms `π_X^{-1} ℱ ≅ ℱ` and `ℱ ≅ (π_X)_* ℱ`, natural in `ℱ`.

Here `(π_X)_*` is precomposition with base change along `π_X`, and the inverse image `π_X^{-1}`
is the left adjoint of `(π_X)_*`; its existence is proved, not assumed, since `(π_X)_*` is an
equivalence. Where the coefficients admit sheafification it agrees with the sheafified left Kan
extension (`CategoryTheory.Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullbackIso`), whose Kan
extensions exist by `hasLeftKanExtension_smallEtaleBaseChange_geometricFrobenius_op`. On
sections over an étale `φ : U ⟶ X` the second isomorphism is restriction along the inverse of
`γ_U = (F_U^f, φ) : U ⟶ U ×_{φ, X, π_X} X` (`geometricFrobeniusPushforwardIso_hom_app_hom_app`),
and the first is its left-adjoint mate
(`sheafAdjunctionContinuous_unit_comp_geometricFrobeniusSheafPullbackIso`).
declarations.statement:
public def geometricFrobeniusDescentIsos :
    (Functor.sheafPullback
        (smallEtaleBaseChange (Stacks.Frobenius.geometricFrobenius X p f hcard).left) A
        (smallEtaleTopology X.left) (smallEtaleTopology X.left) ≅
      𝟭 (Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology X.left) A)) ×
    (𝟭 (Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology X.left) A) ≅
      (smallEtaleBaseChange
          (Stacks.Frobenius.geometricFrobenius X p f hcard).left).sheafPushforwardContinuous A
        (smallEtaleTopology X.left) (smallEtaleTopology X.left))

declarations.name: Stacks.Frobenius.geometricFrobenius_left_eq_absoluteFrobenius_pow_and_exists_ne
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03SS.** The geometric Frobenius of a scheme over a finite field with
`p ^ f` elements is the `f`-fold absolute Frobenius. The exponent is read off from the base
field, so a scheme over two finite fields `k` and `k'` can have two distinct geometric Frobenius
endomorphisms, as does the spectrum of a field with `p ^ 2` elements over the prime field and
over itself.
declarations.statement:
theorem geometricFrobenius_left_eq_absoluteFrobenius_pow_and_exists_ne :
    (∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fintype k] (p f : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p]
        (hcard : Fintype.card k = p ^ f) (U : Over (Spec (.of k))),
        (geometricFrobenius U p f hcard).left =
          End.asHom (End.of (absoluteFrobenius U.left p (isInCharacteristic_of_over U)) ^ f)) ∧
      ∃ (p f f' : ℕ) (_ : Fact p.Prime) (k k' : Type u) (_ : Field k) (_ : Fintype k)
        (_ : CharP k p) (_ : Field k') (_ : Fintype k') (_ : CharP k' p)
        (hcard : Fintype.card k = p ^ f) (hcard' : Fintype.card k' = p ^ f') (U : Scheme.{u})
        (g : U ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (g' : U ⟶ Spec (.of k')),
        (geometricFrobenius (Over.mk g) p f hcard).left ≠
          (geometricFrobenius (Over.mk g') p f' hcard').left

declarations.name: Stacks.Frobenius.fibreComparison_galoisStalkAction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03ST, Galois equivariance in degree zero.** The comparison of Étale
Cohomology, Theorem 03Q9 carries the Galois action of Étale Cohomology Section 03QW on the stalk
`(α_* ℱ)_{Spec k̄}` to restriction along the automorphism `id_X × Spec σ` of the geometric fibre
`X_{k̄}`: on the germ at an étale neighbourhood `W` of the geometric point, acting by `σ` and
then comparing is restricting along `(id_X × Spec σ) ∘ (X_{k̄} ⟶ X_W)`.

Since the germs are jointly surjective onto the stalk, this determines the induced map on the
whole stalk, and it is the statement that the identification of Tag 03Q9 is a map of
`G_k`-modules.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fibreComparison_galoisStalkAction (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K)
    (W : (Spec (.of k)).Etale)
    (u : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale (specAlgebraMap k K)).fiber.obj W) :
    (Scheme.pointSmallEtale (specAlgebraMap k K)).toPresheafFiber W u
          ((sheafToPresheaf _ _).obj ((smallEtalePushforwardAb X.hom).obj F)) ≫
        (galoisStalkAction Ab.{u + 1} K σ (𝟙 (Spec (.of k)))).app
          ((smallEtalePushforwardAb X.hom).obj F) ≫
        fibreComparison K X F =
      (smallEtaleSectionsPullbackAb (pullback.fst X.hom (specAlgebraMap k K))
        ((smallEtaleBaseChange X.hom).obj W)
        (galoisBaseChange X K σ ≫ fibreLift K X W u)
        ((congrArg (fun z => z ≫ ((smallEtaleBaseChange X.hom).obj W).hom)
            (galoisBaseChange_comp_fibreLift K X σ W u).symm).trans
          (fibreLift_comp_hom K X W (galoisLift K σ W u)))).app F
declarations.comment: Galois equivariance of the Theorem 03Q9 comparison in degree zero: unconditional in `α`, in the sheaf and in the algebraically closed extension, stated on the germ at an arbitrary étale neighbourhood of the geometric point. That the comparison is an isomorphism is Tag 03Q9, available in this library only over a strictly henselian base, and the equivariance in degree j > 0 needs transitivity of restriction of sections in the scheme over the base; neither is assumed here

declarations.name: Stacks.Frobenius.higherDirectImageFibreMap_isIso_galoisEquivariant
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03ST.** Let `k` be a finite field, `K` an algebraic closure of `k`,
`G_k = Gal(K/k)`, `α : X ⟶ Spec k` quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and `ℱ` an abelian sheaf on
`X_étale`. For every `j`, the identification `(R^j α_* ℱ)_{Spec K} ≅ H^j(X_K, ℱ|_{X_K})` of
Étale Cohomology, Theorem 03Q9 is an isomorphism of `G_k`-modules:

* it is an isomorphism;
* it carries the Galois action of Étale Cohomology Section 03QW on the stalk at `Spec K` of the
  `j`-th higher direct image (`Stacks.Frobenius.fieldGaloisStalkAction`, which is the base's
  `Stacks.Frobenius.galoisStalkAction` at the rational point `𝟙 (Spec k)`) to the action
  `σ ↦ (Spec σ × id_X)^*` on cohomology (`Stacks.Frobenius.galoisCohomologyAction`);
* the latter is a left action of `G_k`, as the former is (`fieldGaloisStalkAction_one`,
  `fieldGaloisStalkAction_mul`).

The identification is `Stacks.Frobenius.higherDirectImageFibreMap`: the degree-zero comparison of
03Q9 — restriction of the germ of a section of `α_* ℱ` over an étale neighbourhood of `Spec K` to
the geometric fibre `X_K` — passed to right derived functors; the strict henselization of `Spec k`
at `Spec K` is `Spec K`, the finite field `k` being perfect. The hypothesis on `α` is that of
Theorem 03Q9, whose identification exists only then; see the module docstring.

In the language of modules: `Stacks.Frobenius.higherDirectImageFibreAddEquiv` is an additive
equivalence which is `G_k`-equivariant (`Stacks.Frobenius.higherDirectImageFibreAddEquiv_smul`) for
the `G_k`-module structures `Stacks.Frobenius.galoisHigherDirectImageStalkDistribMulAction` and
`Stacks.Frobenius.galoisCohomologyDistribMulAction`.
declarations.statement:
theorem higherDirectImageFibreMap_isIso_galoisEquivariant [Finite k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K]
    [QuasiCompact X.hom] [QuasiSeparated X.hom] (j : ℕ)
    (F : Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology X.left) Ab.{u + 1}) :
    IsIso (higherDirectImageFibreMap K X (acyclic_fieldBaseChangePullbackAb_of_injective K X) j F) ∧
      (∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K,
        (fieldGaloisStalkAction K σ).app (((smallEtalePushforwardAb X.hom).rightDerived j).obj F) ≫
            higherDirectImageFibreMap K X (acyclic_fieldBaseChangePullbackAb_of_injective K X) j F =
          higherDirectImageFibreMap K X (acyclic_fieldBaseChangePullbackAb_of_injective K X) j F ≫
            galoisCohomologyAction K X σ j F) ∧
      galoisCohomologyAction K X (1 : K ≃ₐ[k] K) j F = 𝟙 _ ∧
      ∀ σ τ : K ≃ₐ[k] K, galoisCohomologyAction K X (σ * τ) j F =
        galoisCohomologyAction K X τ j F ≫ galoisCohomologyAction K X σ j F

declarations.name: Stacks.Frobenius.arithmeticFrobenius
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03SU.** The arithmetic Frobenius `x ↦ x ^ q` of a finite field `k`
with `q = p ^ f` elements, acting on a perfect extension field `K` of exponential
characteristic `p`. It is the `f`-fold Frobenius automorphism of `K`, and it fixes `k`
pointwise because every element of a field with `q` elements satisfies `x ^ q = x`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def arithmeticFrobenius (hcard : Fintype.card k = p ^ f) : K ≃ₐ[k] K

declarations.name: Stacks.Frobenius.galoisRestrictionEndo_comp_geometricFrobeniusRestrictionEndo
declarations.doc:
Let `k` be a finite field with `q = p ^ f` elements, let `X` be a scheme over `k`, let
`K/k` be an extension and let `σ` be the arithmetic Frobenius `x ↦ x ^ q` of `K`. For an
abelian sheaf `ℱ` on `X_étale` and every degree `j`, the endomorphism of `H^j(X_K, ℱ|_{X_K})`
induced by the Galois action `id_X × Spec(σ)` undoes the one induced by `π_X × id`: the
arithmetic Frobenius acts as the inverse of `π_X^*`.

Each endomorphism restricts along the morphism of `X_K` and then identifies the coefficients
again: along `X` for the Galois action (`galoisRestrictionCoeff`), and through the Frobenius
descent on `X` for the geometric Frobenius (`geometricFrobeniusRestrictionCoeff`).
declarations.statement:
public theorem galoisRestrictionEndo_comp_geometricFrobeniusRestrictionEndo (n : ℕ)
    (F : Sheaf X.left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}) :
    (etaleCohomologyEndo.{u, v, w} (galoisBaseChange X K σ)
          ((etaleAbelianInverseImage.{u, v} (fieldBaseChangeProj X K)).obj F)
          (galoisRestrictionCoeff.{u, v} X K σ F) n).comp
        (etaleCohomologyEndo.{u, v, w} (geometricFrobeniusBaseChange X K p f hcard)
          ((etaleAbelianInverseImage.{u, v} (fieldBaseChangeProj X K)).obj F)
          (geometricFrobeniusRestrictionCoeff.{u, v} X K p f hcard F) n) =
      AddMonoidHom.id (Sheaf.H.{w}
        ((etaleAbelianInverseImage.{u, v} (fieldBaseChangeProj X K)).obj F) n)
declarations.comment: the Galois action of frob_k after the map induced by the geometric Frobenius is the identity

declarations.name: Stacks.Frobenius.geometricFrobeniusRestrictionEndo_comp_galoisRestrictionEndo
declarations.doc:
With the data of `galoisRestrictionEndo_comp_geometricFrobeniusRestrictionEndo`, the
endomorphism of `H^j(X_K, ℱ|_{X_K})` induced by `π_X × id` undoes the one induced by the Galois
action `id_X × Spec(σ)`; so the two endomorphisms are mutually inverse.
declarations.statement:
public theorem geometricFrobeniusRestrictionEndo_comp_galoisRestrictionEndo (n : ℕ)
    (F : Sheaf X.left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}) :
    (etaleCohomologyEndo.{u, v, w} (geometricFrobeniusBaseChange X K p f hcard)
          ((etaleAbelianInverseImage.{u, v} (fieldBaseChangeProj X K)).obj F)
          (geometricFrobeniusRestrictionCoeff.{u, v} X K p f hcard F) n).comp
        (etaleCohomologyEndo.{u, v, w} (galoisBaseChange X K σ)
          ((etaleAbelianInverseImage.{u, v} (fieldBaseChangeProj X K)).obj F)
          (galoisRestrictionCoeff.{u, v} X K σ F) n) =
      AddMonoidHom.id (Sheaf.H.{w}
        ((etaleAbelianInverseImage.{u, v} (fieldBaseChangeProj X K)).obj F) n)
declarations.comment: the map induced by the geometric Frobenius after the Galois action of frob_k is the identity

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredDerived.filteredRightDerivedFunctorGrPIso
declarations.doc:

additive functor `T : A ⥤ B` out of an abelian category with enough injectives, there is a
natural isomorphism `RT ⋙ gr^p ≅ gr^p ⋙ RT` of functors `DF⁺(A) ⥤ D⁺(B)`.

        CochainComplex.FilteredDerivedCategory.liftDFPlus (FiniteFilteredObject.grP p)

      CochainComplex.FilteredDerivedCategory.liftDFPlus (FiniteFilteredObject.grP p)

        T.rightDerivedFunctorPlus
