        finiteProjectiveComplex.{u, v} R K ∧ Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K ≅ X)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredDerived.PerfectDerivedCategory
declarations.doc: The full subcategory `D_perf(R)` of perfect derived objects.
declarations.statement: public abbrev PerfectDerivedCategory (R : Type u) [Ring R]

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredDerived.perfectDerivedTrace_eq_alternatingTrace
declarations.doc:
The trace of an endomorphism of a perfect derived object is computed on any bounded
finite-projective representative, and hence is independent of the representative, the chosen
isomorphism, and the cochain map representing the endomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem perfectDerivedTrace_eq_alternatingTrace (R : Type u) [Ring R]
    (K : PerfectDerivedCategory.{u, v} R) (f : K.obj ⟶ K.obj)
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} R) ℤ)
    (hP : finiteProjectiveComplex R P)
    (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ K.obj) (g : P ⟶ P)
    (hg : DerivedCategory.Q.map g = e.hom ≫ f ≫ e.inv) :
    perfectDerivedTrace R K f = alternatingTrace R P hP g

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredDerived.perfectDerivedTrace_eq_sum_grDF
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03TK.** Trace is additive along the filtration of a perfect
filtered derived complex.
declarations.statement:
public theorem perfectDerivedTrace_eq_sum_grDF (R : Type u) [Ring R]
    (K : FilteredPerfectData.{u, v} R) (f : K.obj ⟶ K.obj) :
    perfectDerivedTrace R
      ⟨(CochainComplex.FilteredDerivedCategory.forgetDF).obj K.obj,
        K.forgetPerfect R⟩
      ((CochainComplex.FilteredDerivedCategory.forgetDF).map f) =
      ∑ᶠ p : ℤ, perfectDerivedTrace R
        ⟨(CochainComplex.FilteredDerivedCategory.grDF p).obj K.obj,
          K.gradedPerfect R p⟩
        ((CochainComplex.FilteredDerivedCategory.grDF p).map f)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredDerived.projectiveModuleTrace_eq_sum_grP
declarations.doc:
The trace of a filtered endomorphism of a finite projective module is the sum of the traces on
its associated graded pieces.
declarations.statement:
public theorem projectiveModuleTrace_eq_sum_grP (R : Type u) [Ring R]
    (P : FiniteFilteredObject (ModuleCat.{max u v} R))
    (hP : IsFilteredFiniteProjective P)
    (f : P ⟶ P) :
    (letI : Module.Finite R ((FiniteFilteredObject.forget
          (𝒜 := ModuleCat.{max u v} R)).obj P) :=
        hP.finite_projective_forget.1;
      letI : Module.Projective R ((FiniteFilteredObject.forget
          (𝒜 := ModuleCat.{max u v} R)).obj P) :=
        hP.finite_projective_forget.2;
      Stacks.Trace.projectiveModuleTrace R
        ((FiniteFilteredObject.forget (𝒜 := ModuleCat.{max u v} R)).obj P)
        ((FiniteFilteredObject.forget (𝒜 := ModuleCat.{max u v} R)).map f).hom) =
      ∑ᶠ p : ℤ,
        (letI : Projective ((FiniteFilteredObject.grP
            (𝒜 := ModuleCat.{max u v} R) p).obj P) := (hP p).2;
          letI : Module.Finite R ((FiniteFilteredObject.grP
              (𝒜 := ModuleCat.{max u v} R) p).obj P) := (hP p).1;
          letI : Module.Projective R ((FiniteFilteredObject.grP
              (𝒜 := ModuleCat.{max u v} R) p).obj P) := inferInstance;
          Stacks.Trace.projectiveModuleTrace R
            ((FiniteFilteredObject.grP (𝒜 := ModuleCat.{max u v} R) p).obj P)
            ((FiniteFilteredObject.grP (𝒜 := ModuleCat.{max u v} R) p).map f).hom)

declarations.name: StacksDraft.Perfect.HasFiniteTorDimensionCanonical
declarations.doc:
An object `K` of `D(Λ)` has *finite Tor dimension* if there are integers `a, b` such that
`Hⁱ(N ⊗ᴸ[Λ] K) = 0` for every right `Λ`-module `N` and every `i ∉ [a, b]`. This is the definition
at the balanced derived tensor product constructed here, so it takes no parameter; by
`hasFiniteTorDimensionCanonical_iff` it is the same condition as
`StacksDraft.Perfect.HasFiniteTorDimension` at any term of `BalancedDerivedTensoring Λ`.
declarations.statement: def HasFiniteTorDimensionCanonical [Small.{v} Λ] (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{v} Λ)) : Prop

declarations.name: StacksDraft.Perfect.HasFiniteTorDimension
declarations.doc:
An object `K` of `D(Λ)` has *finite Tor dimension* if there are integers `a, b` such that
`Hⁱ(N ⊗ᴸ[Λ] K) = 0` for every right `Λ`-module `N` and every `i ∉ [a, b]`.
declarations.statement:
def HasFiniteTorDimension {Λ : Type u} [Ring Λ] (D : BalancedDerivedTensoring.{u, v} Λ)
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{v} Λ)) : Prop

declarations.name: StacksDraft.Perfect.isPerfect_iff_hasFiniteTorDimension_balancedDerivedTensoring
declarations.doc:
Let `Λ` be a left Noetherian ring and let `K` be an object of `D(Λ)`. Then `K` is perfect if
and only if `K` has finite Tor dimension and `Hⁱ(K)` is a finite `Λ`-module for every `i`. This is
`StacksDraft.Perfect.isPerfect_iff_hasFiniteTorDimension_and_finite_homology` with its parameter
supplied by `balancedDerivedTensoring`, so no datum is assumed.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPerfect_iff_hasFiniteTorDimension_balancedDerivedTensoring
    [IsNoetherianRing Λ] [Small.{v} Λ] (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{v} Λ)) :
    IsPerfect K ↔
      (HasFiniteTorDimensionCanonical Λ K ∧
        ∀ i : ℤ,
          Module.Finite Λ ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} Λ) i).obj K))

declarations.name: StacksDraft.Perfect.isPerfect_iff_hasFiniteTorDimension_and_finite_homology
declarations.doc:
Let `Λ` be a left Noetherian ring and let `K` be an object of `D(Λ)`. Then `K` is perfect if
and only if `K` has finite Tor dimension and `Hⁱ(K)` is a finite `Λ`-module for every `i`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPerfect_iff_hasFiniteTorDimension_and_finite_homology
    {Λ : Type u} [Ring Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ] [Small.{v} Λ]
    (D : BalancedDerivedTensoring.{u, v} Λ) (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{v} Λ)) :
    IsPerfect K ↔
      (HasFiniteTorDimension D K ∧
        ∀ i : ℤ,
          Module.Finite Λ ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} Λ) i).obj K))

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.CanonicalConstructibleFiniteTorDerivedCategory
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03TQ.** The category `D_{ctf}(X_étale, Λ)`: the full subcategory of the
constructible derived category of Stacks 095W consisting of the objects whose image in the
derived category of modules over the constant coefficient ring sheaf has locally finite Tor
dimension in the sense of Stacks 08FZ.

Tor dimension is measured against the derived tensor products
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.canonicalSliceDerivedTensorProduct` of Stacks 06YU on the slices of that
ringed site.
declarations.statement: abbrev CanonicalConstructibleFiniteTorDerivedCategory
declarations.comment: the derived tensor products on the slices of the constant-coefficient étale ringed site are constructed here, by Stacks 06YU at free universes, so no derived tensor product is assumed

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.ConstructibleFiniteTorDerivedCategory
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03TQ.** The category `D_{ctf}(X_étale, Λ)`: the full subcategory of the
constructible derived category of Stacks 095W consisting of the objects whose image in the
derived category of modules over the constant coefficient ring sheaf has locally finite Tor
dimension in the sense of Stacks 08FZ, measured against the derived tensor products `T` on the
slices of that ringed site.
declarations.statement:
abbrev ConstructibleFiniteTorDerivedCategory
    (T : ∀ U : (constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, w, r} B X Λ).C,
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.{u + 1, u, max (u + 1) w r, d}
        ((constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, w, r} B X Λ).over U))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalk_finite
declarations.doc:
Every term of the stalk at a geometric point of a complex of constructible sheaves of
`Λ`-modules is a finite `Λ`-module.

The constructibility hypothesis is spelled out as stratumwise local constancy with finitely
generated values, which is what `AlgebraicGeometry.IsConstructibleModuleSheaf` — Tag 03RW part
(3) — unfolds to; stating it this way is what makes the statement available for a coefficient
ring that is not commutative, the definition of Tag 03RW being given for a Noetherian ring.
declarations.statement:
theorem stalk_finite
    [∀ (S T : B.Scheme) (f : T ⟶ S),
      ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        (ModuleCat.{w} Λ) (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property)).IsRightAdjoint]
    [∀ (T : B.Scheme) (V : SmallEtale B T.obj T.property),
      HasWeakSheafify ((SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property).over V) (ModuleCat.{w} Λ)]
    (K : CochainComplex
      (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{w} Λ)) ℤ)
    (hconstructible : ∀ i : ℤ,
      IsStratifiedLocallyConstantWith B X Λ (ModuleCat.isFG Λ) (K.X i))
    (s : GeometricPoint X.obj) (i : ℤ) :
    Module.Finite Λ ((etaleModuleStalkFunctor B X Λ s).obj (K.X i))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalk_projective
declarations.doc:
Every term of the stalk at a geometric point of a complex of constructible sheaves of
`Λ`-modules which are flat over the constant coefficient ring sheaf is a projective
`Λ`-module.
declarations.statement:
theorem stalk_projective
    [∀ (S T : B.Scheme) (f : T ⟶ S),
      ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        (ModuleCat.{w} Λ) (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property)).IsRightAdjoint]
    [∀ (T : B.Scheme) (V : SmallEtale B T.obj T.property),
      HasWeakSheafify ((SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property).over V) (ModuleCat.{w} Λ)]
    (K : CochainComplex
      (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{w} Λ)) ℤ)
    (hconstructible : ∀ i : ℤ, IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X Λ (K.X i))
    (hflat : ∀ i : ℤ, Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsFlat.{u, u + 1, max (u + 1) w r, max (u + 1) w r}
      (moduleSheafOverConstantCoefficients.{u, w, r} B X Λ (K.X i)))
    (s : GeometricPoint X.obj) (i : ℤ) :
    Module.Projective Λ ((etaleModuleStalkFunctor B X Λ s).obj (K.X i))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalk_isPerfect
declarations.doc:
The stalk at a geometric point of a bounded complex of constructible sheaves of `Λ`-modules
which are flat over the constant coefficient ring sheaf is a perfect object of the derived
category of `Λ`-modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem stalk_isPerfect
    [∀ (S T : B.Scheme) (f : T ⟶ S),
      ((smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        (ModuleCat.{w} Λ) (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property)).IsRightAdjoint]
    [∀ (T : B.Scheme) (V : SmallEtale B T.obj T.property),
      HasWeakSheafify ((SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property).over V) (ModuleCat.{w} Λ)]
    (K : CochainComplex
      (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{w} Λ)) ℤ)
    (hbounded : (CochainComplex.plus _ K) ∧ (CochainComplex.minus _ K))
    (hconstructible : ∀ i : ℤ, IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X Λ (K.X i))
    (hflat : ∀ i : ℤ, Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsFlat.{u, u + 1, max (u + 1) w r, max (u + 1) w r}
      (moduleSheafOverConstantCoefficients.{u, w, r} B X Λ (K.X i)))
    (s : GeometricPoint X.obj)
    [HasDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{w} Λ)] :
    StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (etaleModuleStalkComplex B X Λ s K))

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.exists_constructibleFiniteTor_iff_isRepresentedByConstructibleFlatComplex
declarations.doc:
Let `Λ` be a Noetherian ring and `X` a quasi-compact and quasi-separated
scheme. An object `K` of `D(X_étale, Λ)` lies in `D_ctf(X_étale, Λ)` (Tag 03TQ) if and only if it
can be represented by a finite complex of constructible flat sheaves of `Λ`-modules.

`D_ctf(X_étale, Λ)` is the category of Tag 03TQ, measured against the given derived tensor
products `T` on the slices; membership of `K` is the existence of an object of that category
isomorphic to `K`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_constructibleFiniteTor_iff_isRepresentedByConstructibleFlatComplex
    (T : ∀ U : (constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B X Λ).C,
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.{u + 1, u, max (u + 1) r, d}
        ((constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B X Λ).over U))
    (K : DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ))) :
    (∃ L : ConstructibleFiniteTorDerivedCategory.{u, max (u + 1) r, r, d} B X Λ T,
        Nonempty (L.obj.obj ≅ K)) ↔
      IsRepresentedByConstructibleFlatComplex.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B X Λ K

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.exists_constructibleFlat_representative_of_hasTorAmplitude
declarations.doc:
Let `Λ` be a Noetherian ring and `X` a quasi-compact and
quasi-separated scheme. If `K ∈ D_ctf(X_étale, Λ)` has Tor amplitude in `[a, b]`, then `K` can be
represented by a complex `F^a → ⋯ → F^b` of constructible flat sheaves of `Λ`-modules.

Tor amplitude is that of the associated object of `D(𝒪)`, `𝒪` the constant coefficient ring
sheaf, against a derived tensor product `T₀` on `𝒪` (Stacks 08FZ (1)); the hypothesis `hK` is
the constructibility of the cohomology sheaves of `K`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_constructibleFlat_representative_of_hasTorAmplitude
    (T₀ : Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.{u + 1, u, max (u + 1) r, d}
      (constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B X Λ))
    (K : DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ)))
    (hK : IsConstructible B X Λ K) (a b : ℤ)
    (hamp : HasTorAmplitude T₀
      ((moduleSheafOverConstantCoefficientsFunctor.{u, max (u + 1) r, r}
        B X Λ).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) a b) :
    ∃ F : CochainComplex
        (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ)) ℤ,
      F.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ F.IsStrictlyLE b ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, IsConstructibleFlatModuleSheaf B X Λ (F.X i)) ∧
        Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj F ≅ K)
declarations.comment: the last sentence: Tor amplitude in [a, b] gives a representative F^a → ⋯ → F^b by constructible flat sheaves

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructible_of_isRepresentedByConstructibleFlatComplex
declarations.doc:
**Tag 03TT, the direction (2) ⟹ (1) for the constructible-cohomology condition.** An
object of `D(X_étale, Λ)` represented by a bounded complex of constructible flat sheaves of
`Λ`-modules has constructible cohomology sheaves, so it lies in the constructible derived
category of Tag 095W.

The cohomology sheaf in degree `i` is a cokernel of a map from the term in degree `i - 1` into
the sheaf of cycles, which is a kernel of a map between the terms in degrees `i` and `i + 1`;
each term is constructible, and the hypothesis `hSerre` that the constructible sheaves of
`Λ`-modules form a weak Serre subcategory of all sheaves of `Λ`-modules — Tag 0754, closure
under kernels, cokernels, extensions and isomorphism — carries constructibility to the kernel
and then to the cokernel.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructible_of_isRepresentedByConstructibleFlatComplex
    (hSerre : (isConstructibleModuleSheafProperty.{u, w, r} B X Λ).IsWeakSerreClass)
    (K : DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{w} Λ)))
    (hK : IsRepresentedByConstructibleFlatComplex.{u, w, r} B X Λ K) :
    IsConstructible B X Λ K
declarations.comment: the direction (2) => (1), the constructible-cohomology half, from the weak Serre property `hSerre` of the constructible sheaves of modules

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructibleFiniteTor_iff_isRepresentedByFlatConstructibleComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03TT.** Let `Λ` be a Noetherian ring, let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated
scheme and let `K ∈ D(X_étale, Λ)`. The following are equivalent:

1. `K ∈ D_ctf(X_étale, Λ)`, that is, `K` has constructible cohomology sheaves and the image of
   `K` over the constant coefficient ringed site of Tag 03TR has locally finite Tor dimension in
   the sense of Tag 08FZ;
2. `K` is represented by a finite complex of constructible flat sheaves of `Λ`-modules.

In fact, if `K` has Tor amplitude in `[a, b]` then it can be represented by a complex
`F^a → ⋯ → F^b` with each `F^p` a constructible flat sheaf of `Λ`-modules.

Condition (1) is membership of
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.ConstructibleFiniteTorDerivedCategory`, whose defining property is
exactly this conjunction; condition (2) is
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.IsRepresentedByFlatConstructibleComplex`.

Condition (1) is stated **absolutely**: the derived tensor products against which finite Tor
dimension and Tor amplitude are measured are not parameters of the statement but the canonical
ones, `Stacks.SheafOfModules.canonicalDerivedTensorProduct` of Tag 06YU on the constant
coefficient ringed site and on each of its slices. Those exist at the universes this chapter
works in — the site is an `AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.{u + 1, u, max (u + 1) r}`, whose
morphisms and whose sections lie in *different* universes — because the K-flat resolutions
Tag 06YU is built from resolve by flat modules supplied by a flat cover and so relate none of
the three universes of the site. The two directions and the refinement are proved above against
an arbitrary datum, which is the more general statement; the tag is carried here, where the
quantifier over the datum is gone and the equivalence is therefore not vacuous.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isConstructibleFiniteTor_iff_isRepresentedByFlatConstructibleComplex
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
      (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ))) :
    ((IsConstructible B X Λ K ∧
        Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.LocallyHasFiniteTorDimension
          (X := constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B X Λ)
          (fun U => Stacks.SheafOfModules.canonicalDerivedTensorProductGeneral.{u + 1, u,
            max (u + 1) r, d}
            ((constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B X Λ).over U))
          ((moduleSheafOverConstantCoefficientsFunctor.{u, max (u + 1) r,
            r} B X Λ).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)) ↔
      IsRepresentedByFlatConstructibleComplex.{u, r} B X Λ K) ∧
    ∀ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b → IsConstructible B X Λ K →
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.HasTorAmplitude
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.canonicalDerivedTensorProductGeneral.{u + 1, u, max (u + 1) r, d}
          (constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B X Λ))
        ((moduleSheafOverConstantCoefficientsFunctor.{u, max (u + 1) r,
          r} B X Λ).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) a b →
      ∃ F : CochainComplex (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
          (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ)) ℤ,
        F.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ F.IsStrictlyLE b ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X Λ (F.X i)) ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFlat.{u, u + 1, max (u + 1) r,
          max (u + 1) r} (O := (constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B X Λ).O)
          ((moduleSheafOverConstantCoefficientsFunctor.{u, max (u + 1) r,
            r} B X Λ).obj (F.X i))) ∧
        Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj F ≅ K)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.locallyHasFiniteTorDimension_of_isRepresentedByConstructibleFlatComplex
declarations.doc:
**Tag 03TT, the finite-Tor-dimension half of the direction (2) ⟹ (1).** An object of
`D(X_étale, Λ)` represented by a bounded complex of constructible flat sheaves of `Λ`-modules
has locally finite Tor dimension in the sense of Tag 08FZ, read on its image under the change of
coefficients of Tag 03TR and measured against the derived tensor products `T` on the slices of
the constant coefficient ringed site.

Each term of the complex becomes a flat module over the constant coefficient ring sheaf, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.isFlat_moduleSheafOverConstantCoefficients_of_isConstructibleFlatModuleSheaf`;
the change of coefficients is exact, so applied degreewise it carries the complex to a
representative of the image of `K`; and
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.FreeModuleUniverse.locallyHasFiniteTorDimension_of_flatRepresentative`
reads Stacks 08G1 on every slice.
declarations.statement:
theorem locallyHasFiniteTorDimension_of_isRepresentedByConstructibleFlatComplex
    (T : ∀ U : (constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, w, r} B X Λ).C,
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.{u + 1, u, max (u + 1) w r, d}
        ((constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, w, r} B X Λ).over U))
    (K : DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{w} Λ)))
    (hK : IsRepresentedByConstructibleFlatComplex.{u, w, r} B X Λ K) :
    Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.LocallyHasFiniteTorDimension
      (X := constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, w, r} B X Λ) T
      ((moduleSheafOverConstantCoefficientsFunctor.{u, w, r} B X Λ).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)
declarations.comment: the finite-tor-dimension half of the direction (2) => (1), at a free coefficient universe; the constructible-cohomology half of that direction is `Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructible_of_isRepresentedByConstructibleFlatComplex` and the two are combined in `Stacks.EtaleCohomology.constructibleFiniteTorDerivedCategoryOfConstructibleFlatComplex`

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.constructibleFiniteTorDerivedCategoryOfConstructibleFlatComplex
declarations.doc:
**Tag 03TT, the direction (2) ⟹ (1).** An object of `D(X_étale, Λ)` represented by a bounded
complex of constructible flat sheaves of `Λ`-modules is an object of `D_{ctf}(X_étale, Λ)`: its
cohomology sheaves are constructible and its image under the change of coefficients of Tag 03TR
has locally finite Tor dimension.

The two halves are
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isConstructible_of_isRepresentedByConstructibleFlatComplex` and
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.locallyHasFiniteTorDimension_of_isRepresentedByConstructibleFlatComplex`.
The weak Serre property of the constructible sheaves of modules, which the first of them asks
for, is Tag 03RZ (3) at the coefficient universe `max (u + 1) r`; that is why the module sections
are fixed there rather than left free, and it is why nothing is carried as a hypothesis.
declarations.statement:
def constructibleFiniteTorDerivedCategoryOfConstructibleFlatComplex
    (T : ∀ U : (constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B X Λ).C,
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.{u + 1, u, max (u + 1) r, d}
        ((constantCoefficientRingedSite.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B X Λ).over U))
    (K : DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ)))
    (hK : IsRepresentedByConstructibleFlatComplex.{u, max (u + 1) r, r} B X Λ K) :
    ConstructibleFiniteTorDerivedCategory.{u, max (u + 1) r, r, d} B X Λ T
declarations.comment: the direction (2) => (1), both halves, with the weak Serre property of the constructible sheaves of modules discharged by Tag 03RZ (3) at the coefficient universe max (u + 1) r. The direction (1) => (2) and the sharpened bound on the length of the representative are not proved

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.CurveGlobalSections.isPerfect
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03TV.** Let `k` be a field, let `X` be a projective curve over `k`, let `Λ` be a
finite commutative ring and let `K` be an object of `D_ctf(X_étale, Λ)`. Then the derived global
sections `RΓ(X_k̄, K)` of the restriction of `K` to the geometric fibre
`X_k̄ = X ×_{Spec k} Spec k̄` form a perfect complex of `Λ`-modules.

The geometric fibre is the object `Y` of the big étale site, pinned down by `_hbase`, and the
restriction of `K` to it is the bounded below complex `Kbar`, pinned down by `eKbar`. The proof
is the one of the source: the hypercohomology spectral sequence `hSS` together with the
finiteness `hFin` of the étale cohomology of a constructible sheaf gives finiteness of the
cohomology modules, the projection formula contained in `hTwisting` together with the
hypercohomology spectral sequence `hSSZ` and the cohomological dimension `hDimZ` gives finite
Tor dimension, and the criterion of Tag 03TO concludes.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPerfect (Y : B.Scheme) (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (Dt : StacksDraft.Perfect.BalancedDerivedTensoring.{r, w} Λ)
    (hSS : HasHypercohomologySpectralSequence.{u, w, r} B Λ Y)
    (hSSZ : HasHypercohomologySpectralSequence.{u, w, 0} B ℤ Y)
    (hFin : HasFiniteConstructibleCohomology.{u, w, r} B Λ Y)
    (hDimZ : HasFiniteEtaleCohomologicalDimension.{u, w, 0} B ℤ Y)
    (hPullback : HasConstructibleDerivedPullback.{u, w, r} B Λ)
    (hTwisting : HasGeometricTwisting.{u, w, r, d} B X Λ T Y f Dt)
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (gk : X.obj ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (_hcurve : IsCurve k gk) (_hprojective : IsProjective gk)
    (_hbase : ∃ e : Y.obj ≅ Stacks.Frobenius.fieldBaseChange (Over.mk gk) (AlgebraicClosure k),
      B.inclusion.map f = e.hom ≫ pullback.fst gk
        (Stacks.Frobenius.specAlgebraMap k (AlgebraicClosure k)))
    (K : ConstructibleFiniteTorDerivedCategory.{u, w, r, d} B X Λ T)
    (Kbar : DerivedCategory.Plus (SmallEtaleModuleSheaf.{u, w, r} B Λ Y))
    (eKbar : Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj Kbar ≅
      (smallEtaleModulePullback.{u, w, r} B Λ f).mapDerivedCategory.obj K.obj.obj)) :
    StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj
        ((smallEtaleModuleDerivedGlobalSections.{u, w, r} B Λ Y).obj Kbar))
declarations.comment: from the hypercohomology spectral sequences `hSS` and `hSSZ`, the finiteness `hFin` of the étale cohomology of a constructible sheaf, the cohomological dimension `hDimZ`, the constructibility `hPullback` of a derived inverse image, and the projection formula with the Tor window `hTwisting`

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.globalLefschetzNumber
declarations.doc:
The global Lefschetz number of `K`: the trace of the action `π_X^*` on the perfect complex
`RΓ(X_k̄, K|_{X_k̄})`, an element of the additive commutator quotient `Λ^natural`.

See [Stacks Project, Tag 03TX](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03TX).
declarations.statement:
public def globalLefschetzNumber (Λ : Type u) [Ring Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (D : FrobeniusActionOnCohomology.{u, v} Λ) :

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.globalLefschetzNumberOfCtf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks, Tag 03TX: the global Lefschetz number of `K`.** Let `Λ` be a finite, possibly
noncommutative, ring, `X` a projective curve over a finite field `k` with `p ^ q` elements, `k̄`
an algebraic closure of `k` and `K ∈ D_ctf(X, Λ)`. The base change `c_K|_{X_k̄}` of the canonical
map `c_K : π_X^{-1} K ⟶ K` induces an action `π_X^*` on the perfect complex
`RΓ(X_k̄, K|_{X_k̄})`; the global Lefschetz number of `K` is its trace
`Tr(π_X^* | RΓ(X_k̄, K|_{X_k̄}))`, an element of `Λ^natural`.

`D_ctf(X, Λ)` is `Stacks.EtaleCohomology.IsCtf`, which makes sense for a noncommutative `Λ`; an
object of it is bounded, so it is taken in the bounded below derived category, on which
`RΓ(X_k̄, -)` is defined. Perfectness of `RΓ(X_k̄, K|_{X_k̄})` is [Stacks, Tag 03TV], proved, not
assumed.
declarations.statement:
public def globalLefschetzNumberOfCtf (hcurve : IsCurve k gk)
    (hproj : IsProjective gk) (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ X.obj))
    (hK : IsCtf.{u, r} B X Λ (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj K)) :
    CategoryTheory.FilteredDerived.AdditiveCommutatorQuotient Λ

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.localLefschetzNumberOfCtf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks, Tag 03TY: the local Lefschetz number of `K`.**  For a finite field `k` with `p ^ q`
elements, an algebraically closed extension `k̄` of `k`, a scheme `X` over `k` with structure
morphism `f` and finitely many `k`-rational points, an arbitrary finite — possibly
noncommutative — coefficient ring `Λ`, and an object `K` of `D_ctf(X_étale, Λ)`, this is the sum

`∑_{x ∈ X(k)} Tr(π_x | K_x̄)`

over the `k`-rational points of `X` of the traces of the geometric Frobenius `π_x` of
[Stacks, Tag 03SW] on the derived stalk `K_x̄` of `K` at the geometric point above `x`, an element
of the additive commutator quotient `Λ^natural`.

Perfection of each stalk `K_x̄`, which the source reads off `K ∈ D_ctf(X, Λ)` through
[Stacks, Tag 03TT], is proved here rather than supplied:  it is
`AlgebraicGeometry.derivedEtaleModuleStalk_isPerfect_of_isRepresentedByConstructibleFlatComplex`.
Membership of `D_ctf(X, Λ)` is written as condition (2) of [Stacks, Tag 03TT], the condition that
`K` be represented by a bounded complex of constructible flat sheaves of `Λ`-modules, which is
also how [SGA 4½, Rapport 4.6] defines `D_ctf`; see the implementation notes of this file for why
that is the formulation the source's generality on `Λ` calls for.
declarations.statement:
public def localLefschetzNumberOfCtf (hcard : Fintype.card k = p ^ q)
    (f : X.obj ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Fintype (rationalPoints f)]
    (K : DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property) (ModuleCat.{w} Λ)))
    (hK : IsRepresentedByConstructibleFlatComplex.{u, w, r} B X Λ K) :
    CategoryTheory.FilteredDerived.AdditiveCommutatorQuotient Λ
declarations.comment: the local Lefschetz number of an object K of D_ctf(X_étale, Λ) on a scheme X over a finite field k: the sum over the k-rational points x of X of the traces of the geometric Frobenius π_x of 03SW on the stalk K_x̄, an element of the additive commutator quotient Λ^natural. Λ is the arbitrary finite, possibly noncommutative, ring of 03TX and 03SZ. X(k), the stalks K_x̄ and the actions π_x are all computed from K and X — K_x̄ is the derived étale stalk of K at the geometric point above x and π_x is the induced action of the geometric Frobenius — and perfection of each K_x̄ is derived from membership of D_ctf, as in the source. Membership of D_ctf(X_étale, Λ) is written as condition (2) of 03TT, that K be represented by a bounded complex of constructible flat sheaves of Λ-modules, which is also how SGA 4½ Rapport 4.6 defines D_ctf

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.LefschetzGaloisDescent.globalLefschetzNumber_eq_localLefschetzNumber
declarations.doc:
**The Lefschetz trace formula (Stacks 03TZ).** Let `X` be a projective curve over a finite
field `k`, let `Λ` be a finite ring and let `K` be an object of `D_ctf(X, Λ)`. Then the global
and local Lefschetz numbers of `K` are equal:

  `Tr(π_X^* | RΓ(X_k̄, K)) = ∑_{x ∈ X(k)} Tr(π_x | K_x̄)`

in `Λ^natural`. The dévissage of `RΓ(X_k̄, K)` along the rational points of `X` splits the left
hand side into the trace on the open complement of `X(k)` plus the right hand side, and the
Galois descent of `Stacks.EtaleCohomology.LefschetzGaloisDescent` makes the trace on the open
complement vanish.
declarations.statement:
public theorem globalLefschetzNumber_eq_localLefschetzNumber [Fintype points] :
    globalLefschetzNumber Λ D.globalDatum = localLefschetzNumber Λ points D.stalkDatum
declarations.comment: the global and local Lefschetz numbers agree, with the Galois decomposition of the trace on the open complement (Stacks 03UC and 03UD) and the annihilation of each coefficient trace by the order of its stabiliser (Stacks 03UB, and Weil's formula Stacks 03U1 through the absence of fixed points on the Galois cover) as hypotheses; the reductions of Steps 3 to 6 of Stacks 03UG are not formalized

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.globalLefschetzNumberOfCtf_eq_sum_rationalPointStalkTrace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks, Tag 03TZ: the Lefschetz trace formula.** Let `X` be a projective curve over a finite
field `k` with `p ^ q` elements, `k̄` an algebraic closure of `k`, `Λ` a finite, possibly
noncommutative, ring of cardinality prime to `p` (the standing hypothesis of the chapter, fixed in
[Stacks, Tag 03SZ]), and `K ∈ D_ctf(X, Λ)`, given as a bounded below complex of sheaves of
`Λ`-modules on `X_étale` whose class lies in `D_ctf(X, Λ)`. Then the stalks `K_x̄` at the rational
points are perfect, and the global and local Lefschetz numbers of `K` are equal:

`Tr(π_X^* | RΓ(X_k̄, K)) = ∑_{x ∈ X(k)} Tr(π_x | K_x̄)` in `Λ^natural`.

The left hand side is the global Lefschetz number of [Stacks, Tag 03TX]
(`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.globalLefschetzNumberOfCtf`); on the right `K_x̄` is the stalk at the
geometric point over `x` and `π_x` the geometric Frobenius of [Stacks, Tag 03SW] acting on it.
Without the hypothesis `#Λ` prime to `p` the statement fails (see the module documentation).
declarations.statement:
theorem globalLefschetzNumberOfCtf_eq_sum_rationalPointStalkTrace (B : BigEtaleSite.{u})
    (X : B.Scheme) (Λ : Type) [Ring Λ] [Finite Λ] {k : Type u} [Field k] [Fintype k]
    (gk : X.obj ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (kbar : Type u) [Field kbar] [IsAlgClosed kbar] [Algebra k kbar]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k kbar] (p q : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p]
    (hcard : Fintype.card k = p ^ q) (hcop : Nat.Coprime (Nat.card Λ) p)
    (hcurve : IsCurve k gk) (hproj : IsProjective gk)
    (K : CochainComplex.Plus (EtaleModules.{u, 0} Λ X.obj))
    (hK : IsCtf.{u, 0} B X Λ (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj (DerivedCategory.Plus.Q.obj K))) :
    letI : CharP kbar p := charP_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap k kbar).injective p
    ∃ hs : ∀ x : rationalPoints gk, StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (rationalPointStalkComplex.{u, 0} Λ kbar x.1 K)),
      globalLefschetzNumberOfCtf.{u, 0} B X Λ gk kbar p q hcard hcurve hproj
          (DerivedCategory.Plus.Q.obj K) hK =
        ∑ᶠ x : rationalPoints gk, perfectDerivedTrace Λ ⟨_, hs x⟩
          (DerivedCategory.Q.map (rationalPointStalkFrobenius.{u, 0} Λ kbar p q hcard x.1 K))
declarations.comment: the Lefschetz trace formula for a projective curve over a finite field: global Lefschetz number (03TX) = sum over X(k) of the traces of the geometric Frobenius on the stalks, in Λ^natural, with K in D_ctf(X, Λ) given by a bounded below complex. Λ is a finite ring of cardinality prime to p, the standing hypothesis of the chapter fixed in 03SZ (trace.tex:386: 'Fix a finite ring Λ with cardinality prime to p'); the literal reading with an arbitrary finite Λ is false (k = F_5, E : y^2 = x^3 + 1 supersingular, Λ = Z/25, K = Λ: global number 1, local number #E(F_5) = 6). Λ : Type as in the formalization of 03UG

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.JacobianCorrespondence.fixedPointNumber_eq
declarations.doc:
**Weil's trace formula (Stacks 03U1).** Let `C` be a nonsingular projective curve over an
algebraically closed field `k` and `φ : C → C` a `k`-endomorphism of `C` distinct from the
identity. Let `V(φ) = Δ_C · Γ_φ`, the intersection number on `C × C` of the diagonal with the
graph of `φ`, let `J = Pic⁰_{C/k}` be the jacobian of `C` and `φ^* : J → J` the action induced
by `φ` by taking pullbacks. Then `V(φ) = 1 - Tr_J(φ^*) + deg φ`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fixedPointNumber_eq (D : W.EndomorphismData) :
    W.fixedPointNumber D = 1 - W.trace D.pullback + D.degree

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CurveGraph.fixedPointIntersection_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03U1 (Weil).** Let `C` be a smooth projective curve over an
algebraically closed field `k` and `φ : C ⟶ C` a `k`-endomorphism distinct from the identity.
Let `V(φ) = (Δ · Γ_φ)` be the intersection number of the diagonal and the graph of `φ` on
`C ×_k C`. Then `V(φ) = 1 - Tr_J(φ^*) + deg φ`, where `φ^*` is the endomorphism of the Jacobian
`J = Pic⁰_{C/k}` induced by pullback and `Tr_J(φ^*)` is its trace on the `ℓ`-adic Tate module of
`J`, for any prime `ℓ` invertible in `k` (an integer independent of `ℓ`, see
`AlgebraicGeometry.CurveGraph.existsUnique_jacobianTrace`).
declarations.statement:
theorem fixedPointIntersection_eq {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {C : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve k f] [Smooth f] [IsProper f]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim C ≤ 1) (φ : C ⟶ C) (w : φ ≫ f = f) (hφ : φ ≠ 𝟙 C)
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (hℓ : IsUnit (ℓ : k)) :
    ((fixedPointIntersection f hdim φ w : ℤ) : ℤ_[ℓ]) =
      1 - jacobianTateTrace f hdim φ w ℓ + (curveMapDegree f φ w : ℤ_[ℓ])

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.sum_trace_etaleConstantCohomologyPullback_eq_fixedPointIntersection
declarations.doc:
**Weil's trace formula modulo `ℓ^n` (Stacks 03U3).** Let `C` be a nonsingular projective curve
over an algebraically closed field `k`, let `φ : C → C` be a `k`-endomorphism of `C` distinct from
the identity, and let `ℓ` be a prime invertible in `k`. Then every étale cohomology module
`H^i(C, ℤ/ℓ^n)` of the constant sheaf is free of finite rank over `ℤ/ℓ^n`, and

  `∑_{i=0}^{2} (-1)^i Tr(φ^* | H^i(C, ℤ/ℓ^n)) = V(φ) mod ℓ^n`,

with `V(φ) = Δ_C · Γ_φ` the intersection number on `C ×_k C`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.CurveGraph.fixedPointIntersection`), and `φ^*` the pullback on étale
cohomology: restriction along `φ` followed by the canonical identification `φ^{-1}(ℤ/ℓ^n) ≅ ℤ/ℓ^n`.

The degreewise traces are `1`, `Tr_J(φ^*) mod ℓ^n` and `deg φ`
(`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.sum_trace_etaleConstantCohomologyPullback_eq_toZModPow`), and Weil's
formula `V(φ) = 1 - Tr_J(φ^*) + deg φ` ([Stacks, Tag 03U1],
`AlgebraicGeometry.CurveGraph.fixedPointIntersection_eq`) concludes.
declarations.statement:
theorem sum_trace_etaleConstantCohomologyPullback_eq_fixedPointIntersection
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {C : Scheme.{u}} (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsCurve k f] [Smooth f] [IsProper f] (φ : C ⟶ C) (w : φ ≫ f = f) (hφ : φ ≠ 𝟙 C)
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (hℓ : IsUnit (ℓ : k)) (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ i : ℕ, Module.Free (ZMod (ℓ ^ n))
        (Sheaf.H.{u + 1} (etaleConstantSheaf.{u, 0} C (ZMod (ℓ ^ n))) i) ∧
      Module.Finite (ZMod (ℓ ^ n))
        (Sheaf.H.{u + 1} (etaleConstantSheaf.{u, 0} C (ZMod (ℓ ^ n))) i)) ∧
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range 3, (-1 : ZMod (ℓ ^ n)) ^ i * LinearMap.trace (ZMod (ℓ ^ n)) _
        ((etaleConstantCohomologyPullback φ (ZMod (ℓ ^ n)) i).toZModLinearMap (ℓ ^ n)) =
      (CurveGraph.fixedPointIntersection f (IsCurve.topologicalKrullDim_eq_one (f := f)).le φ w :
        ZMod (ℓ ^ n))

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.JacobianCorrespondence.EtaleFrobeniusAction.alternatingTrace_eq
declarations.doc:
**Weil's trace formula modulo `ℓ^n` (Stacks 03U3).** In the situation of Weil's theorem,
Tag 03U1, let `ℓ` be a prime invertible in `k`. Then

  `∑_{i=0}^{2} (-1)^i Tr(φ^* | H^i(C, Z/ℓ^n Z)) = V(φ) mod ℓ^n`,

the alternating sum of the traces of `φ^*` on the étale cohomology of `C` with coefficients in
`Z/ℓ^n Z` being `1 - Tr_J(φ^*) + deg φ` by the three degreewise computations carried by
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.JacobianCorrespondence.EtaleFrobeniusAction`, and that being `V(φ)` by
Weil's formula.
declarations.statement:
public theorem alternatingTrace_eq :
    T.alternatingTrace = (W.fixedPointNumber D : ZMod (ℓ ^ n))
declarations.comment: the alternating sum of the traces on the étale cohomology of the curve is the fixed point number V(φ) modulo ℓ^n, with the three degreewise traces — 1 in degree zero, Tr_J(φ^*) in degree one and deg φ in degree two — as hypotheses, the situation of Stacks 03U1 being the JacobianCorrespondence datum

declarations.name: Stacks.Trace.groupTrace
declarations.doc: The group trace of an endomorphism of a finite projective group-ring module.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev groupTrace (R : Type u) (G : Type v) [Ring R] [Group G]
    (P : Type w) [AddCommGroup P] [Module R[G] P] [Module.Finite R[G] P]
    [Module.Projective R[G] P] (f : Module.End R[G] P) :
    AdditiveCommutatorQuotient R

declarations.name: Stacks.Trace.projectiveModuleTrace_restrictScalars_groupAlgebra
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03U7.** The coefficient-ring trace of an endomorphism of a finite
projective module over the group algebra of a finite group is the order of the group times its
group trace.
declarations.statement:
theorem projectiveModuleTrace_restrictScalars_groupAlgebra
    (R : Type u) (G : Type v) (P : Type w) [Ring R] [Group G] [Finite G]
    [AddCommGroup P] [Module R[G] P]
    [Module.Finite R[G] P] [Module.Projective R[G] P]
    (f : Module.End R[G] P) :
    letI : Module R P := Module.compHom P
      (MonoidAlgebra.singleOneRingHom (R := R) (M := G))
    letI : Module.Finite R P := finite_restrictScalars_groupAlgebra R G P
    letI : Module.Projective R P := projective_restrictScalars_groupAlgebra R G P
    let fR : Module.End R P :=
      { f with
        map_smul' := by
          intro r p
          exact f.map_smul (MonoidAlgebra.singleOneRingHom (R := R) (M := G) r) p }
    projectiveModuleTrace R P fR =
      (Nat.card G) • groupTrace R G P f

declarations.name: Stacks.Trace.groupTrace_diagonalTensorEndomorphism
declarations.doc: The group trace is multiplicative for the diagonal tensor product action.
declarations.statement:
lemma groupTrace_diagonalTensorEndomorphism
    {A : Type uA} {Λ : Type uΛ} {G : Type uG} {P : Type uP} {M : Type uM}
    [CommRing A] [Ring Λ] [Algebra A Λ] [Group G]
    [AddCommGroup P] [Module A P]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module Λ M] [IsScalarTower A Λ M]
    (ρ : _root_.Representation A G P) (σ : _root_.Representation Λ G M)
    [Module.Finite A[G] (asModuleNC ρ)] [Module.Projective A[G] (asModuleNC ρ)]
    [Module.Finite Λ M] [Module.Projective Λ M]
    (u : Module.End A[G] (asModuleNC ρ))
    (v : Module.End Λ[G] (asModuleNC σ)) :
    diagonalTensorGroupTrace ρ σ u v =
      commutativeAdditiveCommutatorQuotientEval A
          (groupTrace A G (asModuleNC ρ) u) •
      projectiveModuleTrace Λ M
          (groupAlgebraEnd_restrictScalars σ v)

declarations.name: Stacks.Trace.trace_eq_card_centralizer_nsmul_groupTrace
declarations.doc: The ordinary trace is the centralizer order times the centralizer trace.
declarations.statement:
lemma trace_eq_card_centralizer_nsmul_groupTrace (i : G →* Γ)
    [Module.Finite Λ[G] (restrictedModule Λ P i)]
    [Module.Projective Λ[G] (restrictedModule Λ P i)]
    (γ : Γ) :
    letI : Module.Finite Λ (coefficientModule Λ Γ P) :=
      finite_over_coefficients (P := P) i
    letI : Module.Projective Λ (coefficientModule Λ Γ P) :=
      projective_over_coefficients (P := P) i
    projectiveModuleTrace Λ (coefficientModule Λ Γ P)
      (coefficientEndomorphism (P := P) γ).val =
      Nat.card (centralizer i γ) • centralizerTrace (P := P) i γ

declarations.name: Stacks.Trace.MonoidExtensionByNat.diagonalTensorCentralizerTrace_eq
declarations.doc: The centralizer trace is multiplicative for the diagonal action on a tensor product.
declarations.statement:
theorem MonoidExtensionByNat.diagonalTensorCentralizerTrace_eq
    {A : Type uA} {Λ : Type uΛ} {G : Type uG} {Γ : Type uΓ} {P : Type uP} {M : Type uM}
    [CommRing A] [Ring Λ] [Algebra A Λ] [Group G] [Finite G] [Monoid Γ]
    [AddCommGroup P] [Module A P]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module Λ M] [IsScalarTower A Λ M]
    (E : MonoidExtensionByNat G Γ)
    (ρ : _root_.Representation A Γ P) (σ : _root_.Representation Λ Γ M)
    [Module.Finite A[G] (asModuleNC (restrictedRepresentation E ρ))]
    [Module.Projective A[G] (asModuleNC (restrictedRepresentation E ρ))]
    [Module.Finite Λ M] [Module.Projective Λ M]
    (γ : Γ) :
    E.diagonalTensorCentralizerTrace ρ σ γ =
      commutativeAdditiveCommutatorQuotientEval A (E.centralizerTrace ρ γ) •
        projectiveModuleTrace Λ M (σ γ)

declarations.name: Stacks.Trace.coinvariantRepresentation
declarations.doc:
The canonical action of the quotient monoid `ℕ` on the coinvariants.  Its
specification records compatibility with every lift in `Γ`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def coinvariantRepresentation (E : MonoidExtensionByNat G Γ)
    [AddCommGroup P] [Module Λ P] (ρ : _root_.Representation Λ Γ P) :
    { σ : _root_.Representation Λ (Multiplicative ℕ)
        (coinvariants (restrictedRepresentation E ρ)) //
      ∀ (γ : Γ) (p : P),
        σ (E.degree γ) (coinvariantsMk (restrictedRepresentation E ρ) p) =
          coinvariantsMk (restrictedRepresentation E ρ) (ρ γ p) }

declarations.name: Stacks.Trace.coinvariants_module_finite
declarations.doc:
The coinvariants of a finite `Λ[G]`-projective representation are finite
over `Λ`.
declarations.statement:
lemma coinvariants_module_finite
    [AddCommGroup P] [Module Λ P] (σ : _root_.Representation Λ G P)
    [Module.Finite Λ[G] (Representation.asModuleNC
      σ)] :
    Module.Finite Λ (coinvariants σ)

declarations.name: Stacks.Trace.coinvariants_module_projective
declarations.doc:
The coinvariants of a finite `Λ[G]`-projective representation are
projective over `Λ`.
declarations.statement:
lemma coinvariants_module_projective
    [AddCommGroup P] [Module Λ P] (σ : _root_.Representation Λ G P)
    [Module.Projective Λ[G] (Representation.asModuleNC
      σ)] :
    Module.Projective Λ (coinvariants σ)

declarations.name: Stacks.Trace.trace_degreeOne_on_coinvariants
declarations.doc:
The trace of degree one on the coinvariants is the sum of the centralizer
traces over the `G`-conjugacy classes of degree-one elements.
declarations.statement:
lemma trace_degreeOne_on_coinvariants [Finite G] (E : MonoidExtensionByNat G Γ)
    [AddCommGroup P] [Module Λ P] (ρ : _root_.Representation Λ Γ P)
    [Module.Finite Λ[G] (Representation.asModuleNC
      (restrictedRepresentation E ρ))]
    [Module.Projective Λ[G] (Representation.asModuleNC
      (restrictedRepresentation E ρ))]
    (S : Finset Γ) (hS : IsConjugacyClassRepresentatives E (.ofAdd 1) S) :
    letI := coinvariants_module_finite (restrictedRepresentation E ρ)
    letI := coinvariants_module_projective (restrictedRepresentation E ρ)
    projectiveModuleTrace Λ (coinvariants (restrictedRepresentation E ρ))
        ((coinvariantRepresentation E ρ).val (.ofAdd 1)) =
      ∑ γ ∈ S, MonoidExtensionByNat.centralizerTrace E ρ γ

declarations.name: Stacks.Trace.isZero_groupHomology_trivial_succ
declarations.doc:
The homology of a finite group with coefficients in the trivial module given by a field
in which the order of the group is invertible vanishes in positive degrees.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_groupHomology_trivial_succ (Λ : Type u) (G : Type u) [Field Λ] [Group G]
    [Finite G] [NeZero (Nat.card G : Λ)] (n : ℕ) :
    Limits.IsZero (groupHomology (Rep.trivial Λ G Λ) (n + 1))
declarations.comment: the vanishing of the homology of `G` in positive degrees

declarations.name: Stacks.Trace.sum_inv_card_centralizer_degreeOne
declarations.doc:
The reciprocals of the orders of the centralizers of the degree-one elements of the
extension monoid, summed over their `G`-conjugacy classes, add up to `1` in any field in which
the order of `G` is invertible.
declarations.statement:
theorem sum_inv_card_centralizer_degreeOne {Λ : Type u} {G : Type v} {Γ : Type w} [Field Λ]
    [Group G] [Finite G] [Monoid Γ] [NeZero (Nat.card G : Λ)] (E : MonoidExtensionByNat G Γ)
    (S : Finset Γ) (hS : IsConjugacyClassRepresentatives E (.ofAdd 1) S) :
    ∑ γ ∈ S, (Nat.card (centralizer E.inclusion γ) : Λ)⁻¹ = 1

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.exists_compactification_and_traceFormulaUpToDim_one
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 03UG]: the trace formula for curves.** Let `k` be a finite field with
`#k = p ^ q`, `k̄` an algebraic closure of `k`, and `Λ` a finite ring whose cardinality is prime
to that of `k`. Every separated scheme `X` of finite type over `k` of dimension at most one has a
compactification over `k`, and for every compactification `j` of `X` and every
`K ∈ D_ctf(X, Λ)`, `RΓ_c(X_k̄, K)` (computed through `j`) and the stalks `K_x̄` at the rational
points are perfect and

`Tr(π_X^* | RΓ_c(X_k̄, K)) = ∑_{x ∈ X(k)} Tr(π_x | K_x̄)`

in `Λ^♮`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_compactification_and_traceFormulaUpToDim_one (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (Λ : Type)
    [Ring Λ] [Finite Λ] {k : Type u} [Field k] [Fintype k] (kbar : Type u) [Field kbar]
    [IsAlgClosed kbar] [Algebra k kbar] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k kbar] (p q : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [CharP k p] [CharP kbar p] (hcard : Fintype.card k = p ^ q)
    (hcop : Nat.Coprime (Nat.card Λ) (Fintype.card k)) :
    (∀ (X : B.Scheme) (f : X.obj ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [QuasiCompact f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
      [IsSeparated f], topologicalKrullDim X.obj ≤ ((1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) →
      Nonempty (CompactificationOf (Over.mk f))) ∧
    TraceFormulaUpToDim B Λ kbar p q hcard 1

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.compactSupportLefschetzNumber_eq_localLefschetzNumber
declarations.doc:
**The trace formula in dimension at most one (Stacks 03UG).**  Let `k` be a finite field
with `p ^ q` elements, let `k̄` be an algebraically closed extension of `k`, let `X` be a
separated scheme of finite type over `k` of dimension at most one, let `Λ` be a finite ring
whose cardinality is prime to that of `k`, and let `K` be a bounded below complex of sheaves of
`Λ`-modules on the small étale site of `X`.  Then

`Tr(π_X^* | RΓ_c(X_k̄, K)) = ∑_{x ∈ X(k)} Tr(π_x | K_x̄)`

in `Λ^natural`, the left hand side being the trace of the action induced on
`RΓ_c(X_k̄, K|_{X_k̄})` by an extension of the geometric Frobenius `π_X × id` of
[Stacks, Tag 03SQ] to a compactification of `X_k̄` over `Spec k̄`, and the right hand side the
sum over the rational points of the traces of the geometric Frobenius of [Stacks, Tag 03SW] on
the stalks of `K` at the geometric points above them.

Perfectness of `RΓ_c(X_k̄, K|_{X_k̄})` and of each stalk, finiteness of `X(k)`, the dévissage of
Step 1 of the source with the identification of its graded pieces, and the Galois decomposition
of Steps 7 to 9 are hypotheses; the implementation notes of this file record what each of them
is and what remains unformalized.
declarations.statement:
public theorem compactSupportLefschetzNumber_eq_localLefschetzNumber
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [Fintype k] {p q : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p]
    (hcard : Fintype.card k = p ^ q) (Y : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [IsSeparated Y.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom] [QuasiCompact Y.hom]
    (_hdim : topologicalKrullDim Y.left ≤ 1)
    (kbar : Type u) [Field kbar] [IsAlgClosed kbar] [Algebra k kbar] [CharP kbar p]
    (Λ : Type r) [Ring Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (_hcoprime : Nat.Coprime (Nat.card Λ) (Fintype.card k))
    (K : CochainComplex.Plus (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ Y.left))
    [Fintype (rationalPoints Y.hom)]
    (j : CompactificationOf
      (Over.mk (pullback.snd Y.hom (Stacks.Frobenius.specAlgebraMap k kbar))))
    (E : CompactificationEndomorphism j
      (Stacks.Frobenius.geometricFrobeniusBaseChange Y kbar p q hcard))
    (γ : 𝟭 (DerivedCategory.Plus (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ j.space)) ⟶
      etaleModuleDerivedDirectImage.{u, r} Λ E.hom)
    (hperf : StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj
      ((compactlySupportedCohomology.{u, r} kbar
          (pullback.snd Y.hom (Stacks.Frobenius.specAlgebraMap k kbar)) j Λ).obj
        (baseChangeCoefficients.{u, r} Λ Y kbar K))))
    (hstalkPerfect : ∀ x : rationalPoints Y.hom, StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (rationalPointStalkComplex.{u, r} Λ kbar x.1 K)))
    (devissage : LefschetzDevissage.{r, max (u + 1) r, u} Λ (rationalPoints Y.hom))
    (hglobal : devissage.globalDatum =
      frobeniusActionOnCompactSupport.{u, r} Λ E γ
        (baseChangeCoefficients.{u, r} Λ Y kbar K) hperf)
    (hstalk : devissage.stalkDatum =
      geometricFrobeniusStalkDatum.{u, r} Λ kbar p q hcard Y.hom K hstalkPerfect)
    (group : Type t) [Fintype group] (prime exponent level : ℕ)
    (stabilizerExponent : group → ℕ) (coefficientTrace : group → ℤ)
    (moduleTrace : group → AdditiveCommutatorQuotient Λ)
    (hprime : Nat.Prime prime)
    (hannihilate : ∀ y : AdditiveCommutatorQuotient Λ, ((prime : ℤ) ^ exponent) • y = 0)
    (hlevel : ∀ g : group, stabilizerExponent g + exponent ≤ level)
    (hdecomposition : globalLefschetzNumber Λ devissage.openDatum =
      ∑ g : group, coefficientTrace g • moduleTrace g)
    (hdivisible : ∀ g : group, ((prime : ℤ) ^ level) ∣
      ((prime : ℤ) ^ stabilizerExponent g) * coefficientTrace g) :
    compactSupportLefschetzNumber.{u, r} Λ E γ
        (baseChangeCoefficients.{u, r} Λ Y kbar K) hperf =
      localLefschetzNumber Λ (rationalPoints Y.hom)
        (geometricFrobeniusStalkDatum.{u, r} Λ kbar p q hcard Y.hom K hstalkPerfect)
declarations.comment: RESTRICTED: 03UH with both sides built from the scheme; the extra hypotheses are 03TV as hperf and hstalkPerfect (K is a bounded below complex of étale sheaves of modules rather than an object of the D_ctf of 03TQ: the two small étale sites are identified by SmallEtale.sheafEquiv, but the transport of finite Tor dimension across it and the direction (1) => (2) of 03TT are missing), finiteness of X(k), the Step 1 dévissage with the identification of its pieces (devissage, hglobal, hstalk), and the Steps 7 to 9 Galois decomposition feeding 03TZ (hdecomposition, hdivisible, hannihilate, hlevel); Steps 3 to 6 are not formalized

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.compactificationFieldBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**The base change `X̄_k̄` of a compactification of `X` over `k`**, as a compactification of
`X_k̄` over `k̄`: the fibre product `X̄ ×_{Spec k} Spec k̄` is proper over `Spec k̄` because `X̄`
is proper over `Spec k`, and `X_k̄ ⟶ X̄_k̄` is an open immersion because `X ⟶ X̄` is one.  This
is the ambient scheme the source takes `RΓ_c(X_k̄, -)` on.
declarations.statement:
public def compactificationFieldBaseChange :
    CompactificationOf (Over.mk (pullback.snd f (Stacks.Frobenius.specAlgebraMap k kbar)))
declarations.comment: item (2): the base change X̄_k̄ of a compactification X̄ of X over k is a compactification of X_k̄ over k̄, which is where RΓ_c(X_k̄, -) is formed

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.geometricCompactSupportCohomology
declarations.doc:
**The complex `RΓ_c(X_k̄, K) = RΓ(X̄_k̄, j_! K)`** of the source: cohomology with compact
support of a bounded below complex of sheaves of `Λ`-modules on the small étale site of the
base change `X_k̄`, formed through the base change `X̄_k̄` of a compactification `X̄` of `X`
over `k`.  The compactification is an argument, not a choice.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev geometricCompactSupportCohomology :
    DerivedCategory.Plus
        (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ (pullback f (Stacks.Frobenius.specAlgebraMap k kbar))) ⥤
      DerivedCategory.Plus (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ)
declarations.comment: item (2): RΓ_c(X_k̄, K) := RΓ(X̄_k̄, j_! K) for a chosen compactification j of X over k, taken through its base change

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.geometricCompactSupportCohomologyGroup
declarations.doc: **The module `H^i_c(X_k̄, K)`**: the `i`-th cohomology of `RΓ_c(X_k̄, K)`.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev geometricCompactSupportCohomologyGroup (i : ℤ) :
    DerivedCategory.Plus
        (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ (pullback f (Stacks.Frobenius.specAlgebraMap k kbar))) ⥤
      ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) r} Λ
declarations.comment: item (2): H^i_c(X_k̄, K) is the i-th cohomology of RΓ_c(X_k̄, K)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.geometricCompactSupportComparison
declarations.doc:
**Independence of the compactification.**  An isomorphism of the derived lower shriek
functors attached to two compactifications of `X` over `k`, which is [Stacks, Tag 0F7I],
induces an isomorphism of the complexes `RΓ_c(X_k̄, -)` they present, natural in the
coefficient complex.
declarations.statement:
public def geometricCompactSupportComparison
    (e : geometricLowerShriek.{u, r} f j₁ kbar Λ ≅ geometricLowerShriek.{u, r} f j₂ kbar Λ) :
    geometricCompactSupportCohomology.{u, r} f j₁ kbar Λ ≅
      geometricCompactSupportCohomology.{u, r} f j₂ kbar Λ
declarations.comment: item (2): RΓ_c(X_k̄, -) is independent of the compactification, reduced to the independence of Rf_! of 0F7I, which is a hypothesis here

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.geometricCompactSupportGroupComparison
declarations.doc:
**Independence of the compactification for `H^i_c`.**  The comparison of the complexes
induces an isomorphism of the modules `H^i_c(X_k̄, -)` in every degree, natural in the
coefficient complex.
declarations.statement:
public def geometricCompactSupportGroupComparison
    (e : geometricLowerShriek.{u, r} f j₁ kbar Λ ≅ geometricLowerShriek.{u, r} f j₂ kbar Λ)
    (i : ℤ) :
    geometricCompactSupportCohomologyGroup.{u, r} f j₁ kbar Λ i ≅
      geometricCompactSupportCohomologyGroup.{u, r} f j₂ kbar Λ i
declarations.comment: item (2): H^i_c(X_k̄, -) is independent of the compactification, induced by the comparison of the complexes

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.geometricCompactSupportCanonicalComparison
declarations.doc:
**Remark 03UI (2): `RΓ_c(X_k̄, -)` is independent of the compactification.**  Let `k` be a
field, `X` a separated scheme of finite type over `k`, `k̄` an extension field of `k` and `Λ` a
ring.  For any two compactifications `X ⟶ X̄₁` and `X ⟶ X̄₂` of `X` over `k` (open immersions
into proper `k`-schemes, which projective ones are) of dimension at most one, the complexes
`RΓ(X̄₁_k̄, j₁! K)` and `RΓ(X̄₂_k̄, j₂! K)` are canonically isomorphic, naturally in the bounded
below complex `K` of sheaves of `Λ`-modules on `X_k̄`.  The isomorphism is induced by the
canonical isomorphism `geometricLowerShriekCanonicalIso` of the derived lower shriek functors,
through the closure of `X` in `X̄₁ ×_k X̄₂`.

The coefficient ring is taken in `Type` (universe `0`), as in the companion results of
Tags 03VK and 03VL: integral base change for sheaves of modules, through which the finite
projections of the dominating compactification are handled, is available at that universe. A
finite ring, the coefficient ring of the source, is isomorphic to one in `Type`.
declarations.comment: (2): independence of the compactification -- RΓ_c(X_k̄, -) = RΓ(X̄_k̄, j_! -) does not depend on the compactification X̄ of X over k of dimension at most one (proper, which a projective X̄ is): canonical isomorphism through the closure of X in X̄₁ ×_k X̄₂

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.geometricCompactSupportGroupCanonicalComparison
declarations.doc:
**Remark 03UI (2): `H^i_c(X_k̄, -)` is independent of the compactification**, in every degree,
naturally in the coefficient complex: the isomorphism induced on cohomology by
`geometricCompactSupportCanonicalComparison`.  The coefficient ring is taken in `Type`, as in
`geometricCompactSupportCanonicalComparison`.
declarations.comment: (2): independence of the compactification -- H^i_c(X_k̄, -) does not depend on the compactification X̄ of X over k of dimension at most one, in every degree

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.compactSupportLefschetzNumber_eq_localLefschetzNumber_of_galoisDescent
declarations.doc:
**The trace formula in any dimension (Stacks 03UI, item (1)).**  Let `k` be a finite field
with `p ^ q` elements, let `k̄` be an algebraically closed extension of `k`, let `X` be a
separated scheme of finite type over `k` — of arbitrary dimension — let `Λ` be a finite ring
whose cardinality is prime to that of `k`, and let `K` be a bounded below complex of sheaves of
`Λ`-modules on the small étale site of `X`.  Then

`Tr(π_X^* | RΓ_c(X_k̄, K)) = ∑_{x ∈ X(k)} Tr(π_x | K_x̄)`

in `Λ^natural`, given the dévissage of `RΓ_c(X_k̄, K)` along the rational points with the
identification of its graded pieces and the Galois descent of Steps 7 to 9 of the source.  The
bound `topologicalKrullDim X ≤ 1` of
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.compactSupportLefschetzNumber_eq_localLefschetzNumber` plays no part in
the deduction and is absent here.
declarations.statement:
public theorem compactSupportLefschetzNumber_eq_localLefschetzNumber_of_galoisDescent
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [Fintype k] {p q : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p]
    (hcard : Fintype.card k = p ^ q) (Y : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [IsSeparated Y.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom] [QuasiCompact Y.hom]
    (kbar : Type u) [Field kbar] [IsAlgClosed kbar] [Algebra k kbar] [CharP kbar p]
    (Λ : Type r) [Ring Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (_hcoprime : Nat.Coprime (Nat.card Λ) (Fintype.card k))
    (K : CochainComplex.Plus (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ Y.left))
    [Fintype (rationalPoints Y.hom)]
    (j : CompactificationOf
      (Over.mk (pullback.snd Y.hom (Stacks.Frobenius.specAlgebraMap k kbar))))
    (E : CompactificationEndomorphism j
      (Stacks.Frobenius.geometricFrobeniusBaseChange Y kbar p q hcard))
    (γ : 𝟭 (DerivedCategory.Plus (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ j.space)) ⟶
      etaleModuleDerivedDirectImage.{u, r} Λ E.hom)
    (hperf : StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj
      ((compactlySupportedCohomology.{u, r} kbar
          (pullback.snd Y.hom (Stacks.Frobenius.specAlgebraMap k kbar)) j Λ).obj
        (baseChangeCoefficients.{u, r} Λ Y kbar K))))
    (hstalkPerfect : ∀ x : rationalPoints Y.hom, StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (rationalPointStalkComplex.{u, r} Λ kbar x.1 K)))
    (devissage : LefschetzDevissage.{r, max (u + 1) r, u} Λ (rationalPoints Y.hom))
    (hglobal : devissage.globalDatum =
      frobeniusActionOnCompactSupport.{u, r} Λ E γ
        (baseChangeCoefficients.{u, r} Λ Y kbar K) hperf)
    (hstalk : devissage.stalkDatum =
      geometricFrobeniusStalkDatum.{u, r} Λ kbar p q hcard Y.hom K hstalkPerfect)
    (group : Type t) [Fintype group]
    (descent : LefschetzGaloisDescent.{r, max (u + 1) r, u, t} Λ devissage group) :
    compactSupportLefschetzNumber.{u, r} Λ E γ
        (baseChangeCoefficients.{u, r} Λ Y kbar K) hperf =
      localLefschetzNumber Λ (rationalPoints Y.hom)
        (geometricFrobeniusStalkDatum.{u, r} Λ kbar p q hcard Y.hom K hstalkPerfect)
declarations.comment: item (1) RESTRICTED: the 03UG identity with no bound on the dimension of X, from the Step 1 devissage with its identifications (devissage, hglobal, hstalk) and the Steps 7 to 9 Galois descent of 03TZ; the source's reduction of the general case to dimension one is not here

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.canonicalTraceFormula_of_isCtf
declarations.doc:
**The trace formula in any dimension ([Stacks, Tag 03UI] (1)).** Let `k` be a finite field
with `p ^ q` elements and `k̄` an algebraic closure, `X` a separated scheme of finite type over `k`
of any dimension, `Λ` a finite ring whose cardinality is prime to that of `k`, and
`K ∈ D_ctf(X, Λ)`. Then for every compactification `j : X ⟶ X̄` over `k`, the complex
`RΓ_c(X_k̄, K) = RΓ(X̄_k̄, (j_! K)|_{X̄_k̄})` and the stalks `K_x̄` at the rational points are
perfect, and `Tr(π_X^* | RΓ_c(X_k̄, K)) = ∑_{x ∈ X(k)} Tr(π_x | K_x̄)` in `Λ^natural`, for the
canonical Frobenius actions (`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.CanonicalTraceFormula`). The coefficient
ring is in `Type` (see the module docstring).
declarations.statement:
theorem canonicalTraceFormula_of_isCtf (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (Λ : Type) [Ring Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [Fintype k] (kbar : Type u) [Field kbar] [IsAlgClosed kbar]
    [Algebra k kbar] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k kbar] (p q : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p]
    [CharP kbar p] (hcard : Fintype.card k = p ^ q)
    (hcop : Nat.Coprime (Nat.card Λ) (Fintype.card k))
    (X : B.Scheme) (f : X.obj ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [QuasiCompact f] (K : CochainComplex.Plus (EtaleModules.{u, 0} Λ X.obj))
    (hK : IsCtf B X Λ (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K.obj)) (j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f)) :
    CanonicalTraceFormula Λ kbar p q hcard f j K
declarations.comment:
(1): the trace formula in any dimension: Tag 03UG for `X` separated of finite type
over `k` with no bound on its dimension, through every compactification. `Λ : Type` (universe 0),
see the module docstring.

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.localLefschetzNumber_constantStalkDatum
declarations.doc:
**With constant coefficients the local Lefschetz number is a point count.**  The sum
`∑_{x ∈ X(k)} Tr(π_x | K_x̄)` of [Stacks, Tag 03TY] has equal terms when the coefficient system
is constant, so it is `#X(k)` times the trace at a single rational point.
declarations.statement:
public theorem localLefschetzNumber_constantStalkDatum (Λ : Type u) [Ring Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (points : Type w) [Fintype points] (S : PerfectDerivedCategory.{u, r} Λ)
    (g : S.obj ⟶ S.obj) :
    localLefschetzNumber Λ points (constantStalkDatum.{u, r, w} Λ points S g) =
      (Fintype.card points : ℤ) • perfectDerivedTrace Λ S g
declarations.comment: with constant coefficients the right hand side of 03UG collapses to #X(k) times the trace at one rational point, which is the point count Weil's formula 03U1 computes

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.compactSupportLefschetzNumber_eq_weil_of_constantCoefficients
declarations.doc:
**The trace formula with constant coefficients is Weil's formula (Stacks 03UJ).**  In the
situation of `Stacks.EtaleCohomology.compactSupportLefschetzNumber_eq_localLefschetzNumber`,
suppose the coefficient system is constant, so that the stalk of `K` at every rational point is
one perfect complex `S` with one endomorphism `g` on it, and suppose the number of rational
points of `X` is the intersection number `V(π_X) = Δ_C · Γ_{π_X}` of Weil's formula for the
geometric Frobenius.  Then

`Tr(π_X^* | RΓ_c(X_k̄, K)) = (1 - Tr_J(π_X^*) + deg π_X) · Tr(π_x | K_x̄)`

in `Λ^natural`: the right hand side of the trace formula is the point count, and Weil's formula
[Stacks, Tag 03U1] evaluates it on the jacobian of the curve.
declarations.statement:
public theorem compactSupportLefschetzNumber_eq_weil_of_constantCoefficients
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [Fintype k] {p q : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p]
    (hcard : Fintype.card k = p ^ q) (Y : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [IsSeparated Y.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom] [QuasiCompact Y.hom]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim Y.left ≤ 1)
    (kbar : Type u) [Field kbar] [IsAlgClosed kbar] [Algebra k kbar] [CharP kbar p]
    (Λ : Type r) [Ring Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (hcoprime : Nat.Coprime (Nat.card Λ) (Fintype.card k))
    (K : CochainComplex.Plus (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ Y.left))
    [Fintype (rationalPoints Y.hom)]
    (j : CompactificationOf
      (Over.mk (pullback.snd Y.hom (Stacks.Frobenius.specAlgebraMap k kbar))))
    (E : CompactificationEndomorphism j
      (Stacks.Frobenius.geometricFrobeniusBaseChange Y kbar p q hcard))
    (γ : 𝟭 (DerivedCategory.Plus (EtaleModules.{u, r} Λ j.space)) ⟶
      etaleModuleDerivedDirectImage.{u, r} Λ E.hom)
    (hperf : StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj
      ((compactlySupportedCohomology.{u, r} kbar
          (pullback.snd Y.hom (Stacks.Frobenius.specAlgebraMap k kbar)) j Λ).obj
        (baseChangeCoefficients.{u, r} Λ Y kbar K))))
    (hstalkPerfect : ∀ x : rationalPoints Y.hom, StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (rationalPointStalkComplex.{u, r} Λ kbar x.1 K)))
    (devissage : LefschetzDevissage.{r, max (u + 1) r, u} Λ (rationalPoints Y.hom))
    (hglobal : devissage.globalDatum =
      frobeniusActionOnCompactSupport.{u, r} Λ E γ
        (baseChangeCoefficients.{u, r} Λ Y kbar K) hperf)
    (hstalk : devissage.stalkDatum =
      geometricFrobeniusStalkDatum.{u, r} Λ kbar p q hcard Y.hom K hstalkPerfect)
    (group : Type t) [Fintype group] (prime exponent level : ℕ)
    (stabilizerExponent : group → ℕ) (coefficientTrace : group → ℤ)
    (moduleTrace : group → AdditiveCommutatorQuotient Λ)
    (hprime : Nat.Prime prime)
    (hannihilate : ∀ y : AdditiveCommutatorQuotient Λ, ((prime : ℤ) ^ exponent) • y = 0)
    (hlevel : ∀ g : group, stabilizerExponent g + exponent ≤ level)
    (hdecomposition : globalLefschetzNumber Λ devissage.openDatum =
      ∑ g : group, coefficientTrace g • moduleTrace g)
    (hdivisible : ∀ g : group, ((prime : ℤ) ^ level) ∣
      ((prime : ℤ) ^ stabilizerExponent g) * coefficientTrace g)
    (S : PerfectDerivedCategory.{r, max (u + 1) r} Λ) (g : S.obj ⟶ S.obj)
    (hconstant : geometricFrobeniusStalkDatum.{u, r} Λ kbar p q hcard Y.hom K hstalkPerfect =
      constantStalkDatum.{r, max (u + 1) r, u} Λ (rationalPoints Y.hom) S g)
    {Adiv : Type w} [AddCommGroup Adiv] {EndJ : Type z} [Ring EndJ]
    (W : JacobianCorrespondence Adiv EndJ) (frobenius : W.EndomorphismData)
    (hfixedPoints : (Fintype.card (rationalPoints Y.hom) : ℤ) =
      W.fixedPointNumber frobenius) :
    compactSupportLefschetzNumber.{u, r} Λ E γ
        (baseChangeCoefficients.{u, r} Λ Y kbar K) hperf =
      (1 - W.trace frobenius.pullback + frobenius.degree) • perfectDerivedTrace Λ S g
declarations.comment: RESTRICTED: 03UG specialised to constant coefficients computes #X(k), and 03U1 evaluates that count as 1 - Tr_J + deg; the hypotheses of the library's 03UG are carried unchanged, and the constancy of the stalks and the fixed point count are hypotheses

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.traceFormula_constantCoefficients_eq_weil
declarations.statement:
theorem traceFormula_constantCoefficients_eq_weil
    [IsCurve kbar (pullback.snd f (specAlgebraMap k kbar))] (hℓ : ℓ ≠ p) :
    canonicalCompactSupportLefschetzNumber.{u, 0} (ZMod (ℓ ^ n)) f (CompactificationOf.ofProper f)
        kbar p q hcard (constantCoefficients (ZMod (ℓ ^ n)) X.obj)
        (isPerfect_compactSupportFrobeniusCohomology_constantCoefficients B (ZMod (ℓ ^ n)) f
          (isProjective_of_isProper_of_isCurve f) kbar) =
      (Nat.card (rationalPoints f) : ℤ) • additiveCommutatorQuotientMk (ZMod (ℓ ^ n)) 1 ∧
    canonicalCompactSupportLefschetzNumber.{u, 0} (ZMod (ℓ ^ n)) f (CompactificationOf.ofProper f)
        kbar p q hcard (constantCoefficients (ZMod (ℓ ^ n)) X.obj)
        (isPerfect_compactSupportFrobeniusCohomology_constantCoefficients B (ZMod (ℓ ^ n)) f
          (isProjective_of_isProper_of_isCurve f) kbar) =
      additiveCommutatorQuotientMk (ZMod (ℓ ^ n))
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range 3, (-1 : ZMod (ℓ ^ n)) ^ i * LinearMap.trace (ZMod (ℓ ^ n)) _
          ((etaleConstantCohomologyPullback
            (geometricFrobeniusBaseChange (Over.mk f) kbar p q hcard)
            (ZMod (ℓ ^ n)) i).toZModLinearMap (ℓ ^ n))) ∧
    AlgebraicGeometry.CurveGraph.fixedPointIntersection (pullback.snd f (specAlgebraMap k kbar))
        (IsCurve.topologicalKrullDim_eq_one (k := kbar)
          (f := pullback.snd f (specAlgebraMap k kbar))).le
        (geometricFrobeniusBaseChange (Over.mk f) kbar p q hcard)
          (geometricFrobeniusBaseChange_comp_toBase (Over.mk f) kbar p q hcard) =
      Nat.card (rationalPoints f) ∧
    (((Nat.card (rationalPoints f) : ℤ)) : ℤ_[ℓ]) =
      1 - AlgebraicGeometry.CurveGraph.jacobianTateTrace (pullback.snd f (specAlgebraMap k kbar))
        (IsCurve.topologicalKrullDim_eq_one (k := kbar)
          (f := pullback.snd f (specAlgebraMap k kbar))).le
        (geometricFrobeniusBaseChange (Over.mk f) kbar p q hcard)
          (geometricFrobeniusBaseChange_comp_toBase (Over.mk f) kbar p q hcard) ℓ +
        (AlgebraicGeometry.CurveGraph.curveMapDegree (pullback.snd f (specAlgebraMap k kbar))
          (geometricFrobeniusBaseChange (Over.mk f) kbar p q hcard)
          (geometricFrobeniusBaseChange_comp_toBase (Over.mk f) kbar p q hcard) : ℤ_[ℓ])

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.LAdicSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03UM.** An ℓ-adic sheaf is an inverse system of constructible `ℤ/ℓⁿℤ`-module
sheaves whose successive scalar reductions are isomorphisms.
declarations.statement: public structure LAdicSheaf [IsNoetherian X.obj] [Fact ℓ.Prime]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.LAdicSheaf.Hom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03UM.** A morphism of ℓ-adic sheaves is a compatible family of morphisms at the
finite levels.
declarations.statement:
public structure LAdicSheaf.Hom [IsNoetherian X.obj] [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (F G : LAdicSheaf.{u, m} B X ℓ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.LAdicSheaf.IsLisse
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03UM.** A lisse ℓ-adic sheaf has locally constant sheaves at every finite
level.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev LAdicSheaf.IsLisse [IsNoetherian X.obj] [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (F : LAdicSheaf.{u, m} B X ℓ) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.exists_lAdicSheaf_of_eventuallyConstant_reductions
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03UN.** Eventually constant reductions of a constructible inverse system give an
ℓ-adic sheaf whose levels are the stable values of those reductions.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_lAdicSheaf_of_eventuallyConstant_reductions
    [IsNoetherian X.obj] [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (G : ∀ n, FiniteLevelSheaf.{u, m} B X ℓ n)
    (t : ∀ n, G (n + 1) ⟶ (G n).restrictScalars B X ℓ n)
    (hG : ∀ n, IsConstructibleModuleSheaf B X (ZMod (ℓ ^ (n + 1))) (G n))
    (heventually : ∀ (k : ℕ), ∃ (N : ℕ), ∀ (n : ℕ), N ≤ n → (h : k ≤ n) →
      IsIso ((Sheaf.composeAndSheafify
        (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{0, 0, m}
          (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow ℓ (by omega : k + 1 ≤ n + 2)) _ :
            ZMod (ℓ ^ (n + 2)) →+* ZMod (ℓ ^ (k + 1))))).map (t n))) :
    ∃ F : LAdicSheaf.{u, m} B X ℓ, ∃ N : ℕ → ℕ,
      ∃ e : ∀ (k n : ℕ), N k ≤ n → (h : k ≤ n) →
        F.level k ≅ FiniteLevelSheaf.reduceTo B X ℓ n k h (G n),
      (∀ (k n : ℕ) (hn : N k ≤ n) (h : k ≤ n),
        (e k (n + 1) (by omega) (by omega)).hom ≫
          ((Sheaf.composeAndSheafify
            (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
            (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{0, 0, m}
              (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow ℓ (by omega : k + 1 ≤ n + 2)) _ :
                ZMod (ℓ ^ (n + 2)) →+* ZMod (ℓ ^ (k + 1))))).map (t n)) ≫
          (FiniteLevelSheaf.canonicalRestrictionComparison B X ℓ n k h (G n)) =
          (e k n hn h).hom) ∧
      (∀ (k n : ℕ) (hn₁ : N k ≤ n) (hn₂ : N (k + 1) ≤ n)
          (h : k + 1 ≤ n),
        F.transition k ≫
          (sheafCompose (SmallEtale.topology B X.obj X.property)
            (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{m, 0, 0}
              (finiteLevelRingHom ℓ k))).map
            ((e k n hn₁ (by omega)).hom) =
        (e (k + 1) n hn₂ h).hom ≫
          (FiniteLevelSheaf.canonicalReductionTransition B X ℓ n k h (G n)))

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.LAdicSheaf.normalEpiCategory
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03UO**, normality of epimorphisms: every epimorphism of ℓ-adic sheaves is a
cokernel.
declarations.statement: public instance normalEpiCategory : IsNormalEpiCategory (LAdicSheaf.{u, u + 1} B X ℓ)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.LAdicSheaf.hasKernels
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03UO**, the kernel part: the category of ℓ-adic sheaves on a Noetherian scheme has
kernels. The kernel of a morphism is the kernel of the epimorphism in its image
factorisation.
declarations.statement: public instance hasKernels : HasKernels (LAdicSheaf.{u, u + 1} B X ℓ)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.LAdicSheaf.normalMonoCategory
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03UO**, normality of monomorphisms: every monomorphism of ℓ-adic sheaves is a
kernel. In the image factorisation of a monomorphism the epimorphic half is also a
monomorphism, hence an isomorphism, so the monomorphism is the kernel the factorisation
provides.
declarations.statement: public instance normalMonoCategory : IsNormalMonoCategory (LAdicSheaf.{u, u + 1} B X ℓ)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.LAdicSheaf.abelian
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03UO.** The category of `ℤ_ℓ`-sheaves on a Noetherian scheme is abelian: it is
preadditive with finite biproducts, has kernels and cokernels, and every monomorphism is a
kernel while every epimorphism is a cokernel.
declarations.statement: public instance abelian : Abelian (LAdicSheaf.{u, u + 1} B X ℓ)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.LAdicSheaf.hasZeroObject
declarations.doc: The category of ℓ-adic sheaves has a zero object.
declarations.statement: public instance LAdicSheaf.hasZeroObject : HasZeroObject (LAdicSheaf B X ℓ)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.LAdicSheaf.hasFiniteBiproducts
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03UO**, the additive part: the category of ℓ-adic sheaves on a Noetherian scheme
has finite biproducts, the biproduct being formed levelwise.
declarations.statement: public instance hasFiniteBiproducts : HasFiniteBiproducts (LAdicSheaf B X ℓ)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.LAdicSheaf.hasCokernels
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03UO**, the cokernel part: the category of ℓ-adic sheaves on a Noetherian scheme has
cokernels, formed levelwise.
declarations.statement: public instance hasCokernels : HasCokernels (LAdicSheaf B X ℓ)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.LAdicSheaf.normalMono_of_app_mono
declarations.doc:
A morphism of ℓ-adic sheaves whose components are monomorphisms is the kernel of its
levelwise cokernel.
declarations.statement:
public def normalMono_of_app_mono {F G : LAdicSheaf.{u, u + 1} B X ℓ} (f : F ⟶ G)
    (hf : ∀ n, Mono (f.app n)) : NormalMono f
declarations.comment: monomorphisms with monomorphic components are kernels, of the levelwise cokernel

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.LAdicSheaf.normalEpi_of_epi_kernelLift
declarations.doc:
An epimorphism of ℓ-adic sheaves is the cokernel of a morphism killed by it whose levelwise
kernel comparisons are epimorphisms.
declarations.statement:
public def normalEpi_of_epi_kernelLift {K F G : LAdicSheaf.{u, u + 1} B X ℓ} (i : K ⟶ F)
    (f : F ⟶ G) [Epi f] (w : i ≫ f = 0)
    (hi : ∀ n, Epi (kernel.lift (f.app n) (i.app n) (comp_eq_zero_app i f w n))) :
    NormalEpi f
declarations.comment: epimorphisms whose levelwise kernel comparisons are epimorphisms are cokernels, of the morphism those comparisons compare to

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.LAdicSheaf.preadditive
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03UO.** ℓ-adic sheaves form a preadditive category: morphisms add levelwise and
composition is bilinear.
declarations.statement: public instance LAdicSheaf.preadditive : Preadditive (LAdicSheaf.{u, m} B X ℓ)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.finite_finiteLevelStalk
declarations.doc: Every finite-level stalk of an ℓ-adic sheaf at a geometric point is finite.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finite_finiteLevelStalk (F : LAdicSheaf B X ℓ) (s : GeometricPoint X.1) (n : ℕ) :
    Finite (finiteLevelStalk B X ℓ F s n)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.finiteLevelStalkTransition_surjective
declarations.doc: Each transition between consecutive finite-level stalks is surjective.

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.finiteLevelStalkTransition_quotient
declarations.doc:
The transition identifies the quotient of the level-`n+1` stalk by `ℓⁿ⁺¹` with the
level-`n` stalk.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finiteLevelStalkTransition_quotient (F : LAdicSheaf B X ℓ)
    (s : GeometricPoint X.1) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ e : (finiteLevelStalk B X ℓ F s (n + 1) ⧸
        (Ideal.span ({(ℓ ^ (n + 1) : ZMod (ℓ ^ (n + 2)))} : Set (ZMod (ℓ ^ (n + 2))))) •
          (⊤ : Submodule (ZMod (ℓ ^ (n + 2))) (finiteLevelStalk B X ℓ F s (n + 1))))
        ≃ₗ[ZMod (ℓ ^ (n + 2))]
          (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (finiteLevelRingHom ℓ n)).obj
            (finiteLevelStalk B X ℓ F s n),
      ∀ x, e (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = (finiteLevelStalkTransition B X ℓ F s n).hom x

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.LAdicSheaf.stalk
declarations.doc:
The stalk of an ℓ-adic sheaf at a geometric point: the inverse limit of its finite-level
stalks, as a `ℤ_[ℓ]`-module.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev LAdicSheaf.stalk (F : LAdicSheaf B X ℓ) (x : GeometricPoint X.1) :
    Type (u + 1)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.LAdicSheaf.finite_stalk
declarations.doc: The stalk of an ℓ-adic sheaf is finite over the ℓ-adic integers.
declarations.statement:
public instance LAdicSheaf.finite_stalk
    (F : LAdicSheaf B X ℓ) (x : GeometricPoint X.1) :
    Module.Finite (PadicInt ℓ)
      (LAdicSheaf.stalk B X ℓ F x)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.LAdicSheaf.stalk_equiv_free_prod_torsion
declarations.doc: A stalk of an ℓ-adic sheaf is a sum of free and prime-power cyclic modules.
declarations.statement:
public theorem LAdicSheaf.stalk_equiv_free_prod_torsion
    (F : LAdicSheaf B X ℓ) (x : GeometricPoint X.1) :
    ∃ (r t : ℕ) (e : Fin t → ℕ),
      (∀ i, 1 ≤ e i) ∧
      Nonempty (LAdicSheaf.stalk B X ℓ F x ≃ₗ[PadicInt ℓ]
