declarations.name: Stacks.TraceFormula.AbstractTraceFormula
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Section 03VO.** An *abstract trace formula* for an extension of profinite
groups `1 → G → Γ → Ẑ → 1`, given by a continuous surjective degree map `deg : Γ → Ẑ` with kernel
`G`: an integer `q ≥ 1`, for every `d` a finite set `S_d` and for each `x ∈ S_d` a conjugacy class
`F_x` of degree `d` (for `d ≥ 1`), such that `cd_ℓ(G) < ∞` for all primes `ℓ ∤ q` and such that
for all finite rings `Λ` with `q ∈ Λ^*`, all finite projective `Λ`-modules `M` with continuous
`Γ`-action and all `n > 0`, the derived homology `LH₀(G, M) = M ⊗^L_{Λ[[G]]} Λ` is perfect and
`∑_{d ∣ n} d ∑_{x ∈ S_d} Tr(F_x^{n/d} | M) = q^n Tr(F^n | LH₀(G, M))` in `Λ^♮`, for every element
`F` of degree one and all representatives of the classes `F_x`.
declarations.statement:
public structure AbstractTraceFormula (Γ : Type u) [Group Γ] [TopologicalSpace Γ]
    [IsTopologicalGroup Γ] [CompactSpace Γ] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace Γ]
    (deg : Γ →* Multiplicative ProfiniteIntegers) (hdeg : Continuous deg)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective deg)
declarations.comment: an extension 1 → G → Γ → Ẑ → 1 of profinite groups has an abstract trace formula

declarations.name: Stacks.TraceFormula.HasAbstractTraceFormula
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Section 03VO.** The extension `1 → G → Γ → Ẑ → 1` *has an abstract trace
formula* if the data of `Stacks.TraceFormula.AbstractTraceFormula` exist.
declarations.statement:
public def HasAbstractTraceFormula (Γ : Type u) [Group Γ] [TopologicalSpace Γ]
    [IsTopologicalGroup Γ] [CompactSpace Γ] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace Γ]
    (deg : Γ →* Multiplicative ProfiniteIntegers) (hdeg : Continuous deg)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective deg) : Prop

declarations.name: Stacks.TraceFormula.frobenius_conj
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03VQ.** The extension `1 → Ẑ^{(q)} → Γ → Ẑ → 1` exhibited by the
semidirect product: conjugation by the Frobenius element is multiplication by the unit
`u = χ 1`, that is, `F x F⁻¹ = u x` for every `x` in the kernel `G = Ẑ^{(q)}`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem frobenius_conj (x : RestrictedProfiniteIntegers q) :
    frobenius χ * incl χ (Multiplicative.ofAdd x) * (frobenius χ)⁻¹ =
      incl χ (Multiplicative.ofAdd
        ((χ (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ProfiniteIntegers)) :
          RestrictedProfiniteIntegers q) * x))
declarations.comment:
the exact sequence 1 → Ẑ^{(q)} → Γ → Ẑ → 1 with F of degree 1 and F x F⁻¹ = u x,
as an extension of groups

declarations.name: Stacks.TraceFormula.isTopologicalGroup_gamma
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03VQ.** The extension `Γ = Ẑ^{(q)} ⋊ Ẑ` is a topological group, as
soon as the powers `u^z = χ z` of the unit vary continuously with `z`. Together with
`Stacks.TraceFormula.compactSpace_gamma` and
`Stacks.TraceFormula.totallyDisconnectedSpace_gamma` this makes `Γ` profinite.
declarations.statement: public theorem isTopologicalGroup_gamma (hχ : Continuous χ) : IsTopologicalGroup (Gamma χ)

declarations.name: Stacks.TraceFormula.eq_intCast_traceParameter
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03VQ.** The congruence for the trivial coefficient modules forces
`qu` to be the ordinary integer `a = q - #S_1`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem eq_intCast_traceParameter (h : IsTrivialModuleCongruence q b s) :
    b = ((traceParameter q s : ℤ) : RestrictedProfiniteIntegers q)
declarations.comment: qu = a ∈ ℤ, with a = q - #S₁

declarations.name: Stacks.TraceFormula.abs_traceParameter_lt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03VQ.** If some `S_d` is nonempty then the integer `a` with `qu = a`
satisfies `|a| < q`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem abs_traceParameter_lt (hq : 1 ≤ q) (h : IsTrivialModuleCongruence q b s)
    (hs : ∃ d : ℕ, 0 < d ∧ s d ≠ 0) : |traceParameter q s| < (q : ℤ)

declarations.name: Stacks.TraceFormula.exists_intCast_eq_and_abs_lt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03VQ.** For a unit `u` of `Ẑ^{(q)}`, the congruence
`q^n - (qu)^n ≡ ∑_{d ∣ n} d · #S_d` for the trivial coefficient modules forces `qu` to be an
integer `a` with `|a| < q`, provided some `S_d` is nonempty.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_intCast_eq_and_abs_lt (hq : 1 ≤ q) (u : (RestrictedProfiniteIntegers q)ˣ)
    (s : ℕ → ℕ)
    (h : IsTrivialModuleCongruence q ((q : RestrictedProfiniteIntegers q) * u) s)
    (hs : ∃ d : ℕ, 0 < d ∧ s d ≠ 0) :
    ∃ a : ℤ, (q : RestrictedProfiniteIntegers q) * u =
      (a : RestrictedProfiniteIntegers q) ∧ |a| < (q : ℤ)
declarations.comment:
q^n - (qu)^n ≡ ∑_{d ∣ n} d #S_d for all moduli prime to q implies qu = a ∈ ℤ with
|a| < q

declarations.name: Stacks.TraceFormula.commutativeExample_hasAbstractTraceFormula_one
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03VQ: the case `u = 1`, a counterexample to `|a| < q`.** For every
`q ≥ 1` the extension `1 → Ẑ^{(q)} → Γ → Ẑ → 1` with `F x F⁻¹ = x` (that is, `u = 1`,
`Γ = Ẑ^{(q)} × Ẑ`) has an abstract trace formula with integer `q` and all the sets `S_d` empty;
for it `qu = a = q`, so `|a| < q` fails, and the corrected integrality statement
`Stacks.TraceFormula.commutativeExample_integrality` (`|a| ≤ q`, with `|a| < q` exactly when
`u ≠ 1`) is sharp.
declarations.statement:
public theorem commutativeExample_hasAbstractTraceFormula_one (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    ∃ T : AbstractTraceFormula (Gamma (trivialCharacter (q := q))) (degree _)
        (continuous_degree _) (degree_surjective _),
      T.q = q ∧ (∀ d, IsEmpty (T.S d)) ∧
        frobenius (trivialCharacter (q := q)) * incl _ (Multiplicative.ofAdd 1) *
            (frobenius (trivialCharacter (q := q)))⁻¹ = incl _ (Multiplicative.ofAdd 1) ∧
        ¬ |((q : ℤ) * 1)| < q
declarations.comment: the case u = 1: Γ = Ẑ^(q) × Ẑ has an abstract trace formula with integer q and all S_d empty, so qu = a = q and the source's bound |a| < q fails

declarations.name: Stacks.TraceFormula.commutativeExample_congruence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03VQ: the congruence.** If the extension
`1 → Ẑ^{(q)} → Γ → Ẑ → 1` with `F x F⁻¹ = u x` has an abstract trace formula with integer `q`,
then `q^n - (qu)^n ≡ ∑_{d ∣ n} d #S_d` in `ℤ/m` for every `m` prime to `q`: as an identity in
`Ẑ^{(q)} = lim_{(m,q)=1} ℤ/m`, and, `qu` being the integer `a = q - #S_1`, as the identity
`q^n - a^n = ∑_{d ∣ n} d #S_d` of integers.
declarations.statement:
public theorem commutativeExample_congruence (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (q : RestrictedProfiniteIntegers q) ^ n - ((q : RestrictedProfiniteIntegers q) * u) ^ n =
        (pointCountSum (fun d => Fintype.card (T.S d)) n : RestrictedProfiniteIntegers q) ∧
      (q : ℤ) ^ n - ((q : ℤ) - Fintype.card (T.S 1)) ^ n =
        pointCountSum (fun d => Fintype.card (T.S d)) n
declarations.comment: q^n - (qu)^n ≡ ∑_{d ∣ n} d #S_d in ℤ/m for all m prime to q, derived from the abstract trace formula on the trivial modules ℤ/m

declarations.name: Stacks.TraceFormula.commutativeExample_integrality
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03VQ (corrected).** If the extension `1 → Ẑ^{(q)} → Γ → Ẑ → 1` with
`F x F⁻¹ = u x` has an abstract trace formula with integer `q` and sets `S_d`, then `qu = a ∈ ℤ`
with `a = q - #S_1`, and `|a| ≤ q`; moreover `|a| < q` exactly when `u ≠ 1`, exactly when some
`S_d` (`d ≥ 1`) is nonempty. The source's unconditional `|a| < q` fails for `u = 1`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem commutativeExample_integrality :
    ∃ a : ℤ, (q : RestrictedProfiniteIntegers q) * u = (a : RestrictedProfiniteIntegers q) ∧
      a = q - Fintype.card (T.S 1) ∧ |a| ≤ q ∧
      (|a| < q ↔ u ≠ 1) ∧ (|a| < q ↔ ∃ d : ℕ, 0 < d ∧ Nonempty (T.S d))
declarations.comment: corrected: qu = a ∈ ℤ with |a| ≤ q, and |a| < q iff u ≠ 1 iff some S_d is nonempty; the source's unconditional |a| < q fails for u = 1, where Γ = Ẑ^(q) × Ẑ has an abstract trace formula with all S_d empty

declarations.name: Stacks.TraceFormula.commutativeExample_card_eq_of_eq_one
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03VQ: the special case `a = 1`.** If `qu = 1`, the sets `S_1` and
`S_2` have `q - 1` and `((q² - 1) - (q - 1))/2` elements, the numbers of closed points of
`G_{m, F_q}` of degree `1` and `2`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem commutativeExample_card_eq_of_eq_one
    (h1 : (q : RestrictedProfiniteIntegers q) * u = 1) :
    Fintype.card (T.S 1) = q - 1 ∧ Fintype.card (T.S 2) = ((q ^ 2 - 1) - (q - 1)) / 2
declarations.comment: the special case a = 1: #S₁ = q - 1 and #S₂ = ((q² - 1) - (q - 1))/2

declarations.name: Stacks.TraceFormula.commutativeExample_hasAbstractTraceFormula_inverse
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03VQ: the special case `a = 1` occurs.** For every `q ≥ 2` the
extension `1 → Ẑ^{(q)} → Γ → Ẑ → 1` with `F x F⁻¹ = q⁻¹ x` (so `u = q⁻¹` and `qu = a = 1`) has an
abstract trace formula with integer `q`; its sets `S_d` are the orbits of exact size `d` of
multiplication by `q` on `ℤ/(q^d - 1)`, and `#S_1 = q - 1`, `#S_2 = ((q² - 1) - (q - 1))/2`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem commutativeExample_hasAbstractTraceFormula_inverse :
    ∃ T : AbstractTraceFormula (Gamma (inverseCharacter q)) (degree _) (continuous_degree _)
        (degree_surjective _),
      T.q = q ∧
        (∀ x : RestrictedProfiniteIntegers q,
          frobenius (inverseCharacter q) * incl _ (Multiplicative.ofAdd x) *
              (frobenius (inverseCharacter q))⁻¹ =
            incl _ (Multiplicative.ofAdd ((qInv q : RestrictedProfiniteIntegers q) * x))) ∧
        (q : RestrictedProfiniteIntegers q) * (qInv q : RestrictedProfiniteIntegers q) = 1 ∧
        (∀ d, T.S d = Necklace.Orbits q d) ∧
        Fintype.card (T.S 1) = q - 1 ∧ Fintype.card (T.S 2) = ((q ^ 2 - 1) - (q - 1)) / 2
declarations.comment: the special case a = 1 does occur: Γ = Ẑ^(q) ⋊ Ẑ with F x F⁻¹ = q⁻¹ x has an abstract trace formula with integer q, with #S₁ = q - 1 and #S₂ = ((q² - 1) - (q - 1))/2

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.TameMultiplicativeGroup.tameFundamentalGroup_zmod_hasAbstractTraceFormula
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03VQ: the special case `a = 1` occurs with
`Γ = π₁ᵗ(𝐆_{m,𝔽_p}, η̄)`, `#S_1 = q - 1` and `#S_2 = ((q² - 1) - (q - 1))/2`.** For `p` prime there
is an isomorphism of topological groups `e : Ẑ^{(p)} ⋊ Ẑ ≃ₜ* π₁ᵗ(𝐆_{m,𝔽_p}, η̄)`, with
`F x F⁻¹ = u x`, `u = p⁻¹`, compatible with the degrees (an element of degree `d` acts on the
constants `𝔽_{p^n}` of the points of every tame cover as the geometric Frobenius to the power
`d mod n`, so the kernel `Ẑ^{(p)}` is the geometric part); and this extension has an abstract trace
formula with integer `q = p`, `qu = a = 1`, `#S_1 = q - 1` and `#S_2 = ((q² - 1) - (q - 1))/2`.
declarations.statement:
theorem tameFundamentalGroup_zmod_hasAbstractTraceFormula (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    ∃ e : Gamma (inverseCharacter p) ≃ₜ* tameFundamentalGroup (ZMod p),
      (∀ (γ : Gamma (inverseCharacter p)) (Y : TameCover (ZMod p))
        (y : (tameFiberFunctor (ZMod p)).obj Y) (c : Γ(Y.obj.left, ⊤)) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0),
          fiberRingHom y c ∈ frobField (ZMod p) n →
          fiberRingHom (autApply (e γ) Y y) c ^ (p ^ (restrictedMod 1 n hn
            (Nat.coprime_one_right n) (Multiplicative.toAdd (degree _ γ))).val) =
            fiberRingHom y c) ∧
      ∃ T : AbstractTraceFormula (Gamma (inverseCharacter p)) (degree _) (continuous_degree _)
          (degree_surjective _),
        T.q = p ∧
          (∀ x : RestrictedProfiniteIntegers p,
            frobenius (inverseCharacter p) * incl _ (Multiplicative.ofAdd x) *
                (frobenius (inverseCharacter p))⁻¹ =
              incl _ (Multiplicative.ofAdd ((qInv p : RestrictedProfiniteIntegers p) * x))) ∧
          (p : RestrictedProfiniteIntegers p) * (qInv p : RestrictedProfiniteIntegers p) = 1 ∧
          (∀ d, T.S d = Necklace.Orbits p d) ∧
          Fintype.card (T.S 1) = p - 1 ∧ Fintype.card (T.S 2) = ((p ^ 2 - 1) - (p - 1)) / 2
declarations.comment: the special case a = 1 does occur with Γ = π₁ᵗ(𝐆_{m,𝔽_p}, η̄), #S₁ = q - 1 and #S₂ = ((q² - 1) - (q - 1))/2

declarations.name: Stacks.Adeles.IsUnramifiedCuspForm
declarations.doc:
An unramified cusp form on `GL₂(A)` with values in `Λ`: a function on `GL₂(A)` invariant
under right multiplication by `GL₂(K)` and under left multiplication by `GL₂(O)`, whose
constant term along the unipotent `(1, z; 0, 1)` over `A` modulo `K` vanishes.

See [Stacks Project, Tag 03VS](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03VS).
declarations.statement:
public structure IsUnramifiedCuspForm {Λ : Type w} [AddCommMonoid Λ]
    (f : GL (Fin 2) (AdeleRing K) → Λ) : Prop

declarations.name: Stacks.Adeles.GlobalFunctionField.cuspFormsCentralChar_fg_and_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03VW.** Let `k` be a finite field of characteristic `p` and `K` a function field
over `k` (a finite extension of `k(x)`; this includes `K = k(X)` for every geometrically
irreducible smooth projective curve `X` over `k`, whose places are the closed points of `X`). Let
`Λ` be a ring in which `p` is invertible.

1. If `Λ` is Noetherian, then `C(Λ)` is a finitely generated `Λ`-module.
2. If `Λ` is a field with prime subfield `F` (the bottom subfield `⊥`), then
   `C(Λ) = C(F) ⊗_F Λ` compatibly with `T_v` acting: there is a `Λ`-linear isomorphism
   `e : Λ ⊗_F C(F) ≃ C(Λ)` given by `c ⊗ f ↦ c · (ι ∘ f)` (`ι : F → Λ` the inclusion), and for
   every place `v` and every choice of the data `π, λ, g₀, g` of the formula for `T_v`
   (`Stacks.Adeles.IsHeckeDataAt`), `T_v` restricts to linear endomorphisms `T_F` of `C(F)` and
   `T_Λ` of `C(Λ)` with `e ∘ (id ⊗ T_F) = T_Λ ∘ e`.

`C(Λ)` is `Stacks.Adeles.cuspFormsCentralChar`: the unramified cusp forms (Tag 03VS) with
`U_v f = φ_v⁻¹ f` for all `v`, where the source's undefined `φ_v` is read as `q_v`, as in that
definition's docstring. The characteristic `p` of `k` is `ringChar k`. The tensor product is
written `Λ ⊗_F C(F)`, with `Λ` on the left so that it carries its `Λ`-module structure; it is
`C(F) ⊗_F Λ` of the source up to the swap of factors.
declarations.statement:
public theorem cuspFormsCentralChar_fg_and_baseChange :
    (∀ (Λ : Type w) [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ], IsUnit (ringChar k : Λ) →
      (cuspFormsCentralChar K Λ).FG) ∧
    ∀ (Λ : Type w) [Field Λ], IsUnit (ringChar k : Λ) →
      ∃ e : Λ ⊗[↥(⊥ : Subfield Λ)] cuspFormsCentralChar K ↥(⊥ : Subfield Λ) ≃ₗ[Λ]
          cuspFormsCentralChar K Λ,
        (∀ (c : Λ) (f : cuspFormsCentralChar K ↥(⊥ : Subfield Λ)),
          ((e (c ⊗ₜ f) : cuspFormsCentralChar K Λ) : GL (Fin 2) (AdeleRing K) → Λ) =
            c • mapCoeffs (algebraMap ↥(⊥ : Subfield Λ) Λ) f) ∧
        ∀ {v : Place K} {q : ℕ} (π : v.integers) (lam : Fin q → v.integers)
          (g₀ : GL (Fin 2) (AdeleRing K)) (g : Fin q → GL (Fin 2) (AdeleRing K)),
          IsHeckeDataAt v π lam g₀ g →
            ∃ (TF : cuspFormsCentralChar K ↥(⊥ : Subfield Λ) →ₗ[↥(⊥ : Subfield Λ)]
                cuspFormsCentralChar K ↥(⊥ : Subfield Λ))
              (TΛ : cuspFormsCentralChar K Λ →ₗ[Λ] cuspFormsCentralChar K Λ),
              (∀ f, (TF f : GL (Fin 2) (AdeleRing K) → ↥(⊥ : Subfield Λ)) =
                heckeOperator g₀ g f) ∧
              (∀ f, (TΛ f : GL (Fin 2) (AdeleRing K) → Λ) = heckeOperator g₀ g f) ∧
              e.toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.baseChange Λ TF = TΛ ∘ₗ e.toLinearMap

declarations.name: Stacks.Adeles.CuspFormsFinite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03VW, carried as a hypothesis.** `C(Λ)` is a finitely generated `Λ`-module for `Λ`
Noetherian, and `C(Λ) = C(F) ⊗_F Λ` compatibly with `T_v` for `Λ` a field with prime subfield
`F`.

The base change is recorded as the existence of a finite family in `C(F)` which is an `F`-basis
of `C(F)` and whose image under `F → Λ` is a `Λ`-basis of `C(Λ)`; that is what
`C(Λ) = C(F) ⊗_F Λ` says. Compatibility with `T_v` is automatic for this rendering, because the
map `C(F) → C(Λ)` is postcomposition with `F → Λ` and `T_v` commutes with postcomposition by a
ring homomorphism (`Stacks.Adeles.heckeOperator_mapCoeffs`). The prime subfield of `Λ` is the
bottom subfield `⊥`.

The subject of both clauses is `Stacks.Adeles.cuspFormsCentralChar`. The source defines `C(Λ)`
by the condition `U_v f = φ_v⁻¹ f` without ever defining `φ_v`; that definition reads `φ_v` as
`q_v`, the reading forced by the normalization `u_v = q_v⁻¹` for representations into `SL₂`,
and clears the inverse. See its docstring in `StacksFrontier.NumberTheory.Adeles.HeckeEigenform`.

Clause (1) is stated here for every Noetherian `Λ`. The source's section fixes `Λ` to be a ring
in which `p` is invertible and defines `C(Λ)` only for such `Λ`, so for a Noetherian `Λ` in
which some `q_v` is not invertible — `Λ = ℤ`, say — the cleared condition `q_v · U_v f = f` is
not the source's `U_v f = φ_v⁻¹ f` and the proposition asserts nothing. The field `fg` is
therefore stronger than the source's clause (1), and the attribute records this. Because the
bundle is consumed whole, anything discharging it owes the stronger statement.

The Stacks source proves this by citing de Jong, so it cannot be discharged here: this
declaration is the formal statement of the proposition, which the results below take as a
hypothesis. Its two fields are the proposition's two clauses. See the implementation notes of
`StacksFrontier.NumberTheory.Adeles.SwitchingEll`.
declarations.statement: public structure CuspFormsFinite (K : Type u) [Field K] : Prop
declarations.comment:
clauses (1) and (2) both stated; (1) is stated for every Noetherian Λ, dropping
the standing hypothesis that p is invertible in Λ, so it is stronger than the source's (1)

declarations.name: Stacks.Adeles.IsEigenform.isAlgebraic_heckeEigenvalue
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03VX.** Algebraicity of eigenvalues: if `Λ` is a field then the
eigenvalues `t_v` of an eigenform `f ∈ C(Λ)` are algebraic over the prime subfield `F ⊂ Λ`,
the subfield `⊥`, which is `𝔽_p` or `ℚ` according to the characteristic of `Λ`.

Proposition 03VW is carried as the hypothesis `hVW`, and `hdata` is the data of the source's
formula for `T_v` at `v`, without which the eigenvalue equation is vacuous; see the
implementation notes of `StacksFrontier.NumberTheory.Adeles.AlgebraicEigenvalues`.
declarations.comment: conditional on cited 03VW, carried as a hypothesis; assumes T_v has data at v, without which the eigenvalue equation is vacuous

declarations.name: Stacks.Adeles.GlobalFunctionField.isAlgebraic_eigenvalues_of_isEigenform
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03VX.** Algebraicity of eigenvalues. Let `k` be a finite field of
characteristic `p`, `K` a function field over `k` (for instance `K = k(X)` for a geometrically
irreducible smooth projective curve `X` over `k`), and `Λ` a field in which `p` is invertible,
with prime subfield `F ⊂ Λ` (the bottom subfield `⊥`). If `f ∈ C(Λ)` is an eigenform, with
`T_v f = t_v f` and `U_v f = u_v f` at every place `v`, then the eigenvalues `t_v` are algebraic
over `F`; so are the `u_v`, which equal `q_v⁻¹ ∈ F`.

`C(Λ)` is `Stacks.Adeles.cuspFormsCentralChar` and an eigenform is `Stacks.Adeles.IsEigenform`
(an unramified cusp form with a unit value, Tag 03VS). The proof uses Proposition 03VW,
`Stacks.Adeles.GlobalFunctionField.cuspFormsCentralChar_fg_and_baseChange`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isAlgebraic_eigenvalues_of_isEigenform (hp : IsUnit (ringChar k : Λ))
    {f : GL (Fin 2) (AdeleRing K) → Λ} {t u : Place K → Λ} (hf : IsEigenform f t u)
    (hfC : f ∈ cuspFormsCentralChar K Λ) (v : Place K) :
    IsAlgebraic ↥(⊥ : Subfield Λ) (t v) ∧ IsAlgebraic ↥(⊥ : Subfield Λ) (u v)

declarations.name: Stacks.TraceFormula.finite_geometricMonodromy_of_two_mul_lt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03W0.** *The Conjecture holds if `ℓ > 2n` modulo some unproven
things.* For a smooth, projective, geometrically irreducible curve over a finite field of
characteristic `p` and a prime `ℓ ≠ p` with `2n < ℓ`, every continuous representation of the
étale fundamental group of rank `n` over `F_ℓ[[t]]` has finite geometric monodromy.

The theorem is Gaitsgory's, it is not proved here, and the source states it as conditional.
The unproven things it is conditional on are hypotheses: `formalism`, the constructible
`F_ℓ((t))`-sheaf theory of §1.4, and `satake`, the extended geometric Satake equivalence of
§1.6 and Theorem 2.2 for that formalism. Granted those two, Gaitsgory's conclusion is the
hypothesis `hGaitsgory`, whose remaining antecedents are the hypotheses his theorem imposes —
the curve is projective, `ℓ` differs from the characteristic, and `2n < ℓ` — and whose
consequent is that the representation becomes trivial on an open subgroup of the geometric
fundamental group. What is proved is that this yields the Conjecture's conclusion for the
geometric monodromy group.
declarations.statement:
theorem finite_geometricMonodromy_of_two_mul_lt [Finite k] [IsAlgClosed K] [Smooth f]
    (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (x : GeometricPoint (geometricBaseChange k K f))
    [∀ Y, Finite ((finiteEtaleFiberFunctor x).obj Y)]
    (ρ : EtaleFundamentalGroup X (x.map (geometricProjection k K f)) →ₜ*
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) (PowerSeries (ZMod ℓ)))
    (hproj : IsProjective f) (hℓp : ℓ ≠ p) (hn : 2 * n < ℓ)
    (formalism : FSheafFormalism k ℓ)
    (satake : ExtendedGeometricSatake k ℓ formalism)
    (hGaitsgory : ∀ F : FSheafFormalism k ℓ, ExtendedGeometricSatake k ℓ F →
      IsProjective f → ℓ ≠ p → 2 * n < ℓ → IsTrivialOnOpenSubgroup k K f x ρ) :
    Finite (geometricMonodromy k K f x ρ)
declarations.comment: Gaitsgory's range 2n < ℓ of the Conjecture; the F-sheaf formalism of §1.4 and the extended geometric Satake equivalence of §1.6 and Theorem 2.2 are hypotheses, as is his conclusion that the representation is then trivial on an open subgroup of the geometric fundamental group, and what is proved is that this makes the geometric monodromy group finite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.finite_of_isUniversalFixedDeterminantDeformation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03W1 (finiteness).** Let `X` be a smooth, geometrically irreducible,
projective curve over a finite field `k` of characteristic `p`, let `ℓ ≠ p` be a prime, and let
`ρ₀ : π₁(X) → GLₙ(ZMod ℓ)` be a continuous representation of its étale fundamental group. Assume
that de Jong's conjecture holds for `X`, that the restriction of `ρ₀` to the geometric
fundamental group is absolutely irreducible, and that `ℓ` does not divide `n`. Then the universal
deformation ring of `ρ₀` with determinant fixed to a continuous character `δ` lifting `det ρ₀` is
finite over `ℤ_[ℓ]`.

The step of de Jong's cited argument in which the conjecture is used, namely that the special
fibre `R/ℓR` of the deformation ring is finite, is carried as the hypothesis
`hspecialFibre`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finite_of_isUniversalFixedDeterminantDeformation
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Finite k] [Field K] [Algebra k K] [IsAlgClosed K]
    (p ℓ n : ℕ) [CharP k p] [Fact ℓ.Prime] (_hℓp : ℓ ≠ p) (_hn : ¬ ℓ ∣ n)
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsCurve k f] [Smooth f] [IsProper f] [GeometricallyIrreducible f] [ConnectedSpace X]
    (X' : Scheme.{u}) (q : X' ⟶ X) (fK : X' ⟶ Spec (.of K))
    (hbc : IsPullback q fK f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))
    [ConnectedSpace X'] (x : GeometricPoint X')
    (ρ₀ : EtaleFundamentalGroup X (x.map q) →ₜ* Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) (ZMod ℓ))
    (δ : EtaleFundamentalGroup X (x.map q) →ₜ* ℤ_[ℓ]ˣ)
    (_hconj : DeJongConjectureHolds.{u, w} k K ℓ n X f X' q fK hbc x)
    (_hirred : Deformation.IsAbsolutelyIrreducible
      fun g : EtaleFundamentalGroup X' x => ρ₀ (etaleFundamentalGroupMap q x g))
    (R : Type v) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [TopologicalSpace R] [Algebra ℤ_[ℓ] R]
    (reduce : R →+* ZMod ℓ)
    (ρuniv : EtaleFundamentalGroup X (x.map q) →ₜ* Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) R)
    (hR : Deformation.IsUniversalFixedDeterminantDeformation ℓ n _ ρ₀ δ R reduce ρuniv)
    (hspecialFibre :
      Finite (R ⧸ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ℤ_[ℓ] • (⊤ : Submodule ℤ_[ℓ] R)))) :
    Module.Finite ℤ_[ℓ] R
declarations.comment: fixed-determinant finiteness; the step of the cited argument in which the conjecture is used, that the special fibre R/lR of the universal deformation ring is finite, is carried as the hypothesis hspecialFibre

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.flat_of_isUniversalFixedDeterminantDeformation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03W1 (flatness).** Under the same hypotheses, the universal
fixed-determinant deformation ring of `ρ₀` is flat over `ℤ_[ℓ]`.

The step of de Jong's cited argument in which the conjecture is used, namely that `ℓ` is a
nonzerodivisor on the deformation ring, is carried as the hypothesis `hregular`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem flat_of_isUniversalFixedDeterminantDeformation
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Finite k] [Field K] [Algebra k K] [IsAlgClosed K]
    (p ℓ n : ℕ) [CharP k p] [Fact ℓ.Prime] (_hℓp : ℓ ≠ p) (_hn : ¬ ℓ ∣ n)
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsCurve k f] [Smooth f] [IsProper f] [GeometricallyIrreducible f] [ConnectedSpace X]
    (X' : Scheme.{u}) (q : X' ⟶ X) (fK : X' ⟶ Spec (.of K))
    (hbc : IsPullback q fK f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))
    [ConnectedSpace X'] (x : GeometricPoint X')
    (ρ₀ : EtaleFundamentalGroup X (x.map q) →ₜ* Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) (ZMod ℓ))
    (δ : EtaleFundamentalGroup X (x.map q) →ₜ* ℤ_[ℓ]ˣ)
    (_hconj : DeJongConjectureHolds.{u, w} k K ℓ n X f X' q fK hbc x)
    (_hirred : Deformation.IsAbsolutelyIrreducible
      fun g : EtaleFundamentalGroup X' x => ρ₀ (etaleFundamentalGroupMap q x g))
    (R : Type v) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [TopologicalSpace R] [Algebra ℤ_[ℓ] R]
    (reduce : R →+* ZMod ℓ)
    (ρuniv : EtaleFundamentalGroup X (x.map q) →ₜ* Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) R)
    (hR : Deformation.IsUniversalFixedDeterminantDeformation ℓ n _ ρ₀ δ R reduce ρuniv)
    (hregular : algebraMap ℤ_[ℓ] R (ℓ : ℤ_[ℓ]) ∈ nonZeroDivisors R) :
    Module.Flat ℤ_[ℓ] R
declarations.comment: fixed-determinant flatness; the step of the cited argument in which the conjecture is used, that l is a nonzerodivisor on the universal deformation ring, is carried as the hypothesis hregular

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.finite_flat_of_isUniversalFixedDeterminantDeformation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03W1.** Let `X` be a smooth, geometrically irreducible, proper curve
over a finite field `k` of characteristic `p`, `k̄` an algebraic closure of `k`, `x` a geometric
point of `X_k̄`, `ℓ ≠ p` a prime and `ρ₀ : π₁(X) → GLₙ(𝐅_ℓ)` continuous. Assume de Jong's
conjecture for `X` (in every rank `m`, every continuous `ρ : π₁(X) → GL_m(𝐅_ℓ[[t]])` has finite
image on `π₁(X_k̄)`), that `ρ₀|_{π₁(X_k̄)}` is absolutely irreducible and that `ℓ ∤ n`. Then for
every continuous character `δ : π₁(X) → ℤ_ℓ^*`, the universal deformation ring `R` of `ρ₀` with
determinant fixed to `δ` (`δ` lifts `det ρ₀`, a field of the universal property) is finite and
flat over `ℤ_ℓ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem finite_flat_of_isUniversalFixedDeterminantDeformation
    (k kbar : Type u) [Field k] [Finite k] [Field kbar] [Algebra k kbar] [IsAlgClosure k kbar]
    (p ℓ n : ℕ) [CharP k p] [Fact ℓ.Prime] (hℓp : ℓ ≠ p) (hn : ¬ ℓ ∣ n)
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsCurve k f] [Smooth f] [IsProper f] [GeometricallyIrreducible f] :
    letI : ConnectedSpace X :=
      haveI : IsIntegral X := (inferInstance : IsCurve k f).toIsIntegral
      inferInstance
    letI : ConnectedSpace ↥(pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k kbar)))) :=
      @IrreducibleSpace.connectedSpace _ _
        ((inferInstance : GeometricallyIrreducible f).geometrically_irreducibleSpace
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k kbar))) (pullback.fst _ _) (pullback.snd _ _)
          (IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _))
    ∀ (x : GeometricPoint (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k kbar)))))
      (ρ₀ : EtaleFundamentalGroup X (x.map (pullback.fst f
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k kbar))))) →ₜ*
          Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) (ZMod ℓ))
      (δ : EtaleFundamentalGroup X (x.map (pullback.fst f
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k kbar))))) →ₜ* ℤ_[ℓ]ˣ),
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (ρ : EtaleFundamentalGroup X (x.map (pullback.fst f
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k kbar))))) →ₜ*
          Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin m) (PowerSeries (ZMod ℓ))),
        (Set.range fun g : EtaleFundamentalGroup _ x => ρ (etaleFundamentalGroupMap
          (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k kbar)))) x g)).Finite) →
      (Deformation.IsAbsolutelyIrreducible fun g : EtaleFundamentalGroup _ x =>
        ρ₀ (etaleFundamentalGroupMap (pullback.fst f
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k kbar)))) x g)) →
      ∀ (R : Type v) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [TopologicalSpace R] [Algebra ℤ_[ℓ] R]
        (reduce : R →+* ZMod ℓ)
        (ρuniv : EtaleFundamentalGroup X (x.map (pullback.fst f
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k kbar))))) →ₜ*
            Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) R),
        Deformation.IsUniversalFixedDeterminantDeformation ℓ n _ ρ₀ δ R reduce ρuniv →
        Module.Finite ℤ_[ℓ] R ∧ Module.Flat ℤ_[ℓ] R

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finite_closedPoints_frobeniusElements_topologicalClosure_eq_top
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03W5.** For a smooth, geometrically irreducible, proper curve over a
finite field there is a finite set of closed points such that the set of **all** Frobenius elements
at these points topologically generates the étale fundamental group.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_finite_closedPoints_frobeniusElements_topologicalClosure_eq_top (k : Type u)
    [Field k] [Finite k] {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve k f] [Smooth f]
    [IsProper f] [GeometricallyIrreducible f] (base : GeometricPoint X) :
    letI := FrobeniusSplitting.connectedSpace_of_isCurve f
    ∃ S : Set (closedPoints X), S.Finite ∧
      (Subgroup.closure (frobeniusElements base S)).topologicalClosure = ⊤

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isZariskiLocallyQuasiSeparatedOver_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03W7.** For an algebraic space over a scheme `S`, Zariski local
quasi-separatedness over `S`, absolute Zariski local quasi-separatedness, and the existence of
a Zariski covering by open subspaces carrying quasi-compact surjective étale atlases by affine
schemes — with or without the requirement that those affine schemes map into affine opens of
`S` — are equivalent.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZariskiLocallyQuasiSeparatedOver_tfae
    (hZ : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u})) (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) :
    List.TFAE
      [IsZariskiLocallyQuasiSeparatedOver B S hS X,
        IsAbsolutelyZariskiLocallyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ X,
        HasAffineQuasiCompactEtaleCover B S hS X,
        HasAffineQuasiCompactEtaleCoverIntoAffineBase B S hS X]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAffineHom_tfae_of_isAlgebraicSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03WG.** For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over `S` the following are
equivalent: `f` is representable and affine as a morphism of presheaves; `f` is affine in the
sense of Stacks 03WF; for every affine object of the site étale over `Y` the base change of `f`
is represented by an affine object of the site; there is a surjective étale scheme chart of `Y`
along which the base change of `f` is affine; and there is a Zariski covering of `Y` over whose
members the base changes of `f` are affine.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAffineHom_tfae` with its descent hypothesis discharged by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEffectiveDescentAlongSurjectiveEtale_isAffineHom`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAffineHom_tfae_of_isAlgebraicSpace
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) :
    List.TFAE [
      (yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f ∧
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineHom.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf f),
      IsAffineHom B S hS f,
      (∀ (V : BigAffineFppf B S hS)
        (g : yoneda.obj ((BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj V) ⟶ Y),
        IsEtale B S hS g →
          ∃ (W : BigAffineFppf B S hS)
            (p : yoneda.obj ((BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj W) ⟶ X)
            (q : (BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj W ⟶
              (BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj V),
            IsPullback p (yoneda.map q) f g),
      (∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y),
        IsSurjective B S hS g ∧
        IsEtale B S hS g ∧
        IsAffineHom B S hS (pullback.snd f g)),
      (∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → Subfunctor Y),
        IsZariskiCover B S hS I U ∧
        ∀ i, IsAffineHom B S hS (pullback.snd f (U i).ι))]
declarations.comment: items (1) and (2): affine as a representable morphism iff every base change to

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.presheaf_isAffineHom_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03WE.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a representable morphism of algebraic spaces over a
scheme `S`. Then `f` is affine in the sense of Stacks 03HA — every represented base change of
`f` is an affine morphism of schemes — if and only if for every affine object `Z` of the site
and every morphism `yoneda.obj Z ⟶ Y` the fibre product `X ×_Y Z` is represented by an affine
object of the site.

The right-hand side is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsAffineHom`, Stacks 03WF, with its
abbreviation unfolded, so that the quantifier over the test object stands in the statement: it
ranges over *all* morphisms from an affine object of the site, not over the étale ones alone.
That is what separates it from condition (3) of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAffineHom_tfae_of_isAlgebraicSpace`, which is the same condition
restricted to the étale test morphisms.

The equivalence is the one between conditions (1) and (2) of that theorem, whose condition (1)
conjoins representability to the Stacks 03HA condition; representability is the hypothesis `hf`
of the source here, and `MorphismProperty.presheaf` carries it on the left anyway.
declarations.statement:
theorem presheaf_isAffineHom_iff
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hf : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f) :
    (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineHom.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf f ↔
      ∀ (Z : BigAffineFppf B S hS)
        (g : yoneda.obj ((BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj Z) ⟶ Y),
        ∃ (W : BigAffineFppf B S hS)
          (p : yoneda.obj ((BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj W) ⟶ X)
          (q : (BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj W ⟶
            (BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj Z),
          IsPullback p (yoneda.map q) f g

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsAffineHom
declarations.doc:
A morphism of algebraic spaces is affine if each base change to an affine scheme is
represented by an affine scheme.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsAffineHom {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : F ⟶ G) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAffineHom_tfae_of_isAlgebraicSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03WG.** For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over `S` the following are
equivalent: `f` is representable and affine as a morphism of presheaves; `f` is affine in the
sense of Stacks 03WF; for every affine object of the site étale over `Y` the base change of `f`
is represented by an affine object of the site; there is a surjective étale scheme chart of `Y`
along which the base change of `f` is affine; and there is a Zariski covering of `Y` over whose
members the base changes of `f` are affine.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAffineHom_tfae` with its descent hypothesis discharged by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEffectiveDescentAlongSurjectiveEtale_isAffineHom`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAffineHom_tfae_of_isAlgebraicSpace
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) :
    List.TFAE [
      (yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f ∧
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineHom.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf f),
      IsAffineHom B S hS f,
      (∀ (V : BigAffineFppf B S hS)
        (g : yoneda.obj ((BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj V) ⟶ Y),
        IsEtale B S hS g →
          ∃ (W : BigAffineFppf B S hS)
            (p : yoneda.obj ((BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj W) ⟶ X)
            (q : (BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj W ⟶
              (BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj V),
            IsPullback p (yoneda.map q) f g),
      (∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y),
        IsSurjective B S hS g ∧
        IsEtale B S hS g ∧
        IsAffineHom B S hS (pullback.snd f g)),
      (∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → Subfunctor Y),
        IsZariskiCover B S hS I U ∧
        ∀ i, IsAffineHom B S hS (pullback.snd f (U i).ι))]

    IsAffineHom B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsQuasiAffineHom
declarations.doc:
A morphism of algebraic spaces is quasi-affine if each of its base changes to an affine scheme
is represented by a quasi-affine scheme.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsQuasiAffineHom (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiAffineHom_tfae_etaleChart_of_isAlgebraicSpace
declarations.doc:
For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S` the following four conditions
are equivalent: `f` is relatively representable and all of its represented base changes are
quasi-affine morphisms of schemes; `f` is quasi-affine in the sense of Stacks 03WL; the base
change of `f` along some surjective étale scheme chart of `Y` is quasi-affine; and there is a
Zariski covering of `Y` over whose members `f` is quasi-affine.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiAffineHom_tfae_etaleChart_of_isAlgebraicSpace
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    List.TFAE [
      (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsQuasiAffineHom.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) f,
      IsQuasiAffineHom B S hS f,
      (∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y),
        (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) g ∧
        (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) g ∧
        IsQuasiAffineHom B S hS (pullback.fst g f)),
      (∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → Subfunctor Y),
        IsZariskiCover B S hS I U ∧
        ∀ i, IsQuasiAffineHom B S hS (pullback.fst (U i).ι f))
    ]

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Functor.IsFiberedInGroupoids.existsUnique_vertical_factorisation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03WP.**
The two-step lift `ψ ∘ φ : z ⟶ x` of `g ∘ f` factors through the direct lift `γ : z' ⟶ x` by a
unique morphism `χ : z ⟶ z'` of the fibre over `W`, i.e. a unique `χ` lying over `id_W`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_vertical_factorisation :
    ∃! χ : z ⟶ z', p.IsHomLift (𝟙 W) χ ∧ χ ≫ γ = ψ ≫ φ

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Functor.IsFiberedInGroupoids.twoStepLiftIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03WP.**
The comparison isomorphism `z ≅ z'` between the domain of the two-step lift of `g ∘ f` and the
domain of a direct lift of `g ∘ f`. Both lifts are cartesian, so this is the canonical
isomorphism between the domains of two cartesian lifts of one morphism of the base.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def twoStepLiftIso : z ≅ z'

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Functor.IsFiberedInGroupoids.isIso_of_vertical_comp_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03WP.**
Every morphism `χ : z ⟶ z'` of the fibre over `W` filling the diagram is an isomorphism: by
uniqueness it is the comparison isomorphism `CategoryTheory.Functor.twoStepLiftIso`.
declarations.statement:
lemma isIso_of_vertical_comp_eq (χ : z ⟶ z') [p.IsHomLift (𝟙 W) χ] (hχ : χ ≫ γ = ψ ≫ φ) :
    IsIso χ

declarations.name: stronglyCartesianOver_isMultiplicative
declarations.doc:
**Stacks tag 03WQ** (auxiliary multiplicativity).
The morphism property `stronglyCartesianOver p` (strongly cartesian morphisms over
their image) contains identities and is closed under composition — this is the
content of the first sentence of the Stacks proof, namely that the subcategory
`𝒮'` of strongly cartesian morphisms is well-defined as a subcategory.
declarations.statement:
theorem stronglyCartesianOver_isMultiplicative
    {𝒞 : Type*} [Category 𝒞] {𝒮 : Type*} [Category 𝒮]
    (p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒞) [p.IsFibered] :
    (stronglyCartesianOver p).IsMultiplicative

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.etale_boundsFiberDegrees_tfae
declarations.doc:
For an étale morphism, bounding fibre degrees, bounding the points of every field-valued base
change, and bounding the points after passage to separable closures of residue fields are
equivalent.
declarations.statement:
theorem etale_boundsFiberDegrees_tfae {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [Etale f] (n : ℕ) :
    List.TFAE [
      BoundsFiberDegrees f (n : ℤ),
      ∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] (g : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Y),
        Cardinal.mk (pullback g f : Scheme.{u}) ≤ n,
      ∀ (y : Y) (ksep : Type u) [Field ksep] [Algebra (Y.residueField y) ksep]
        [IsSepClosure (Y.residueField y) ksep],
        Cardinal.mk
          (pullback
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Y.residueField y) ksep)))
            (f.fiberToSpecResidueField y) : Scheme.{u}) ≤ n]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidScheme.exists_finite_openClosed_restriction
declarations.doc:
The finite open-and-closed subgroupoid around a quasi-finite point can be chosen as the
full restriction when the relation morphism is universally closed.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_finite_openClosed_restriction
    {S : Scheme.{u}} (G : Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme S) (p : S)
    (u : G.objects.left) (hu : G.objects.hom u = p)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType G.objects.hom]
    (hqu : AlgebraicGeometry.quasiFiniteAt G.objects.hom u)
    [IsSeparated G.objects.hom] [IsSeparated G.arrows.hom]
    [Flat G.source.left] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation G.source.left]
    [Flat G.target.left] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation G.target.left]
    (hfinite : Set.Finite (G.source.left ⁻¹' {u}))
    [UniversallyClosed (prod.lift G.target G.source).left] :
    ∃ (N : AlgebraicGeometry.EtaleNeighborhood S p), N.IsElementary ∧
      ∃ (H : Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme N.scheme) (W W' : Scheme.{u})
        (jU : H.objects.left ⟶ pullback G.objects.hom N.toBase)
        (jW : W ⟶ pullback G.objects.hom N.toBase)
        (jR : H.arrows.left ⟶ pullback G.arrows.hom N.toBase)
        (jW' : W' ⟶ pullback G.arrows.hom N.toBase),
        IsOpenImmersion jU ∧ IsClosedImmersion jU ∧
        IsOpenImmersion jW ∧ IsClosedImmersion jW ∧
        IsIso (coprod.desc jU jW) ∧
        IsOpenImmersion jR ∧ IsClosedImmersion jR ∧
        IsOpenImmersion jW' ∧ IsClosedImmersion jW' ∧
        IsIso (coprod.desc jR jW') ∧
        H.objects.hom = jU ≫ pullback.snd G.objects.hom N.toBase ∧
        H.arrows.hom = jR ≫ pullback.snd G.arrows.hom N.toBase ∧
        (∃ u' : H.objects.left,
          (jU ≫ pullback.fst G.objects.hom N.toBase) u' = u ∧
          jU '' {x : H.objects.left | H.objects.hom x = N.point} =
            (pullback.map G.arrows.hom N.toBase G.objects.hom N.toBase
              G.target.left (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (by simp) (by simp)) ''
              ((pullback.map G.arrows.hom N.toBase G.objects.hom N.toBase
                G.source.left (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (by simp) (by simp)) ⁻¹' {jU u'}) ∧
          jR '' {r : H.arrows.left | H.arrows.hom r = N.point} =
            (pullback.map G.arrows.hom N.toBase G.objects.hom N.toBase
              G.source.left (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (by simp) (by simp)) ⁻¹'
                (jU '' {x : H.objects.left | H.objects.hom x = N.point})) ∧
        IsFinite H.objects.hom ∧ IsFinite H.arrows.hom ∧
        H.source.left ≫ jU ≫ pullback.fst G.objects.hom N.toBase =
          jR ≫ pullback.fst G.arrows.hom N.toBase ≫ G.source.left ∧
        H.target.left ≫ jU ≫ pullback.fst G.objects.hom N.toBase =
          jR ≫ pullback.fst G.arrows.hom N.toBase ≫ G.target.left ∧
        (∃ k : (pullback H.source H.target).left ⟶
            (pullback G.source G.target).left,
          k ≫ (pullback.fst G.source G.target).left =
              (pullback.fst H.source H.target).left ≫ jR ≫
                pullback.fst G.arrows.hom N.toBase ∧
          k ≫ (pullback.snd G.source G.target).left =
              (pullback.snd H.source H.target).left ≫ jR ≫
                pullback.fst G.arrows.hom N.toBase ∧
          H.comp.left ≫ jR ≫ pullback.fst G.arrows.hom N.toBase =
            k ≫ G.comp.left) ∧
        (∀ (T : Scheme.{u})
          (f : T ⟶ pullback G.arrows.hom N.toBase)
          (x y : T ⟶ H.objects.left),
          (f ≫ pullback.map G.arrows.hom N.toBase G.objects.hom N.toBase
              G.source.left (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (by simp) (by simp) = x ≫ jU) →
          (f ≫ pullback.map G.arrows.hom N.toBase G.objects.hom N.toBase
              G.target.left (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (by simp) (by simp) = y ≫ jU) →
          (∃! g : T ⟶ H.arrows.left,
            g ≫ jR = f ∧ g ≫ H.source.left = x ∧ g ≫ H.target.left = y))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.coveringMorphismProperty
declarations.doc: The property required of morphisms in a covering family for the selected topology.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev coveringMorphismProperty (τ : CoveringTopology) :
    MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsStandardCovering
declarations.doc:
A finite family of affine schemes covering an affine target, with morphisms of the standard
form appropriate to the chosen topology.
declarations.statement:
public structure IsStandardCovering (τ : CoveringTopology) {T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine T]
    {I : Type v} (U : I → Scheme.{u}) (f : ∀ i, U i ⟶ T) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_standardCovering_refinement
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03XA.** A covering of an affine scheme in one of the five standard
topologies can be refined by a standard covering in that topology.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_standardCovering_refinement (τ : CoveringTopology)
    {T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine T] (U : PreZeroHypercover.{v} T)
    (hU : U.presieve₀ ∈ Scheme.precoverage (coveringMorphismProperty τ) T) :
    ∃ (V : PreZeroHypercover.{v} T) (_ : V.Hom U), IsStandardCovering τ V.X V.f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.presheaf_universallyClosed_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XD.** A representable morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is universally
closed in the sense of Stacks 03HI exactly when each of its represented base changes is a
universally closed morphism of schemes.
declarations.statement:
theorem presheaf_universallyClosed_iff
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (hf : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f) :
    (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
      (@AlgebraicGeometry.UniversallyClosed.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf f ↔ UniversallyClosed B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsLocallyOfFiniteType
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XF, part (1).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *locally of
finite type* when every commuting square of étale scheme charts induces a scheme morphism
which is locally of finite type.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsLocallyOfFiniteType (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFiniteType
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XF, part (3).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *of finite type*
when it is locally of finite type and quasi-compact.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsFiniteType (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFiniteTypeAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XF, part (2).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *of finite type at*
a point `x` of its source when some open subspace of the source containing `x` is locally of
finite type over the target.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsFiniteTypeAt (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : points B S hS X) : Prop
declarations.comment: part (2): finite type at a point

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyOfFiniteType_comp'
declarations.doc:
The composite `f ≫ g` of two morphisms locally of finite type is locally of finite type, as
soon as the intermediate and final presheaves `G` and `H` are algebraic spaces over `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFiniteType_comp' (f : F ⟶ G) (g : G ⟶ H)
    (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G) (hH : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS H)
    (hf : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f) (hg : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS g) :
    IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyOfFiniteType_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XG**, the case of being locally of finite type: the composite of two morphisms of
algebraic spaces over `S` which are locally of finite type is locally of finite type.

Being locally of finite type is étale local on the source and target (Stacks 04R3) and stable
under composition (Stacks 01T3), so this is an instance of Stacks 0AML.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFiniteType_comp
    {F G H : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G)
    (hH : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS H)
    (f : F ⟶ G) (g : G ⟶ H)
    (hf : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f)
    (hg : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS g) :
    IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteType_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XG, finite type.** The composite of two morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S`
which are of finite type is of finite type: it is locally of finite type by Stacks 03XG and
quasi-compact by Stacks 03HG.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteType_comp (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : IsFiniteType B S hS f) (hg : IsFiniteType B S hS g) :
    IsFiniteType B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteType_comp'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XG, finite type.** The composite of two morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S`
which are of finite type is of finite type.

Algebraicity of the source is not needed and is not assumed, which is what distinguishes this
from `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteType_comp`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteType_comp' (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z)
    (hf : IsFiniteType B S hS f) (hg : IsFiniteType B S hS g) :
    IsFiniteType B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyOfFiniteType_isStableUnderBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XH**, the case of being locally of finite type: being locally of finite type is
stable under base change.

Being locally of finite type is étale local on the source and target (Stacks 04R3) and stable
under base change (Stacks 01T4), so this is an instance of Stacks 0AMM.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFiniteType_isStableUnderBaseChange :
    MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange
      (fun ⦃F G : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS⦄ (f : F ⟶ G) =>
        IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f.hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteType_isStableUnderBaseChange
declarations.doc:
Being of finite type is stable under base change for morphisms of algebraic spaces over
`S`.
declarations.statement:
instance isFiniteType_isStableUnderBaseChange :
    MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange
      (fun ⦃F G : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS⦄ (f : F ⟶ G) => IsFiniteType B S hS f.hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsLocallyOfFiniteType.of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
The base change of a morphism of algebraic spaces over
`S` which is locally of finite type along an arbitrary morphism of algebraic spaces is
locally of finite type.

The square is the one with `p` over `f`, so `p : W ⟶ Z` is the base change of
`f : X ⟶ Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsLocallyOfFiniteType.of_isPullback
    {W X Z Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    {p : W ⟶ Z} {q : W ⟶ X} {g : Z ⟶ Y} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (sq : IsPullback p q g f)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hf : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f) :
    IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS p

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFiniteType.of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
The base change of a morphism of algebraic spaces over
`S` which is of finite type along an arbitrary morphism of algebraic spaces is of finite
type.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsFiniteType.of_isPullback
    {W X Z Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    {p : W ⟶ Z} {q : W ⟶ X} {g : Z ⟶ Y} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (sq : IsPullback p q g f)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hf : IsFiniteType B S hS f) :
    IsFiniteType B S hS p

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsLocallyQuasiFinite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XJ, part (1).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *locally
quasi-finite* when every commuting square of étale scheme charts induces a scheme morphism
which is locally of finite type and locally quasi-finite.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsLocallyQuasiFinite (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsQuasiFinite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XJ, part (3).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *quasi-finite*
when it is locally quasi-finite and quasi-compact.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsQuasiFinite (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsQuasiFiniteAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XJ, part (2).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *quasi-finite at*
a point `x` of its source when some open subspace of the source containing `x` is locally
quasi-finite over the target.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsQuasiFiniteAt (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : points B S hS X) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyQuasiFinite_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XK**, the locally quasi-finite case: the composite of two locally quasi-finite
morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is locally quasi-finite.

Local quasi-finiteness of morphisms of schemes is étale local on the source and target
(**Stacks 04R3**) and stable under composition, each conjunct being, so this is an instance of
**Stacks 0AML**.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyQuasiFinite_comp {F G H : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G)
    (hH : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS H) (f : F ⟶ G) (g : G ⟶ H)
    (hf : IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS f) (hg : IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS g) :
    IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiFinite_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XK**, the quasi-finite case: the composite of two quasi-finite morphisms of
algebraic spaces over `S` is quasi-finite.

Quasi-finiteness is local quasi-finiteness together with quasi-compactness, and the latter is
stable under composition by **Stacks 03HG**.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiFinite_comp {F G H : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G)
    (hH : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS H) (f : F ⟶ G) (g : G ⟶ H)
    (hf : IsQuasiFinite B S hS f) (hg : IsQuasiFinite B S hS g) :
    IsQuasiFinite B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsLocallyQuasiFinite.of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
The base change of a locally quasi-finite morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` along an
arbitrary morphism of algebraic spaces is locally quasi-finite.

The square is the one with `p` over `f`, so `p : W ⟶ Z` is the base change of
`f : X ⟶ Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsLocallyQuasiFinite.of_isPullback
    {W X Z Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    {p : W ⟶ Z} {q : W ⟶ X} {g : Z ⟶ Y} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (sq : IsPullback p q g f)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hf : IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS f) :
    IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS p

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsQuasiFinite.of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
The base change of a quasi-finite morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` along an arbitrary
morphism of algebraic spaces is quasi-finite.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsQuasiFinite.of_isPullback
    {W X Z Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    {p : W ⟶ Z} {q : W ⟶ X} {g : Z ⟶ Y} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (sq : IsPullback p q g f)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hf : IsQuasiFinite B S hS f) :
    IsQuasiFinite B S hS p

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyQuasiFinite_isStableUnderBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XL**, the locally quasi-finite case: being locally quasi-finite is stable under
base change.

Local quasi-finiteness of morphisms of schemes is étale local on the source and target
(**Stacks 04R3**) and stable under base change, each conjunct being, so this is an instance of
**Stacks 0AMM**.
declarations.statement:
instance isLocallyQuasiFinite_isStableUnderBaseChange :
    MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange
      (fun ⦃F G : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS⦄ (f : F ⟶ G) =>
        IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS f.hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiFinite_isStableUnderBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XL**, the quasi-finite case: being quasi-finite is stable under base change.

Quasi-finiteness is local quasi-finiteness together with quasi-compactness, and the latter is
stable under base change by **Stacks 03HF**.
declarations.statement:
instance isQuasiFinite_isStableUnderBaseChange :
    MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange
      (fun ⦃F G : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS⦄ (f : F ⟶ G) => IsQuasiFinite B S hS f.hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyQuasiFinite_of_isImmersion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XM.** An immersion of algebraic spaces over `S` is locally quasi-finite.

Neither the source nor the target has to be an algebraic space: the immersion property is a
condition on the represented base changes of the morphism, and so is what the proof uses.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyQuasiFinite_of_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XN.** If a composite of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is locally
quasi-finite, then so is its first factor.

Local quasi-finiteness of morphisms of schemes is étale local on the source and target
(Stacks 04R3) and is inherited by the first factor of a composite that has it, local finite
type by Stacks 01T8 and the fibre condition by `AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyQuasiFinite.of_comp`,
so this is an instance of the cancellation form of Stacks 03MJ.

This is also the locally-quasi-finite clause of part (1) of **Stacks 0AGC**, whose other
clauses are in `StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Spaces/Morphisms/Immersions.lean`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyQuasiFinite_of_comp {F G H : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G)
    (hH : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS H)
    (f : F ⟶ G) (g : G ⟶ H)
    (hfg : IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS (f ≫ g)) :
    IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XP, part (1).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *locally of
finite presentation* when every commuting square of étale scheme charts induces a scheme
morphism which is locally of finite presentation.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFinitePresentationAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XP, part (2).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *of finite
presentation at* a point `x` of its source when it is locally of finite presentation on an
open subspace of the source containing `x`.

Ten predicates of this library share this signature, among them
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFiniteTypeAt` and `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsSmoothAt`: each applies
the same "holds on an open subspace through `x`" schema to a different property of morphisms of
schemes, and each is a different part of a different tag of the source. The shape is shared, the
content is not.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsFinitePresentationAt (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : points B S hS X) : Prop
declarations.comment: part (2): finite presentation at a point

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFinitePresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XP, part (3).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *of finite
presentation* when it is locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and
quasi-separated.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsFinitePresentation (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XQ**, the case of being locally of finite presentation: the composite of two
morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` which are locally of finite presentation is locally of
finite presentation.

Being locally of finite presentation is étale local on the source and target (Stacks 04R3) and
stable under composition (Stacks 01TR), so this is an instance of Stacks 0AML.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_comp
    {F G H : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G)
    (hH : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS H)
    (f : F ⟶ G) (g : G ⟶ H)
    (hf : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f)
    (hg : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS g) :
    IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFinitePresentation_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XQ**, the case of being of finite presentation: the composite of two morphisms
of algebraic spaces over `S` which are of finite presentation is of finite presentation.

Finite presentation is local finite presentation together with quasi-compactness and
quasi-separatedness, and each of the three is stable under composition.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_comp
    {F G H : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G)
    (hH : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS H)
    (f : F ⟶ G) (g : G ⟶ H)
    (hf : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f)
    (hg : IsFinitePresentation B S hS g) :
    IsFinitePresentation B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_isStableUnderBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XR**, the case of being locally of finite presentation: that property of
morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is stable under base change.

Being locally of finite presentation is étale local on the source and target (Stacks 04R3) and
stable under base change, so this is the instance of Stacks 0AMM at that property.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_isStableUnderBaseChange
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S) :
    MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange
      (fun ⦃F G : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS⦄ (f : F ⟶ G) =>
        IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFinitePresentation_isStableUnderBaseChange
declarations.doc:
Being of finite presentation is a property of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` that is
stable under base change.
declarations.statement:
instance isFinitePresentation_isStableUnderBaseChange :
    MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange
      (fun ⦃F G : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS⦄ (f : F ⟶ G) => IsFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEtale_local_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XT.** Nine equivalent criteria for a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces
over `S` to be étale: `f` is étale; `f` is étale at every point of `|X|`; the base change of
`f` to every scheme is étale; the base change of `f` to every affine scheme is étale; the base
change of `f` to one surjective étale scheme chart of `Y` is étale; the composite of `f` with
one surjective étale scheme chart of `X` is étale; in every commuting square of étale scheme
charts of `f` the morphism of schemes between the charts is étale; there is one such square
with surjective chart of the source; and there are Zariski coverings `Y = ⋃ Yᵢ` and
`f⁻¹(Yᵢ) = ⋃ Xᵢⱼ` with every `Xᵢⱼ ⟶ Yᵢ` étale.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtale_local_tfae
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    List.TFAE [
      IsEtale B S hS f,
      ∀ x : points B S hS X, IsEtaleAt B S hS f x,
      ∀ (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ Y),
        IsEtale B S hS (pullback.snd f g),
      ∀ (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ Y),
        IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Z) →
          IsEtale B S hS (pullback.snd f g),
      ∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y),
        IsSurjective B S hS g ∧ IsEtale B S hS g ∧ IsEtale B S hS (pullback.snd f g),
      ∃ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (p : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X),
        IsSurjective B S hS p ∧ IsEtale B S hS p ∧ IsEtale B S hS (p ≫ f),
      ∀ (U V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (p : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X) (q : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y) (a : U ⟶ V),
        IsEtale B S hS p → IsEtale B S hS q → p ≫ f = yoneda.map a ≫ q →
          AlgebraicGeometry.Etale ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map a),
      ∃ (U V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (p : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X) (q : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y) (a : U ⟶ V),
        IsEtale B S hS p ∧ IsEtale B S hS q ∧ IsSurjective B S hS p ∧
          p ≫ f = yoneda.map a ≫ q ∧
            AlgebraicGeometry.Etale ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map a),
      ∃ (I : Type u) (Yopen : I → Subfunctor Y) (J : I → Type u)
        (Xopen : ∀ i, J i → Subfunctor (pullback f (Yopen i).ι)),
        IsZariskiCover B S hS I Yopen ∧ (∀ i, IsZariskiCover B S hS (J i) (Xopen i)) ∧
          ∀ i j, IsEtale B S hS ((Xopen i j).ι ≫ pullback.snd f (Yopen i).ι)
    ]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyQuasiFinite_of_isEtale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XU.** An étale morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is locally quasi-finite: an
étale morphism of schemes is locally of finite type and locally quasi-finite (Stacks 03II).

Only the target has to be an algebraic space, where the source requires both.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyQuasiFinite_of_isEtale
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : IsEtale B S hS f) :
    IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isOpenSubspace_isQuasiCompactSpace_isRepresentable_image
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XW.** Let `t : T' ⟶ T` be an étale morphism of affine objects of the big fppf
category over `S`, let `f : X ⟶ yoneda.obj T` be a separated and locally quasi-finite morphism
of algebraic spaces over `S`, and let `V'` be an open subspace of `T' ×_T X` which is
quasi-affine over `T'`. Then the image of `V'` in `X` is a quasi-compact open subspace of `X`
which is representable.

The image is the subspace cut out by the image of the point set of `V'`, whose own point set is
that image by Tag 03BZ. Openness and quasi-compactness are
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isOpenSubspace_isQuasiCompactSpace_image_of_isQuasiAffineHom` and
representability is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRepresentable_image_of_isQuasiAffineHom`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpenSubspace_isQuasiCompactSpace_isRepresentable_image
    {T' T : BigFppfOver B S hS}
    (hT : IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T))
    (hT' : IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T'))
    {t : T' ⟶ T} (ht : Etale ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map t))
    {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    {f : X ⟶ yoneda.obj T} (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS f)
    (hlqf : IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS f)
    (V : Subfunctor (pullback (yoneda.map t) f)) (hV : IsOpenSubspace B S hS V)
    (hVqa : IsQuasiAffineHom B S hS (V.ι ≫ pullback.fst (yoneda.map t) f)) :
    IsOpenSubspace B S hS (openSubspaceOfPoints B S hS X
        (Set.range (pointsMap B S hS V.toFunctor
          (V.ι ≫ pullback.snd (yoneda.map t) f)))) ∧
      IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS (openSubspaceOfPoints B S hS X
        (Set.range (pointsMap B S hS V.toFunctor
          (V.ι ≫ pullback.snd (yoneda.map t) f)))).toFunctor ∧
      (openSubspaceOfPoints B S hS X
        (Set.range (pointsMap B S hS V.toFunctor
          (V.ι ≫ pullback.snd (yoneda.map t) f)))).toFunctor.IsRepresentable

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRepresentable_of_locallyQuasiFinite_separated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XX.** A separated, locally quasi-finite algebraic space over a representable
algebraic space over `S` is representable.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRepresentable_of_locallyQuasiFinite_separated
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (X T : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hT : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS T)
    (f : X ⟶ T)
    (hTrep : T.IsRepresentable)
    (hlqf : IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS f)
    (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS f) :
    X.IsRepresentable

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAlgebraicSpaceULift_pullback_of_isRepresentableULift
declarations.doc:
The fibre product of an algebraic space over `S` with the source of a
morphism representable by algebraic spaces, over the target of that morphism, is an algebraic
space over `S`, for presheaves on the big fppf site of `S` with values in `Type (max w u)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpaceULift_pullback_of_isRepresentableULift
    {F G X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (max w u)} (a : F ⟶ G) (f : X ⟶ G)
    (ha : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpacesULift.{w} B S hS a)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpaceULift.{w} B S hS X) :
    IsAlgebraicSpaceULift.{w} B S hS (pullback f a)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAlgebraicSpace_pullback_of_isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XY.** The fibre product of an algebraic space over `S` with the source of a
morphism representable by algebraic spaces, over the target of that morphism, is an
algebraic space over `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpace_pullback_of_isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces
    {F G X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (a : F ⟶ G) (f : X ⟶ G)
    (ha : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS a)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) :
    IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (pullback f a)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasProperty
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XZ.** A map of presheaves `a : F ⟶ G` on the big fppf site of `S` which is
representable by algebraic spaces *has property `P`* when, for every object `U` of the site
and every `ξ : h_U ⟶ G`, the morphism of algebraic spaces `U ×_G F ⟶ U` has `P`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev HasProperty (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (P : MorphismProperty (AlgebraicSpaces B S hS))
    {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (a : F ⟶ G)
    (ha : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS a) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03Y0.** A cartesian base change of a morphism representable by
algebraic spaces is representable by algebraic spaces.
declarations.statement:
lemma isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_of_isPullback
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {F G G' H : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (p : H ⟶ F) (a' : H ⟶ G') (a : F ⟶ G) (g : G' ⟶ G)
    (h : IsPullback p a' a g)
    (ha : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS a) :
    IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS a'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03Y1.** A composite of morphisms of presheaves on the big fppf site of `S`
representable by algebraic spaces is representable by algebraic spaces.

The base change of `a ≫ b` along `ξ` is the base change of `a` along the second projection
of the base change of `b` along `ξ`, which is an algebraic space by Stacks 03XY.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_comp
    {F G H : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (a : F ⟶ G) (b : G ⟶ H)
    (ha : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS a)
    (hb : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS b) :
    IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS (a ≫ b)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_diag_iff_forall_yoneda
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03Y2, conditions (1) and (2).** The absolute diagonal of a presheaf on the big
fppf site of `S` is representable by algebraic spaces exactly when every morphism to that
presheaf from a scheme over `S` is representable by algebraic spaces.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_diag_iff_forall_yoneda
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) :
    IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS (diag F) ↔
      ∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ F),
        IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.forall_yoneda_isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_iff_isAlgebraicSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03Y2, conditions (2) and (3).** Representability by algebraic spaces of every
morphism to a presheaf on the big fppf site of `S` from a scheme over `S` is equivalent to
representability by algebraic spaces of every morphism to it from an algebraic space over
`S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem forall_yoneda_isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_iff_isAlgebraicSpace
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) :
    (∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ F),
        IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f) ↔
      ∀ (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u), IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X →
        ∀ (f : X ⟶ F), IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAlgebraicSpace_of_isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_surjective_etale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03Y3, conditions (a) and (b).** Let `F` be an fppf sheaf on the big fppf site of
a scheme `S` admitting a morphism `f : X ⟶ F` from an algebraic space over `S` which is
representable by algebraic spaces, surjective and étale. Then `F` is an algebraic space over `S`.

The chart of `F` is the composite of a chart of `X` with `f`, which is representable by
algebraic spaces by **Stacks 03Y1** and therefore by objects of the site; the diagonal is the
only clause of **Stacks 025Y** needing effective fppf descent, which is supplied by
`isEffectiveDescentAlongCoveringSieve_monomorphisms_inf_lft`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpace_of_isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_surjective_etale
    {F X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hF : Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) F)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (f : X ⟶ F)
    (hf : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f)
    (hfSurj : HasProperty B S hS (surjectiveMorphismProperty B S hS) f hf)
    (hfEtale : HasProperty B S hS (etaleMorphisms B S hS) f hf) :
    IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAlgebraicSpace_of_isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_diag
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03Y3, conditions (1), (2) and (3).** Let `F` be an fppf sheaf on the big fppf
site of a scheme `S` whose diagonal is representable by algebraic spaces and which admits a
surjective étale morphism from an algebraic space over `S`. Then `F` is an algebraic space over
`S`.

Condition (2) makes the morphism of condition (3) representable by algebraic spaces by **Stacks
03Y2**, so the hypotheses (a) and (b) hold and the previous theorem applies.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpace_of_isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_diag
    {F X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hF : Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) F)
    (hdiag : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS (diag F))
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (f : X ⟶ F)
    (hfSurj : HasProperty B S hS (surjectiveMorphismProperty B S hS) f
      (isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_of_diagonal B S hS hdiag hX f))
    (hfEtale : HasProperty B S hS (etaleMorphisms B S hS) f
      (isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_of_diagonal B S hS hdiag hX f)) :
    IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFppfCovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03Y8.** A family of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` with common target
is an *fppf covering* when every member is flat and locally of finite presentation and the
family is jointly surjective on points.
declarations.statement:
structure IsFppfCovering {I : Type v} {F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (X : I → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ F) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFppfCovering_fibreProduct
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03Y9.** Pulling an fppf covering of algebraic spaces over `S` back along a
morphism of algebraic spaces gives an fppf covering of the new target: the first projections of
the fibre products of Stacks 02X2 form an fppf covering.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFppfCovering_fibreProduct
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {I : Type v} {X X' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    (Xi : I → AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (f : ∀ i, Xi i ⟶ X) (g : X' ⟶ X)
    (hf : IsFppfCovering B S hS (fun i => (Xi i).1) (fun i => (f i).hom)) :
    IsFppfCovering B S hS
      (fun i => (AlgebraicSpaces.fiberProduct B S hS g (f i)).1)
      (fun i => pullback.fst g.hom (f i).hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFppfCovering_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03Y9.** Composing an fppf covering of an algebraic space over `S` with an fppf
covering of each of its members gives an fppf covering: flatness and being locally of finite
presentation are stable under composition (Stacks 03MN and 03XQ), and a point of the target is
hit by a member of the first covering, hence by a member of the covering of that member.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFppfCovering_comp
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (I : Type v) (J : I → Type w)
    (Xᵢ : I → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (Xᵢⱼ : ∀ i, J i → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (f : ∀ i, Xᵢ i ⟶ X) (g : ∀ i j, Xᵢⱼ i j ⟶ Xᵢ i)
    (hf : IsFppfCovering B S hS Xᵢ f)
    (hg : ∀ i, IsFppfCovering B S hS (Xᵢⱼ i) (g i)) :
    IsFppfCovering B S hS (fun p : Σ i, J i => Xᵢⱼ p.1 p.2)
      (fun p => g p.1 p.2 ≫ f p.1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFppfCovering_of_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03Y9**, the isomorphism clause. An isomorphism of algebraic spaces over `S`,
regarded as a family indexed by a point, is an fppf covering: it is an étale covering by
**Stacks 041F**, hence an fppf covering by **Stacks 0DFC**.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFppfCovering_of_isIso
    (X X' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (f : X' ⟶ X) [IsIso f]
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) :
