    IsFppfCovering B S hS (fun _ : PUnit.{v + 1} => X') (fun _ => f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.Topology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03YH.** The topologies for which locality on the base of a property of morphisms
of algebraic spaces is considered.
declarations.statement: inductive Topology

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.Topology.IsCovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03YH.** A family of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` with common target is
a covering family for the topology `τ` when its source and target presheaves are algebraic
spaces and it satisfies the covering condition of `τ`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev Topology.IsCovering (τ : Topology)
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {I : Type v} {Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (Yi : I → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (g : ∀ i, Yi i ⟶ Y) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.Topology.precoverage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03YH.** The precoverage on the category of algebraic spaces over `S` presented by
the `τ`-covering families. A property `P` of morphisms of algebraic spaces is local on the
base for `τ` exactly when
`CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.IsLocalAtTarget P (τ.precoverage B S hS)`.

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Functor.IsStack.isStackInGroupoids_stronglyCartesianOver
declarations.doc:
**The category fibred in groupoids associated to a stack is a stack in groupoids.** Let
`(𝒞, J)` be a site and let `p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒞` be a stack (Stacks 026F). Let `p' : 𝒮' ⥤ 𝒞` be the category
fibred in groupoids associated to `𝒮` constructed in Stacks 03WQ: the objects of `𝒮'` are those
of `𝒮`, its morphisms are the strongly cartesian morphisms of `𝒮`, and `p'` is the restriction
of `p`. Then
`p'` is a stack in groupoids (Stacks 02ZI): it is fibred in groupoids, its presheaves `Isom(x, y)`
are sheaves, and every descent datum relative to a covering family of `J` is effective.
declarations.statement:
public theorem IsStack.isStackInGroupoids_stronglyCartesianOver
    {p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒞} {J : GrothendieckTopology 𝒞} (hp : p.IsStack J) :
    haveI : p.IsFibered := hp.isFibered
    haveI : (stronglyCartesianOver p).IsMultiplicative :=
      stronglyCartesianOver_isMultiplicative p
    IsStackInGroupoids.{w} (wideSubcategoryInclusion (stronglyCartesianOver p) ⋙ p) J

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_schemePoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks, Section 03YJ.** If the diagonal of a category fibred in groupoids `𝒳` over the
big fppf site of `S` is representable by algebraic spaces, then every 1-morphism
`x : (Sch/U)_fppf → 𝒳` from the category represented by a scheme `U` over `S` is representable
by algebraic spaces. This is condition (3) of Stacks 045G obtained from condition (1).
declarations.statement:
theorem isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_schemePoint
    (𝒳 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, u, u + 1, u + 1} (BigFppfOver B S hS))
    (h𝒳 : HasRepresentableDiagonal B S hS 𝒳) {U : BigFppfOver B S hS}
    (x : schemeFibredCategory B S hS U ⟶ 𝒳) :
    IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS x.hom
declarations.comment: in the situation of Lemma 045G, every 1-morphism x : (Sch/U)_fppf -> X is representable by algebraic spaces, so that saying x has P makes sense

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.SchemePointHasRelativeProperty
declarations.doc:
**Stacks, Section 03YJ.** Let `𝒳` be a category fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site
of `S` whose diagonal is representable by algebraic spaces, and let `𝒫` be a property of
morphisms of algebraic spaces as in Definition 03YK. A 1-morphism `x : (Sch/U)_fppf → 𝒳` from
the category represented by a scheme `U` over `S` *has `𝒫`* when it has `𝒫` in the sense of
Stacks 03YK; it is representable by algebraic spaces by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_schemePoint`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev SchemePointHasRelativeProperty
    (P : MorphismProperty (AlgebraicSpaces B S hS))
    [P.IsStableUnderBaseChange]
    [P.IsLocalAtTarget (Space.Topology.fppf.precoverage B S hS)]
    (𝒳 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, u, u + 1, u + 1} (BigFppfOver B S hS))
    (h𝒳 : HasRepresentableDiagonal B S hS 𝒳) {U : BigFppfOver B S hS}
    (x : schemeFibredCategory B S hS U ⟶ 𝒳) : Prop
declarations.comment: for X as in Lemma 045G and P as in Definition 03YK, the property that a 1-morphism x : (Sch/U)_fppf -> X has P

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.surjective_smooth_etale_relativePropertyHypotheses
declarations.doc:
**Stacks, Section 03YJ.** Surjectivity, smoothness and étaleness of morphisms of algebraic
spaces over `S` are each properties as in Definition 03YK: each is stable under base change and
local on the base for the fppf topology (Stacks 041Q, 0429 and 042B).
declarations.statement:
theorem surjective_smooth_etale_relativePropertyHypotheses :
    ((Space.surjectiveMorphismProperty B S hS).IsStableUnderBaseChange ∧
        (Space.surjectiveMorphismProperty B S hS).IsLocalAtTarget
          (Space.Topology.fppf.precoverage.{u, v} B S hS)) ∧
      ((Space.smoothMorphismProperty B S hS).IsStableUnderBaseChange ∧
        (Space.smoothMorphismProperty B S hS).IsLocalAtTarget
          (Space.Topology.fppf.precoverage.{u, v} B S hS)) ∧
      ((Space.etaleMorphisms B S hS).IsStableUnderBaseChange ∧
        (Space.etaleMorphisms B S hS).IsLocalAtTarget
          (Space.Topology.fppf.precoverage.{u, v} B S hS))
declarations.comment: surjective, smooth and etale are properties as in Definition 03YK

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.HasRelativeProperty
declarations.doc:
A 1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of `S` which is
representable by algebraic spaces *has the property `P`* when every algebraic space representing
its base change along a scheme-valued point of the target has structural morphism with `P`, read
as a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev HasRelativeProperty
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (P : MorphismProperty (AlgebraicSpaces B S hS))
    [P.IsStableUnderBaseChange]
    [P.IsLocalAtTarget (Space.Topology.fppf.precoverage B S hS)]
    {𝒳 𝒴 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, v, u + 1, w} (BigFppfOver B S hS)}
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (_hf : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom) :
    Prop

declarations.name: Stacks.QCoh.projection_isFibered
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03YM, condition (1) of Stacks 026F**: the projection from quasi-coherent modules on
the schemes of the big fppf site over `S` to that site is a fibred category. A cartesian lift of
`f : V ⟶ U` at a module `F` on `U` is the unit `F ⟶ f_* f^* F` of the pullback–pushforward
adjunction, read as an `f`-map.
declarations.comment: condition (1): the functor is a fibred category

declarations.name: Stacks.QCoh.projection_isStack
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03YM.**  The projection `p : 𝒬𝒞oh ⟶ (Sch/S)_fppf` from quasi-coherent modules on the
schemes of the big fppf site over `S` to that site satisfies the three conditions of Stacks 026F:
it is a fibred category, the presheaves `Mor(x, y)` of Stacks 02ZB on each slice of the site are
sheaves, and every descent datum along a covering sieve is effective.

The three conditions are the three fields of `CategoryTheory.Functor.IsStack`.  Condition (1) is
the existence of the cartesian lifts given by the units of the pullback–pushforward adjunction,
and conditions (2) and (3) are Mathlib's stack condition for the pullback pseudofunctor of `p`
(`CategoryTheory.Functor.isStack_pullbackPseudofunctor_iff`), hence the statement that the
comparison from each fibre to the descent data of each fppf covering family is an equivalence.
That comparison is identified with the canonical descent functor of Stacks 023D on schemes
(`canonicalComparisonNatIso`), which is an equivalence by the two halves of Stacks 023T: full
faithfulness `AlgebraicGeometry.nonempty_fullyFaithful_canonicalDescentFunctor'` and effectivity
`AlgebraicGeometry.QuasicoherentDescentData.isEffective_fpqcPrecoverage`, both of which hold for
an arbitrary fpqc covering family, fppf coverings being fpqc coverings.
declarations.statement:
public theorem projection_isStack (B : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) :
    Functor.IsStack (projection (B := B) (S := S) (hS := hS))
      (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.topology B S hS)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.IsDeligneMumfordStack
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03YO.** An algebraic stack over `S` is a *Deligne-Mumford stack* when it admits a
presentation by a scheme which is surjective and étale: a 1-morphism from the category
represented by a scheme `U` over `S`, representable by algebraic spaces, such that every
algebraic space representing its base change along a scheme-valued point of the stack has
surjective and étale structural morphism.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03YP.** The 2-category of algebraic stacks over `S`: the full sub-2-category of the
2-category of categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of `S` whose objects are the
algebraic stacks. Its 1-morphisms and 2-morphisms are those of the ambient 2-category, with no
further condition.
declarations.statement:
abbrev AlgebraicStacks.{u, w}
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isAlgebraicStack_iff_of_equivalence
declarations.doc:
Two categories over the big fppf site of `S` which are equivalent as categories over that
site are algebraic stacks at the same time.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicStack_iff_of_equivalence
    {𝒳 𝒴 : BasedCategory.{v, t} (BigFppfOver B S hS)}
    (e : BasedCategory.Equivalence 𝒳 𝒴) :
    IsAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳 ↔ IsAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒴

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isDeligneMumfordStack_iff_of_equivalence
declarations.doc:
Two categories over the big fppf site of `S` which are equivalent as categories over that
site are Deligne-Mumford stacks at the same time.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDeligneMumfordStack_iff_of_equivalence
    {𝒳 𝒴 : BasedCategory.{u, u + 1} (BigFppfOver B S hS)}
    (e : BasedCategory.Equivalence 𝒳 𝒴) :
    IsDeligneMumfordStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳 ↔ IsDeligneMumfordStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒴

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isAlgebraicStack_iff_of_equivalence'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03YQ, the algebraic-stack assertion.** Two categories over the big fppf site of `S`
which are equivalent as categories over the site are algebraic stacks at the same time.

Stated for categories in the universes `CategoryTheory.BasedCategory.{u, u + 1}`, with both of
them explicit; `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isAlgebraicStack_iff_of_equivalence` is the same
assertion for categories in arbitrary universes.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicStack_iff_of_equivalence'
    (𝒳 𝒴 : BasedCategory.{u, u + 1} (BigFppfOver B S hS))
    (e : BasedCategory.Equivalence 𝒳 𝒴) :
    IsAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳 ↔ IsAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒴

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isAlgebraicStack_of_equivalenceOver
declarations.doc:
A category over the big fppf site of `S` which is equivalent over that site to an algebraic
stack is an algebraic stack, the two categories being allowed independent object and morphism
universes.
declarations.comment: the two categories in independent universes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace_iff_isStackInSetoids
declarations.doc:
An algebraic stack over `S` is representable by an algebraic space if and only if it is a
stack in setoids, that is, objects of its fibre categories have no nontrivial automorphisms.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace_iff_isStackInSetoids
    (halg : IsAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳.val) :
    IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace B S hS 𝒳 ↔
      𝒳.val.p.IsStackInSetoids (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS)
declarations.comment:
the main result: an algebraic stack is an algebraic space exactly when its fibre
  categories are setoids

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isDeligneMumfordStack_of_isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace
registrations.comment: representable by an algebraic space implies Deligne-Mumford

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isDeligneMumfordStack_fibredCategory
registrations.comment: the category associated with an algebraic space is Deligne-Mumford

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isDeligneMumfordStack_fibredCategory
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03YS, part (2).** The category of elements of an algebraic space `F` over `S`, read
as a category fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of `S`, is a Deligne-Mumford stack.

It is an algebraic stack by `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isAlgebraicStack_fibredCategory`, and the
same scheme atlas of `F` presents it étale-ly: the atlas of Stacks 025Y is surjective and étale,
and `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.prop_presentationBasedFunctor` carries both properties to the
induced 1-morphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDeligneMumfordStack_fibredCategory (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) :
    IsDeligneMumfordStack.{u, w} B S hS (fibredCategory B S hS F).val

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isDeligneMumfordStack_of_isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03YS, part (1).** A category fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of `S`
which is representable by an algebraic space over `S` is a Deligne-Mumford stack.

It is an algebraic stack by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isAlgebraicStack_of_isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace`, and the
surjective étale scheme atlas of Stacks 025Y for the representing algebraic space presents it
étale-ly, again by `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.prop_transportedPresentation`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDeligneMumfordStack_of_isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace
    (𝒳 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, u, u + 1, u + 1} (BigFppfOver B S hS))
    (h𝒳 : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace B S hS 𝒳) :
    IsDeligneMumfordStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳.val

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isDeligneMumfordStack_schemeFibredCategory
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03YS, part (3).** The big fppf site of a scheme `X` over `S`, read as a category
fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of `S`, is a Deligne-Mumford stack.

It is an algebraic stack by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isAlgebraicStack_schemeFibredCategory`, and the same identity
1-morphism presents it étale-ly, since the identity of `yoneda.obj X` is surjective and
étale.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDeligneMumfordStack_schemeFibredCategory (X : BigFppfOver B S hS) :
    IsDeligneMumfordStack.{u, w} B S hS (schemeFibredCategory B S hS X).val

declarations.name: main_theorem03YT
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03YT.** For `𝒮₁, …, 𝒮₄` over `𝒞` and equivalences `φ : 𝒮₁ ⟶ 𝒮₂`,
`ψ : 𝒮₃ ⟶ 𝒮₄` over `𝒞`, conjugation `α ↦ ψ ∘ α ∘ φ` is an equivalence of hom-categories
`Mor_{Cat/𝒞}(𝒮₂, 𝒮₃) ⥤ Mor_{Cat/𝒞}(𝒮₁, 𝒮₄)`.

The source additionally assumes each `𝒮ᵢ` is fibred in groupoids over `𝒞`.  Conjugation by
equivalences is an equivalence in any bicategory, so that hypothesis is unused; it is
omitted here and the statement proved is correspondingly more general than the tag.
declarations.statement:
theorem main_theorem03YT
    (𝒮₁ 𝒮₂ 𝒮₃ 𝒮₄ : BasedCategory 𝒞)
    (eφ : Bicategory.Equivalence 𝒮₁ 𝒮₂)
    (eψ : Bicategory.Equivalence 𝒮₃ 𝒮₄) :
    (conjugationFunctor eφ.hom eψ.hom).IsEquivalence

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.BiggerSiteGlobal.sheafCohomologyIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03YU (1): restriction from a bigger site does not change global cohomology.** For
terminal objects `e_C` of `C` and `e_D` of `D` with `u(e_C) = e_D`, and every degree `p`,

`H^p(C, g⁻¹ F) ≅ H^p(D, F)`

naturally in the abelian sheaf `F` on the bigger site `(D, K)`, where `H^p` is `Ext^p` out of the
constant sheaf on `ℤ`.

The two hypotheses on `g⁻¹` beyond continuity — right exactness and preservation of injective
objects — are the content of Stacks 03A4 that this lemma consumes: they hold whenever `g⁻¹` has
an exact left adjoint `g_!`, which for a fully faithful continuous and cocontinuous `u` between
sites with fibre products is Stacks 03A4 itself.
declarations.statement:
def sheafCohomologyIso {eC : C} {eD : D} (heC : IsTerminal eC) (heD : IsTerminal eD)
    (hu : u.obj eC = eD) (p : ℕ) :
    u.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{w} J K ⋙
        Sheaf.functorH.{max u w, w, v, u} J p ≅
      Sheaf.functorH.{max u w, w, v, u} K p
declarations.comment: global cohomology, at independent site and coefficient universes

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.BiggerSiteGlobal.sheafCohomologyIsoOfAcyclic
declarations.doc:
**Restriction from a bigger site does not change global cohomology, from acyclicity.** For
terminal objects `e_C` of `C` and `e_D` of `D` with `u(e_C) = e_D`, and every degree `p`,

`H^p(C, g⁻¹ F) ≅ H^p(D, F)`

naturally in the abelian sheaf `F` on the bigger site `(D, K)`, provided only that the
restriction of an injective abelian sheaf has vanishing higher global cohomology on `(C, J)`.

This is `Stacks.Cohomology.BiggerSiteGlobal.sheafCohomologyIso` with the hypothesis
`[(u.sheafPushforwardContinuous …).PreservesInjectiveObjects]` replaced by the acyclicity
statement it is only ever a route to. The replacement is what makes the lemma applicable to the
inclusion of a subsite that is not closed under fibre products: there `g_!` is not exact, so
restriction does not preserve injective objects, while the restriction of an injective sheaf is
still acyclic — the content of Stacks 0D6X, by comparison of Čech complexes along `u`.

The hypothesis is stated as the vanishing of `CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H` rather than as
preservation of injectives precisely so that 0D6X can discharge it.

The terminal objects are used only to produce the comparison of constant sheaves which
`sheafCohomologyIsoOfConstantSheafIsoOfAcyclic` takes as a datum.
declarations.statement:
def sheafCohomologyIsoOfAcyclic {eC : C} {eD : D} (heC : IsTerminal eC) (heD : IsTerminal eD)
    (hu : u.obj eC = eD)
    (hacyclic : ∀ (I : Sheaf K AddCommGrpCat.{w}), Injective I → ∀ (n : ℕ)
      (a : Sheaf.H ((u.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{w} J K).obj I) (n + 1)), a = 0)
    (p : ℕ) :
    u.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{w} J K ⋙
        Sheaf.functorH.{max u w, w, v, u} J p ≅
      Sheaf.functorH.{max u w, w, v, u} K p
declarations.comment: global cohomology, from acyclicity of the restriction of an injective sheaf

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.BiggerSiteGlobal.cohomologyOverObjectIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03YU (2): restriction from a bigger site does not change cohomology over an
object.** For every `X : C` and every degree `p`,

`H^p(C/X, g⁻¹ F) ≅ H^p(D/u(X), F)`

naturally in the abelian sheaf `F` on the bigger site `(D, K)`, where cohomology over an object
is the global cohomology of the sheaf restricted to the slice site.

This is the global comparison `sheafCohomologyIso` applied to `Over.post u`, whose two slice
sites have the terminal objects `𝟙 X` and `𝟙 u(X)`; the identification of the two ways of
restricting to the slice is `overPullback_comp_sheafPushforwardContinuous`.
declarations.statement:
def cohomologyOverObjectIso (p : ℕ) :
    u.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{w} J K ⋙
        J.overPullback AddCommGrpCat.{w} X ⋙
          Sheaf.functorH.{max u v w, w, v, max u v} (J.over X) p ≅
      K.overPullback AddCommGrpCat.{w} (u.obj X) ⋙
        Sheaf.functorH.{max u v w, w, v, max u v} (K.over (u.obj X)) p
declarations.comment: cohomology over an object, at independent site and coefficient universes

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.BiggerSiteGlobal.cohomologyOverObjectIsoOfAcyclic
declarations.doc:
**Restriction from a bigger site does not change cohomology over an object, from
acyclicity.** For every `X : C` and every degree `p`,

`H^p(C/X, g⁻¹ F) ≅ H^p(D/u(X), F)`

naturally in the abelian sheaf `F` on the bigger site `(D, K)`, provided only that the
restriction to `C/X` of an injective abelian sheaf on `D/u(X)` has vanishing higher cohomology
there.

This is `Stacks.Cohomology.BiggerSiteGlobal.cohomologyOverObjectIso` with preservation of
injective objects by restriction on the slice replaced by acyclicity, exactly as
`sheafCohomologyIsoOfAcyclic` replaces it in the global statement; it is that statement applied
to `Over.post u`, whose two slice sites have the terminal objects `𝟙 X` and `𝟙 u(X)`.
declarations.statement:
def cohomologyOverObjectIsoOfAcyclic
    (hacyclic : ∀ (I : Sheaf (K.over (u.obj X)) AddCommGrpCat.{w}), Injective I → ∀ (n : ℕ)
      (a : Sheaf.H (((Over.post (X := X) u).sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{w}
        (J.over X) (K.over (u.obj X))).obj I) (n + 1)), a = 0)
    (p : ℕ) :
    u.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{w} J K ⋙
        J.overPullback AddCommGrpCat.{w} X ⋙
          Sheaf.functorH.{max u v w, w, v, max u v} (J.over X) p ≅
      K.overPullback AddCommGrpCat.{w} (u.obj X) ⋙
        Sheaf.functorH.{max u v w, w, v, max u v} (K.over (u.obj X)) p
declarations.comment: cohomology over an object, from acyclicity of the restriction of an injective sheaf

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CompositeRightDerived.statement2_derived
declarations.doc:
**Statement 2 (cohomology over an object), derived-category level.**
For every object `U` of `C` there is a canonical isomorphism in `D^+(\mathbf Z)`
`R\Gamma(U, g^{-1}\mathcal F) \cong R\Gamma(u(U), \mathcal F)`, functorially (i.e.
as a natural isomorphism of functors `Sheaf K Ab ⥤ D^+(\mathbf Z)`).  Witnessed
canonically by `derivedObjectIso`.
declarations.statement:
theorem statement2_derived (U : C) :
    Nonempty (gInvAb J K F ⋙ RGamma J U ≅ RGamma K (F.obj U))

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CompositeRightDerived.statement2_cohomology
declarations.doc:
**Statement 2 (cohomology over an object), cohomology-group level.**
For every object `U` of `C` and every `p`, a natural isomorphism of functors
`Sheaf K Ab ⥤ Ab`, `H^p(U, g^{-1} -) \cong H^p(u(U), -)`.  Witnessed canonically by
`cohomologyObjectIso`.
declarations.statement:
theorem statement2_cohomology (U : C) (p : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (gInvAb J K F ⋙ cohomology J U p ≅ cohomology K (F.obj U) p)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CompositeRightDerived.statement1_derived
declarations.doc:
**Statement 1 (cohomology over the whole site), derived-category level.**
For terminal objects `e_C` of `C` and `e_D` of `D` with `u(e_C) = e_D`
(hypothesis (e)), a canonical isomorphism in `D^+(\mathbf Z)`
`R\Gamma(C, g^{-1}\mathcal F) \cong R\Gamma(D, \mathcal F)`, functorially.
Witnessed canonically by `derivedSiteIso`.
declarations.statement:
theorem statement1_derived (eC : C) (eD : D) (heC : IsTerminal eC)
    (heD : IsTerminal eD) (hu : F.obj eC = eD) :
    Nonempty (gInvAb J K F ⋙ RGammaSite J ≅ RGammaSite K)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CompositeRightDerived.statement1_cohomology
declarations.doc:
**Statement 1 (cohomology over the whole site), cohomology-group level.**
For terminal objects `e_C` of `C` and `e_D` of `D` with `u(e_C) = e_D`
(hypothesis (e)) and every `p`, a natural isomorphism of functors
`Sheaf K Ab ⥤ Ab`, `H^p(C, g^{-1} -) \cong H^p(D, -)`.  Witnessed canonically by
`cohomologySiteIso`.
declarations.statement:
theorem statement1_cohomology (eC : C) (eD : D) (heC : IsTerminal eC)
    (heD : IsTerminal eD) (hu : F.obj eC = eD) (p : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (gInvAb J K F ⋙ siteCohomology J p ≅ siteCohomology K p)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.unramified_isLocalAtSource
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03YV, unramified case.** Unramifiedness of morphisms of schemes is
local on the source for the étale topology.
declarations.statement:
instance unramified_isLocalAtSource :
    MorphismProperty.IsLocalAtSource (@Unramified.{u}) Scheme.etalePrecoverage

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.gUnramified_isLocalAtSource_etale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03YV, G-unramified case.** G-unramifiedness of morphisms of schemes
is local on the source for the étale topology.
declarations.statement:
instance gUnramified_isLocalAtSource_etale :
    MorphismProperty.IsLocalAtSource (@GUnramified.{u}) Scheme.etalePrecoverage

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.constantSchemeOverIntegers
declarations.doc: The scheme `G_{Spec ℤ}`, before equipping it with its group structure.
declarations.statement: abbrev constantSchemeOverIntegers (G : Type v) [Small.{u} G] : Scheme.{u}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.constantGroupSchemeStructure
declarations.doc:
The group-object structure on the coproduct of copies of `Spec ℤ` indexed by `G`, whose
multiplication sends the component `(g, h)` to the component `g * h`.
declarations.statement:
def constantGroupSchemeStructure (G : Type v) [Small.{u} G] [Group G] :
    { s : GrpObj (constantSchemeOverIntegersObj G) // IsConstantGroupSchemeStructure G s }

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.constantGroupScheme
declarations.doc: The constant group scheme `G_S`, obtained by base-changing `G_{Spec ℤ}` to `S`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev constantGroupScheme (G : Type v) [Small.{u} G] [Group G] (S : Scheme.{u}) :
    Grp (Over S)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.constantSchemeOverIntegersPointsIsoLocallyConstantMaps
declarations.doc:
The canonical group-valued functor-of-points isomorphism for the constant group scheme
over `Spec ℤ`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.constantSchemeOverIntegersPointsIsoLocallyConstantMaps_component
declarations.doc:
The canonical isomorphism sends the inclusion of the component indexed by `g` to the
constant function with value `g`.
declarations.statement:
theorem constantSchemeOverIntegersPointsIsoLocallyConstantMaps_component
    (G : Type v) [Small.{u} G] [Group G] (g : G) :
    ((constantSchemeOverIntegersPointsIsoLocallyConstantMaps G).hom.app
      (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 (⊤_ Scheme.{u})))))
        (ULift.up (constantComponent G g)) = LocallyConstant.const (⊤_ Scheme.{u}) g

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.locallyConstantMaps_representableBy_constantSchemeOverIntegers
declarations.doc:
The functor assigning to a scheme the group of locally constant maps to `G` is represented
by the underlying scheme of the constant group scheme over `Spec ℤ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem locallyConstantMaps_representableBy_constantSchemeOverIntegers
    (G : Type v) [Small.{u} G] [Group G] :
    Nonempty ((locallyConstantMaps G ⋙ forget GrpCat).RepresentableBy
      (constantSchemeOverIntegers G))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.constantGroupSchemePointsIsoLocallyConstantMaps
declarations.doc:
The group-valued functor of points of the constant group scheme `G_S` is naturally
isomorphic to the functor of locally constant `G`-valued maps. Under this isomorphism
multiplication is pointwise multiplication of functions.
declarations.statement:
def constantGroupSchemePointsIsoLocallyConstantMaps (G : Type v) [Small.{u} G] [Group G]
    (S : Scheme.{u}) :
    (yonedaGrp.obj (constantGroupScheme G S) ⋙ GrpCat.uliftFunctor.{v}) ≅
      locallyConstantMapsOver G S

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigSmallEtaleSheafCohomologyIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03YX, étale case.** Big étale cohomology over `S` agrees, naturally in the abelian
sheaf, with the cohomology of its restriction to the small étale site.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def bigSmallEtaleSheafCohomologyIso
    (F : Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology B S hS) Ab.{u + 1})
    [HasSheafify (BigEtaleOver.topology B S hS) Ab.{u + 1}]
    [HasSheafify (SmallEtale.topology B S hS) Ab.{u + 1}]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology B S hS) Ab.{u + 1})]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS) Ab.{u + 1})]
    (p : ℕ) :
    Sheaf.H.{w, u + 1} F p ≃+
      (((SmallEtale.inclusion B S hS).sheafPushforwardContinuous
          Ab.{u + 1} (SmallEtale.topology B S hS)
          (BigEtaleOver.topology B S hS)).obj F).H p

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigSmallEtaleSheafCohomologyIso_naturality
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03YX, étale naturality.** The étale comparison commutes with morphisms of abelian
sheaves.
declarations.statement:
public theorem bigSmallEtaleSheafCohomologyIso_naturality
    [HasSheafify (BigEtaleOver.topology B S hS) Ab.{u + 1}]
    [HasSheafify (SmallEtale.topology B S hS) Ab.{u + 1}]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology B S hS) Ab.{u + 1})]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS) Ab.{u + 1})]
    {F G : Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology B S hS) Ab.{u + 1}}
    (f : F ⟶ G) (p : ℕ) (x : Sheaf.H.{w, u + 1} F p) :
    bigSmallEtaleSheafCohomologyIso B S hS G p (Sheaf.H.map f p x) =
      Sheaf.H.map
        (((SmallEtale.inclusion B S hS).sheafPushforwardContinuous
          Ab.{u + 1} (SmallEtale.topology B S hS)
          (BigEtaleOver.topology B S hS)).map f) p
        (bigSmallEtaleSheafCohomologyIso B S hS F p x)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigSmallZariskiCohomologyIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03YX, Zariski case.** Big Zariski cohomology over `S` agrees, naturally in the
abelian sheaf, with the cohomology of its restriction to the small Zariski site.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def bigSmallZariskiCohomologyIso
    (F : Sheaf (BigZariskiOver.topology B S.obj S.property) Ab.{u + 1})
    [HasSheafify (BigZariskiOver.topology B S.obj S.property) Ab.{u + 1}]
    [HasSheafify (SmallZariski.topology B S.obj S.property) Ab.{u + 1}]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (BigZariskiOver.topology B S.obj S.property) Ab.{u + 1})]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (SmallZariski.topology B S.obj S.property) Ab.{u + 1})]
    (p : ℕ) :
    Sheaf.H.{w, u + 1} F p ≃+
      (((SmallZariski.inclusion B S.obj S.property).sheafPushforwardContinuous
          Ab.{u + 1} (SmallZariski.topology B S.obj S.property)
          (BigZariskiOver.topology B S.obj S.property)).obj F).H p

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigSmallZariskiCohomologyIso_naturality
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03YX, Zariski naturality.** The Zariski comparison commutes with morphisms of
abelian sheaves.
declarations.statement:
public theorem bigSmallZariskiCohomologyIso_naturality
    [HasSheafify (BigZariskiOver.topology B S.obj S.property) Ab.{u + 1}]
    [HasSheafify (SmallZariski.topology B S.obj S.property) Ab.{u + 1}]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (BigZariskiOver.topology B S.obj S.property) Ab.{u + 1})]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (SmallZariski.topology B S.obj S.property) Ab.{u + 1})]
    {F G : Sheaf (BigZariskiOver.topology B S.obj S.property) Ab.{u + 1}}
    (f : F ⟶ G) (p : ℕ) (x : Sheaf.H.{w, u + 1} F p) :
    bigSmallZariskiCohomologyIso B S G p (Sheaf.H.map f p x) =
      Sheaf.H.map
        (((SmallZariski.inclusion B S.obj S.property).sheafPushforwardContinuous
          Ab.{u + 1} (SmallZariski.topology B S.obj S.property)
          (BigZariskiOver.topology B S.obj S.property)).map f) p
        (bigSmallZariskiCohomologyIso B S F p x)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_extension_abelianSheaf
declarations.doc:
**An abelian sheaf on a big site extends to any larger big site of the same topology.** For
nested big `τ`-sites over a scheme `S`, every abelian sheaf on the smaller localized site is the
restriction, up to isomorphism, of an abelian sheaf on the larger one.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_extension_abelianSheaf {τ : CoveringTopology}
    (B B' : BigSite.{u} τ) (h : IsContained B B')
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : S.size < cutoff τ B)
    (F : Sheaf (overTopology τ B S hS) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    ∃ F' : Sheaf (overTopology τ B' S (largerContains h hS)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1},
      Nonempty ((abelianRestrictionOver B B' h S hS).obj F' ≅ F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.cohomologyRestrictionIso
declarations.doc:
**Restricting an abelian sheaf from a larger big site to a smaller one preserves cohomology
over every object of the smaller site, naturally in the sheaf.** For nested big `τ`-sites
localized at a scheme `S` of the smaller one, the cohomology over `U` of the restriction of an
abelian sheaf agrees with its cohomology over the image of `U`.

The inclusion of the localized sites is continuous, cocontinuous and preserves finite limits, and
a localized big site is essentially small, so this is
`Stacks.Cohomology.BiggerSite.cohomologyPresheafFunctorIso`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def cohomologyRestrictionIso {τ : CoveringTopology}
    (B B' : BigSite.{u} τ) (h : IsContained B B') (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : S.size < cutoff τ B)
    [HasSheafify (overTopology τ B S hS) Ab.{u}]
    [HasSheafify (overTopology τ B' S (largerContains h hS)) Ab.{u}]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (overTopology τ B S hS) Ab.{u})]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (overTopology τ B' S (largerContains h hS)) Ab.{u})]
    (U : Over (base B S hS)) (p : ℕ) :
    (inclusionOver h S hS).sheafPushforwardContinuous Ab.{u} (overTopology τ B S hS)
          (overTopology τ B' S (largerContains h hS)) ⋙
        Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor (overTopology τ B S hS) p ⋙
          (evaluation (Over (base B S hS))ᵒᵖ Ab.{w}).obj (op U) ≅
      Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor (overTopology τ B' S (largerContains h hS)) p ⋙
        (evaluation (Over (base B' S (largerContains h hS)))ᵒᵖ Ab.{w}).obj
          (op ((inclusionOver h S hS).obj U))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.cohomologyOverRestrictionIso
declarations.doc:
**Restricting an abelian sheaf from a larger big site to a smaller one preserves cohomology
over every object of the smaller site, naturally in the sheaf.** Let `τ` be one of the Zariski,
étale, smooth, syntomic and fppf topologies, `S` a scheme, and `B ⊆ B'` two big `τ`-sites with
`S` in `B`. For every object `U` of the localized site `(Sch/S)_τ` of `B`, every degree `p` and
every abelian sheaf `ℱ'` on the localized site `(Sch'/S)_τ` of `B'`,
`H^p_τ(U, ℱ'|_{(Sch/S)_τ}) ≅ H^p_τ(U, ℱ')`, naturally in `ℱ'`, with cohomology over an object
the `Ext`-based `CategoryTheory.Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor` with values in any universe
`max u w`. Sheafification and the `Ext`-groups on both localized sites come from their
essential smallness, `AlgebraicGeometry.hasSheafify_overTopology_addCommGrp` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.hasExt_sheaf_overTopology`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def cohomologyOverRestrictionIso {τ : CoveringTopology}
    (B B' : BigSite.{u} τ) (h : IsContained B B') (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : S.size < cutoff τ B) (U : Over (base B S hS)) (p : ℕ) :
    letI := hasExt_sheaf_overTopology.{u, w} τ B S hS
    letI := hasExt_sheaf_overTopology.{u, w} τ B' S (largerContains h hS)
    (inclusionOver h S hS).sheafPushforwardContinuous Ab.{u} (overTopology τ B S hS)
          (overTopology τ B' S (largerContains h hS)) ⋙
        Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor (overTopology τ B S hS) p ⋙
          (evaluation (Over (base B S hS))ᵒᵖ Ab.{max u w}).obj (op U) ≅
      Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor (overTopology τ B' S (largerContains h hS)) p ⋙
        (evaluation (Over (base B' S (largerContains h hS)))ᵒᵖ Ab.{max u w}).obj
          (op ((inclusionOver h S hS).obj U))
declarations.comment:
part (1): for nested big sites `(Sch/S)_τ ⊆ (Sch'/S)_τ` of one of the five
  topologies, the cohomology over an object `U` of the smaller site of the restriction of an
  abelian sheaf on the bigger site is isomorphic to its cohomology over `U` on the bigger site,
  naturally in the sheaf, with sheafification and `Ext`-groups constructed from essential
  smallness of the sites

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.presheaf_universallyOpen_iff
declarations.doc:
A representable morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is universally open, that is, every
base change of it by an algebraic space over `S` is open on points, exactly when each of its
represented base changes is a universally open morphism of schemes.
declarations.statement:
theorem presheaf_universallyOpen_iff {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (hf : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f) :
    (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
      (@AlgebraicGeometry.UniversallyOpen.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf f ↔ UniversallyOpen B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsOpenMorphism
declarations.doc:
A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *open* when the map it induces on points is an
open map for the topology detected by scheme-valued points.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsOpenMorphism (f : F ⟶ G) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.UniversallyOpen
declarations.doc:
A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *universally open* when its base change along
every morphism to its target from an algebraic space over `S` is open.
declarations.statement: abbrev UniversallyOpen (f : F ⟶ G) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.universallyOpen_pullback
declarations.doc:
A base change of a universally open morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is universally
open.
declarations.statement:
theorem universallyOpen_pullback {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (_hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (_hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (_hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    (hf : UniversallyOpen B S hS f) :
    UniversallyOpen B S hS (pullback.fst g f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsOpenMorphism.comp
declarations.doc: A composition of open morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is open.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsOpenMorphism.comp {f : F ⟶ G} {g : G ⟶ H} (hg : IsOpenMorphism B S hS g)
    (hf : IsOpenMorphism B S hS f) :
    IsOpenMorphism B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.universallyOpen_comp
declarations.doc:
A composition of universally open morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is universally
open.
declarations.statement:
theorem universallyOpen_comp {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (_hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : UniversallyOpen B S hS f) (hg : UniversallyOpen B S hS g) :
    UniversallyOpen B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.universallyOpen_tfae
declarations.statement:
theorem universallyOpen_tfae (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    List.TFAE
      [UniversallyOpen B S hS f,
        ∀ (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ Y),
          IsOpenMorphism B S hS (pullback.fst g f),
        ∀ (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS), IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Z) →
          ∀ g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ Y, IsOpenMorphism B S hS (pullback.fst g f),
        ∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (v : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y),
          IsSurjective B S hS v ∧ IsEtale B S hS v ∧
            UniversallyOpen B S hS (pullback.fst v f),
        ∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → Subfunctor Y), IsZariskiCover B S hS I U ∧
          ∀ i, UniversallyOpen B S hS (pullback.fst (U i).ι f)]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsSyntomic
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03Z7, part (1).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *syntomic* when
the scheme morphism underlying every commuting square of étale scheme charts of it is
syntomic.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsSyntomic (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsSyntomicAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03Z7, part (2).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *syntomic at* a
point `x` of its source when it is syntomic on some open subspace of the source having a
point over `x`.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsSyntomicAt (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : points B S hS X) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSyntomic_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03Z8.** The composite of two syntomic morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is
syntomic.

Syntomicity of scheme morphisms is stable under composition ([Stacks Project, Tag 01UH]) and is
étale local on the source and target (Tag 04R3), so this is the instance of
[Stacks Project, Tag 0AML] at that property.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSyntomic_comp
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : IsSyntomic B S hS f) (hg : IsSyntomic B S hS g) :
    IsSyntomic B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSyntomic_isStableUnderBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03Z9.** Syntomic morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` are stable under base
change.

Syntomicity of scheme morphisms is stable under base change ([Stacks Project, Tag 01UI]) and is
étale local on the source and target (Tag 04R3), so this is the instance of
[Stacks Project, Tag 0AMM] at that property.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSyntomic_isStableUnderBaseChange :
    MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange
      (fun ⦃F G : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS⦄ (f : F ⟶ G) => IsSyntomic B S hS f.hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSyntomic_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ZA.** Nine criteria for a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` to be syntomic:
pointwise syntomicity, syntomicity of every base change to a scheme or to an affine scheme or
to one surjective étale chart of the target, syntomicity of the composite with one surjective
étale chart of the source, syntomicity of the morphism of schemes in every — or in one
surjective — commuting square of étale charts, or over a pair of Zariski coverings.

Syntomicity of morphisms of schemes is étale local on the source and target (Tag 04R3), stable
under composition ([Stacks Project, Tag 01UH]) and under base change
([Stacks Project, Tag 01UI]), and implied by étaleness ([Stacks Project, Tag 01VD]), so this
is the instance of `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.holdsOnEveryEtaleChart_tfae` — Tag 03MM for an
arbitrary such property — at that property. Condition (2) is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsSyntomicAt`, which is by definition condition (2) of that
theorem.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSyntomic_tfae (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    List.TFAE [
      IsSyntomic B S hS f,
      ∀ x : points B S hS X, IsSyntomicAt B S hS f x,
      ∀ (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ Y),
        IsSyntomic B S hS (pullback.fst g f),
      ∀ (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ Y),
        IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Z) → IsSyntomic B S hS (pullback.fst g f),
      ∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y),
        IsSurjective B S hS g ∧ IsEtale B S hS g ∧ IsSyntomic B S hS (pullback.fst g f),
      ∃ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (p : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X),
        IsSurjective B S hS p ∧ IsEtale B S hS p ∧ IsSyntomic B S hS (p ≫ f),
      ∀ (U V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (p : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X) (q : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y) (a : U ⟶ V),
        IsEtale B S hS p → IsEtale B S hS q → p ≫ f = yoneda.map a ≫ q →
          IsSyntomic B S hS (yoneda.map a),
      ∃ (U V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (p : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X) (q : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y) (a : U ⟶ V),
        IsEtale B S hS p ∧ IsEtale B S hS q ∧ IsSurjective B S hS p ∧
          p ≫ f = yoneda.map a ≫ q ∧ IsSyntomic B S hS (yoneda.map a),
      ∃ (I : Type u) (Yopen : I → Subfunctor Y) (J : I → Type u)
        (Xopen : ∀ i, J i → Subfunctor (pullback f (Yopen i).ι)),
        IsZariskiCover B S hS I Yopen ∧ (∀ i, IsZariskiCover B S hS (J i) (Xopen i)) ∧
          ∀ i j, IsSyntomic B S hS ((Xopen i j).ι ≫ pullback.snd f (Yopen i).ι)
    ]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsSmooth
declarations.doc:
A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *smooth* when the scheme morphism underlying every
commuting square of étale scheme charts of it is smooth.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsSmooth (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsSmoothAt
declarations.doc:
A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *smooth at* a point `x` of its source when it is
smooth on some open subspace of the source having a point over `x`.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsSmoothAt (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : points B S hS X) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSmooth_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ZD.** The composite of two smooth morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is
smooth: this is Stacks 0AML applied to the smooth property of morphisms of schemes, which is
étale local on the source and target and stable under composition.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSmooth_comp {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : IsSmooth B S hS f) (hg : IsSmooth B S hS g) :
    IsSmooth B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSmooth_isStableUnderBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 03ZE.** Smoothness of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is
stable under base change.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSmooth_isStableUnderBaseChange :
    MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange
      (fun ⦃F G : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS⦄ (f : F ⟶ G) => IsSmooth B S hS f.hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSmooth_tfae
declarations.doc:
The pointwise, scheme-local, étale-local, and Zariski-local criteria for
smoothness of a morphism of algebraic spaces.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSmooth_tfae
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    List.TFAE [
      IsSmooth B S hS f,
      (∀ x : points B S hS X, IsSmoothAt B S hS f x),
      (∀ (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ Y),
        IsSmooth B S hS (pullback.snd f g)),
      (∀ (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ Y),
        IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Z) →
          IsSmooth B S hS (pullback.snd f g)),
      (∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y),
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf g ∧
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf g ∧
        IsSmooth B S hS (pullback.snd f g)),
      (∃ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (p : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X),
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf p ∧
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf p ∧
        IsSmooth B S hS (p ≫ f)),
      HoldsOnEveryEtaleChart B S hS
        (@Smooth.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) f,
      HoldsOnSurjectiveEtaleChart B S hS
        (@Smooth.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) f,
      (∃ (I : Type u) (V : I → Subfunctor Y),
        IsZariskiCover B S hS I V ∧
        ∀ i, ∃ (J : Type u)
          (U : J → Subfunctor (pullback f (V i).ι)),
          IsZariskiCover B S hS J U ∧
          ∀ j, IsSmooth B S hS
            ((U j).ι ≫ pullback.snd f (V i).ι))
    ]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsUnramified
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ZH, part (1).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *unramified* when the
scheme morphism in every commuting square of étale scheme charts is unramified.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsUnramified (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsGUnramified
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ZH, part (3).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *G-unramified* when the
scheme morphism in every commuting square of étale scheme charts is G-unramified.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsGUnramified (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsUnramifiedAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ZH, part (2).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *unramified at* a point
`x` of its source when it is unramified on some open subspace of the source having a point
over `x`.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsUnramifiedAt (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : points B S hS X) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsGUnramifiedAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ZH, part (4).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *G-unramified at* a
point `x` of its source when it is G-unramified on some open subspace of the source having a
point over `x`.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsGUnramifiedAt (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : points B S hS X) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isUnramified_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ZI.** The composite of two unramified morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S`
is unramified.

Unramifiedness of scheme morphisms is étale local on the source and target and stable under
composition, so this is the instance of [Stacks Project, Tag 0AML] at that property.
declarations.statement:
theorem isUnramified_comp (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : IsUnramified B S hS f) (hg : IsUnramified B S hS g) :
    IsUnramified B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isUnramified_isStableUnderBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ZJ.** Unramified morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` are stable under base
change.

Unramifiedness of scheme morphisms is étale local on the source and target and stable under
base change, so this is the instance of [Stacks Project, Tag 0AMM] at that property.
declarations.statement:
theorem isUnramified_isStableUnderBaseChange :
    MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange
      (fun ⦃F G : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS⦄ (f : F ⟶ G) => IsUnramified B S hS f.hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isUnramified_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ZK.** Nine criteria for a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` to be
unramified: pointwise unramifiedness, unramifiedness of every base change to a scheme or to an
affine scheme or to one surjective étale chart of the target, unramifiedness of the composite
with one surjective étale chart of the source, unramifiedness of the morphism of schemes in
every — or in one surjective — commuting square of étale charts, or over a pair of Zariski
coverings.

Unramifiedness of morphisms of schemes is étale local on the source and target
([Stacks Project, Tag 04R3]), stable under composition ([Stacks Project, Tag 02G9]) and under
base change ([Stacks Project, Tag 02GA]), and implied by étaleness, so this is the instance of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.holdsOnEveryEtaleChart_tfae` — Stacks 03MM for an arbitrary such
property — at that property. Condition (2) is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsUnramifiedAt`, which
is by definition condition (2) of that theorem.
declarations.statement:
theorem isUnramified_tfae (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    List.TFAE [
      IsUnramified B S hS f,
      ∀ x : points B S hS X, IsUnramifiedAt B S hS f x,
      ∀ (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ Y),
        IsUnramified B S hS (pullback.fst g f),
      ∀ (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ Y),
        IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Z) → IsUnramified B S hS (pullback.fst g f),
      ∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y),
        IsSurjective B S hS g ∧ IsEtale B S hS g ∧ IsUnramified B S hS (pullback.fst g f),
      ∃ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (p : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X),
        IsSurjective B S hS p ∧ IsEtale B S hS p ∧ IsUnramified B S hS (p ≫ f),
      ∀ (U V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (p : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X) (q : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y) (a : U ⟶ V),
        IsEtale B S hS p → IsEtale B S hS q → p ≫ f = yoneda.map a ≫ q →
          IsUnramified B S hS (yoneda.map a),
      ∃ (U V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (p : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X) (q : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y) (a : U ⟶ V),
        IsEtale B S hS p ∧ IsEtale B S hS q ∧ IsSurjective B S hS p ∧
          p ≫ f = yoneda.map a ≫ q ∧ IsUnramified B S hS (yoneda.map a),
      ∃ (I : Type u) (Yopen : I → Subfunctor Y) (J : I → Type u)
        (Xopen : ∀ i, J i → Subfunctor (pullback f (Yopen i).ι)),
        IsZariskiCover B S hS I Yopen ∧ (∀ i, IsZariskiCover B S hS (J i) (Xopen i)) ∧
          ∀ i j, IsUnramified B S hS ((Xopen i j).ι ≫ pullback.snd f (Yopen i).ι)
    ]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isProperULift_whiskerRight_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ZM for a universe lift.** The universe lift of a morphism of presheaves of
`Type u` on the big fppf site of `S` is proper — separated, of finite type and universally
closed — exactly when the morphism is.

Each conjunct transfers separately: separatedness by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSeparatedULift_whiskerRight_iff`, being of finite type by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteTypeULift_whiskerRight_iff` and universal closedness by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.universallyClosedULift_whiskerRight_iff`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProperULift_whiskerRight_iff {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (q : F ⟶ G) :
    IsProperULift.{w} B S hS (Functor.whiskerRight q uliftFunctor.{w}) ↔
      IsProper B S hS q

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsProper
declarations.doc:
A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *proper* when it is separated, of finite type and
universally closed.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsProper (f : F ⟶ G) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIntegralHom_iff_representable
declarations.doc:
A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is integral in the sense of Stacks 03ZP exactly when it
is relatively representable and all of its represented base changes are integral morphisms of
schemes.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIntegralHom_iff_representable {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) :
    IsIntegralHom B S hS f ↔
      (yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f ∧
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsIntegralHom.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf f)
declarations.comment: integral case: the affine test criterion for a representable morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFinite
declarations.doc:
A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *finite* when, for every object `U` of the big fppf
site with affine underlying scheme and every morphism `ξ` from `yoneda.obj U` to the target, the
base change of `f` along `ξ` is represented by an object `V` of the site with affine underlying
scheme whose projection to `U` is a finite morphism of schemes.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsFinite (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsIntegralHom
declarations.doc:
A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *integral* when, for every object `Z` of the big
fppf site with affine underlying scheme and every morphism `g` from `yoneda.obj Z` to the target,
the base change of `f` along `g` is represented by an object `W` of the site with affine underlying
scheme whose projection to `Z` is an integral morphism of schemes.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsIntegralHom (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : F ⟶ G) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIntegralHom_of_surjectiveEtaleChart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ZQ for integral morphisms, condition (3) implies condition (2).** A morphism of
algebraic spaces over `S` whose base change along some surjective étale morphism from a scheme
is integral is itself integral.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIntegralHom_of_surjectiveEtaleChart (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) {U : BigFppfOver B S hS}
    {q : yoneda.obj U ⟶ Y} (hqs : IsSurjective B S hS q) (hqe : IsEtale B S hS q)
    (hbase : IsIntegralHom B S hS (pullback.snd f q)) :
    IsIntegralHom B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFinite_of_surjectiveEtaleChart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ZQ for finite morphisms, condition (3) implies condition (2).** A morphism of
algebraic spaces over `S` whose base change along some surjective étale morphism from a scheme
is finite is itself finite.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFinite_of_surjectiveEtaleChart (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) {U : BigFppfOver B S hS}
    {q : yoneda.obj U ⟶ Y} (hqs : IsSurjective B S hS q) (hqe : IsEtale B S hS q)
    (hbase : IsFinite B S hS (pullback.snd f q)) :
    IsFinite B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIntegralHom_iff_etaleLocal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ZQ for integral morphisms, conditions (2) and (3).** A morphism of algebraic
spaces over `S` is integral in the sense of Stacks 03ZP exactly when there is one surjective
étale morphism from a representable presheaf onto its target along which its base change is
integral.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIntegralHom_iff_etaleLocal (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) :
    IsIntegralHom B S hS f ↔
      ∃ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj U ⟶ Y),
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf g ∧
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf g ∧
        IsIntegralHom B S hS (pullback.snd f g)

declarations.statement:
theorem isFinite_iff_etaleLocal (f : X ⟶ Y)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIntegralHom_iff_zariskiCover
declarations.doc:
A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is integral in the sense of Stacks 03ZP exactly when
there is a Zariski covering of its target over whose members its base changes are integral.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIntegralHom_iff_zariskiCover {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y)

    IsIntegralHom B S hS f ↔
      ∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → Subfunctor Y),
        IsZariskiCover B S hS I U ∧
          ∀ i, IsIntegralHom B S hS (Limits.pullback.snd f (U i).ι)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIntegralHom_comp
declarations.doc: The composite of two integral morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is integral.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFinite_comp
declarations.doc: The composite of two finite morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is finite.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIntegralHom_of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
A base change of an integral morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is integral: if `f'` sits
in a Cartesian square over `f`, then `f'` is integral as soon as `f` is.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFinite_of_isPullback
declarations.doc: A base change of a finite morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is finite.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.presheaf_of_isFiniteLocallyFree
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ZU, the "only if" direction.**  A representable morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic
spaces over `S` which is finite locally free in the sense of Stacks 03ZV — affine with `f_*𝒪_X`
a finite locally free `𝒪_Y`-module — is finite locally free in the sense of Section 03HA: every
represented base change of `f` is a finite locally free morphism of schemes.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.presheaf_of_isFiniteLocallyFree_of_chartComparison_at` with its
hypothesis `hcross` discharged by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFree_baseChangeChartHom_of_isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite`,
at an étale chart whose structure morphism is surjective on points; one exists by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_surjective_smallEtale_chart`.  The affineness that the chart
comparison consumes is the first conjunct of Stacks 03ZV, so nothing is assumed beyond it.
declarations.statement:
theorem presheaf_of_isFiniteLocallyFree (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hrep : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f.hom) (h : IsFiniteLocallyFree B S hS f) :
    (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
      (@Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf f.hom
declarations.comment: the only if direction: finite locally free in the sense of 03ZV implies every represented base change is a finite locally free morphism of schemes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.presheaf_iff_isFiniteLocallyFree_iff_chartComparison
declarations.doc:
**The equivalence of Stacks 03ZU for a morphism is equivalent to the chart comparison for
that morphism.** For a representable `f : X ⟶ Y` and an étale chart `V` of `Y` whose structure
morphism is surjective on points, the assertion of Stacks 03ZU for `f` holds exactly when the
scheme-level finite local freeness of the base change of `f` over `V` agrees with affineness of
`f` together with finite local freeness of the restriction of `f_*𝒪_X` to the slice at `V`.

This statement carries no hypothesis.  It says that the chart comparison is not merely one
sufficient input for Stacks 03ZU but is equivalent to it, so that nothing is lost by reducing
the tag to a statement at a single chart.  Affineness appears on the right-hand side because
the module conjunct alone does not bound the morphism; it cannot be dropped, as the
implementation notes record.

Its `@[stacks 03ZU]` attribute is clause-labelled for the reduction alone: it is an equivalence
between Stacks 03ZU and a chart statement, not Stacks 03ZU.  The chart statement is proved, and
with it the biconditional, in
`StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Spaces.FiniteLocallyFreeRepresentableChart`.
declarations.statement:
theorem presheaf_iff_isFiniteLocallyFree_iff_chartComparison (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f.hom)
    (V : (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS Y.1 Y.2).C) (hV : IsSurjective B S hS V.1.hom) :
    (((MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf f.hom ↔
        IsFiniteLocallyFree B S hS f) ↔
      (Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFree
          ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map (hf.snd V.1.hom)) ↔
        (IsAffineHom B S hS f.hom ∧
          SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite
            (R := (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
              (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS Y.1 Y.2).O).over V)
            ((pushforwardStructureModule B S hS f).over V))))
declarations.comment: the reduction of the biconditional to the chart comparison: proved unconditionally, that f is finite locally free in the sense of Section 03HA if and only if it is affine with finite locally free pushforward, holds exactly when the chart comparison holds at a surjective etale chart. The biconditional itself is AlgebraicGeometry.Space .presheaf_iff_isFiniteLocallyFree, which discharges that chart comparison

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.presheaf_iff_isFiniteLocallyFree
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be a scheme and let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a representable morphism of algebraic spaces over
`S`.  Then `f` is finite locally free in the sense of Section 03HA — every represented base change
of `f` is a finite locally free morphism of schemes — if and only if `f` is affine and the sheaf
`f_*𝒪_X` is a finite locally free `𝒪_Y`-module, which is the definition of Stacks 03ZV,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFiniteLocallyFree`.
declarations.statement:
theorem presheaf_iff_isFiniteLocallyFree (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f.hom) :
    (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf f.hom ↔
      IsFiniteLocallyFree B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFiniteLocallyFree
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ZV.** A morphism of algebraic spaces is *finite locally free* when it is
affine and the direct image of the structure sheaf of its source is a finite locally free
module on the small étale ringed site of its target.
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev IsFiniteLocallyFree (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ZV.** A finite locally free morphism of algebraic spaces has *rank* (or
*degree*) `r` when the direct image of the structure sheaf of its source has rank `r`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank (f : X ⟶ Y) (r : ℕ) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFree_presheaf_iff_isFiniteLocallyFree
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ZW, conditions (1) and (2).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is
representable with every represented base change a finite locally free morphism of schemes
exactly when it is finite locally free in the sense of Stacks 03ZV.

No representability hypothesis is imposed, which is what distinguishes this from Stacks 03ZU,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.presheaf_iff_isFiniteLocallyFree`: from condition (1) representability
is `CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.relative.rep`, and from condition (2) it is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.relativelyRepresentable_of_isFiniteLocallyFree`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_presheaf_iff_isFiniteLocallyFree (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf f.hom ↔
      IsFiniteLocallyFree B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFree_iff_exists_etaleChart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ZW, conditions (2) and (3).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is finite
locally free in the sense of Stacks 03ZV exactly when there is one surjective étale morphism from
a representable presheaf onto its target along which its base change is representable and finite
locally free.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFree_presheaf_iff_isFiniteLocallyFree` composed
with `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFree_presheaf_iff_exists_etaleChart`, conditions (1)
and (3).
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_iff_exists_etaleChart (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree B S hS f ↔
      ∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y.1),
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf g ∧
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf g ∧
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf (pullback.snd f.hom g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFree_iff_exists_zariskiCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ZW, conditions (2) and (4).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is finite
locally free in the sense of Stacks 03ZV exactly when there is a Zariski covering `Y = ⋃ Yᵢ` of
its target such that each `f⁻¹(Yᵢ) ⟶ Yᵢ` is representable and finite locally free.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFree_presheaf_iff_isFiniteLocallyFree` composed
with `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFree_presheaf_iff_exists_zariskiCover`, conditions
(1) and (4).
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_iff_exists_zariskiCover (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree B S hS f ↔
      ∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → Subfunctor Y.1),
        IsZariskiCover B S hS I U ∧
        ∀ i, (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf (pullback.snd f.hom (U i).ι)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFree_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ZW.** For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over `S` the following are
equivalent:

1. `f` is representable and finite locally free, i.e. every represented base change of `f` is a
   finite locally free morphism of schemes;
2. `f` is finite locally free in the sense of Stacks 03ZV: affine, with `f_*𝒪_X` a finite
   locally free `𝒪_Y`-module;
3. there exists a scheme `V` and a surjective étale morphism `V ⟶ Y` such that
   `V ×_Y X ⟶ V` is (representable and) finite locally free;
4. there exists a Zariski covering `Y = ⋃ Yᵢ` such that each `f⁻¹(Yᵢ) ⟶ Yᵢ` is (representable
   and) finite locally free.

Assembled from the pairwise equivalences
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFree_presheaf_iff_isFiniteLocallyFree`,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFree_iff_exists_etaleChart` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFree_iff_exists_zariskiCover`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_tfae (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    List.TFAE
      [(MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf f.hom,
        IsFiniteLocallyFree B S hS f,
        ∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y.1),
          (MorphismProperty.inverseImage (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
            (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf g ∧
          (MorphismProperty.inverseImage (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
            (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf g ∧
          (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
            (@Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
            (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf (pullback.snd f.hom g),
        ∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → Subfunctor Y.1),
          IsZariskiCover B S hS I U ∧
          ∀ i, (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
            (@Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
            (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf (pullback.snd f.hom (U i).ι)]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFree_presheaf_iff_exists_etaleChart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ZW, conditions (1) and (3).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is
representable and finite locally free exactly when there is one surjective étale morphism from a
representable presheaf onto its target along which its base change is representable and finite
locally free.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_presheaf_iff_exists_etaleChart
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf f ↔
      ∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y),
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf g ∧
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf g ∧
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf (pullback.snd f g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFree_presheaf_iff_exists_zariskiCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ZW, conditions (1) and (4).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is
representable and finite locally free exactly when there is a Zariski covering `Y = ⋃ Yᵢ` of its
target such that each `f⁻¹(Yᵢ) ⟶ Yᵢ` is.

This is the equivalence the source obtains from the fact that being finite locally free is
Zariski local on the target, which it notes is a weakening of the fpqc locality established
along the way to conditions (1) and (3).  Here it is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.presheaf_tfae` — Stacks 03M4 for an arbitrary property of scheme
morphisms Zariski local at the target — instantiated at finite local freeness: the restriction
`f⁻¹(Yᵢ) ⟶ Yᵢ` is read, as the source reads it, as the base change of `f` along the inclusion of
the open subspace `Yᵢ`, and both sides are read in the representable sense of condition (1).
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_presheaf_iff_exists_zariskiCover
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf f ↔
      ∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → Subfunctor Y),
        IsZariskiCover B S hS I U ∧
        ∀ i, (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
          (@Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf (pullback.snd f (U i).ι)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFree_presheaf_isStableUnderComposition
declarations.doc:
Being representable and finite locally free is a composition-stable class of morphisms of
presheaves on the big fppf site of `S`.
declarations.statement:
instance isFiniteLocallyFree_presheaf_isStableUnderComposition :
    (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
      (@Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf.IsStableUnderComposition

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFree_presheaf_comp
declarations.doc:
The composition of representable finite locally free morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S`
is representable and finite locally free.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_presheaf_comp
    {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
      (@Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf f)
    (hg : (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
      (@Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf g) :
    (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
      (@Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFree_presheaf_isStableUnderBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ZY.** Being representable and finite locally free is a base-change stable class
of morphisms of presheaves on the big fppf site of `S`.
declarations.statement:
instance isFiniteLocallyFree_presheaf_isStableUnderBaseChange :
    (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
      (@Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf.IsStableUnderBaseChange

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFree_presheaf_of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ZY.** A base change of a representable finite locally free morphism of algebraic
spaces over `S` is representable and finite locally free: if `f'` sits in a Cartesian square
over `f`, then `f'` is finite locally free as soon as `f` is.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_presheaf_of_isPullback
    {X Y X' Y' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} {k : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} (sq : IsPullback k f' f g)
    (hf : (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
      (@Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf f) :
    (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
      (@Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf f'

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Functor.small_fibreRepresentatives
declarations.doc:
The objects of the cutdown form a set: they are indexed by the pairs of an object `U` of `𝒮`
and an object of the small model of `𝒳_U`.
declarations.statement:
instance small_fibreRepresentatives :
    ObjectProperty.Small.{max u₁ w} (p.fibreRepresentatives)
declarations.comment: the cutdown: a full subcategory of 𝒳 whose objects form a set

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Functor.small_fiber_restrict_fibreRepresentatives
declarations.doc:
Each fibre of the cutdown is a set at the universe of condition (4): the fibre over `U` is
covered by the small model of `𝒳_U`.
declarations.statement:
instance small_fiber_restrict_fibreRepresentatives (U : 𝒮) :
    Small.{w} ((p.restrict p.fibreRepresentatives).Fiber U)
declarations.comment: the cutdown: each of its fibres is a set

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Functor.isEquivalence_ι_fibreRepresentatives
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ZZ (b).** The inclusion `𝒳_small ⥤ 𝒳` of the cutdown is fully faithful and
essentially surjective.
declarations.statement: theorem isEquivalence_ι_fibreRepresentatives : (p.fibreRepresentatives).ι.IsEquivalence
declarations.comment: (b): the inclusion of the cutdown is fully faithful and essentially surjective

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Functor.IsStack.fibreRepresentatives
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03ZZ (a).** If `p : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒮` satisfies the three conditions of Stacks 026F over the
site `(𝒮, J)`, then so does its restriction to the cutdown; that is, the cutdown is a stack.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsStack.fibreRepresentatives (J : GrothendieckTopology 𝒮) (hp : p.IsStack J) :
    (p.restrict p.fibreRepresentatives).IsStack J
declarations.comment: (a): the restriction of p to the cutdown satisfies the conditions of 026F
